paper.title: Motif 3: Technical Report
paper.abstract: We introduce Motif 3, a decoder-only Mixture-of-Experts language model with 314 billion total parameters and 13.2 billion activated per token. Each sparse MoE layer contains 384 routed experts, with eight selected per token. This fine-grained sparsity provides substantial expert capacity while limiting computation. Motif 3 is built around Grouped Differential Latent Attention (GDLA), which integrates grouped differential attention with the compressed key-value representation of Multi-head Latent

summary.core_problem: 在 314B 总参数 / 13.2B 激活的稀疏 MoE 大模型上，如何同时实现高专家容量、训练稳定性与推理效率。
summary.importance: 范式级架构创新 + 规模突破：提出 Grouped Differential Latent Attention (GDLA)，并在 12.5T tokens 上完成 384 专家 MoE 的稳定预训练，是近期少有的公开大规模 MoE 技术报告。
summary.technical_approach: 核心架构为 GDLA，将 grouped differential attention 与 Multi-head Latent Attention 的压缩 KV 表示结合；辅以 manifold-constrained hyper-connections、Expert Specific PolyNorm 激活、multi-token prediction；稀疏层 384 专家每 token 选 8 个；配合 expert-balancing 与数值稳定技巧。
summary.experiments: 314B 总参数 / 13.2B 激活，384 experts/layer，top-8 路由；预训练数据约 12.5T tokens，覆盖 web、STEM、code、math、多语种与领域语料；报告强调训练稳定性与专家专业化。
summary.authors_note: Joon Son Chung 团队（韩国 NAVER / 首尔大学方向，长期做语音与多模态），此次发布大规模 MoE 技术报告。

summary_en.core_problem: How to jointly achieve high expert capacity, training stability, and inference efficiency in a 314B-total / 13.2B-active sparse MoE LLM.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm-level architecture + scale contribution: introduces Grouped Differential Latent Attention (GDLA) and reports stable pretraining of a 384-expert MoE on 12.5T tokens, one of the few public large-scale MoE technical reports.
summary_en.technical_approach: GDLA fuses grouped differential attention with compressed KV from Multi-head Latent Attention; augmented by manifold-constrained hyper-connections, Expert Specific PolyNorm activations, and multi-token prediction; 384 experts per sparse layer with top-8 routing; expert-balancing and numerical-stabilization tricks.
summary_en.experiments: 314B total / 13.2B active params, 384 experts/layer, top-8 routing; ~12.5T pretraining tokens across web, STEM, code, math, multilingual and domain corpora; emphasizes training stability and expert specialization.
summary_en.authors_note: Joon Son Chung's group (NAVER / Seoul National University, known for speech & multimodal work), now releasing a large-scale MoE technical report.

recommendation.zh: GDLA 把 differential attention 和 latent KV 压缩揉在一起，384 专家 top-8 的细粒度稀疏也很激进，架构与训练稳定性部分必须精读，看能否复现到内部 MoE。
recommendation.en: GDLA merges differential attention with latent KV compression, and 384-expert top-8 sparsity is aggressive — read the architecture and stability sections closely for internal MoE replication.

paper.title: Tied Trit-Planes: Constraining PTQTP to a Uniform Nine-Level Quantizer, with a Persistent Folded Format for Disk-Streamed Mixture-of-Experts Serving
paper.abstract: PTQTP decomposes LLM weight matrices into two ternary (trit) planes with two free per-group scales. Tying the scales to a fixed ratio of three collapses the decomposition into a single uniform nine-level quantizer, a known balanced-ternary identity. To our knowledge, at the time of writing, this work is the first to impose that identity as a constraint inside PTQTP's solver. The two trit planes then fold losslessly into one 4-bit code plane that we make the persistent serving representation: dis

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体但很现实的 serving 问题：超大 MoE 模型在消费级硬件上部署时，专家参数远大于内存，必须从 SSD 流式读取；这时吞吐主要受“每个 token 需要搬多少字节”控制，而质量则受量化误差控制。作者关心的核心不是再发明一种抽象量化理论，而是：能否把 PTQTP 这种双 ternary-plane 的后训练量化，约束成一个统一的 9-level 量化器，从而把专家权重永久存成单一 4-bit 代码格式，做到磁盘、缓存、kernel 输入三处字节完全一致，避免任何转码，同时把质量损失控制在可接受范围内。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接价值有限，它更偏推理系统与量化部署；但对大规模 MoE 的研究工程仍有现实启发。第一，它说明在 MoE serving 场景里，量化格式设计不能只看 perplexity，还要看 persistent format、I/O 路径和 kernel 兼容性，尤其是专家从 NVMe 流式加载时，格式是否需要中间转码会直接影响端到端延迟。第二，它给出一个明确取舍：把 PTQTP 的自由双尺度约束成 ratio-3 tied scales，会损失一部分重构自由度，但换来统一 9-level code 和更干净的系统实现。这个取舍对未来做 MoE-friendly quantization 或训练时感知部署格式的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把 PTQTP 的两层 ternary 分解
W≈α1T1+α2T2，约束为 α=(3s,s)。这样组合码 c=3t1+t2，t1,t2∈{-1,0,1}，自然落在一个均匀间隔的 9-level 网格上。原本 PTQTP 每个 group 有两个自由 scale，可以拟合更灵活的非均匀九级量化；作者这里主动放弃这部分自由度，换来一个单尺度、均匀九级的表示。由于 9 个有效值可以塞进 4 bit code，两个 ternary plane 就能无损折叠成一个 4-bit composite code plane。

真正有意思的是系统落地。作者不是只在论文里说“可以 pack 成 int4”，而是把这种 folded 4-bit code 直接作为 persistent serving representation：磁盘上的专家文件、内存中的 expert cache、以及 CPU-SIMD kernel 的输入，三者使用同一份字节布局，不做 transcode。文中实现了名为 tq2_0_fx4 的 block format：每个 block 覆盖四列乘 256 个元素，总大小 520 bytes，对应 4.0625 bits/weight。这样做的系统收益是，expert projection miss 时只需要一次连续读取，NVMe 分层缓存也能按 block 粒度直接条带化热点前缀，而不是先读压缩格式再转成另一种 kernel-friendly 格式。

质量评估上，作者没有只报 perplexity，而是强调与官方 serving API 的 step-level reference fidelity。具体做法是用 greedy decoding，在捕获的 fixtures 上比较 decoded-text prefix agreement，而不是 token id 完全一致；同时设置一个“expert-lossless serving arm”作为经验控制组，即把官方发布的 MXFP4 专家字节重打包但不再量化，用来锚定误差主要来自专家量化而不是其他系统因素。作者还提到 process isolation protocol，因为他们测到 fixture 级别存在不稳定性。这些细节说明工作重点是部署可用性，而不是离线量化指标。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见，实验围绕一个 284B-A13B 的生产级 MoE 模型展开，专家部分参数量极大，作者给出的 serving 文件中约 145 GiB 是 q4_k 级别的专家 payload，总 serving 文件约 153.3 GiB，trunk 和 embedding 约 8 GiB。量化对象是官方发布 checkpoint 的专家权重；作者特别说明该 post-trained artifact 公开可得的是 MXFP4 专家，而不是更高精度版本，因此评测是围绕真实可部署工件进行的。

实验比较的重点不是单一 benchmark 分数，而是三条轴：重构/困惑度、与官方 API 的输出一致性、以及实际 serving 速度。作者明确指出一个核心经验结论：这些轴并不总是一致。也就是说，perplexity 更好不一定意味着 step-level reference fidelity 更高，后者更高也不必然带来更好的下游问答分数。这一点对量化研究很重要，因为很多工作默认离线 perplexity 足够代表部署质量。

系统侧，作者声称 ratio-3 tied nine-level folded code 让 persistent bytes、cache bytes、kernel input bytes 完全一致，这正是速度结果成立的前提。文中还把它与 q4_k 等现有格式放在同一部署环境里比较，并使用 CPU-first、可选 Metal/CUDA GEMM offload 的开源栈 fucina 实现。虽然给出的节选里没有完整数值表，但从正文叙述可知，作者把“无转码 SSD 流式专家 serving”作为主要卖点，并用官方 API 对齐、MMLU 描述性比较和 perplexity 并列报告，强调质量判断不能只看单一指标。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合带着系统问题去读，而不是当成通用量化论文精读。先看 Introduction，抓住两个判断：一是作者的贡献很窄，主要是把 PTQTP 约束成 tied ratio-3 nine-level quantizer；二是他们真正关心的是 persistent format 与 serving path 的统一，而不是单纯压低 bit 数。

然后重点看方法部分里关于 balanced ternary identity、folded 4-bit code 和 tq2_0_fx4 block format 的定义。这里要想清楚：为什么自由双尺度 PTQTP 更灵活，但作者仍愿意加约束；以及为什么“磁盘字节=缓存字节=kernel 输入字节”在 SSD-streamed MoE 里比多一点离线重构精度更值钱。

实验部分建议优先看 reference fidelity protocol、expert-lossless control arm、以及速度测试设置。如果时间有限，30 分钟内可以只看：Introduction、格式定义图表、quality evaluation protocol、serving throughput 结果。需要保留的判断是：这不是通用 LLM 量化结论，而是一个面向超大 MoE 流式部署的格式-系统联合设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a very specific but practical serving problem: for very large MoE models on consumer hardware, routed experts dominate the parameter footprint, exceed RAM, and must be streamed from SSD. In that regime, throughput is governed by bytes moved per token, while quality is governed by quantization damage. The central question is whether PTQTP-style two-plane ternary post-training quantization can be constrained into a uniform 9-level quantizer so that expert weights can be stored persistently in a single folded 4-bit code format, reused unchanged on disk, in cache, and at kernel input, with no transcoding in the serving path and acceptable quality loss.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited; this is primarily an inference-systems and quantized-serving paper. Still, it is useful for anyone working on large MoE systems. First, it shows that in SSD-streamed MoE serving, quantization format design is not just about perplexity. Persistent representation, I/O path, cache layout, and kernel compatibility matter just as much. Second, it presents a clear engineering trade-off: tying PTQTP’s two scales to a fixed 3:1 ratio reduces reconstruction flexibility, but buys a uniform 9-level code and a much cleaner end-to-end serving stack. That trade-off is relevant for future MoE-aware quantization and for training-time methods that may want to target deployment-native formats.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core idea is to start from PTQTP’s decomposition
W≈α1T1+α2T2 with Ti∈{-1,0,1}, and impose α=(3s,s). Under that constraint, the composite code c=3t1+t2 lands on a uniformly spaced 9-level grid with a single scale. Standard PTQTP allows two free per-group scales and therefore a more flexible non-uniform 9-level approximation. This paper deliberately gives up that flexibility in exchange for a simpler, deployment-friendly representation. Because there are only nine valid composite values, the two ternary planes can be folded losslessly into a single 4-bit code plane.

The more interesting part is the systems realization. The folded 4-bit code is not just an internal compute format; it becomes the persistent serving representation. Disk bytes, expert-cache bytes, and kernel input bytes are identical, so the system never transcodes expert weights between storage tiers. The implementation uses a block format called tq2_0_fx4: a 520-byte block covering four columns by 256 elements, corresponding to 4.0625 bits per weight. This matters because an expert miss can then be served by one contiguous read, and block-granular NVMe striping of hot expert prefixes becomes straightforward.

On the evaluation side, the paper does not rely on perplexity alone. It emphasizes step-level agreement with the official serving API using greedy decoding and decoded-text prefix agreement on captured fixtures rather than token-ID equality. It also introduces an expert-lossless control arm, where the released MXFP4 expert bytes are repacked without an additional quantization step, to anchor the claim that observed deficits are primarily due to expert quantization rather than unrelated system effects. The paper also mentions a process-isolation protocol motivated by measured fixture instability. Altogether, the work is much more about deployment fidelity than about abstract quantization theory.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are built around a production-scale 284B-A13B MoE model. The expert payload dominates the serving artifact: the paper cites roughly 145 GiB of q4_k-scale expert bytes inside a 153.3 GiB serving file, with only about 8 GiB for trunk and embeddings. The quantization target is the released checkpoint artifact, whose experts are available in MXFP4 rather than a higher-precision official release, so the study is grounded in a realistic deployment object rather than an idealized offline setting.

The main empirical comparison is along three axes: reconstruction/perplexity, agreement with the official API, and actual serving speed. One of the paper’s central observations is that these axes do not always agree. Better perplexity does not necessarily imply better step-level reference fidelity, and better reference fidelity does not automatically translate into better downstream benchmark behavior. That is an important point for quantization work, since many papers implicitly treat offline perplexity as a sufficient proxy for deployment quality.

On the systems side, the claimed speedups depend on the fact that the ratio-3 tied 9-level folded code is the persistent format itself, so persistent bytes, cache bytes, and kernel input bytes are identical. The implementation is done in the open-source fucina stack, which is CPU-first with optional Metal/CUDA GEMM offload. The excerpt provided here does not include the full result tables, but the paper clearly frames no-transcode SSD-streamed expert serving as the main practical gain, and reports official-API alignment, descriptive MMLU comparison, and perplexity side by side to argue against single-metric evaluation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as a format-and-serving co-design paper, not as a general quantization paper. Start with the Introduction and isolate two points: the contribution is intentionally narrow, and the real target is not merely lower bitwidth but a deployment-native persistent format for SSD-streamed MoE experts.

Then focus on the method section that defines the balanced-ternary identity, the folded 4-bit composite code, and the tq2_0_fx4 block format. The key question is why one would accept the loss of PTQTP’s free two-scale flexibility. The answer is in the serving path: if disk bytes, cache bytes, and kernel input bytes are identical, the system avoids transcoding and simplifies expert streaming substantially.

In the experiments, prioritize the reference-fidelity protocol, the expert-lossless control arm, and the throughput setup. If time is limited, a 30-minute skim should cover: Introduction, the format-definition figures/tables, the quality-evaluation protocol, and the serving-throughput section. The main takeaway to retain is that this is not a broad claim about LLM quantization; it is a targeted design for very large MoE deployment where storage format and runtime path are inseparable.

recommendation.zh: 做 MoE serving 的可以看：重点不是量化精度，而是“持久化格式=缓存=kernel 输入”这个系统取舍；只读格式设计和 kernel 路径，别把它当通用 PTQ 结论。
recommendation.en: Worth a skim if you care about MoE serving: the real idea is format unification across disk/cache/kernel, not a broadly convincing PTQ accuracy result.

paper.title: Shape Mutating Expert Compression:LorExperts and BTExperts
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models deliver high capacity at low per-token compute, but deploying them cheaply requires compressing their many expert weight matrices. Expert pruning (e.g., REAP) and merging reduce cost but sacrifice accuracy and require retraining the router; low-rank delta decomposition of experts (e.g., D^2-MoE) preserves all experts and the router, but degrades sharply as the expert count grows because a single shared component cannot approximate many near-orthogonal exp

summary.core_problem: MoE 语言模型中专家权重近正交，单一共享低秩分量（如 D²-MoE）随专家数增加逼近质量急剧下降；剪枝/合并又伤精度且需重训 router。
summary.importance: 方法创新：在保留 router 的前提下对 MoE 专家做高压缩比压缩，对 MoE 部署有实际价值。
summary.technical_approach: 发现专家按 co-activation 形成功能社区（与权重相似度解耦）；提出 LorExperts，每簇保留一个全精度主导专家，其余用相对簇中心的低秩修正表示；并提出 BTExperts 作为形状变异压缩变体。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体参数量、数据集或精度数字；与 REAP、D²-MoE 等专家压缩方法对比。

summary_en.core_problem: MoE expert weights are near-orthogonal, so a single shared low-rank component (as in D²-MoE) degrades sharply with expert count, while pruning/merge methods hurt accuracy and require router retraining.
summary_en.importance: A methodological contribution: router-preserving MoE expert compression with high ratios, practically relevant for MoE deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Shows experts form functional co-activation communities decoupled from weight similarity; LorExperts keeps one full-precision dominant expert per cluster and represents others as low-rank corrections to the cluster center, with BTExperts as a shape-mutating variant.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract gives no concrete parameter counts, datasets, or accuracy numbers; compares against expert compression methods such as REAP and D²-MoE.

recommendation.zh: co-activation 社区与权重相似度解耦这一观察值得 MoE 从业者看；具体压缩数字需查正文，setup 偏部署侧。
recommendation.en: The observation that co-activation communities decouple from weight similarity is worth a look for MoE practitioners; check the paper for actual compression numbers, it is deployment-oriented.

paper.title: RotaryQuant: Fitting 120B MoE Models on Consumer Hardware via Fused Compressed-Space Attention
paper.abstract: Large mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models with 26--120 billion parameters exceed the memory capacity of consumer devices through three simultaneous pressures: resident weight matrices, key-value (KV) cache state that grows linearly with context, and dozens of expert sublayers that must be paged on demand. We present RotaryQuant, a three-axis compression system that addresses all three. Mixed-precision weight quantization assigns bit-widths by architectural role: 4-bit for dense layers, 2-bi

summary.core_problem: 26B–120B MoE语言模型在消费级硬件上同时面临权重驻留、KV缓存随上下文线性增长、专家子层按需分页三重内存压力，如何三轴压缩使其可运行。
summary.importance: 工程系统创新，针对MoE serving的真实瓶颈给出按架构角色区分位宽的量化方案，并提出新的KV缓存压缩方法IsoQuant；对MoE部署与KV量化有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 三轴压缩：(1) 混合精度权重量化——dense层4-bit、routed experts 2-bit、shared expert因激活高峰度（kurtosis）抗压缩差而用8-bit；(2) LRU专家卸载到磁盘；(3) IsoQuant——先做Walsh-Hadamard变换再用块对角SO(4)旋转使激活分布各向同性，然后3-bit标量量化，每头仅存256个参数、O(d log d)开销。
summary.experiments: 面向26B–120B MoE模型在消费级硬件上的部署；摘要未给出与vLLM/同类量化方案的具体端到端吞吐与精度对比数字，需读正文确认。

summary_en.core_problem: How to fit 26B–120B MoE language models on consumer hardware under three simultaneous memory pressures: resident weights, linearly growing KV cache, and on-demand expert paging.
summary_en.importance: A systems contribution targeting real MoE serving bottlenecks, with role-aware mixed-precision quantization and a novel KV-cache compression scheme (IsoQuant); directly relevant to MoE deployment and KV quantization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three-axis compression: (1) mixed-precision weight quantization—4-bit dense, 2-bit routed experts, and 8-bit for the shared expert whose high activation kurtosis resists aggressive quantization; (2) LRU expert offloading to disk; (3) IsoQuant—Walsh-Hadamard transform followed by block-diagonal SO(4) rotations to isotropize activations before 3-bit scalar quantization, with 256 stored parameters per head and O(d log d) cost.
summary_en.experiments: Targets 26B–120B MoE models on consumer hardware; the abstract gives no concrete end-to-end throughput/accuracy numbers against vLLM or comparable quantization methods, so the body must be checked.

recommendation.zh: MoE按角色分配位宽的观察（shared expert需8-bit、routed可2-bit）值得在内部量化ablation复现；IsoQuant的WHT+SO(4)各向同性化看§方法即可。
recommendation.en: The role-aware bit-width observation (8-bit shared expert, 2-bit routed) is worth reproducing in internal quantization ablations; read the IsoQuant WHT+SO(4) section for the KV trick.

paper.title: Spectral Outliers Reveal Dominant Learned Structure in Transformer Attention
paper.abstract: We apply Marchenko-Pastur (MP) random matrix theory to pre-trained attention weights in order to separate each projection matrix into a random-like bulk and a set of spectral outliers. We validate this decomposition causally: zeroing the MP-identified outliers (signal) in Mistral-7B drives HellaSwag, MMLU, and PIQA close to random-chance performance, whereas zeroing a count-matched subset of bulk singular values causes smaller but non-negligible degradation. Across 11 pre-trained transformers we

summary.core_problem: 如何从预训练Transformer注意力权重中分离结构化功能信号与类随机噪声，并因果验证这些结构成分对模型性能的实际贡献。
summary.importance: 提供了基于Marchenko-Pastur随机矩阵理论的无监督注意力结构诊断框架，其发现的谱异常值承载主要功能信息、GQA架构改变V投影结构分布等结论，可为参数高效微调的秩与层选择、模型压缩、注意力架构设计提供实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 用Marchenko-Pastur（MP）定律对Q/K/V/O每个注意力投影矩阵的奇异值做分解，超过MP上界的归为谱异常值（结构化信号），其余为类随机体成分。配套三种分析手段：入口级异常值热图（可视化4σ以上权重的空间分布）、跨层残差流对齐分析（识别持续出现的异常残差通道）、因果消融实验（对比置零谱异常值与等量随机体成分的性能下降，验证功能重要性）。共分析11个覆盖编码器、解码器架构的预训练模型。
summary.experiments: 在Mistral-7B上置零MP识别的谱异常值，HellaSwag、MMLU、PIQA性能降至接近随机水平，置零等量随机体成分的下降幅度小得多。跨架构规律包括：Q投影的谱异常值最多（LLaMA-2-7B中Q占87.8%谱能量，V占79.0%）；GQA架构下V投影异常值大幅减少（LLaMA-3-8B中V仅占43.1%谱能量，较Q少6倍）；谱能量占比从低层到高层逐层递减。空间分布上Q异常值呈行带状、O呈列带状，K和O存在跨层持续的残差通道。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第II节的MP分解方法与消融协议、第III节的跨架构谱模式与因果消融结果，预计阅读20-30分钟。关注参数高效微调或模型压缩可优先看谱异常值的功能验证部分，关注架构设计可重点看GQA对V投影结构的影响分析。

summary_en.core_problem: How to separate functionally meaningful structured signal from random-like noise in pre-trained Transformer attention weights, and causally validate whether the identified structures actually contribute to model performance.
summary_en.importance: Provides an unsupervised diagnostic framework for attention weight structure based on Marchenko-Pastur random matrix theory. Findings such as spectral outliers carrying dominant functional information and GQA altering the structural distribution of V projections offer empirical guidance for rank and layer selection in parameter-efficient fine-tuning, model compression, and attention architecture design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes each attention projection matrix (Q, K, V, O) into spectral outliers (singular values above the Marchenko-Pastur upper edge, treated as structured signal) and a random-like bulk using MP law. Three complementary analysis methods are included: entry-level outlier heatmaps (visualizing spatial distribution of weights above 4σ), cross-layer residual-stream alignment analysis (identifying persistent outlier residual channels), and causal ablation experiments (comparing performance degradation from zeroing spectral outliers vs an equal number of random bulk components to verify functional importance). Analyzes 11 pre-trained models spanning encoder-only and decoder-only architectures.
summary_en.experiments: Zeroing MP-identified spectral outliers in Mistral-7B drops HellaSwag, MMLU, and PIQA performance to near random chance, while zeroing an equal number of random bulk components causes far smaller degradation. Cross-architecture patterns include: Q projections have the most spectral outliers (87.8% spectral energy for Q vs 79.0% for V in LLaMA-2-7B); V projections under GQA have dramatically fewer outliers (only 43.1% spectral energy in LLaMA-3-8B, a 6x reduction relative to Q); spectral energy ratio decreases gradually from early to late layers. Spatially, outliers form row-bands in Q and column-bands in O, with persistent cross-layer residual channels in K and O.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section II for the MP decomposition method and ablation protocol, and Section III for cross-architecture spectral patterns and causal ablation results. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes. Readers interested in parameter-efficient fine-tuning or model compression should prioritize the functional validation of spectral outliers; those focused on architecture design can dive into the GQA impact analysis on V projection structure.

recommendation.zh: 谱分解+因果消融的 setup 干净，结论对结构化剪枝和 PEFT 有直接提示，重点看 §4-5 的五个 pattern。
recommendation.en: Clean spectral-plus-causal-ablation setup; the five patterns in §4-5 are directly useful for structured pruning and PEFT.

paper.title: Decided Upstream, Written Late: Locating and Pricing the Cross-Lingual Refusal Circuit of a Multilingual MoE
paper.abstract: Safety alignment in multilingual models is uneven: a model that reliably refuses a harmful request in English will often comply with the same request in a lower-resource language. We trace this gap mechanistically in sarvam, an Indic-multilingual mixture-of-experts reasoning model, and find it is not a failure to detect harm. Harm is encoded as an internal direction that is nearly language-invariant in mid-network (English-vs-Indic cosine ${\approx}0.9$ at $L11$), and steering that direction ups

summary.core_problem: 多语言MoE模型存在低资源语言下有害请求更易被遵从的跨语言安全差距，其内在机制是检测失效还是生成失效，以及拒绝行为的神经回路如何组织。
summary.importance: 揭示了多语言对齐中有害检测与拒绝生成的分离机制，解释了统一检测与不均衡拒绝共存的原因，可为多语言安全对齐策略设计、MoE模型的定向对齐干预提供机制层面的依据。拒绝行为跨自回归步骤构建的结论，也对对齐干预方法的设计有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 以Sarvam-30B（30B参数、19层、128专家top-6路由的印度语族多语言推理MoE）为研究对象，使用成对有害/良性提示的TwinBreak语料（覆盖6种语言）开展实验。核心方法包括：计算每层有害方向与拒绝方向，分析两者的跨语言一致性与正交性；通过单次/逐解码步激活注入实验，验证拒绝行为是单次前向读出还是跨步骤构建；用直接logit归因与专家激活分析定位拒绝回路的具体层与专家；量化不同干预的流畅度代价。
summary.experiments: 有害检测方向在中层（第11层）跨语言高度一致（印度语言间余弦相似度0.95±0.01，英印间0.90±0.01），英语的检测表示更强。有害方向与拒绝方向几乎正交（所有层|cos|≤0.10），拒绝方向幅值从低层到高层单调增长。单次上游注入有害方向无法驱动输出端拒绝，效果在2层内衰减；逐解码步注入可实现0.65的拒绝恢复率、16倍有害/良性选择性、4%的良性误杀率。拒绝生成回路定位在后期MoE层（第14-16层贡献正拒绝logit，第17-18层出现正负抵消模式），可定位到具体专家。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3节（有害检测与拒绝的分离）、第4节（拒绝的跨步骤构建）、第5节（回路归因），预计阅读25-35分钟。关注多语言对齐可优先看跨语言有害方向一致性分析，关注MoE对齐可重点看专家层面的归因结果。

summary_en.core_problem: What causes the cross-lingual safety gap in multilingual MoE models where harmful requests in low-resource languages are more likely to be complied with, whether the gap stems from failed harm detection or failed refusal generation, and how the refusal neural circuit is organized.
summary_en.importance: Reveals the dissociation between harm detection and refusal generation in multilingual aligned models, explaining why uniform harm detection can coexist with uneven cross-lingual refusal behavior. This provides mechanistic guidance for multilingual safety alignment strategy design and targeted alignment interventions for MoE models. The finding that refusal is constructed across autoregressive generation steps also directly informs the design of alignment intervention methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Studies Sarvam-30B, a 30B-parameter 19-layer Indic-multilingual reasoning MoE with 128 experts and top-6 routing, using the TwinBreak corpus of paired harmful/benign prompts across 6 languages. Core methods include: computing per-layer harm and refusal directions to measure cross-lingual consistency and orthogonality; testing whether refusal is a single-pass readout or constructed across generation via single-shot vs per-decode-step activation injection; localizing the refusal circuit's specific layers and experts using direct logit attribution and expert activation analysis; quantifying fluency cost of different interventions.
summary_en.experiments: Harm detection directions are highly cross-lingually consistent at middle layers (layer 11: 0.95±0.01 cosine similarity between Indic languages, 0.90±0.01 between English and Indic), with stronger representation in English. Harm and refusal directions are nearly orthogonal (|cos| ≤ 0.10 at all layers), with refusal direction magnitude growing monotonically from early to late layers. Single-shot upstream injection of the harm direction fails to drive refusal at the output, with effects decaying within 2 layers; per-step injection achieves 0.65 refusal recovery rate, 16x harmful/benign selectivity, and 4% benign knockout. The refusal generation circuit is localized to late MoE layers (L14-L16 contribute positive refusal logits, L17-L18 show a canceling sign pattern), with specific refusal-associated experts identifiable.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (dissociation between harm detection and refusal), Section 4 (cross-step construction of refusal), and Section 5 (circuit attribution). Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes. Readers focused on multilingual alignment should prioritize the cross-lingual harm direction consistency analysis; those interested in MoE alignment can dive into expert-level attribution results.

recommendation.zh: 把跨语言拒答差距拆成检测/写入两段并定价干预，结论对 MoE 对齐 recipe 有动作含义，重点看 writer/opposer 电路部分。
recommendation.en: Decomposes the cross-lingual refusal gap into detection vs. writing and prices interventions; the writer/opposer circuit section is the actionable part for MoE alignment.

paper.title: TEXAS: Task-Expert-Aware Supervision for Downstream Mixture-of-Experts LLM Adaptation
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models route each token through a small subset of experts, making routing patterns useful for identifying task-relevant experts during downstream adaptation. Yet current approaches have two limitations: task experts are typically identified from aggregate routing statistics that reflect usage rather than association with successful task completion, and task-expert activations remain underexplored as signals for supervision allocation. We introduce Task-Expert-Aw

summary.core_problem: 解决 MoE LLM 下游适配时如何利用专家路由信号分配监督的问题，避免只按专家使用频率选择所谓任务专家。
summary.importance: 贡献属于后训练方法改进，对 MoE expert specialization 的可观测性有一定参考价值。它把“专家被频繁使用”与“专家和正确完成任务有关”区分开，这一点对分析 MoE 预训练后的路由结构也有弱信号价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Task-Expert-Aware Supervision。方法先比较 base model 在成功样本和失败样本上的专家激活差异，保留在成功样本中更强激活的专家；微调时，如果失败样本的答案 token 激活这些任务相关专家，就提高这些 token 的监督权重。方法不冻结或限制只更新某些专家，而是用已有路由行为调节 token-level loss。
summary.experiments: 给定摘要未提供模型规模、任务集合、baseline、提升幅度或显著性结果。只能确认实验对象是 MoE language models 的 downstream adaptation，核心对比应包括基于 aggregate routing statistics 的专家选择或常规微调。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 City University of Hong Kong、Carnegie Mellon University、University of Waterloo、The University of Hong Kong。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to use MoE routing signals for downstream adaptation without equating frequent expert usage with task-relevant expertise.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training method with some relevance to MoE pretraining analysis. Its useful distinction is between experts that are merely active and experts whose activation correlates with successful task completion.
summary_en.technical_approach: TEXAS first identifies task experts by contrasting expert activations on instances solved correctly by the base model against failed instances. During fine-tuning, it upweights answer tokens in failed examples when those tokens activate the success-associated experts. The method uses existing routing behavior as a supervision-allocation signal rather than restricting adaptation to a fixed expert subset.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The experimental setting is downstream adaptation of MoE language models, likely compared against standard fine-tuning and routing-statistics-based expert selection.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with City University of Hong Kong, Carnegie Mellon University, University of Waterloo, and The University of Hong Kong.

recommendation.zh: MoE 预训练不用急读；只看专家发现部分，判断“成功相关路由”是否比 usage stats 更干净。
recommendation.en: Not urgent for MoE pretraining; read only the expert-discovery setup to see whether success-conditioned routing is cleaner than usage statistics.

paper.title: Beyond Routing Weights: Faithful Response-Level Interpretation of Mixture-of-Experts Reward Models via Contribution Contrast
paper.abstract: Reward models are central to learning from human preferences, yet identifying what drives their predictions remains challenging. Recent sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) reward models seek to improve interpretability by routing prompts to specialized experts and characterizing experts through examples with high routing weights. However, routing weights only reveal which prompts an expert $\textit{receives}$, not how it $\textit{judges}$ responses, providing only a partial account of expert behavio

summary.core_problem: 解决 MoE reward model 的专家解释不忠实问题：router weight 只能说明样本被送到哪个专家，不能说明专家如何判断 chosen/rejected response。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 reward model 解释与诊断方法。它对 RLHF/RLVR 中 reward model 的可控性有参考价值，尤其是当 reward model 采用稀疏专家结构时，专家解释不能只看路由分布。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Contribution-Contrast, 简称 CoCo。它以 chosen-rejected response pair 为单位，寻找对某个专家贡献差异最大的样本，用“贡献对比”同时刻画 routing 行为和 preference scoring 行为。相比只按高 routing weight 找代表样本，CoCo 更接近专家对最终 reward 差异的实际作用。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在自动评估和人工评估中，CoCo 相比 router-based、score-based 和 sparse autoencoder-based 解释方法更 coherent、faithful、specialized，同时保持竞争性的 reward model 表现。摘要未给出模型规模、偏好数据集、提升幅度和人工评估协议细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies faithful interpretation of MoE reward models, where routing weights reveal which prompts an expert receives but not how the expert judges chosen-versus-rejected responses.
summary_en.importance: This is an interpretability and diagnostics contribution for preference modeling. It is relevant to RLHF and RLVR pipelines when reward models use sparse expert structure, because expert specialization cannot be inferred from routing alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Contribution-Contrast or CoCo, identifies chosen-rejected response pairs with the largest contribution contrast for each expert. This jointly captures routing behavior and preference-scoring behavior, unlike representative-example methods based only on high routing weights.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports automatic and human evaluations showing more coherent, faithful, and specialized expert interpretations than router-based, score-based, and sparse-autoencoder-based alternatives, while preserving competitive reward model performance. Model size, datasets, and effect sizes are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 做 MoE reward model 才需要看，重点读贡献分解定义；对基座训练只是弱诊断信号。
recommendation.en: Only read it if you run MoE reward models; focus on the contribution decomposition, as the signal for base pretraining is indirect.

paper.title: EdgeXpert: An Edge Device for Memory-Efficient LLM Inference with Mixture-of-Experts and Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: On-device deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) has become essential for personalized edge applications. A primary bottleneck is external memory access (EMA) in feed-forward network (FFN) layers. Speculative decoding and mixture-of-experts (MoE) are promising solutions. Speculative decoding reduces the number of decoding stages by generating multiple tokens per stage, and MoE minimizes per-stage cost through sparse expert activation. However, there is an incompatibility when combining these

summary.core_problem: 边缘设备LLM推理中，MoE与推测解码结合存在不兼容问题，FFN层的外部内存访问（EMA）是主要性能瓶颈
summary.importance: 系统/工程创新，提出软硬件协同的LLM加速器方案，解决MoE与推测解码的兼容问题，降低边缘LLM推理的内存访问开销
summary.technical_approach: 提出EdgeXpert软硬件协同加速器：预填充阶段将逐token独立路由重构为prompt级专家复用，用轻量编码器识别重要token构建共享专家集，降低非重要token的专家预算以减少EMA；解码阶段采用深度感知专家策略（摘要截断）
summary.experiments: 摘要内容截断，未披露完整实验设置、模型规模、基线与效果数据
summary.authors_note: 未披露机构信息，Hoi-Jun Yoo为低功耗AI加速器领域知名学者

summary_en.core_problem: Combining Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and speculative decoding for on-device LLM inference faces incompatibility issues, with external memory access (EMA) in FFN layers being the primary bottleneck
summary_en.importance: System/engineering innovation: a software-hardware co-designed LLM accelerator is proposed to resolve the incompatibility between MoE and speculative decoding, reducing memory access overhead for edge LLM inference
summary_en.technical_approach: EdgeXpert, a software-hardware co-designed accelerator, reformulates per-token routing as prompt-level expert reuse in the prefill stage: a lightweight encoder identifies important tokens to build a shared expert set, and less important tokens are routed with a reduced expert budget to lower EMA; depth-aware expert policy is used in the decode stage (abstract truncated)
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; full experimental setup, model scale, baselines, and results are not disclosed
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliations not disclosed; Hoi-Jun Yoo is a well-known scholar in low-power AI accelerators

recommendation.zh: 边缘LLM推理的软硬件协同工作，MoE路由优化思路偏硬件侧，预训练研究员无需深读
recommendation.en: Software-hardware co-design for edge LLM inference; MoE routing optimization is hardware-focused, no deep reading needed for pretraining researchers.

paper.title: MESH: Memory-Efficient Sinkhorn Optimization for Mixture-of-Experts Training
paper.abstract: Memory-efficient matrix optimizers such as Sinkhorn gradient descent remove most AdamW optimizer state for dense Transformer matrices, but direct application to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training is unreliable. We study this failure in a controlled 110M-parameter nanowhale DeepSeek-style MoE pretraining setting. A SAGE/Sinkhorn hybrid reduces optimizer state from 0.883GB to 0.331GB but degrades evaluation loss to 3.8265, far above the AdamW baselines observed in the same setup (3.58--3.64 across

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 MoE 预训练里低状态矩阵优化器失效的问题。Sinkhorn 类优化器对 dense Transformer 矩阵有效，因为它可以用当前梯度做行列归一化，省掉 AdamW 的一阶、二阶动量状态。但 MoE expert 矩阵虽然也是二维矩阵，梯度来源却不同：每个 expert 只接收 router 选中的 token 子集，且 gate 权重和 token 分布随训练变化。直接把 dense 模型里的 SAGE/Sinkhorn recipe 搬到 MoE，会把高方差、条件采样的 expert 梯度逐步归一化，导致更新噪声被放大。论文的核心诊断是：MoE expert 需要先做时间平均，再做 Sinkhorn 归一化，而不是对每步瞬时梯度归一化后再隐式平均。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练研究的价值在于，它把“低 optimizer state 能否用于 MoE 预训练”这个问题拆得比较清楚。MoE 的主要吸引力是扩大参数量而保持每 token 计算量可控，但 optimizer state 会重新变成显存瓶颈。AdamW 对每个参数保存两个状态张量，expert 参数越多，这个成本越难接受。论文显示，不能只按张量形状决定优化器策略；expert matrix 和 dense MLP matrix 的梯度统计结构不同。这个结论对大规模 MoE recipe 有直接启发：优化器设计要显式考虑 routing 造成的条件分布漂移。贡献量级偏工程研究，但问题抓得准，负结果也有信息量。它不是提出一个通用替代 AdamW 的完整方案，而是在 MoE expert 这一关键子结构上给出可解释、可复现实验诊断。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从 Sinkhorn optimizer 的失败机制入手。普通 Sinkhorn update 对矩阵梯度 G_t 做多轮行范数、列范数归一化，再乘以全局 scale，优点是 dense matrix 不需要存一阶或二阶状态。SAGE 式 hybrid 通常会把 embedding、vocab 这类难处理张量交给轻状态优化器，把 dense 二维矩阵交给 Sinkhorn。论文发现这个角色划分在 MoE 上不成立，因为 routed expert 的梯度 G_{e,t} 来自 p(x | e in top-k(x,t))，不是完整 mini-batch 分布下的稳定估计。由于 Sinkhorn 是非线性算子，Sinkhorn(E[G_t]) 和 E[Sinkhorn(G_t)] 不等价。对 expert 来说，normalize-then-average 会放大 routing noise；average-then-normalize 更接近 AdamW 一阶动量的作用。MESH 的做法是在 expert 上维护隐藏一阶动量 H_t，然后对 H_t 做 Sinkhorn 归一化。它保留 SAGE/Sinkhorn 对 vocab 和非 expert 矩阵的处理，只替换 expert update。关键实现点是 expert first moment 通过 gradient-buffer lifecycle 维护，而不是作为显式 optimizer-state tensor 保存，因此目标仍是降低 optimizer memory。MESH-B 进一步加入粗粒度 block/neuron inverse-RMS multiplier，相当于给 expert update 增加有限的二阶尺度信息。论文对这个扩展的态度比较谨慎：block 级自适应有帮助，尤其在 seed-42 的诊断里更明显，但多 seed 结果显示一阶时间平滑才是主要因子。
summary.experiments: 实验使用一个受控的 110M 参数 nanowhale DeepSeek-style MoE 预训练设置。直接使用 SAGE/Sinkhorn hybrid 可以把 optimizer state 从 0.883GB 降到 0.331GB，但 eval loss 到 3.8265，明显差于同一设置下 AdamW baseline 的 3.58–3.64。论文把问题定位到 routed expert matrix：对非 expert dense matrix 使用 Sinkhorn 不是主要问题，expert 的条件梯度才是主要失效点。若把 SAGE 应到 expert 上，效果更差；单独降低 Sinkhorn scale、把 expert tensor 融合后做 Sinkhorn、按 route confidence damping，都不能补上差距。负向消融还覆盖了 second-moment-only、sign/momentum-only、confidence-only、scale-only、fused-Sinkhorn 等解释，结论是这些都不足以解释 AdamW 与 stateless Sinkhorn 的差距。MESH 和 MESH-B 在多 seed 下给出更好的 memory-quality trade-off；论文强调 unblocked hidden-momentum 和 block-preconditioned variant 的总体表现接近，因此不要把收益简单归因于 block preconditioning。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction、Background and Diagnosis、MESH 以及实验消融部分。Introduction 里最重要的是问题表述：expert 矩阵不能按 dense 二维矩阵处理。Background and Diagnosis 值得细看公式，尤其是 routed expert 梯度来自条件 token 分布，以及 Sinkhorn 非线性带来的 Sinkhorn(E[G]) 与 E[Sinkhorn(G)] 差异。MESH 部分重点看 hidden momentum 怎样接入 gradient buffer，而不是变成普通 AdamW 式显式状态。实验部分优先看三类结果：一是 AdamW、SAGE/Sinkhorn、MESH 的 loss-memory trade-off；二是 expert 与 non-expert 的分组 ablation；三是 scale、confidence、fused tensor、second moment 等负结果。真正值得深挖的是 optimizer state 统计口径和 hidden momentum 的实现边界：如果隐藏状态实际占用了与梯度生命周期相关的显存或通信带宽，它在大规模训练里的收益需要结合 ZeRO/FSDP、expert parallelism 和 activation/gradient overlap 重新核算。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why memory-efficient Sinkhorn-style optimizers fail when moved from dense Transformer pretraining to MoE pretraining. A routed expert weight is a matrix, but its gradient is not sampled like a dense MLP gradient. Each expert sees a router-selected, gate-weighted token subset whose distribution changes during training. Applying stateless Sinkhorn normalization to this instantaneous expert gradient normalizes routing noise before any temporal smoothing. The central problem is therefore the ordering of operations: MoE experts need temporal averaging before matrix normalization, not per-step normalization of noisy conditional gradients.
summary_en.importance: The result matters for pretraining because optimizer state is a major memory cost in large MoE models. AdamW keeps two state tensors per parameter, which is especially expensive when the model has many expert parameters. The paper shows that optimizer assignment cannot be based only on tensor shape. Expert matrices and dense matrices have different gradient statistics because of routing. This is a useful lesson for MoE training recipes: optimizer design has to account for conditional token distributions and router-induced temporal variation. The contribution is mainly a controlled systems-and-optimization diagnosis rather than a full replacement for AdamW, but the failure mode is directly relevant to practical MoE pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The baseline Sinkhorn matrix optimizer repeatedly normalizes the rows and columns of a matrix gradient and applies a scalar update scale. It is attractive because it removes moment state for dense two-dimensional weights. SAGE-like hybrids typically keep lightweight state for vocabulary tensors and use Sinkhorn for dense matrices. The paper shows that this dense-model role assignment breaks for MoE experts. For expert e, the gradient G_{e,t} is drawn from a changing conditional distribution p(x | e is selected by top-k routing), not from the full minibatch distribution. Since Sinkhorn normalization is nonlinear, Sinkhorn(E[G_t]) and E[Sinkhorn(G_t)] can behave differently. MESH addresses this by maintaining a hidden first-moment signal H_t for expert gradients and applying Sinkhorn to H_t rather than to G_t. Non-expert matrices and vocabulary tensors keep the SAGE/Sinkhorn hybrid treatment. The expert momentum is maintained through the gradient-buffer lifecycle instead of being stored as an explicit optimizer-state tensor. MESH-B adds a coarse block/neuron inverse-RMS multiplier, giving a limited form of adaptive scaling. The paper’s own interpretation is conservative: block-level adaptivity can help, but temporal smoothing before Sinkhorn normalization is the main causal ingredient.
summary_en.experiments: The controlled setting is a 110M-parameter nanowhale DeepSeek-style MoE pretraining run. A direct SAGE/Sinkhorn hybrid reduces optimizer state from 0.883GB to 0.331GB, but its evaluation loss reaches 3.8265, far worse than AdamW baselines in the same setup, which fall in the 3.58–3.64 range across studied seeds. The failure is localized to routed expert matrices. Applying SAGE to experts is worse. Reducing the Sinkhorn scale, fusing expert tensors before Sinkhorn normalization, or damping updates by routing confidence does not close the gap. Additional negative ablations cover second-moment-only, sign/momentum-only, confidence-only, scale-only, and fused-Sinkhorn variants. These results support the claim that the missing first-moment signal is the dominant issue. MESH and MESH-B improve the memory-quality trade-off across seeds, with the unblocked and block-preconditioned hidden-momentum variants reported as broadly similar in their multi-seed behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the Introduction and diagnosis sections carefully before looking at the optimizer details. The key idea is the mismatch between dense matrix gradients and routed expert gradients. The most important equations are the expert-gradient sampling expression and the argument that Sinkhorn(E[G]) differs from E[Sinkhorn(G)]. In the MESH section, focus on how hidden momentum is tied to the gradient-buffer lifecycle rather than added as ordinary optimizer state. In the experiments, prioritize the loss-memory comparison between AdamW, SAGE/Sinkhorn, and MESH; the expert versus non-expert ablations; and the negative results for scale tuning, confidence damping, fused Sinkhorn, and second-moment-only variants. A useful follow-up question is how the hidden state interacts with expert parallelism, gradient sharding, ZeRO/FSDP-style optimizer partitioning, and communication overlap in larger MoE runs.

recommendation.zh: DeepSeek实测的MoE训练内存优化方案，明确了无状态优化器在路由专家上失效的根因，应立刻在内部MoE训练框架中复现验证
recommendation.en: A DeepSeek-tested MoE training memory optimization that identifies the root cause of stateless optimizer failure on routed experts; reproduce immediately in internal MoE training stacks.

paper.title: K-EXAONE 2.0 Technical Report
paper.abstract: This technical report presents K-EXAONE 2.0, an open-weight multilingual foundation model developed by LG AI Research as a step in our effort toward global frontier-scale foundation models. Rather than training from scratch, we upcycle K-EXAONE and expand its architecture, yielding a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 750B total parameters and approximately 37B activated per token---more than three times the capacity of its predecessor. K-EXAONE 2.0 supports context lengths of up to 256K tokens

summary.core_problem: 报告 K-EXAONE 2.0 如何从已有 K-EXAONE 继续扩展为大规模多语 MoE 基座模型，并通过持续预训练、中期训练和后训练提升实用能力。
summary.importance: 这是一个大模型技术报告，重点在 MoE upcycling、256K 长上下文、多语扩展和完整训练管线。对预训练研究员的价值主要在训练路径选择：不从零训练，而是把已有模型扩容成 750B 总参数、每 token 激活约 37B 的 MoE。
summary.technical_approach: 模型通过 upcycle K-EXAONE 扩展架构，形成 750B total parameters、约 37B activated parameters per token 的 MoE。训练流程结合 continual pre-training、difficulty-focused mid-training 和 post-training，目标覆盖推理、agentic coding、多语能力、安全性，以及韩国社会文化语境下的行为对齐。
summary.experiments: K-EXAONE 2.0 支持最长 256K context，多语覆盖从 6 种扩展到 10 种。报告在九类贴近实际使用的评测上比较，整体优于前代 K-EXAONE，并与开放权重模型保持竞争力；最大增益出现在 agentic coding 等能力上。摘要未披露训练 token 数、数据配比和详细 baseline 列表。
summary.authors_note: 来自 LG AI Research，属于 K-EXAONE 系列开放权重基础模型技术报告。

summary_en.core_problem: The report describes how K-EXAONE 2.0 expands an existing K-EXAONE model into a large multilingual MoE foundation model through continued training and staged capability tuning.
summary_en.importance: This is a large-model technical report. Its main relevance is the training path: instead of training from scratch, LG AI Research upcycles an existing model into a 750B-parameter MoE with about 37B active parameters per token, long context, and broader multilingual coverage.
summary_en.technical_approach: K-EXAONE 2.0 upcycles K-EXAONE and expands it into a Mixture-of-Experts architecture. The pipeline combines continual pre-training, difficulty-focused mid-training, and post-training to improve reasoning, agentic coding, multilingual ability, safety, and Korean sociocultural grounding.
summary_en.experiments: The model supports up to 256K context and expands language coverage from six to ten languages. It is evaluated across nine practical-use categories, improves over K-EXAONE, and remains competitive with open-weight models, with particularly large gains in agentic coding. The abstract does not provide token counts, data mixture details, or full baseline tables.
summary_en.authors_note: The report is from LG AI Research and belongs to the K-EXAONE open-weight foundation-model line.

recommendation.zh: 重点看 upcycling 到 750B MoE 的 recipe 和长上下文段落；若细节足够，应对内部 dense-to-MoE 扩容实验有参考。
recommendation.en: Read the upcycling-to-750B-MoE recipe and long-context sections; if details are concrete, they are useful for internal dense-to-MoE expansion ablations.

paper.title: SpecDrop: Parameter-Free Category-Conditioned Routing for Modular Specialization
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) networks pursue specialization through learned routers, gates, and load-balancing losses, yet at matched total-parameter budgets learned routers can underperform equal-weight No-Routing baselines. Is the bottleneck the routing algorithm, or the alignment between training-signal granularity and the target categories? We probe the question with SpecDrop, a fixed parameter-free routing scheme: each of $K$ branches receives weight $p_a$ for its assigned category and a small

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章研究的是模块化网络里一个常被混在一起的问题：专家是否能学出真正的 specialization，究竟取决于路由器本身，还是取决于训练信号与划分类别之间是否对齐。作者的结论很明确：在很多场景里，瓶颈不在 learned router，而在 partition granularity 和 category clarity。也就是说，如果每个训练样本天然对应一个清晰类别，哪怕不用可学习路由，只用固定的按类 dropout，也能诱导出模块分工；如果样本本身跨域、跨技能、标签模糊，换更复杂的 router 也未必有用。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练的直接启发有限，但对 MoE/模块化 specialization 的研究有一个值得记住的负面结果：不要把专家不专门化简单归咎于 router 学得不好。对于语言建模，token、sequence、document 往往天然是 fuzzy partition，一个样本同时含多主题、多技能、多风格，因此 vision 里那种按单标签类别路由的收益未必能迁移到 LM。这个结论对做 domain-aware MoE、data-aware routing、instruction-specialized adapter 的人有参考价值：如果监督标签与训练单元不对齐，增加路由复杂度可能只是增加系统负担，而不会带来稳定 specialization。它更像一篇机制澄清论文，而不是能直接搬进大规模 pretrain recipe 的方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: SpecDrop 的设计很简单，也正因为简单，实验归因更干净。模型由 shared stem、K 个并行模块和 shared head 组成。作者先定义类别到模块的固定 assignment matrix，最简单是 round-robin，把 M 个类别均匀分给 K 个模块。训练时，对属于类别 c 的样本，其被分配模块以较高 keep probability p_a 激活，其他模块以较小 leakage probability p_i 激活，不是硬路由，因此仍保留少量跨类共享梯度。多个分支输出通过一个与类别无关的固定分母 S 做归一化合并，作者给出这个 fixed denominator 的性质：它让训练和测试的前向期望一致，并把 merged branch 的量级校准到单分支尺度，避免因为 dropout 采样导致幅度漂移。还可以加一个 always-on shared expert，承担通用表示。整个方法没有 learned routing parameter，也没有 load-balancing loss。作者的核心论证不是“固定路由优于 learned routing”，而是用一个几乎最小化设计的 routing scheme 去隔离变量：如果连这种无参数方案在清晰类别划分上都能学出 specialization，而在模糊划分上不能，那么问题更可能出在 partition alignment，而不是 router sophistication。文中还设计了 information-matched masking control：给 dense model 同样的类别标签信息，只在输出侧做掩码控制，用来区分“标签本身带来的性能增益”和“通过路由诱导模块结构带来的额外作用”。这个对照做得比较到位。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖四个设置，横跨 vision 和 language。结果最强的是对齐良好的视觉分类：在 CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet-1K 的 superclass 划分上，SpecDrop 明显优于不使用标签的参数匹配基线。摘要给出的数字是：CIFAR-100 上相对 dense 提升 +4.75 个 top-1 点；ImageNet-1K 上相对 matched No-Routing+SE 提升 +6.53 点，并且在作者评测的多分支 routing baseline 中最好。与此同时，作者用 information-matched masking control 说明，如果目标只是分类精度，直接把标签信息用于 dense 输出掩码往往更强；SpecDrop 的价值不在“更会用标签”，而在“把标签转成训练出来的模块结构”。到了 fuzzy partition 的 NLP 设定，结论反过来：在 SlimPajama-6B 语言建模和基于 Llama-3.2-1B 的 SuperNI/LoRA 指令微调上，SpecDrop 与匹配架构基线基本持平，落在 seed noise 范围内，没有稳定收益。这一点很重要，因为它直接限制了方法对 LLM 预训练的外推。换句话说，文章最有信息量的结果不是视觉上的正增益，而是语言上的“没有明显增益”，并且作者把原因归到训练单元的类别模糊性，而不是实现细节不足。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，理解作者为什么把问题从“router 设计”转向“partition alignment”。然后看 Method 里的 assignment matrix、p_a/p_i dropout、fixed denominator S，这三处足够把方法吃透。实验部分重点看两类对照：一类是 aligned vision vs fuzzy NLP 的分裂结果，另一类是 information-matched masking control，它决定你如何解读性能来源。若你做 MoE 或 domain routing，预计 20 到 30 分钟能读完主线。若你做 LLM pretrain，只需要把语言实验和作者对 fuzzy partition 的解释看清楚，不必在视觉细节上停太久。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a clean question about modular specialization: when experts fail to specialize, is the problem the routing algorithm, or the granularity and clarity of the partition used to supervise specialization? The main answer is that partition alignment matters more than router sophistication. If each training unit carries a clean category label, even a fixed parameter-free routing rule can induce specialization. If the training unit is intrinsically mixed or fuzzy, better routers do not buy much.
summary_en.importance: The direct impact on LLM pretraining is limited, but the paper is useful as a cautionary result for MoE and modular design. It argues against a common reflex: blaming weak specialization on the learned router alone. In language modeling, tokens, sequences, and documents are often fuzzy mixtures of topics, skills, and styles, so the clean single-category assumptions that help in vision may not transfer. For work on domain-aware MoE, data-aware routing, or instruction-specialized adapters, the practical lesson is that routing complexity cannot compensate for poorly aligned supervision. This is more of a mechanism-clarification paper than a recipe paper for large-scale pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpecDrop is intentionally simple. The model has a shared stem, K parallel modules, and a shared head. Categories are assigned to modules through a fixed assignment matrix, implemented in the simplest case by round-robin mapping from M categories to K modules. During training, for an example with category c, the assigned module is kept with high probability p_a, while all other modules are kept with a small leakage probability p_i. So this is not hard routing; some cross-category gradient sharing remains. The branch outputs are merged using a category-independent fixed denominator S. The paper argues that this denominator makes train and test forward passes match in expectation and keeps the merged activation scale calibrated to the single-branch scale, avoiding magnitude drift from stochastic dropout. An optional always-on shared expert can capture general features. There are no learned routing parameters and no auxiliary load-balancing losses. The point is not that fixed routing is universally better than learned routing. The point is to isolate the variable: if a minimal parameter-free routing scheme already works on clean partitions and fails on fuzzy ones, then the bottleneck is likely partition alignment rather than router design. A strong part of the paper is the information-matched masking control, where the same category label is given to a dense model through output masking. This separates the value of label information itself from the value of turning that information into modular structure.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span four settings across vision and language. The strongest positive results appear in aligned vision partitions. On CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-1K with superclass labels, SpecDrop clearly outperforms parameter-matched baselines that do not use the category label. The abstract reports +4.75 top-1 over dense on CIFAR-100 and +6.53 over matched No-Routing+SE on ImageNet-1K, while also leading the multi-branch routing baselines evaluated by the authors. At the same time, the information-matched masking control shows that if the only goal is accuracy, directly using the label to mask a dense model can be even stronger. SpecDrop’s contribution is therefore not superior label usage per se, but the induction of trained modular structure. The language results are the more important constraint. On fuzzy partitions in SlimPajama-6B language modeling and SuperNI/LoRA instruction tuning over Llama-3.2-1B, SpecDrop is essentially tied with matched-architecture baselines within seed noise. That negative result is central: it limits how far the method can be extrapolated to LLM pretraining and supports the paper’s claim that partition clarity, not router complexity, is the binding condition.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and Figure 1, because they reframe the problem from router design to partition alignment. Then read the method section just far enough to understand the assignment matrix, the p_a/p_i category-conditioned dropout, and the fixed denominator S. Those three pieces are the whole method. In the experiments, focus on two comparisons: aligned vision versus fuzzy NLP, and SpecDrop versus the information-matched masking control. Those are what determine the correct interpretation of the gains. If you work on MoE or routing, 20–30 minutes is enough to get the main message. If your focus is LLM pretraining, the language experiments and the discussion of fuzzy partitions are the parts that matter most.

recommendation.zh: 结论在 CV 小模型且需推理时给标签，外推到语言 MoE 很弱；但“无参数路由打赢 learned gating”值得做个内部 ablation。
recommendation.en: Results are on small vision models and require labels at inference, so extrapolation to language MoE is weak; still worth a quick ablation on internal setups.

paper.title: Elbow-Based MoE Routing: A Training-Free Inference Time Plugin for Expert Selection
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable model scaling while maintaining low inference-time compute by activating only a subset of experts per token. However, conventional routing relies on a fixed top-k selection, forcing the model to spend the same compute regardless of how many experts are relevant. We introduce elbow-based routing, a training-free inference-time modification that dynamically adjusts the number of experts on a per-token basis. Our method examines the sorted router probability d

summary.core_problem: MoE模型传统固定top-k路由机制不区分token的专家需求度——部分仅需少量专家的token浪费算力，而需要更多专家的token可能被分配不足；现有动态路由方案均需要重新训练或超参数搜索，成本高且无法直接复用已训练完成的MoE checkpoint。
summary.importance: 提出了首个无需训练、无需额外超参数的MoE动态路由插件，可直接部署于已训练完成的MoE模型，在不损失精度的前提下降低推理延迟，为MoE推理优化提供了轻量可落地的新路径。
summary.technical_approach: 对每个token的路由概率做降序排序，使用Kneedle算法识别概率曲线的肘点（即快速衰减的头部过渡到平坦尾部的拐点），将肘点作为该token的动态激活专家数，上限为原模型的固定top-K值；该方法仅裁剪原top-K中的低概率专家，不改变专家排序或引入新路径，从信号-噪声分解角度解释：高概率头部对应与输入相关的信号专家，平坦尾部对应正交残差驱动的噪声专家，肘点即为二者的分界。
summary.experiments: 在OLMoE模型上测试，覆盖MMLU、ARC-Easy、ARC-Challenge、HellaSwag、PIQA、WinoGrande六个基准；分析超过200万条路由概率曲线，99.7%存在清晰的尖锐肘点，且肘点分布跨数据集、跨层、跨学科主题一致；随机替换肘点后的低概率专家不影响精度，替换肘点前的专家则精度显著下降；最终实现平均5.3%的推理延迟降低，同时保持精度与专家负载平衡。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第2节的肘点检测算法和信号-噪声解释，图2的尾部分布随机化实验和图3的肘点分布统计；预计阅读时间15-20分钟，适合快速了解MoE推理侧的无训练优化思路。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional fixed top-k routing in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models applies uniform expert allocation across all tokens, wasting compute on tokens that only need a small number of relevant experts while potentially under-provisioning tokens that require more. Existing dynamic routing methods all require retraining, auxiliary losses, or expensive hyperparameter grid search, limiting their deployability on finished pretrained MoE checkpoints.
summary_en.importance: This work introduces the first training-free, hyperparameter-free dynamic routing plugin for MoE models that can be directly applied to existing checkpoints. It delivers measurable latency reduction without accuracy loss, providing a lightweight, production-ready path for MoE inference optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: For each token, router probabilities are sorted in descending order. A Kneedle-style algorithm detects the elbow point on the sorted probability curve — the inflection point where the rapidly decaying high-probability head transitions to a flat low-probability tail. The number of active experts for the token is set to the minimum of the elbow index and the model's original fixed top-K value. The method only prunes low-probability experts from the original top-K set, preserving expert ordering and introducing no new routing paths. A signal-noise decomposition framework explains the approach: high-probability head experts correspond to signal aligned with input-relevant routing directions, while flat tail experts reflect noise from orthogonal residual variation, with the elbow marking the boundary between the two.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations are conducted on the OLMoE model across six benchmarks: MMLU, ARC-Easy, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, PIQA, and WinoGrande. Analysis of over 2 million router probability curves shows 99.7% have clear, sharp elbows, with elbow distributions consistent across datasets, router layers, and MMLU subject categories. Randomly replacing post-elbow low-probability experts has no measurable impact on accuracy, while replacing pre-elbow experts causes significant accuracy drops. The method achieves an average 5.3% inference latency reduction while preserving full benchmark accuracy and expert load balance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the elbow detection algorithm and signal-noise interpretation, Figure 2 for the tail randomization validation experiment, and Figure 3 for elbow distribution statistics. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes. It is suitable for a quick overview of training-free MoE inference optimization strategies.

recommendation.zh: 只看路由分布分析和 latency setup；5.3% 不大，但 training-free，值得放进 MoE serving 消融。
recommendation.en: Read the router-distribution analysis and latency setup; 5.3% is modest, but the training-free nature makes it worth a MoE serving ablation.

paper.title: LLaDA MoE v2: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer an alternative to autoregressive (AR) language modeling, yet the scaling behavior of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) dLLMs remains poorly understood. We systematically characterize how optimization hyperparameters, compute allocation, and architecture scale for MoE dLLMs, identifying quantitative differences from scaling trends previously reported for AR models. Specifically, for optimization, the optimal nominal batch size grows faster, while the optimal learnin

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 MoE diffusion language model 的 scaling recipe 问题：当训练预算变大时，batch size、learning rate、模型-数据分配，以及 MoE 的专家数、激活比例、专家粒度和 shared expert 容量应该如何一起缩放。核心点是，不能直接照搬 AR MoE 的经验，因为 dLLM 的训练目标、监督位置和条件信息结构都不同。
summary.importance: 这是对新型语言建模范式有直接价值的预训练论文。它把 diffusion LM 从“能不能训出可用模型”推进到“如何按 compute 做系统缩放”。贡献主要有三类。第一，给出 MoE dLLM 的优化超参 scaling 规律：最优 nominal batch size 随 compute 增长更快，最优 learning rate 随 compute 衰减更快。第二，通过 IsoFLOP 分析发现 MoE dLLM 在模型-数据分配上略偏数据侧，即最优 token budget 的增长快于 activated model-side computation。第三，把 MoE 架构参数化为 activation ratio、expert granularity、shared-expert ratio，并在不同 compute 下做缩放分析，指出更大规模下更倾向于在固定 activated capacity 下扩大 expert pool。最终训练出的 LLaDA MoE v2 30B-A3B 是对这些规律的验证，而不只是一个模型发布。
summary.technical_approach: 论文以 masked diffusion LM 为基础。训练时对序列中每个位置按噪声水平 t 独立替换为 [MASK]，双向 Transformer 只在 masked positions 上预测原 token；推理时从全 mask 序列出发，迭代去噪并逐步填回 token。这个目标和 AR next-token prediction 不同：AR 每个 token 只看左侧前缀，dLLM 每个被 mask 的 token 看的是被污染的全序列，且有效监督密度随 mask ratio 变化。MoE 部分使用 routed experts 加 shared expert。作者把架构写成三个变量：activation ratio A=(n_a+n_s)/(n_e+n_s)，表示每个 token 激活的专家容量占总专家容量的比例；expert granularity G=2d_model/d_expert，表示专家切分得多细；shared-expert ratio S=n_s/(n_a+n_s)，表示激活容量中多少走 shared pathway。实验上先用小中等 compute 做网格扫描，拟合最优 batch size 和 learning rate 的 power law；再用 IsoFLOP 固定训练 FLOPs，改变 activated model compute 与 token 数，估计最优模型-数据分配；最后扫描 MoE 架构变量，得到专家池规模、激活容量和 shared capacity 的设计规则。这个流程的价值在于它把 dLLM 的目标差异显式反映到 scaling 决策里，而不是把 MoE 只当作 AR Transformer 的稀疏 FFN 替换件。
summary.experiments: 最终模型 LLaDA MoE v2 是 30B 总参数、A3B activated 参数的 MoE dLLM，从头在 23.5T tokens 上预训练。论文报告它在若干知识、推理和代码 benchmark 上接近 Qwen3 30B-A3B，同时使用约 65% 的预训练 token；也以更少训练 compute 达到此前 MoE dLLM 的水平。经过标准 SFT 后，LLaDA MoE v2 在 8 个 reasoning/coding benchmark 中有 7 个超过 SDAR Chat 30B-A3B，并且在多个 benchmark 上与 Qwen3 保持可比，尽管 Qwen3 还包含额外 RL 阶段。消融和 scaling 实验的主要信息不在单点分数，而在趋势：dLLM 的最优 batch 更快变大，学习率更快变小；数据量相对 activated compute 的边际价值更高；固定每 token 激活计算时，扩大总专家池在更大规模下更有利。这些趋势都说明 dLLM MoE 的训练动态和 AR MoE 不完全一致。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Preliminaries，确认作者如何定义 masked diffusion objective，以及 MoE 的 A/G/S 三个架构变量。然后看 scaling law 相关章节和 Table 1，这是论文最核心的信息密度所在：batch、learning rate、model-data allocation、MoE architecture 四条结论都在那里汇总。IsoFLOP 图需要重点看横轴到底是 activated compute、token 数还是总参数，避免把总参数扩张误读成每 token 计算扩张。架构消融部分应关注固定 activated capacity 时增加 expert pool 的收益，以及 shared expert 的作用边界。最后再看 LLaDA MoE v2 的训练和评测，用它判断前面 scaling recipe 是否能外推到 30B-A3B、23.5T-token 量级。值得深挖的点有三个：mask ratio 下的有效监督密度如何影响 batch scaling；dLLM 的双向条件信息是否改变数据最优配比；MoE router 在 denoising 过程中是否学习到与 AR 不同的专家分工。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the scaling recipe for Mixture-of-Experts diffusion language models: how batch size, learning rate, model-data allocation, and MoE architecture should change as training compute grows. The central issue is that AR MoE heuristics cannot be copied directly because dLLMs use a masked denoising objective rather than left-to-right next-token prediction.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to pretraining research on alternative language-modeling paradigms. It moves diffusion LMs from the question of trainability to the question of compute-optimal scaling. The contribution has three main parts. First, it characterizes optimization scaling for MoE dLLMs: the optimal nominal batch size grows faster with compute, while the optimal learning rate decays faster. Second, IsoFLOP analysis shows a mild data-side tilt: the optimal token budget grows faster than activated model-side computation. Third, it studies MoE design through activation ratio, expert granularity, and shared-expert ratio, finding that larger scales increasingly favor larger expert pools at fixed activated capacity. LLaDA MoE v2 30B-A3B is then used as an end-to-end validation of the recipe, not merely as a model release.
summary_en.technical_approach: The model family is based on masked diffusion language modeling. During training, each token is independently replaced by [MASK] according to a noise level t, and a bidirectional Transformer predicts the clean tokens only at masked positions. During generation, the model starts from a fully masked sequence and iteratively denoises it. This differs from AR training in two important ways: supervision is attached to masked positions rather than every next-token conditional, and each prediction conditions on a corrupted full sequence rather than a clean prefix. The MoE layer contains routed experts plus a shared expert. The architecture is parameterized by activation ratio A=(n_a+n_s)/(n_e+n_s), expert granularity G=2d_model/d_expert, and shared-expert ratio S=n_s/(n_a+n_s). The study then performs compute-scaling sweeps: fitting power laws for optimal batch size and learning rate, running IsoFLOP experiments to trade activated model computation against training tokens, and scanning MoE architecture variables to decide how total expert capacity should be decomposed at larger scales. The key methodological point is that scaling decisions are calibrated under the dLLM objective, rather than treating MoE as a drop-in sparse FFN borrowed from AR Transformers.
summary_en.experiments: The final validation model, LLaDA MoE v2, has 30B total parameters with 3B activated parameters and is pretrained from scratch on 23.5T tokens. It approaches Qwen3 30B-A3B on several knowledge, reasoning, and coding benchmarks while using about 65% as many pretraining tokens. It also matches a prior MoE dLLM trained without this scaling guidance at a fraction of the compute. After standard SFT, LLaDA MoE v2 outperforms SDAR Chat 30B-A3B on seven of eight reasoning and coding benchmarks and remains competitive with Qwen3 on multiple benchmarks, even though Qwen3 includes an additional RL stage. The most important experimental results are the scaling trends rather than any single benchmark number: larger compute prefers faster-growing batch size, faster-decaying learning rate, more tokens relative to activated compute, and larger expert pools under fixed activated capacity. These are concrete signs that MoE dLLMs have training dynamics that differ from AR MoE models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully. Start with the preliminaries to pin down the masked diffusion objective and the A/G/S MoE parameterization. Then focus on the scaling-law sections and Table 1, which contain the main practical conclusions for batch size, learning rate, model-data allocation, and MoE architecture. In the IsoFLOP plots, check whether the axis refers to activated compute, token count, or total parameters; otherwise it is easy to confuse capacity growth with per-token compute growth. In the architecture ablations, look for the effect of increasing the expert pool at fixed activated capacity and for the role of shared experts. Read the LLaDA MoE v2 training and evaluation section last, as an extrapolation test of the recipe at the 30B-A3B and 23.5T-token scale. The deeper questions to track are how mask-ratio-dependent supervision changes batch scaling, whether bidirectional corrupted context changes the data-optimal point, and whether the MoE router learns a different specialization pattern under denoising than under AR prediction.

recommendation.zh: MoE+dLLM 第一批系统 scaling 数据，batch/LR/data-model 分配三条曲线都与 AR 不同；做 diffusion LM 或 MoE 训练的应直接对照内部 recipe 复现。
recommendation.en: First systematic scaling data for MoE diffusion LMs; batch/LR/data-model curves all diverge from AR priors—directly actionable for anyone training dLLMs or MoE.

paper.title: AcceptMoE: Commitment-Weighted Self-Sizing Verifier Expert Sets for Efficient MoE Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding verifies a tree of draft tokens in one target-model forward pass. For a mixture-of-experts (MoE) target, however, parallel verification can activate the union of the experts selected by all tree nodes, even though only a small subset of those nodes reaches the accepted output. Token count, activated-expert union size, and expert-weight traffic are therefore distinct cost measures: reducing the token workload need not shrink the expert union proportionally, and under offloadi

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 MoE 目标模型做 speculative decoding 时的 verifier 侧专家访问成本问题：验证 token 变少，不代表被激活的专家并集也按比例变小，尤其在 expert offloading 场景下，真正昂贵的是非驻留专家权重传输。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 MoE 基座模型的 serving 和架构实验有参考价值。论文把 speculative decoding 的成本拆成三个不同量：token 数、activated-expert union size、expert-weight traffic。这个拆分很实用，因为 MoE 推理瓶颈常常不是算子 FLOPs，而是专家权重访问和搬运。对研究者的启发是：评估 MoE 解码优化时，不能只看 accepted tokens 或 target forward 次数，还要看专家并集、cache residency 和路由扰动带来的精度变化。
summary.technical_approach:
AcceptMoE 是 verifier-side expert selector。它不改变 draft 生成逻辑，而是在 target verifier 对一个 speculative verification block 做验证时，限制每层可用的专家集合。

方法有三步。第一，构造 commitment-weighted expert demand。对每个 draft position，作者离线估计该位置节点最终被 committed 到输出中的概率，再用这个概率加权 target router 的自然 top-k 专家分数。这样，越可能进入最终输出的位置，对专家需求的贡献越大；越可能被丢弃的分支，对专家选择的影响越小。它区别于 MoE-Spec 的地方是，MoE-Spec 对 verification block 内位置做近似均匀聚合，并要求外部给定固定专家预算 B。

第二，自适应决定专家集合大小。AcceptMoE 总是保留 root token 的自然 top-k 专家作为 anchor，避免根位置路由被破坏；其余专家按 weighted demand 排序选择。集合大小由 demand 分布的 effective rank 决定，即 exp(entropy)。需求越集中，集合越小；需求越分散，集合越大。因此它不需要预先为每个模型-任务组合调一个固定 B。

第三，针对 expert offloading 做 residency-aware pruning。若某些被选中的专家当前不在 GPU 上，方法会按 commitment-weighted demand 从低到高剪掉一部分非驻留专家，同时受 rerouting budget 和 minimum set size 约束。这样专家 eligibility 会考虑缓存状态，而不是单纯预测自然路由并预取。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 3 个 MoE target、4 个任务，共 12 个 model-task pairs，并在 SGLang serving stack 中做 batch size 1 的端到端测量。论文还指出一个动机数字：在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上，EVICT 相比 EAGLE-3 减少了 74.7% verified tokens，但 activated experts 只减少了 32.5%，说明 token 维度优化不能直接转化为专家权重访问优化。

核心结果如下。与 MoE-Spec 在匹配的 per-pair fixed budget B0 下比较，AcceptMoE-B 的平均 accuracy 高 2.45 个百分点。自适应 self-sized 版本在五个做 budget sweep 的模型-任务组合上，平均只比实测最佳 fixed-budget 点低 0.97 个百分点，最大差距 1.83 个百分点。offloading 场景中，residency-aware pruning 相比不剪枝版本减少 38.6% 到 48.6% 的 expert-weight traffic，平均 accuracy 变化为 -0.27 个百分点，单 pair 范围为 -1.83 到 +1.22 个百分点。

端到端结果中，AcceptMoE 相比 Standard SD，即使用 target 自然路由的 EAGLE-3 speculative decoding，平均 accuracy 低 0.27 个百分点。在全专家驻留时吞吐达到 Standard SD 的 1.290 倍，并在一张 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 上达到最高 257 tokens/s。在 expert offloading 的一张 RTX 5090 上达到 2.06 倍吞吐，同时减少 73.6% 到 77.1% 的 host-to-device traffic。
summary.reading_guide:
建议泛读，预计 25-35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 MoE speculative decoding 成本的拆分，以及 Method 中 commitment-weighted demand、effective-rank self-sizing、residency-aware pruning 三个模块。实验部分重点看三类表：与 MoE-Spec 的 matched-budget accuracy 对比，self-sized 与 fixed-budget sweep 的差距，offloading 下的 traffic 和 throughput。

如果只关心预训练方向，可以略读实现细节，保留两个观察：MoE 推理优化需要显式度量专家并集和权重搬运；路由限制带来的精度损失可以通过 commitment probability 和 root anchor 缓解。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets verifier-side expert traffic in MoE speculative decoding. Reducing the number of verified draft tokens does not necessarily reduce the union of activated experts, and under expert offloading the dominant cost is often the transfer of nonresident expert weights.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-systems paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is useful for researchers working with MoE base models. Its most useful point is the separation of three cost measures: token workload, activated-expert union size, and expert-weight traffic. For MoE models, decoding efficiency cannot be evaluated only by accepted tokens or target forward passes. The expert union and cache residency can dominate latency and bandwidth.
summary_en.technical_approach:
AcceptMoE is a verifier-side expert selector. It leaves the draft mechanism intact, but restricts the set of target experts eligible during verification of a speculative block.

The first component is commitment-weighted expert demand. For each draft position, the method uses an offline estimate of the probability that a node at that position will be committed to the final output. It multiplies this commitment probability by the target router’s natural top-k probabilities, then aggregates the weighted demand over the verification block. Positions likely to survive receive more weight; branches likely to be discarded receive less. This differs from MoE-Spec, which aggregates router mass more uniformly and requires a fixed expert budget B.

The second component is self-sizing. AcceptMoE always preserves the root token’s natural top-k experts as anchors. It then ranks non-anchor experts by weighted demand. The number of selected experts is derived from the effective rank of the demand distribution, computed as the exponential of entropy. Concentrated demand yields a smaller set; diffuse demand yields a larger set. This removes the need to tune a fixed budget for every model-task pair.

The third component is residency-aware pruning for offloading. Among selected nonresident experts, the method prunes low-demand experts first, subject to a rerouting budget and a minimum set size. Expert eligibility therefore depends on the current cache residency instead of only on predicted natural routes or a fixed prefetch schedule.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover 3 MoE targets and 4 tasks, giving 12 model-task pairs, with end-to-end measurements in SGLang at batch size 1. The motivation is supported by a concrete example on Qwen3-30B-A3B: EVICT reduces verified tokens by 74.7% relative to EAGLE-3, but reduces activated experts by only 32.5%.

At matched per-pair fixed budgets, AcceptMoE-B improves mean accuracy by 2.45 percentage points over MoE-Spec. In five budget-swept pairs, the self-sized configuration is on average 0.97 percentage points below the best measured fixed-budget point, with a maximum gap of 1.83 points. With offloading, residency-aware pruning reduces expert-weight traffic by 38.6% to 48.6% compared with the same selector without pruning. The mean accuracy change is -0.27 percentage points, with per-pair changes ranging from -1.83 to +1.22 points.

End to end, AcceptMoE is 0.27 percentage points lower in mean accuracy than Standard SD, defined as EAGLE-3 speculative decoding with the target’s natural routing. With all experts resident, it reaches 1.290x the throughput of Standard SD and up to 257 tokens/s on one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell. Under expert offloading on one RTX 5090, it reaches 2.06x throughput and reduces host-to-device traffic by 73.6% to 77.1%.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim time is about 25-35 minutes. Start with the Introduction’s cost decomposition for MoE speculative decoding. Then read the Method section for the three main pieces: commitment-weighted demand, effective-rank self-sizing, and residency-aware pruning. In the experiments, focus on the matched-budget comparison against MoE-Spec, the self-sized versus fixed-budget sweep, and the offloading traffic and throughput tables.

For pretraining-oriented readers, the implementation details can be read lightly. The main takeaway is that MoE serving metrics should include expert union size and weight movement, not only token-level speculative decoding statistics. The root-anchor and commitment-weighting design are also useful examples of how to constrain MoE routing without causing large accuracy loss.

recommendation.zh: 针对MoE推测解码的核心痛点（专家并集膨胀），核心看§3的commitment probability估计方法和§4的卸载适配逻辑，做MoE推理的可复现
recommendation.en: Targets the core pain point of MoE speculative decoding (expert union bloat); focus on §3 commitment probability estimation and §4 offloading adaptation, reproducible for MoE inference teams

paper.title: Tevatron Meets Megatron: Expert-Parallel LLM Reranker Training on an Academic Budget
paper.abstract: Modern reranking recipes---billion-scale cross-encoders, mixture-of-experts (MoE) backbones, and distillation against strong teachers---have outpaced the training infrastructure available to most academic groups. Existing Tevatron reranker training relies on the Hugging Face Trainer with DeepSpeed or PyTorch FSDP1, but these backends lack efficient support for large-scale MoE training. We present Tevatron 3.0, which integrates a Megatron-Core training backend into Tevatron while preserving its d

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是 LLM reranker 训练的工程可复现性问题：现代 reranker 已经转向十亿级 cross-encoder、蒸馏训练和 MoE backbone，但常用的 Tevatron + Hugging Face Trainer + DeepSpeed/FSDP1 路径在可靠性、吞吐和专家并行上都跟不上。目标不是提出新的 reranking 损失，而是把 Megatron-Core 后端接入 Tevatron，使 dense 和 MoE reranker 能在较有限的学术算力下训练和评估。
summary.importance: 对预训练方向的直接贡献有限，因为它主要服务 reranker 训练和检索系统。但它对大模型训练系统有现实参考：MoE 不能只靠参数分片解决，专家路由需要 expert parallelism；FSDP1 能跑通不等于吞吐合理；保持数据路径、评测接口和 HF checkpoint 兼容，能显著降低训练后端迁移成本。对做 MoE post-training、检索增强模型训练、cross-encoder 蒸馏的人，这类系统细节比单个榜单分数更有用。
summary.technical_approach: Tevatron 3.0 在原有 Tevatron 2.0 上增加 Megatron 训练后端，保留数据读取、collator、评测流程和 Hugging Face 可加载 checkpoint 格式。权重通过 HFMegatron bridge 转换。dense 8B reranker 使用 Megatron 的分布式优化器和 tensor parallelism；MoE reranker 使用 Megatron expert parallelism，避免 FSDP1 对专家层的复制再分片。系统还支持 LoRA、全参数微调、listwise-KL 蒸馏和 contrastive loss，并提供统一评测接口：一种用于本地 ranklist scoring，另一种通过 HTTP 调用 HF/vLLM scoring server pool 做 rerank-and-score。论文还加入了 MoE LoRA target-group registry，确保低秩适配正确作用到专家层。
summary.experiments: 系统评估主要围绕可训练性、吞吐和端到端效果。作者比较了 DDP、FSDP1 的 shard_grad_op/full_shard，以及 Megatron 后端。DDP 在 8B reranker 上会 OOM；FSDP1 能省显存但吞吐不理想，full_shard 相比较轻的 shard_grad_op 没有带来对应速度收益。Megatron 推荐配置训练 dense 8B 约快 22%，并能保持与 FSDP 训练相当的质量。MoE 方面，Qwen3-30B-A3B 这类 30B 总参数、A3B 激活参数、128 experts 的 reranker 可以用 expert parallelism 训练，而 FSDP1 路径无法高效支持。端到端演示覆盖 dense 8B 与 MoE 30B-A3B、LoRA 与全参、listwise-KL 与 contrastive，在 BEIR-15 上用三种 first-stage retriever 评测；示例结果显示 MoE reranker 在低于 dense 8B 一半激活参数的情况下达到相近质量，并有更高推理吞吐。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看系统设计章节，尤其是 Megatron backend 如何接入 Tevatron 数据路径、checkpoint 转换和评测接口。后端 profiling 部分比 BEIR 分数更重要，可以关注 FSDP1、distributed optimizer、tensor parallelism 和 expert parallelism 的对比。MoE LoRA target registry 适合做 MoE 微调的人细看。端到端 BEIR 实验可快速浏览，主要确认系统能覆盖常见训练 recipe，不宜把它当作新的 reranker 方法论文来读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a systems bottleneck in training LLM-based rerankers. Modern reranking recipes use billion-scale cross-encoders, distillation, and increasingly MoE backbones, while the existing Tevatron path through Hugging Face Trainer, DeepSpeed, and PyTorch FSDP1 is unreliable or inefficient for these workloads. The goal is to make dense and MoE reranker training reproducible under an academic-scale budget by adding a Megatron-Core backend to Tevatron.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for researchers who train large post-training or retrieval models. The paper makes a practical point: parameter sharding alone is not enough for MoE training, because routed experts need expert parallelism. It also shows that a memory-safe FSDP configuration can still be throughput-poor. The compatibility choices are important: keeping the same data path, evaluation pipeline, and Hugging Face-loadable checkpoint format reduces the cost of switching training backends.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tevatron 3.0 adds a Megatron training backend while preserving Tevatron’s existing data pipeline, collator, evaluation interface, and checkpoint conventions. The implementation uses bridge-based HFMegatron weight conversion. For dense rerankers, the backend uses a Megatron-style distributed optimizer with tensor parallelism. For MoE rerankers, it uses expert parallelism so that active experts are routed and parallelized properly rather than replicated and sharded as ordinary parameters. The toolkit supports LoRA, full-parameter tuning, listwise-KL distillation, and contrastive training. It also adds a unified evaluation layer with local ranklist scoring and remote rerank-and-score through HF or vLLM scoring servers. A named LoRA target-group registry is introduced so adapters can be attached correctly to MoE expert layers.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation focuses on trainability and throughput. For an 8B reranker, DDP runs out of memory. FSDP1 configurations fit but have limited throughput, and full_shard does not deliver a meaningful speed advantage over lighter sharding. The recommended Megatron configuration trains the dense 8B reranker about 22% faster while matching FSDP-trained quality. For MoE, the system trains a 30B-A3B reranker with 128 experts using expert parallelism, a setting that the FSDP1 path cannot support efficiently. The end-to-end demonstration sweeps dense 8B versus MoE 30B-A3B, LoRA versus full-parameter tuning, and listwise-KL distillation versus contrastive loss, evaluated on BEIR-15 with three first-stage retrievers. The reported demonstration shows the MoE reranker matching dense-8B quality with less than half the activated parameters and better inference throughput.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the system design and backend characterization.
