They then propose EAACD, an expert-aware adaptive contrastive decoding method that partitions high-layer experts by factual versus non-factual activation patterns and uses the contrast during generation.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments target QA hallucination mitigation. The abstract reports that standard layer-wise differences are absent in shared-expert MoEs, while upper-layer expert activations differ between factual and non-factual outputs across MoE models. EAACD uses this signal to reduce hallucinations, but the abstract does not specify model sizes, baselines, or numeric gains.
summary_en.authors_note: National University of Defense Technology.

recommendation.zh: 只看专家激活分析即可；解码方法偏工程补丁，但“shared expert 破坏层间对比”是有用弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the expert-activation analysis; the decoding method is a patch, but shared experts breaking layer-wise contrast is a useful weak signal.

paper.title: Solar Open 2 Technical Report
paper.abstract: We present Solar Open 2, a 250B-A15B Mixture-of-Experts language model built for long-horizon agentic tasks, scaled up from Solar Open 1 (Solar Open 100B). To hold entire agent trajectories in a single context, Solar Open 2 reaches a 1M-token window through a hybrid attention stack that interleaves one softmax layer among every three linear-attention layers, using no positional encoding and a gated delta rule extended to negative eigenvalues. To train at this scale under a fixed compute budget,

summary.core_problem: 在固定计算预算下训练一个面向长程agent任务的250B-A15B MoE语言模型，并把上下文窗口扩到1M token。
summary.importance: 这是一个大模型技术报告，价值主要在三点：长上下文架构、跨架构初始化、以及按token价值做预训练数据筛选和配比。它直接触及预训练研究中的架构-数据-计算预算取舍。
summary.technical_approach: Solar Open 2采用混合注意力栈：每三个线性注意力层插入一个softmax注意力层，不使用位置编码，并把gated delta rule扩展到负特征值场景。训练上从Solar Open 1迁移5.69B共享骨架参数，其余部分继续完整预训练。数据上从20T token池中做质量、稀有度感知筛选和mixture-ratio优化，形成10T token训练混合。
summary.experiments: 模型规模为250B总参数、15B激活参数，目标上下文长度为1M token。摘要称10T高价值混合在相同token预算下优于未说明的对照混合，并以Solar Open 1作为起点；具体benchmark、消融和长上下文稳定性结果需要看正文表格。

summary_en.core_problem: The report describes how to train a 250B-A15B MoE language model for long-horizon agentic workloads with a 1M-token context window under a fixed compute budget.
summary_en.importance: The main value is the combination of long-context architecture, cross-architecture warm start, and value-per-token data curation. These are central pretraining tradeoffs rather than downstream tuning details.
summary_en.technical_approach: Solar Open 2 uses a hybrid attention stack with one softmax attention layer interleaved after every three linear-attention layers, no positional encoding, and a gated delta rule extended to negative eigenvalues. It initializes the 5.69B-parameter shared skeleton from Solar Open 1 and pretrains the remaining parameters. Its data pipeline refines a 20T-token pool into a 10T-token mixture using quality, rarity, and mixture-ratio optimization.
summary_en.experiments: The model is reported as 250B total parameters with 15B active parameters and a 1M-token context length. The abstract claims that the curated 10T-token mixture outperforms alternatives at equal token budget, but detailed benchmark numbers and ablations are not present in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 应看架构和数据消融：1M上下文若能靠3:1线性/softmax混合稳住，值得立刻纳入内部长上下文预训练对照。
recommendation.en: Read the architecture and data ablations: if the 3:1 linear/softmax stack really holds at 1M context, it belongs in internal long-context pretraining comparisons.

paper.title: BaseRT: Advancing Best-in-Class LLM Inference with Apple M5 Neural Accelerators
paper.abstract: Apple's M5 generation introduces a redesigned GPU architecture in which every core carries a dedicated Neural Accelerator: on-die matrix units exposed through the Metal~4 tensor API. We show that BaseRT, our native Metal inference runtime for large language models on Apple Silicon, exploits these units to push inference throughput on Apple hardware substantially beyond both llama.cpp and MLX. Building on BaseRT's framework-free design, we add a family of hand-written Metal~4 tensor-core kernels

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 Apple M5 上 LLM 推理 runtime 如何用好新增的 Neural Accelerators。关键问题不是再做一个通用推理框架，而是判断 transformer 推理中哪些算子受计算限制、哪些受内存带宽限制，并只把适合矩阵单元的部分迁移到 Metal 4 tensor API。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是核心论文，但对基座模型研究有系统侧参考价值。原因是本地推理和小集群推理正在影响模型设计取舍，例如 MoE 路由、量化格式、prefill/decode 比例、长上下文吞吐和端侧可部署性。论文给出的经验很明确：专用矩阵单元主要改善 prefill 和 MoE 中的 GEMM，decode 阶段仍主要受内存带宽约束。这对评估架构在真实硬件上的收益有帮助，尤其是不要把峰值算力提升简单等同于端到端 token 速度提升。
summary.technical_approach: BaseRT 是一个直接基于 Apple Metal 的 LLM 推理 runtime，不依赖中间框架。作者在原有 BaseRT 的基础上加入一组手写 Metal 4 cooperative-tensor kernels，用来驱动 M5 每个 GPU core 上的 Neural Accelerator。覆盖的核心算子包括 dense GEMM、MoE expert GEMM、融合 expert projections，以及 prefill attention 中的 QK^T 和 PV 乘法。调度策略是 workload-aware：prefill 和 MoE 这类计算密集阶段走 tensor-core 路径；decode 阶段继续使用已有的专用 kernel，因为单 token decode 更容易被 KV-cache 读取和内存带宽限制，tensor unit 很难带来同等收益。对 M5 之前的硬件则保留 SIMD fallback。这个取舍比“所有 matmul 都上 tensor API”更稳，因为它按瓶颈分配 kernel，而不是按算子名称分配硬件。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Apple M5 Pro 上进行，覆盖 15 个模型配置，并与 llama.cpp 和 MLX 对比。结果集中体现在 prompt processing/prefill 和 MoE 推理上：相对 llama.cpp，prefill 吞吐最高达到 6.4 倍提升；相对 MLX 也有明显优势。decode 的提升较小，并且受到内存带宽上限约束。这个结果和作者的调度假设一致：M5 Neural Accelerators 对大块矩阵乘法有效，但不能绕开自回归 decode 中 KV-cache 访问、低 batch、访存占比高的问题。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。Introduction 可以快速扫过，重点放在 M5 GPU 与 Metal 4 tensor operations 的背景说明、kernel 设计、workload-aware dispatch，以及实验中 prefill/decode 分开的吞吐图表。读这篇不需要纠结端侧市场叙述，真正有用的是两个工程判断：一是 tensor cores 适合计算密集的 prefill 和 MoE GEMM；二是 decode 优化仍要围绕内存布局、KV-cache、量化和 dispatch overhead 做文章。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how an LLM inference runtime on Apple M5 should use the new per-core Neural Accelerators. The key issue is not simply exposing a tensor API, but deciding which parts of transformer inference are compute-bound enough to benefit from the matrix units and which parts remain limited by memory bandwidth.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is useful systems context for foundation model work. Hardware behavior affects practical architecture choices, including MoE deployment, quantization formats, prefill/decode balance, long-context serving, and on-device model design. The main lesson is clear: dedicated matrix units help most in prefill and MoE GEMMs, while autoregressive decode is still largely constrained by memory traffic. That distinction is important when translating peak compute improvements into actual token throughput.
summary_en.technical_approach: BaseRT is a native Metal runtime for LLM inference on Apple Silicon, avoiding an intermediate framework layer. The paper extends it with hand-written Metal 4 cooperative-tensor kernels that target the M5 Neural Accelerators. The covered kernels include dense GEMM, MoE expert GEMM, fused expert projections, and the QK^T and PV products in prefill attention. The dispatch policy is workload-aware: compute-bound prefill and MoE paths use the tensor-core kernels, while the memory-bound decode path stays on BaseRT’s existing specialized kernels. Pre-M5 hardware falls back to the SIMD path. This is the main engineering choice: the runtime routes work based on the bottleneck profile, not just on whether an operation is a matrix multiplication.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation runs on an Apple M5 Pro across fifteen model configurations and compares against llama.cpp and MLX. The largest gains appear in prompt processing and MoE inference. Prefill throughput is reported up to 6.4x higher than llama.cpp. Decode gains are much smaller and bounded by memory bandwidth, matching the expected behavior of single-token autoregressive generation with KV-cache traffic and low arithmetic intensity. The results support the paper’s dispatch design: Neural Accelerators help when large matrix products dominate, but they do not remove the main bottlenecks in decode.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 20–30 minutes. The useful parts are the description of the M5 GPU and Metal 4 tensor operations, the kernel design, the workload-aware dispatch policy, and the evaluation figures that separate prefill from decode. The broader motivation for on-device inference can be read quickly. The durable engineering takeaway is that tensor-core optimization should target compute-heavy prefill and MoE paths, while decode still requires attention to memory layout, KV-cache movement, quantization, and dispatch overhead.

recommendation.zh: 做 pretrain 的不用通读，但如果你关心 serving 反哺架构设计，重点看它对 prefill/ decode 分治和 MoE GEMM kernel 的处理，里面有真实系统味道。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining reading, but worth skimming if serving constraints inform your architecture choices; focus on the prefill/decode split and MoE GEMM kernel design.

paper.title: Multi-level context Modeling for consistent expert selection in Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) enables efficient scaling of Transformer models by routing tokens to a small subset of experts. However, existing routers typically condition expert selection on shallow or isolated token representations, which often produce unstable and semantically inconsistent routing decisions across layers. In this work, we revisit expert selection from a representation perspective and identify context incompleteness as a key bottleneck limiting effective expert specialization. To a

summary.core_problem: MoE 路由器只依赖当前层、当前 token 的局部表示，容易导致跨层专家选择不一致、同一语义片段内路由不连贯，进而削弱专家分工。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对 MoE 预训练的启发在于：路由质量不只取决于 top-k、负载均衡或路由正则，路由输入表示本身也可能是瓶颈。它把问题定位为“上下文不完整”，并尝试用跨层语义信息和局部 token 关系来稳定专家选择。贡献更偏 MoE router 设计，量级属于可泛读的结构改进；是否能用于大规模基座预训练，还要看额外显存、通信和延迟成本。
summary.technical_approach: MCF-MOE 的核心做法是先构造更完整的路由表示，再做专家选择。第一部分是跨层语义聚合：当前层 hidden state 生成 query，过去 k 层 hidden state 加上层索引 embedding 后作为 key/value，通过带 causal mask 的跨层 attention 聚合历史层信息，避免自回归场景下看到未来 token。第二部分是局部语义一致性建模：在固定半径窗口内建模 token 之间的相似性和局部关系，让相邻或语义相关 token 的路由更连贯。与 HyperRouter、RMOE 这类偏路由参数生成或跨层激活记忆的方法不同，MCF-MOE 更强调路由前的表示构造。代价是需要维护历史层输出缓存，并引入额外 attention 或局部相似度计算；在长序列和大模型 MoE 中，这部分开销需要单独评估。
summary.experiments: 给出的全文片段展示了两类诊断：全局跨层一致性和局部语义一致性。作者观察到常规 MoE 的跨层专家分配一致性很低，序列内部的语义连贯性也不稳定，并据此引出 MCF-MOE。实验部分声称在多个 benchmark 上改善下游表现，并提升专家选择一致性，但提供的内容没有包含具体模型规模、数据规模、benchmark 名称、提升数字或消融表。泛读时应重点确认两个问题：跨层聚合和局部融合各自贡献多少；性能收益是否超过额外训练与推理开销。
summary.reading_guide: 建议用 20–30 分钟泛读。优先看 Figure 1 的路由一致性诊断，因为这是方法成立的主要依据。然后看 Method 中跨层 attention 的 causal 设计、历史层缓存方式、局部窗口融合方式。实验部分如果可获取，应直接查三类结果：下游任务增益、路由一致性指标、计算开销。若没有大模型规模或真实 MoE 预训练实验，这篇更适合作为 router 表示设计的参考，而不是训练 recipe 依据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses unstable and semantically inconsistent expert routing in MoE models, caused by routers that rely on shallow, layer-local token representations.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is that MoE routing should not be treated only as a top-k selection or load-balancing problem. The representation fed into the router can be under-specified. The work proposes to make routing decisions from richer contextual evidence across layers and within local token neighborhoods. This is a router-design contribution rather than a full-scale pretraining recipe, and its practical impact depends on the memory and latency overhead introduced by cross-layer caches and extra context fusion.
summary_en.technical_approach: MCF-MOE builds a context-enriched routing representation before expert selection. It first performs cross-layer semantic aggregation: the current layer hidden states form queries, while hidden states from the previous k layers, augmented with layer-index embeddings, provide keys and values. A causal mask is used so that autoregressive generation does not leak future-token information. It then adds local similarity-aware fusion over a fixed-radius token neighborhood to capture fine-grained sequence structure. Compared with methods that modify routing parameters or maintain expert-activation memory, the main change here is the construction of the router input itself. The trade-off is extra hidden-state storage and additional attention or similarity computation, which may matter in long-context and large-scale MoE training.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text reports two diagnostics: low global cross-layer consistency of expert assignments and weak local semantic coherence within sequences. The authors claim improved downstream performance and more consistent expert specialization across multiple benchmarks, but the supplied content does not include model sizes, training data scale, benchmark names, numerical gains, or ablation tables. The key experiments to verify are the separate contributions of cross-layer aggregation and local fusion, and whether the routing gains justify the added compute and memory cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Start with Figure 1, since the routing-consistency diagnosis is the main motivation. Then inspect the method details around causal cross-layer attention, historical hidden-state caching, and local-window fusion. If the full experimental section is available, focus on downstream gains, routing-consistency metrics, and overhead measurements. Without large-scale MoE pretraining evidence, the paper is best read as a router-representation idea rather than as a production training recipe.

recommendation.zh: 只看路由一致性定义和消融即可；若实验规模偏小，可当作 MoE router 表示设计的弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the routing-consistency metric and ablations; if the scale is small, treat it as a weak signal for MoE router representation design.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen)
Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University

paper.title: Half the Experts, All the Code: One-Shot Domain Pruning of Mixture-of-Experts LLMs for Coding
paper.abstract: The strongest open-weight coding models are mixture-of-experts (MoE) networks: most of their size comes from large pools of "expert" subnetworks, of which only a few act on any token. That pool is why these models do not fit on the machines most developers own, yet for a user who only wants coding help, most experts encode abilities that will never be invoked. We ask how many experts can be removed, and which, by pruning two recent open-weight MoE models from different families (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B

summary.core_problem: 研究面向代码使用场景时，开源 MoE LLM 能否一次性剪掉大量 expert 而不明显损害代码能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 MoE 推理压缩和专家专门化分析。它对预训练研究员的价值不在于剪枝 recipe 本身，而在于给出一个可检验信号：MoE 的 expert capacity 可能对不同能力高度非均匀，且通用 perplexity 不一定能预测领域能力保留。
summary.technical_approach: 对两个不同家族的开源 MoE 编码模型 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 与 Gemma-4-26B-A4B 做 one-shot domain pruning。比较五种 expert 选择策略，用代码 benchmark 的正确性而不是困惑度来决定剪枝是否成功，并观察能力损失是否集中在非代码任务。
summary.experiments: 摘要称两个模型都可以移除约一半 expert，在主要代码 benchmark 上没有统计显著下降；损失主要出现在代码外能力。最优剪枝策略在两个模型家族之间相反，说明跨架构迁移不稳。摘要还指出 perplexity 与用户关心的代码正确性不完全一致，但后续细节被截断。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether open-weight MoE LLMs can drop many experts in a single pass while preserving coding performance.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is MoE inference compression plus an analysis of expert specialization. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is that expert capacity may be highly uneven across capabilities, and generic perplexity may be a weak proxy for domain retention.
summary_en.technical_approach: It prunes two open-weight MoE coding models from different families, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B, using five expert-selection strategies. The pruning decision is judged by code correctness rather than perplexity, and the analysis tracks whether damage appears mostly outside coding.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that roughly half of the experts can be removed from either model without a statistically detectable loss on the primary coding benchmark. Most degradation appears on non-coding abilities. The best selection strategy flips across model families, and perplexity is reported as an unreliable guide, though the provided abstract is truncated before full details.

recommendation.zh: 只看剪枝策略对比和 perplexity 失效部分；它会提醒你 MoE 路由分析不能只看平均 loss。
recommendation.en: Skim the pruning-strategy comparison and the perplexity failure cases; it is a useful warning against reading MoE routing only through average loss.

paper.title: LookME: Lookup-Based Multimodal Embeddings for Layer Injection in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong progress in multimodal understanding. However, scaling dense or sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models to improve performance limits deployment in resource-constrained environments due to the trade-off between high memory usage from full loading and increased latency from on-demand loading. Recently, the Per-Layer Embedding (PLE) architecture addresses this by scaling models with large external embedding tables stored in ROM and performing light

summary.core_problem: 把 Per-Layer Embedding（PLE）的查表式参数扩展从纯文本推广到多模态 VLM，缓解 MoE 扩容带来的显存/延迟矛盾。
summary.importance: 工程型架构扩展：用 ROM 存储大 embedding 表 + 按需查表替代全量加载 MoE，思路对边缘部署有参考。
summary.technical_approach: LookME：为 VLM 设计多模态 lookup-based embedding，支持分区存储和按需加载，在层注入时用查表增强 token 表示，适配视觉 token 而非仅文本 ID。
summary.experiments: 在 VLM 上对比 dense/sparse MoE 与 PLE 基线，报告显存、延迟与视觉任务精度权衡。

summary_en.core_problem: Extend Per-Layer Embedding (PLE) lookup-based parameter scaling from text-only to multimodal VLMs, mitigating the memory/latency trade-off of MoE scaling.
summary_en.importance: Engineering-oriented architecture extension: large ROM-resident embedding tables with on-demand lookup replace full MoE loading, relevant to edge deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: LookME: multimodal lookup-based embeddings for VLMs with partitioned storage and on-demand loading, injecting retrieved embeddings per layer to enhance token representations beyond text IDs.
summary_en.experiments: Compared against dense/sparse MoE and PLE baselines on VLMs, reporting memory, latency, and vision-task accuracy trade-offs.

recommendation.zh: 把 PLE 查表扩容搬到多模态，属部署侧工程增量；作为 ROM-based 参数化思路备查，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Extends PLE lookup-scaling to multimodal; an engineering-side deployment variant—file it as literature, skip the body.

paper.title: QUADS: Stabilizing NVFP4 Reinforcement Learning for MoE via QUantization-error Alignment across Dual Sides
paper.abstract: Rollout generation is a major bottleneck in Reinforcement Learning (RL) for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Large Language Models, motivating low-precision rollout acceleration such as FP8. As an emerging low-precision format, NVFP4 combines fine-grained scaling for accuracy preservation with native W4A4 FP4 GEMMs for higher throughput than FP8. However, we find that directly applying NVFP4 to MoE RL rollout is impractical. NVFP4 rollout with BF16 training collapses after roughly 150 steps, accompanied

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很具体的工程—算法接口问题：在 MoE 大模型的 RL 训练里，rollout 端如果用 Blackwell 上原生 W4A4 的 NVFP4 来提速，会因为 rollout 与 trainer 的 log-probability 偏差迅速放大而训练崩溃。作者要找出的不是“低精度会不会掉点”这种泛泛结论，而是：崩溃主要来自权重量化还是激活量化；如果主要来自激活误差，那么在 rollout 和 trainer 分离的 RL 管线里，怎样做误差对齐，才能既保住 W4A4 吞吐，又不破坏 GRPO 的策略梯度稳定性。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口、训练稳定性和低精度系统设计很有参考价值。原因有两点。第一，RL 训练越来越像一个分布式异构系统问题，rollout 精度不只是 serving 细节，而是直接进入 importance ratio 和 policy update 的训练信号。第二，这篇工作把“低精度不稳定”拆成了可操作的误差来源分析，指出在 NVFP4 这种极低比特格式下，激活误差比权重误差更致命，而两者不能用同一种对齐策略处理。这个结论对未来更激进的低精度 pretrain / mid-train 也有启发：如果训练和推理路径不一致，先分清哪些张量可同步、哪些张量是在线重算的，往往比统一做 fake quant 更关键。贡献量级属于强工程方法论文，尤其适合关注 RL 系统、MoE 和 Blackwell 低精度栈的人。
summary.technical_approach: 作者的方法叫 QUADS，核心是 dual-side quantization-error alignment，也就是 trainer 侧和 rollout 侧分别处理不同来源的误差，而不是试图用一个统一的量化方案覆盖全部路径。诊断部分先做了关键 ablation：把 rollout 中的权重和激活分开量化，比较 W4A16 与 W16A4。结果显示 W16A4 的失败模式几乎贴近完整 W4A4，而 W4A16 明显更稳定，说明 activation quantization 才是主导项，且权重误差与激活误差近似可加。基于这个发现，QUADS 分两部分。其一是 trainer-side asymmetric QAT：在训练端只对权重做 NVFP4 fake quantization / dequantization，对激活保持 BF16。这样做的原因很直接：权重在 rollout engine 与 trainer 之间是同步参数，可以共享匹配的 QDQ 路径；而激活是每次 rollout 在线重算的，若在 trainer 端也强行做对称 W4A4 fake quant，反而会把本来无法严格对齐的激活误差注入学习过程。其二是 rollout-side residual activation compensation：既然激活误差是主因，就在真正的 W4A4 rollout 里对高残差通道做 second-pass quantization，用额外一轮更精细的补偿减少 activation quantization 带来的 log-prob 偏差。作者强调这部分通过 fused kernels 实现，目的是保住大部分原生 W4A4 Tensor Core 吞吐优势，而不是退回高精度 GEMM。与已有方法相比，QeRL 之类只做 weight-only NVFP4，激活仍用 BF16，本质上没有进入真正的 W4A4 regime；FP8/INT8 RL 系统则处在更宽松的数值网格上，训练—推理不匹配更容易靠 clipping 或 TIS 控住。QUADS 的区别在于它正面处理 full-parameter MoE GRPO 下的原生 FP4 activation mismatch。
summary.experiments: 实验结论很清楚。首先，naive NVFP4 W4A4 rollout + BF16 training 会在大约 150 个 RL step 后崩溃，表现为 reward 和 held-out score 同时下降，且 rollout–trainer 的 per-token log-probability gap 单调增大，importance ratio 被推离 trust region。其次，分离量化的 ablation 证明了误差来源：W16A4 基本复现 W4A4 的不稳定，而 W4A16 更接近稳定训练，支持“激活误差主导”的判断。最终结果上，QUADS 在 full-parameter MoE GRPO 中把平均 pass@1 做到 72.86%，几乎追平 BF16 baseline 的 73.15%，远高于 naive NVFP4 的 51.37%。同时，rollout throughput 比 FP8 还高 16%。摘要里提到评测覆盖四个 held-out benchmarks，但给出的全文片段没有展开具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、专家数、训练 token 数和 group size G 等更细节数字；这些应在实验节和附录里核对。就目前可见信息，最重要的不是绝对分数，而是三组对比关系：BF16≈QUADS >> naive NVFP4，以及 QUADS 在稳定性恢复后仍保留对 FP8 的吞吐优势。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议很明确。先看 Introduction 里对 RL pipeline 的问题定义，确认作者讨论的是 decoupled rollout/trainer 架构下的数值偏差，而不是普通量化推理。然后直接看 Section 3.1 的 ablation，这是全文最关键的一页：如果不先接受“activation error 是主因”，后面的 asymmetric QAT 和 residual compensation 就会显得像两块经验 patch。接着看 trainer-side QAT 和 rollout-side compensation 的实现细节，重点关注为什么一边只量化权重、另一边专门补偿激活，以及 fused kernel 是否真的保住吞吐。最后看主结果表，核对三件事：训练是否稳定到全程、log-prob gap 是否被压回可控范围、吞吐提升是否在端到端而不只是 kernel 级。预计阅读时间 20-30 分钟。若要深挖，建议追问两个问题：一是这种方法对 dense model 是否同样成立，还是 MoE 的路由稀疏性放大了激活误差；二是 residual activation compensation 的额外开销在更长 CoT rollout 下是否仍然划算。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific systems-and-optimization problem in RL for MoE LLMs: native NVFP4 W4A4 rollout on Blackwell is attractive for throughput, but when rollout is run in FP4 while training remains in BF16, the rollout–trainer log-probability mismatch quickly destabilizes GRPO and causes collapse. The key question is not simply whether low precision hurts, but which source of error matters most—weights or activations—and how to align quantization error across the decoupled rollout and trainer paths without giving up the throughput advantage of true W4A4 execution.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is highly relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface, training stability, and low-precision system design. Two points matter. First, in modern RL pipelines, rollout precision is part of the training signal because token log-probabilities feed directly into importance ratios and policy updates; it is not just a serving detail. Second, the paper turns “low precision instability” into a structured error-analysis problem and shows that under NVFP4, activation quantization is much more damaging than weight quantization, and the two should not be handled with the same alignment strategy. That lesson generalizes: whenever training and inference paths diverge, it is often more important to distinguish synchronized tensors from online-recomputed tensors than to apply a uniform fake-quant recipe everywhere. The contribution is best seen as a strong engineering method paper for RL systems, MoE training, and Blackwell-era low-precision deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, QUADS, stands for quantization-error alignment across dual sides. The central idea is to treat trainer-side and rollout-side errors differently instead of forcing a single quantization scheme over both. The diagnostic step is crucial: the authors separately quantize weights and activations during rollout and compare W4A16 against W16A4. W16A4 closely reproduces the failure mode of full W4A4, while W4A16 is much more stable, showing that activation quantization dominates the instability and that weight and activation errors are roughly additive. Based on this, QUADS has two components. First, trainer-side asymmetric QAT: weights are fake-quantized to NVFP4, but activations remain in BF16. The rationale is that weights are synchronized across rollout and trainer engines, so their quantization–dequantization path can be aligned; activations are recomputed online during rollout and cannot be faithfully matched by symmetric W4A4 fake quantization on the learner side. Second, rollout-side residual activation compensation: since activation error is the main problem, the rollout engine performs a second-pass quantization on high-residual channels to reduce activation-induced log-prob bias while preserving native W4A4 GEMMs. The implementation uses fused kernels so that most of the throughput benefit of FP4 Tensor Cores is retained. This differs from prior work in an important way. Weight-only NVFP4 methods such as QeRL never enter the true W4A4 regime because activations stay in BF16, and FP8/INT8 RL systems operate on a much denser numerical grid where mismatch can often be controlled by clipping or truncated importance sampling. QUADS is designed specifically for full-parameter MoE GRPO with native FP4 activation quantization.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical story is straightforward. Naive NVFP4 rollout with W4A4 inference and BF16 training collapses after roughly 150 RL steps: reward and held-out performance drop, while the per-token rollout–trainer log-probability gap grows monotonically and pushes importance ratios outside the trust region. The weight-vs-activation ablation then identifies the source: W16A4 largely matches the instability of full W4A4, whereas W4A16 remains much closer to stable behavior, supporting the claim that activation error is the dominant driver. In the final results, QUADS reaches 72.86% average pass@1 across four held-out benchmarks, essentially matching the BF16 baseline at 73.15% and far outperforming naive NVFP4 at 51.37%. At the same time, it improves rollout throughput by 16% over FP8. The provided text does not expose finer details such as model size, expert count, benchmark names, total RL steps, or exact GRPO group settings, so those should be checked in the experimental section and appendix. The main takeaway is the relation among the three systems: BF16 ≈ QUADS >> naive NVFP4, with QUADS still preserving a throughput edge over FP8.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction to anchor the problem correctly: this is about numerical mismatch in a decoupled rollout/trainer RL pipeline, not generic quantized inference. Then go directly to the ablation in Section 3.1. That is the most important part of the paper. If the activation-dominant failure mode is not established first, the later design choices can look like ad hoc patches. After that, read the trainer-side asymmetric QAT and rollout-side residual compensation sections, focusing on why one side aligns weights while the other explicitly compensates activations, and whether the fused-kernel implementation really preserves throughput. Finally, inspect the main result tables for three things: end-to-end training stability, reduction of the rollout–trainer log-prob gap, and whether the throughput gain survives beyond kernel-level microbenchmarks. A useful skim should take 20–30 minutes. If you want to go deeper, two questions are worth pursuing: whether the same conclusion holds for dense models or is amplified by MoE routing sparsity, and whether the extra cost of residual activation compensation remains favorable for longer chain-of-thought rollouts.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该看的是“激活误差比权重误差更致命”这个结论；若你在做低精度 RL 或 rollout-serving 一体化，先复现 log-prob gap 诊断再谈提速。
recommendation.en: The key takeaway is that activation error, not weight error, dominates FP4 RL collapse; if you run low-precision RL or rollout-serving stacks, reproduce the log-prob-gap diagnostic before chasing throughput.

paper.title: Full-Pipeline Inference Optimization for MiMo-V2.5 Series: Pushing Hybrid SWA Efficiency to the Limit
paper.abstract: We present a full-pipeline inference optimization for the MiMo-V2.5 model family, which combines Hybrid Sliding Window Attention (Hybrid SWA), sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), and multimodal encoders. While Hybrid SWA can ideally reduce both attention compute and KVCache storage significantly compared to Full Attention, realizing these gains in production requires substantial engineering effort. We systematically optimize the KVCache system with layerwise prefetch, SWA-aware prefix cache trees,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工程报告解决的是 Hybrid Sliding Window Attention 在生产推理中的落地问题：理论上 SWA 能显著降低 KVCache 和 attention 计算，但默认 serving 系统往往会把它退化成近似全量 KV 存储。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在架构—系统协同。Hybrid SWA、MoE 和多模态 encoder 常被作为长上下文模型的效率设计，但训练时看到的理论复杂度不等于线上成本。该报告说明，如果 KVCache 池、prefix cache、调度器、跨层预取和分布式缓存没有按 SWA 语义重写，架构节省会被系统抽象吃掉。它对是否在基座模型中采用混合注意力有实际参考价值：预训练架构选择不能只看训练吞吐和 perplexity，还要看 decode 阶段的缓存形态、prefix 复用和多租户调度。
summary.technical_approach: 报告围绕 MiMo-V2.5 系列的完整推理链路做优化。模型侧包含 Hybrid SWA、稀疏 MoE 和多模态 encoder。以 MiMo-V2.5-Pro 为例，共 70 层，其中 10 层 Full Attention，60 层 SWA，窗口大小为 128。系统侧的关键改动是重构 KVCache：物理上拆成 Full KV pool 和 SWA KV pool，Full Attention 层按全序列存储，SWA 层只保留窗口内 KV，从而使 SWA 存储严格保持 O(W)，而不是被统一 KV 池拉回 O(N)。逻辑上仍向上层暴露统一的 sequence view，以 Full Attention 索引为权威引用，并维护 Full 到 SWA 的映射，避免 prefix tree、scheduler 和传输协议感知过多底层细节。调度时同时检查 Full KV 和 SWA KV 容量，避免只按单一缓存维度 admission。报告还提出 layerwise prefetch、SWA-aware prefix cache tree、专门的 cache placement、RDMA 优化的分布式 GCache，以及 KVCache-affinity router，用于提高 prefix 命中、减少重复 prefill，并在 MoE 负载均衡和缓存亲和之间做折中。多模态部分针对大图和长视频 encoder 吞吐瓶颈做流水线优化。
summary.experiments: 已给出的关键量化锚点主要来自架构上界：MiMo-V2.5-Pro 的 70 层中有 60 层为 SWA，窗口为 128，因此 SWA 层占 6/7；在 chunked prefill 场景下，Hybrid SWA 的 attention 计算理论上约为全注意力的 1/7；长上下文 decode 中，KVCache 体积也接近降到全注意力的 1/7。报告还比较了不同参数规模模型的 KVCache 存储，称 MiMo-V2.5 和 MiMo-V2.5-Pro 在各自规模组内 KV 需求较低，仅次于 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 和 DeepSeek-V4-Pro。完整片段没有给出端到端 QPS、TTFT、TPOT、cache hit rate 或成本下降的具体表格，因此应把这些数字看作系统设计的理论和结构性依据，而不是完整性能结论。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 30–45 分钟。重点看 Background 中对 Hybrid SWA 理论边界的计算，以及 KVCache System Refactor 中 Full/SWA 双池、统一逻辑视图、Full 到 SWA 映射和 admission 约束。对基座预训练研究员，最有用的问题不是具体用了哪套 serving 框架，而是这种注意力结构会给后续推理系统带来哪些硬约束。若只关心训练，可快速扫过 GCache、RDMA 和 router；若在设计长上下文模型架构，需要仔细看 prefix cache tree 和 SWA 语义的一致性处理。

summary_en.core_problem: The report addresses a practical gap in serving Hybrid Sliding Window Attention: the architecture promises much lower attention and KV-cache cost, but standard inference stacks can silently fall back to near-full KV storage.
summary_en.importance: The main lesson for pretraining is that long-context architecture choices must be evaluated together with inference systems. Hybrid SWA, sparse MoE, and multimodal encoders may look efficient on paper, yet the realized gain depends on cache layout, prefix reuse, admission control, prefetching, routing, and distributed storage. This matters when choosing a base-model architecture: a lower training-time attention cost is not enough if decode-time KV semantics are hard to serve. The report is therefore useful as architecture-system feedback for future long-context model design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The optimization targets the MiMo-V2.5 family, which combines Hybrid SWA, sparse MoE, and multimodal encoders. For MiMo-V2.5-Pro, the document describes a 70-layer model with 10 full-attention layers and 60 SWA layers, using a window size of 128. The central system change is a KV-cache refactor. Instead of a single KV pool that forces all layers to reserve O(N) sequence storage, the system separates full-attention KV from SWA KV. Full-attention layers retain full-sequence keys and values, while SWA layers keep only window-local entries, enforcing O(W) storage for the SWA part. A unified logical sequence view is still exposed to prefix trees, schedulers, and transport layers, with full-attention indices used as the authoritative reference and mappings maintained from full positions to SWA positions. Admission control checks both full and SWA cache constraints. The broader pipeline adds layerwise prefetching, SWA-aware prefix-cache trees, specialized placement policies, an RDMA-optimized distributed cache named GCache, and a KV-cache-affinity router to trade off cache reuse against load balance. Multimodal encoder throughput is treated as another bottleneck, especially for large images and long videos.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text gives structural numbers rather than a complete performance table. The key anchors are the 70-layer configuration, 10 full-attention layers, 60 SWA layers, and window size 128. Since SWA accounts for 6/7 of the layers, the theoretical attention compute in chunked prefill is described as roughly 1/7 of full attention, and long-context KV-cache storage can also approach 1/7 of a full-attention implementation. The report also states that MiMo-V2.5 and MiMo-V2.5-Pro have low estimated KV-cache requirements within their parameter-scale groups, behind only the corresponding DeepSeek-V4 Flash/Pro variants in the comparison shown. Concrete end-to-end serving metrics such as TTFT, TPOT, QPS, cache hit rate, and cost per token are not visible in the supplied content, so the numerical evidence should be read mainly as architectural and systems rationale.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–45 minutes. Read the background section for the cost model of Hybrid SWA, then focus on the KVCache refactor: the split full/SWA pools, unified logical indexing, full-to-SWA mapping, and dual-capacity admission control. For pretraining researchers, the most useful part is the constraint that this architecture imposes on downstream serving. GCache, RDMA, and routing details can be skimmed unless serving cost is part of the model-design loop. If designing a long-context base model, spend more time on the interaction between SWA semantics and prefix-cache reuse.

recommendation.zh: 做长上下文或 MoE serving 的人该看，尤其缓存树和 affinity router；不改建模 prior，但会改你对 SWA 落地成本的估计。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you work on long-context or MoE serving, especially for the cache-tree and affinity-router design; it won’t change modeling priors, but it may change your estimate of SWA’s real deployment cost.

paper.title: Less Experts, Faster Decoding: Cost-Aware Speculative Decoding for Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become an important approach for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs), but their inference efficiency depends strongly on expert activation patterns. Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates autoregressive generation by verifying multiple draft tokens in parallel, yet existing draft selection strategies primarily optimize acceptance likelihood. In large-scale MoE models, however, selecting draft tokens also determines the union of experts activated during

summary.core_problem: 解决 MoE 模型中 speculative decoding 只追求草稿 token 接受率、却忽略专家权重访存成本的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统与 MoE 成本建模。它指出 MoE 推理的瓶颈不只是 token 数和接受率，还取决于验证阶段被草稿树触发的专家集合大小；这个观察对 MoE serving、路由设计和推测解码策略都有直接影响。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 EcoSpec，在 draft-tree 选择时加入预测的边际专家激活成本。相较于只按 token 概率或接受概率扩展草稿，它把候选 token 会引入的新专家权重访存纳入目标函数，从而减少 expert scattering，即高概率候选路由到互不重叠专家导致的访存扩散。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明实验围绕大规模 MoE 推理中的 speculative decoding 展开，对比现有以接受率为中心的草稿选择策略。给定信息未提供具体 MoE 模型、参数量、专家数、硬件配置、吞吐提升或延迟下降幅度，因此需要读正文确认收益是否来自真实 serving 瓶颈而非简化成本模型。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses speculative decoding for MoE models when draft-token selection ignores expert-weight memory cost.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems and MoE cost-modeling contribution. It argues that MoE speculative decoding is governed not only by acceptance rate and token count, but also by the union of experts activated during verification, which directly affects serving efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: EcoSpec augments draft-tree selection with predicted marginal expert activation cost. Instead of expanding candidates purely by probability or expected acceptance, it penalizes tokens that introduce additional expert-weight memory traffic, reducing expert scattering across draft candidates.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare cost-aware speculative decoding against acceptance-centered draft selection for large MoE inference. The supplied abstract does not give the exact MoE models, parameter counts, expert counts, hardware setup, throughput gains, or latency reductions, so the main paper is needed to judge how much of the gain holds under real serving conditions.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 expert-scattering 的测量和成本模型；若复现成立，MoE 推测解码不能再只优化接受率。
recommendation.en: Read the expert-scattering measurements and cost model; if they reproduce, MoE speculative decoding should not optimize acceptance rate alone.

paper.title: MawForge: Memory-Bounded Expert Materialization for Local Mixture-of-Experts Inference
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models separate total parameter count from per-token active computation, but local inference systems often still require the full model, key-value cache, runtime buffers, and operatingsystem headroom to fit in fast memory. MawForge tests a different systems hypothesis: local MoE serving can be made practical on constrained unified-memory machines by storing the full model on disk, keeping common tensors resident, and materializing routed expert tensors in

summary.core_problem: 本地MoE推理需要加载全量模型到高速内存，在消费级统一内存设备上内存占用过高难以部署。
summary.importance: 提出了磁盘存储全量模型、按需加载专家到有界执行缓存的本地MoE serving思路，明确了该方案的适用边界和性能权衡因素。
summary.technical_approach: 将全量MoE模型存储在磁盘，驻留公共张量到内存，路由命中的专家按需加载到固定大小的执行缓存中，系统测量了不同配置下的性能表现。
summary.experiments: 在macOS统一内存设备上测试，发现该方案作为有界执行机制有效，但作为缓存最大化策略效果不佳；性能受专家复用率、驻留内存占比、KV-cache大小、量化、路由局部性、系统内存压力共同影响。

summary_en.core_problem: Local MoE inference requires loading the full model into fast memory, leading to prohibitive memory footprint on consumer-grade unified-memory devices.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a local MoE serving design that stores the full model on disk and loads experts on demand into a bounded execution cache, clarifying its applicability boundary and performance tradeoffs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Stores the full MoE model on disk, keeps common tensors resident in memory, loads routed experts on demand into a fixed-size execution cache, and systematically measures performance across configurations.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on macOS unified-memory devices: the approach works well as a bounded execution mechanism but poorly as a cache-maximization policy; performance depends on expert reuse rate, resident memory ratio, KV-cache size, quantization, route locality, and OS memory pressure.

recommendation.zh: 消费级设备跑MoE的工程优化，仅涉及推理加载策略，路由局部性结论可作为MoE训练路由设计的弱参考，不用读正文。
recommendation.en: An engineering optimization for running MoE on consumer devices, only covers inference loading strategies; the route locality observation is a weak reference for MoE routing design, no need to read the full text.

paper.title: Mach-Mind-4-Flash Technical Report
paper.abstract: We present Mach-Mind-4-Flash, a 35B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic model with 3B activated parameters. Through post-training optimization alone without scaling pre-training compute, the model achieves performance on par with or surpassing that of 100B-parameter-class models. By introducing scalable agentic interaction environments for large-scale reinforcement learning, the model attains significant performance gains on real-world application tasks. Our pipeline comprises three stage

summary.core_problem: 这篇技术报告要解决的是一个很现实的问题：在不继续显著扩大预训练算力的前提下，能否把一个推理时只激活 3B 参数的 35B MoE 基座，通过更强的 post-training 管线，推到接近甚至进入 100B 级模型的能力区间。更具体地说，作者面对的是三个耦合难题：一是 RL、蒸馏、multi-turn agent 训练通常是分裂的系统，工程和优化目标不统一；二是把 reasoning、general、agent 三类能力混在一个 reward mixture 里训，容易出现能力跷跷板；三是强推理模型常常输出过长，服务成本高，但简单压长度又容易 reward hack 或伤准确率。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员，这篇工作的价值不在于它替代 pretrain，而在于它把 pretrain 之后还能榨出多少能力、以及这种能力提升依赖什么训练接口，讲得比较具体。它说明了一个趋势：当 base model 已经足够强时，post-training 的组织方式、奖励环境、专家分治、蒸馏目标和长度控制，可能决定了模型最终能否进入更高能力带。对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口的启发主要有三点。第一，统一的 RL/OPD 框架让“在线蒸馏 + 策略优化”成为连续谱，而不是两个割裂阶段，这对 mid-training 或 continual adaptation 很有参考意义。第二，先训专家再做多教师 on-policy 融合，提供了一种避免 reward mixture 相互干扰的路线。第三，长度压缩如果设计得当，可以在不明显伤害正确率的情况下显著降低推理 token 成本，这会反过来影响训练时对 verbose CoT 的偏好。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上有三根主线。

第一根是统一的 RL / On-Policy Distillation 基础设施。作者把 OPD 深度并入 RL 框架，用一个加权损失同时容纳蒸馏项和策略梯度项，通过调节系数 α、β 在 pure RL、pure OPD、joint RL+OPD 三种模式间切换。这里的关键不是“把两个 loss 相加”这么简单，而是把分布式调度、经验采样、在线 rollout、teacher supervision 放进同一套训练骨架里。这样做的好处是，蒸馏不再是离线、静态、与环境脱节的过程，而是可以直接监督 student 自己 rollout 出来的轨迹。报告里还提到支持多种 distillation objective，不只传统 MSE，还包括更适合分布匹配的 Forward_kl_TopK 等形式。

第二根是多专家并行训练，再用 Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation 融合。作者没有把所有任务混在一个大杂烩 reward 里训单一策略，而是按三条轨道分别训练 domain-specific RL experts：Reasoning 轨覆盖 Math、Code、STEM；General 轨覆盖 Instruction Following、Writing、Safety；Agent 轨覆盖 Tool-Use、DeepSearch、Code Agent、Claw Agent。每个专家配自己的数据合成、可验证奖励和训练策略，例如稀疏结果任务用两阶段 reward curriculum，多轮 agent 任务则放进可执行环境。之后做 MOPD：每个训练样本路由到对应冻结 teacher，student 在自己的 rollout 上接受 token-level reverse-KL 监督。这个设计的重点是并行化专家开发，减少顺序依赖，同时尽量保留各专家能力而不在融合时互相冲掉。

第三根是 HMPO，用于最后一步长度压缩。作者观察到强 reasoning policy 往往“过想”，输出过长。HMPO 的做法不是直接惩罚长度，而是先从正确 rollout 的中位长度导出 group-adaptive budget，再用 correctness-first 的乘性奖励结构，避免模型通过“更短但错误”的方式刷奖励。报告声称这种设计在数学上能防止短错答案的 reward hacking。更有意思的是，虽然 HMPO 只在数学上训练，但长度压缩效果能迁移到代码、科学和通用指令任务。
summary.experiments:
模型规模是 35B 参数 MoE，推理时激活 3B。系统层面，作者在 SonicMoE indexed grouped GEMM kernel 和 segmented shared-expert fusion 上做了算子与通信重叠优化，报告给出在 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 训练上最高 17% 的端到端提速。

能力结果方面，文中列出的代表性分数包括：AIME’26 92.70，LiveCodeBench-V6 80.91，IFEval 94.64，IFBench 82.82，Content-SafetyBench 98.20，Behavioral-SafetyBench 80.74，ClawBench 84.20，BFCL-v4 75.80。作者的主张是，这样的 post-training 结果使其能与 120B 级模型匹敌，并在部分任务上接近更大系统。这里需要保留一点审慎：这是技术报告口径，比较对象、评测设置和是否同等推理预算，需要读表格和附录细看。

更有研究价值的是训练策略本身带来的增益模式。报告强调，单一 heterogeneous reward mixture 会出现 capability see-saw，而分轨训练专家再蒸馏融合能缓解这一点。HMPO 则把生成长度压缩了 19%–46%，准确率损失最多 0.7 个百分点。这个结果说明长度控制不是简单的 decoding trick，而可以作为 policy optimization 的一部分来学。若这些数字在附录中经得起细看，它对高成本 CoT 模型的部署很有现实意义。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三部分。第一是 Introduction，里面把整条管线的三根主线讲得最清楚：统一 RL/OPD、分轨专家 + MOPD、HMPO 长度压缩。第二是 Infra 部分，重点看 unified weighted loss、dynamic multi-teacher architecture，以及算子级优化到底改了什么。第三是实验章节里关于 expert fusion 和 HMPO 的消融，因为真正有方法含量的是“为什么分开训再融合比混训更稳”，以及“为什么长度压缩没有明显伤准确率”。

如果只给 30 分钟，建议看 Figure 2 一类的训练框架图、MOPD 的样本路由与 reverse-KL 定义、HMPO 的 reward 公式，再扫主表。若有 1 小时以上，值得细看各 agent 环境和 reward 设计，因为这部分决定了所谓 agentic RL 的信号质量。读的时候要特别留意三件事：比较是否在同等 test-time budget 下进行；多教师融合后是否真的保住了单专家峰值；HMPO 的泛化是否来自长度偏好改变，还是来自额外 RL 数据带来的副作用。

summary_en.core_problem: The report asks a practical question: how far can a relatively compact MoE base model be pushed through post-training alone, without scaling pretraining compute? Concretely, the target is a 35B-parameter MoE with only 3B activated parameters at inference, and the challenge is threefold: unify RL and distillation in one training system, avoid capability trade-offs when optimizing heterogeneous domains, and reduce the excessive verbosity of strong reasoning models without rewarding short but wrong outputs.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model researchers, the main value is not that it replaces pretraining, but that it clarifies how much capability can still be extracted after pretraining and which interfaces matter. The report is especially relevant to the pretrain-posttrain boundary. It treats online distillation and policy optimization as a continuum rather than separate stages, proposes specialist RL tracks instead of a single mixed reward soup, and turns response-length control into a learned policy objective rather than a decoding heuristic. Those choices matter for mid-training, continual adaptation, and the economics of reasoning-heavy models.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has three main components.

First, it builds a unified RL / On-Policy Distillation framework. Instead of running distillation as a separate offline pipeline, the authors integrate OPD into the RL training stack with a weighted objective combining a distillation term and a policy-gradient term. By adjusting coefficients, the same infrastructure can operate in pure RL, pure OPD, or joint mode. The important point is not merely adding two losses, but sharing rollout generation, distributed scheduling, experience handling, and online supervision. The report also mentions support for multiple distillation objectives beyond standard MSE, including distribution-matching forms such as Forward_kl_TopK.

Second, it trains multiple domain specialists and then fuses them through Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation. Rather than optimizing one policy on a heterogeneous reward mixture, the authors train separate RL experts across three tracks: Reasoning (Math, Code, STEM), General (Instruction Following, Writing, Safety), and Agent (Tool-Use, DeepSearch, Code Agent, Claw Agent). Each expert uses domain-specific synthetic data, verifiable rewards, and tailored curricula, such as two-stage reward schedules for sparse-outcome tasks and executable multi-turn environments for agent tasks. Fusion is done by routing each sample to the corresponding frozen teacher and supervising the student on its own rollouts with token-level reverse KL. This is designed to parallelize expert development and reduce the capability see-saw that often appears in mixed-domain RL.

Third, the final stage applies HMPO, a length-compression RL method. The motivation is that strong reasoning models often over-generate. HMPO derives a group-adaptive length budget from the median length of correct rollouts and uses a correctness-first multiplicative reward so that the model cannot gain by being shorter if it is wrong. The report claims this structure prevents short-answer reward hacking. An interesting detail is that HMPO is trained only on mathematics, yet the resulting brevity transfers to code, science, and instruction-following tasks.
summary_en.experiments:
The model is a 35B-parameter MoE with 3B activated parameters. On the systems side, the report attributes up to 17% end-to-end training speedup on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B to operator-level and communication-level optimizations, including SonicMoE indexed grouped GEMM kernels and segmented shared-expert fusion.

The headline task results reported in the text include AIME’26 at 92.70, LiveCodeBench-V6 at 80.91, IFEval at 94.64, IFBench at 82.82, Content-SafetyBench at 98.20, Behavioral-SafetyBench at 80.74, ClawBench at 84.20, and BFCL-v4 at 75.80. The claim is that this places the model in the range of 120B-class systems while keeping inference activation at 3B parameters. That comparison should be read carefully against evaluation settings and test-time budgets in the tables and appendix.

The more interesting experimental message is about training structure. The authors argue that a single heterogeneous reward mixture causes capability trade-offs, while specialist training followed by MOPD preserves or even improves expert performance in a unified student. HMPO reportedly reduces generation length by 19% to 46% with at most 0.7 percentage points of accuracy loss. If those numbers hold under close reading, they suggest that response compression can be learned as part of policy optimization rather than treated as a post hoc decoding constraint.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on three parts. Start with the introduction, which lays out the full pipeline clearly: unified RL/OPD, specialist experts plus MOPD, and HMPO for length compression. Then read the infrastructure section for the weighted objective, the dynamic multi-teacher design, and the systems optimizations. Finally, go to the ablations around expert fusion and HMPO, because those sections carry the real methodological content.

If you only have 30 minutes, prioritize the training framework figure, the sample-routing and reverse-KL details of MOPD, the HMPO reward definition, and the main result tables. With more time, inspect the agent environments and reward construction, since the quality of those signals determines whether the reported gains are robust or mostly benchmark-specific. While reading, keep three questions in mind: whether comparisons use comparable test-time budgets, whether the fused student truly retains specialist peaks, and whether HMPO’s gains come from a genuine shift in policy length preference rather than simply from extra RL exposure.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练本身帮助有限，但它在讲一个更现实的问题：post-train 到底能榨出多少能力；先看 MOPD 和 mixed-reward 退化分析，别先信 headline。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it addresses a practical question: how much capability post-training can actually extract; read the MOPD and mixed-reward degradation parts first, not the headline claims.

paper.title: A Sovereign, Open-Source Foundation Model for German and English
paper.abstract: We present Soofi S 30B-A3B, a sovereign, open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) hybrid Mamba Transformer foundation model for German and English. Its hybrid design activates only 3B of 30B parameters per token and keeps the inference cache near-constant as context grows, giving it a decisive throughput advantage over dense models for long-context, high-concurrency deployment. Pretrained on roughly 27 trillion tokens with deliberately up-weighted German, Soofi S matches dense 14 to 27B models on ag

summary.core_problem: 这篇技术报告要解决的是一个可部署的德英双语开放基座模型问题：不仅给权重，还给数据配比、训练 recipe、阶段边界和评测代码，同时用低 KV-cache 的混合 Mamba-MoE 架构降低长上下文高并发生成成本。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在可复现实验记录和服务约束驱动的架构选择。它不是提出新架构，而是把 Nemotron 3 Nano 的混合 Mamba-Transformer MoE 设计用于德英双语预训练，并把数据账本、token 统计、WSD 学习率、阶段 token budget 等细节公开。对基座研究员更有用的是这些工程取舍：在主攻双语能力时，如何控制语料比例；在长上下文场景下，为什么 KV-cache 比 nominal 参数量更直接影响吞吐；在复用成熟架构时，如何把变量收敛到数据和训练 recipe 上。
summary.technical_approach: Soofi S 30B-A3B Base 采用 Nemotron 3 Nano 参考架构：52 层网络中包含 23 个 Mamba-2 sequence-mixing 层、23 个带 shared experts 的 granular MoE 层、6 个稀疏分布的 GQA 层。总参数约 31.6B，每 token 激活约 3.2B 参数，含 embedding 约 3.6B；只有 6 个 GQA 层维护 KV-cache。训练使用 Megatron-Bridge、AdamW 和 Warmup-Stable-Decay 学习率 schedule，预训练数据是三阶段、26.68T token 的德英代码混合 curriculum。选择复用 Nemotron 架构而不重新设计，主要是为了部署栈成熟、长上下文吞吐可控，以及能把架构变量固定住，从而更清楚地观察德英数据 recipe 的作用。
summary.experiments: 报告称模型在英语和德语 base model benchmark 聚合上表现强，覆盖代码、数学和德国区域知识；相对欧洲主权模型基线，在德语 benchmark suite 中全面占优；相对 14B 到 27B dense 国际模型，在英语和德语聚合能力上达到相近水平，但每 token 激活参数低得多。服务实验是更值得看的部分：在 40K context、batch 32 条件下，aggregate decode TPS/GPU 约为 dense 14B 到 24B 模型的 8 到 9 倍；从 4K 到 256K context，aggregate decode TPS 基本保持平坦，而 full-attention 模型随上下文增长明显下降。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。重点看三处：模型配置表，确认 52 层中 Mamba、MoE、GQA 的分布和 active 参数计算；数据章节，尤其是三阶段 26.68T token 的德英代码配比和 tokenizer-exact token accounting；服务评测图，理解低 KV-cache 架构在 batch decoding 时的收益边界。能力评测可以快速扫过，重点不是排名，而是它如何把开放数据账本、训练 recipe 和部署吞吐放在同一个基座模型报告里。

summary_en.core_problem: The report targets a deployable German-English open foundation model: not just a weight release, but a documented pretraining corpus, recipe, phase schedule, and evaluation stack, paired with a low-KV-cache hybrid Mamba-MoE architecture for long-context, high-concurrency serving.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is not a new modeling idea, but the combination of reproducible training records and deployment-driven architecture selection. The report fixes the architecture by adopting the Nemotron 3 Nano design, then exposes the data mixture, exact token accounting, WSD schedule, optimizer settings, and phase budgets. It is useful as a case study in how bilingual pretraining choices interact with inference economics, especially when KV-cache bandwidth dominates decoding cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: Soofi S 30B-A3B Base reuses the Nemotron 3 Nano hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE design. The model has 52 layers: 23 Mamba-2 sequence-mixing layers, 23 granular MoE layers with shared experts, and 6 sparsely placed GQA layers. It has about 31.6B total parameters, about 3.2B active parameters per token, and about 3.6B active parameters including embeddings. Only the 6 GQA layers keep a KV cache. Training uses Megatron-Bridge, AdamW, and a Warmup-Stable-Decay learning-rate schedule over a three-phase 26.68T-token German-English-code curriculum. Reusing an established architecture reduces integration risk, gives access to mature kernels in serving stacks such as vLLM, and makes the data recipe easier to isolate as the main experimental variable.
summary_en.experiments: The report compares the base model against 16 open models of similar or larger active size. It reports strong aggregate English and German base-model results, including code, mathematics, and German regional-knowledge tasks. It also reports parity with dense 14B to 27B international models on aggregate English and German capability while using far fewer active parameters. The serving results are the most informative: at 40K context and batch size 32, aggregate decode TPS per GPU is reported to be about 8 to 9 times that of dense 14B to 24B models, and aggregate decode TPS remains roughly flat from 4K to 256K context, unlike full-attention baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Prioritize the architecture configuration table, the data-mixture section with exact per-source and per-language token accounting, and the long-context serving plots. The benchmark tables can be read quickly; the stronger signal is how the report ties together an open pretraining ledger, a fixed reference architecture, and measured decoding throughput under production-like batch and context regimes.

recommendation.zh: 重点看架构和德语数据配比；能力结论需等完整 eval，但长上下文 cache 设计值得内部复现小规模对照。
recommendation.en: Read the architecture and German data-mixture parts; the benchmark claims need scrutiny, but the long-context cache setup is worth a small internal ablation.

paper.title: It Takes a MAESTRO To Prune Bad Experts
paper.abstract: Sparsely-activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models achieve remarkable inference efficiency by activating only a small fraction of parameters per token, yet their full expert banks reside in memory at all times, creating a prohibitive deployment bottleneck. Existing structured pruning methods, largely designed for dense transformers, assess expert importance using locally derived heuristics that are blind to the interdependent nature of MoE routing. We introduce MAESTRO (Markov-chain App

summary.core_problem: 解决 MoE 语言模型部署时 expert bank 常驻显存带来的内存瓶颈，并避免用 dense Transformer 剪枝启发式误判 expert 重要性。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 MoE 推理压缩和结构化剪枝方法。对基座研究员的间接价值在于，它把 MoE routing 的跨层依赖作为 expert 重要性信号；这类信号也可能反过来帮助分析预训练中的专家专化、路由退化和容量分配。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MAESTRO，即 Markov-chain Approximated Expert Sparsification via Transition-based Routing。方法把自回归生成中的 expert activation trajectory 建模为遍历 Markov chain，用 stationary distribution 表示跨层 expert routing 依赖，从而得到全局 aware 的 expert importance heuristic。相比只看局部权重、激活或梯度的剪枝，它显式利用 token 生成过程中专家选择的转移结构。
summary.experiments: 在五个不同领域评估，包括 Safety、Bias、Ethics 等维度。摘要称 MAESTRO 在结构化剪枝设定下相较现有强 baseline，平均性能保持率最高提升 10.61%。摘要未给出具体 MoE 模型名称、参数规模、保留 expert 比例和完整 benchmark 列表。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Indian Institute of Technology Delhi；未见主流大模型训练团队或知名 MoE 作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the memory bottleneck of MoE language-model deployment, where all experts remain resident in memory despite sparse token-level activation.
summary_en.importance: This is a MoE inference-compression and structured-pruning contribution. Its value for pretraining researchers is indirect but real: it treats cross-layer routing dynamics as an expert-importance signal, which may also inform analysis of expert specialization and routing collapse during training.
summary_en.technical_approach: MAESTRO, or Markov-chain Approximated Expert Sparsification via Transition-based Routing, models autoregressive expert activation trajectories as ergodic Markov chains. The stationary distribution is used as a globally aware expert-importance heuristic that captures cross-layer routing dependencies, unlike local pruning heuristics designed mainly for dense Transformers.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated across five domains, including Safety, Bias, and Ethics. The abstract reports up to a 10.61% improvement in average performance retention over existing pruning baselines under structured expert pruning. The provided abstract does not specify the exact MoE models, parameter counts, pruning ratios, or full benchmark list.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Indian Institute of Technology Delhi; no major foundation-model MoE training lab affiliation is indicated in the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 routing 统计怎么做；若只关心线上压缩，结果表有用，预训练 insight 主要在专家转移矩阵。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the routing statistics; if you only care about deployment compression, the tables suffice, while the pretraining signal is in the expert transition matrix.

paper.title: Rethinking Small VLM Quantization: From Component-Wise Analysis to Hardware-Aware Edge Deployment
paper.abstract: The emergence of vision language models with fewer than 3 billion parameters has accelerated the implementation of on-device multimodal intelligence. However, a detailed understanding of component-wise quantization remains a bottleneck for optimal deployment. This paper presents a systematic evaluation framework for empirically validating five hypotheses across six quantization configurations on the Jetson Orin NX and AGX. By separating the vision encoder, projector, and large language model bac

summary.core_problem: 3B以下小参数VLM的组件级量化规律不清晰，边缘端部署缺乏系统性量化配置指导。
summary.importance: 系统评测贡献，首次在Jetson硬件上对VLM视觉编码器/投影层/LLM主干做分组件量化敏感性分析。
summary.technical_approach: 构建分组件量化评测框架，在Jetson Orin NX/AGX上验证5个假设、测试6种量化配置，分别分析MoE/dense主干、SigLIP编码器、INT4/INT8的精度-延迟-显存关系。
summary.experiments: 发现MoE主干对INT4噪声鲁棒性优于dense；SigLIP在Jetson Ampere上INT8延迟异常是硬件-内核交互问题；LLM INT4降显存但因反量化拖慢token生成。

summary_en.core_problem: Component-wise quantization behavior of sub-3B small VLMs is poorly understood, lacking systematic guidance for edge deployment.
summary_en.importance: Systematic evaluation contribution; the first component-level quantization sensitivity analysis of VLM vision encoder / projector / LLM backbone on Jetson hardware.
summary_en.technical_approach: Builds a component-wise quantization evaluation framework, validates five hypotheses and tests six quantization configurations on Jetson Orin NX/AGX, separately analyzing accuracy-latency-memory tradeoffs for MoE vs dense backbones, SigLIP encoders, and INT4/INT8 formats.
summary_en.experiments: Finds MoE backbones are more robust to INT4 noise than dense ones; SigLIP INT8 latency anomaly on Jetson Ampere stems from hardware-kernel interaction rather than a SigLIP flaw; LLM INT4 reduces VRAM but slows token generation due to dequantization overhead.

recommendation.zh: 边缘VLM量化的经验性结论，做端侧部署可参考结论表格，预训练研究员无需读正文。
recommendation.en: Empirical findings on edge VLM quantization; reference the result tables if working on on-device deployment, no need for pretraining researchers to read the full text.

paper.title: Native Video-Action Pretraining for Generalizable Robot Control
paper.abstract: The advent of video-action models offers a promising path for robot control. Nevertheless, we argue that repurposing video generative models designed for digital content creation is inherently inadequate for physical environments. To bridge this gap, we present LingBot-VA 2.0, a video-action foundation model built from the ground up for embodiment. Four core design principles showcase its evolution from LingBot-VA. (1) Departing from traditional reconstruction-focused VAEs, we introduce a semant

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是机器人控制里的 video-action foundation model 如何预训练。作者认为，把通用视频生成模型改造成机器人策略会有结构性错配：tokenizer 偏重像素重建，backbone 常用双向视频扩散，动作模块通常后接，难以把 web video 的规模转化为控制能力。LingBot-VA 2.0 试图从 tokenizer、预训练目标、时序因果结构和推理部署上重新设计 video-action 模型。
summary.importance: 这篇论文和 LLM 预训练的关系在于统一序列建模和跨模态 tokenizer，而不是传统机器人学习。它把视觉状态、潜在动作、语言条件放到一个可扩展的预训练框架中，并强调因果 next-latent 目标比双向重建式视频生成更贴近闭环控制。对基座研究的启发是：当新模态需要行动或物理动态时，tokenizer 不能只优化重建质量，预训练目标也不能只学外观连续性；表示需要对下游控制变量有对齐约束。
summary.technical_approach: LingBot-VA 2.0 有两个主要预训练阶段。第一阶段是 semantic visual-action tokenizer。它不只做 VAE 式重建，而是把视觉 latent 对齐到冻结视觉基础模型的语义空间，同时通过自监督学习 latent action，使世界状态和动作处在共享 latent space 中。这样，未标注 web video 也能提供和动作相关的监督。第二阶段是 causal diffusion transformer。模型以语言指令为条件，通过 cross-attention 接入冻结语言模型，预测未来视觉 latent 以及连接这些 latent 的潜在动作。作者采用因果 next-latent pretraining，而不是先训练双向视频生成模型再用机器人数据改成因果模型，以避免 temporal objective 和闭环控制之间的错配。架构上使用 sparse MoE feed-forward 来保留容量并降低每步激活计算。训练上加入 multi-chunk prediction，同时监督多个未来 chunk，减少模型只复制相邻帧外观的倾向，迫使 latent 携带更长程的轨迹动态。部署上引入 Foresight Reasoning：在机器人执行动作的同时异步预测未来 latent，并用最新真实观测通过 policy 的 forward-dynamics step 重新校正，避免纯想象 rollout 漂移。系统层面还结合 few-step consistency distillation、量化执行和层级 VLM planner。
summary.experiments: 论文声称 LingBot-VA 2.0 在仿真和真实机器人评测中优于 π0.5 与 LingBot-VA 等强基线。关键数字包括：下游适配只需约 10–15 条 demonstrations；可以跨 embodiment 迁移，部分设置下能 zero-shot 执行新任务；异步部署峰值执行频率达到 225 Hz。实验结论集中在三类收益：semantic visual-action tokenizer 改善指令跟随和动作精度；causal video-action pretraining 提升泛化和少样本适配；Foresight Reasoning、MoE、consistency distillation 与量化让模型能进入实时闭环控制。由于给出的内容未包含完整表格，具体任务成功率、消融幅度和统计方差需要以实验章节为准。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读到半精读，预计 35–50 分钟。优先看四个部分：semantic visual-action tokenizer 的训练目标，causal DiT 的 next-latent / latent-action 预训练目标，multi-chunk prediction 的消融，以及 Foresight Reasoning 的异步推理机制。对预训练研究员，最值得深挖的是 tokenizer 为什么要同时对齐语义和动作，而不是只压缩视频；以及为什么因果预训练比双向视频 diffusion retrofit 更适合控制。实验部分重点看少样本适配、跨 embodiment、真实机器人频率和各模块消融，不必把它当作普通机器人 benchmark 论文来读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how video-action foundation models should be pretrained for robot control. The authors argue that adapting generic video generators is structurally mismatched: reconstruction-oriented tokenizers preserve appearance rather than control-relevant structure, bidirectional video diffusion does not match causal closed-loop control, and action modules are often attached after the fact. LingBot-VA 2.0 redesigns the tokenizer, objective, temporal modeling, and inference path around embodiment from the start.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to foundation-model pretraining lies in multimodal tokenization and causal sequence modeling, not in conventional robotics. The work treats visual states, latent actions, and language conditioning as parts of a scalable pretraining problem. A useful lesson is that new modalities with action and dynamics cannot rely on reconstruction quality alone. The tokenizer must align with downstream control variables, and the pretraining objective must capture how actions change future states rather than only modeling short-term visual continuity.
summary_en.technical_approach: LingBot-VA 2.0 has two central pretraining components. The first is a semantic visual-action tokenizer. Instead of optimizing only VAE-style reconstruction, it aligns visual latents with a frozen visual foundation model and learns latent actions through self-supervision, placing world states and actions in a shared latent space. This lets unlabeled web video provide action-relevant supervision. The second component is a causal diffusion transformer. Conditioned on language instructions via cross-attention to a frozen pretrained language model, it predicts future visual latents and the latent actions connecting them. The causal next-latent objective is chosen instead of retrofitting a bidirectional video generator, because robot control unfolds forward in time. The backbone uses sparse MoE feed-forward layers to keep capacity while reducing active compute. The training objective adds multi-chunk prediction, supervising several future chunks at once so that the model learns trajectory-level dynamics rather than copying adjacent-frame appearance. For deployment, Foresight Reasoning runs future-latent prediction asynchronously with action execution and re-grounds predictions on the latest real observation through a learned forward-dynamics step. The system also uses few-step consistency distillation, quantized execution, and a hierarchical VLM planner for long-horizon tasks.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports improvements over strong baselines such as π0.5 and the previous LingBot-VA in simulation and real-robot settings. Reported operating points include adaptation from roughly 10–15 demonstrations, transfer across embodiments, zero-shot execution in some settings, and a peak asynchronous execution frequency of 225 Hz. The claimed gains come from three sources: the semantic visual-action tokenizer improves instruction following and action precision; causal video-action pretraining improves generalization and data efficiency; and Foresight Reasoning together with MoE, consistency distillation, and quantization makes real-time closed-loop deployment feasible. The provided text does not include the full result tables, so exact success rates and ablation deltas should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim to semi-close read in about 35–50 minutes. Focus on the semantic visual-action tokenizer, the causal DiT next-latent and latent-action objectives, the multi-chunk prediction ablation, and the Foresight Reasoning inference design. For pretraining researchers, the main points to inspect are why the tokenizer is aligned to both semantics and actions rather than optimized only for video compression, and why native causal pretraining is preferred over adapting a bidirectional video diffusion model. In the experiments, prioritize few-shot adaptation, embodiment transfer, real-robot frequency, and module-level ablations.

recommendation.zh: 只看 tokenizer 与 causal pretraining 设计；机器人指标可略过，但它会影响我对 embodied tokenization 的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the tokenizer and causal-pretraining design; skip most robotics metrics, but it should update priors on embodied tokenization.

paper.title: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Video Pretraining for Embodied Intelligence
paper.abstract: Despite the recent promise in robot control, video generative models suffer from a domain mismatch due to their primary focus on content creation. For example, their design inherently prioritizes visual fidelity and creativity over computational efficiency and physical realism. In this work, we present LingBot-Video, a DiT-based video pretraining paradigm specifically tailored for embodied intelligence. From the architecture perspective, we adopt the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), instead of dense, f

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般的视频生成质量问题，而是“视频基础模型怎样更像可用于具身智能的世界模型”。作者指出现有视频扩散模型主要围绕画质、文本对齐和审美优化，缺少对物理可行性、交互一致性、长时状态演化和任务完成信号的建模；同时，视频模型在算力上又普遍采用稠密计算，容量扩展成本高。论文试图同时补三块短板：一是用 MoE 提升视频 DiT 的可扩展性和推理效率，二是把互联网视频与机器人/第一视角/操作数据统一进预训练语料，三是把训练目标从“看起来像”推进到“行为和动力学也更合理”。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它把 MoE 从文本 LLM 更明确地带到视频扩散预训练里，关注的是容量—计算解耦、单流架构下的稀疏激活和大规模训练可行性，这对多模态基座模型的扩展路径有参考价值。第二，它把“具身数据混入通用视频预训练”当成数据配比与目标设计问题来处理，而不是只做下游机器人微调，这一点更接近预训练研究。影响量级上，这篇更像一个方向性系统工作：它提出了较完整的 recipe，但从给出的内容看，真正最有启发的是统一输入形式、单流 DiT + MoE 的工程取舍，以及数据重配和奖励设计如何服务于物理一致性，而不是某个单点算法突破。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三个部分组成。第一部分是任务统一的单流扩散 Transformer。作者把文本条件、图像条件和视频 latent patch 全部投到同一 hidden space，沿序列维拼接成一个统一 token 序列，用 3D MM-RoPE 给条件 token 和视觉 token 分配不重叠的时间坐标区间。这样 T2I、T2V、I2V 都能落在同一个生成框架里，图像被视为 T=1 的特殊视频。与双流结构相比，单流设计的理由很明确：参数复用更高，跨模态交互在每层自然发生，GEMM 更大更整齐，减少频繁 split/concat 带来的 memory-bandwidth 开销，也更适合 sequence parallel 下的分布式训练。

第二部分是稀疏 MoE 扩展。虽然截取内容没有完整展开路由和 expert 细节，但从引言和方法组织可以看出，MoE 被放在 DiT 扩展的核心位置，目标不是改变扩散建模本身，而是在时空建模复杂度上引入条件计算：不同 token/时刻激活不同 expert，以更低激活参数成本换取更大总容量。这和文本 LLM 中 MoE 的动机一致，但视频场景更难，因为 token 结构同时带有空间、时间和条件模态耦合，路由稳定性、负载均衡和时空一致性都会更敏感。作者选择单流 backbone 后再做 MoE，隐含的好处是避免双流下 expert 划分进一步放大通信和负载不均。

第三部分是数据与训练信号。作者构建了 robot-augmented corpus，不是简单拼接，而是通过 data profiling engine 对异构视频源做分析、过滤和重平衡，把互联网视频的视觉多样性与机器人操作、导航、egocentric 数据的交互先验结合起来。训练目标上又加入 multi-dimensional reward system，除了常规感知质量和文本对齐，还强调 physical plausibility 与 task-level success。这里的思路更接近 post-train 对生成模型的对齐，但服务对象仍是预训练视频基础模型：希望模型学到的不只是外观分布，还包括更合理的交互动力学。
summary.experiments: 从已给全文片段里，实验部分没有完整展开，因此无法可靠给出参数量、训练 token/frame 数、具体 benchmark 分数和提升幅度。能确认的是，作者把系统定位为大规模开源 MoE 视频基础模型，并展示了 T2I 与 T2V 的可视化样例，强调视觉保真度、细节和文本对齐。按引言中的主张，实验大概率围绕三类问题展开：一是 MoE 相对稠密 DiT 的效率—质量权衡；二是加入具身数据后的物理交互与动作语义改善；三是多维奖励对任务成功和物理合理性的影响。真正值得核对的是消融是否分别验证了单流设计、数据重配和奖励系统的独立贡献，以及 MoE 是否在相同激活 FLOPs 下优于 dense baseline。如果正文后半部分给出了 load balance、MFU、吞吐、采样延迟或长时一致性指标，这些会比单纯生成样例更关键。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，重点看方法设计逻辑，不必在视觉样例上停留太久。建议先看 Introduction，抓住作者定义的问题：为什么“高质量视频生成”不等于“可用于具身智能的世界模型”。然后看 2.1 的 Unified Input Formulation、Single-Stream Diffusion Transformer 和 3D positional design，这部分最有预训练方法上的信息量。接着重点找 MoE 具体实现：expert 放在哪些层、top-k 路由如何做、是否有 auxiliary load balancing loss、训练和推理的激活参数规模分别是多少。再看数据 profiling engine：数据源构成、过滤标准、重配比例、是否有课程式采样。最后看奖励系统与消融，判断它更像 RL-style alignment、reweighting，还是额外监督头。预计 25–40 分钟能抓住主线；如果只关心基座预训练启发，优先读架构和数据部分。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not mainly about making video generations look better. It asks a harder question: how to turn a video foundation model into something closer to a world model for embodied intelligence. The authors argue that current video diffusion models are optimized for perceptual quality, text alignment, and aesthetics, but not for physical feasibility, interaction consistency, or long-horizon state evolution under intervention. At the same time, most large video models remain densely computed, which makes scaling expensive. The work tries to address all three gaps together: sparse scaling with MoE, embodiment-aware pretraining data, and training signals that go beyond appearance.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mostly methodological. First, it pushes MoE more explicitly into video diffusion pretraining, with the familiar promise of decoupling total capacity from active compute. That matters for multimodal foundation models, where dense scaling is becoming hard to sustain. Second, it treats embodied grounding as a pretraining data-mixture and objective-design problem rather than only a downstream robotics fine-tuning problem. That is the more interesting angle here. The contribution looks more like a systems-level recipe than a single sharp algorithmic advance, but the combination of single-stream DiT, sparse experts, data rebalancing, and physically informed rewards is relevant to anyone thinking about unified multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main pieces. The first is a task-unified single-stream diffusion transformer. Text conditions, image conditions, and visual latent patches are projected into the same hidden space and concatenated into one token sequence. T2I, T2V, and I2V are all handled in one framework, with image generation treated as the special case of a one-frame video. To separate condition tokens from visual tokens without introducing task-specific branches, the model uses 3D MM-RoPE with non-overlapping temporal coordinate ranges. The motivation for the single-stream design is practical and clear: better parameter reuse, denser cross-modal interaction at every layer, larger and cleaner GEMMs, and less split/concat overhead than dual-stream architectures, especially under distributed sequence-parallel training.

The second piece is sparse MoE scaling. The provided text does not include the full routing details, but the intent is clear: MoE is used to scale spatiotemporal modeling capacity without paying dense-compute cost everywhere. This mirrors the logic of MoE in LLMs, but the video setting is harder because routing has to coexist with spatial, temporal, and multimodal structure. Stability, load balancing, and temporal consistency are likely more delicate here. Choosing a single-stream backbone before adding MoE is a sensible systems decision, because it avoids compounding communication and partitioning complexity that a dual-stream design would introduce.

The third piece is data and training signal design. The model is trained on a robot-augmented corpus that mixes internet-scale videos with robot manipulation, navigation, and egocentric data. Importantly, the paper frames this as a profiling, filtering, and rebalancing problem rather than naive concatenation. On top of that, the training objective includes a multi-dimensional reward system that extends beyond perceptual quality and text alignment to physical plausibility and task-level success. Conceptually, this looks like alignment for a generative video model, but the target is still pretraining behavior: learning dynamics and interactions that are more useful for embodied settings.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include the full experimental section, so it is not possible to state reliable numbers for parameter count, training scale, benchmark scores, or exact gains. What can be inferred is that the paper presents qualitative T2I and T2V samples and positions the model as a large-scale open-source MoE video foundation model. The key empirical questions to check in the full paper are straightforward: whether MoE improves the quality-efficiency trade-off over dense DiT baselines, whether embodied data improves physical interaction and action semantics, and whether the reward system improves task success or physical plausibility beyond standard perceptual alignment. The most informative ablations would isolate the effects of the single-stream design, the data rebalancing pipeline, and the reward system. If the paper reports MFU, throughput, latency, load-balance metrics, or long-horizon consistency measures, those are more important than visual samples.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Read it for design choices, not for the demo outputs. Start with the introduction and make sure the problem framing is clear: visually strong video generation is not the same thing as an embodied world model. Then read the unified input formulation, the single-stream DiT section, and the positional encoding design. That is where the pretraining-relevant content is. After that, jump to the MoE implementation details: where experts are inserted, how routing works, whether there is an auxiliary load-balancing loss, and what the active-vs-total parameter scales are. Then inspect the data profiling engine: source composition, filtering rules, mixture ratios, and whether there is any curriculum. Finally, read the reward section and the ablations to understand whether the added supervision behaves more like RL-style alignment, reweighting, or extra supervision heads. Around 30 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 MoE-DiT 和数据 profiling 设计；若正文没有干净 scaling ablation，就只能当具身视频 pretrain recipe 参考。
recommendation.en: Skim the MoE-DiT and data profiling design; without clean scaling ablations, this is mainly a recipe reference for embodied video pretraining.

paper.title: UBEP: Re-architecting Expert Parallelism Communication Library for Production Superpods
paper.abstract: The deployment of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models on production high-bandwidth superpods, such as NVIDIA's NVL72/576 and Huawei's CloudMatrix384, introduces critical challenges beyond raw interconnect bandwidth. While these systems provide unified global address spaces and high-bandwidth fabrics, their full potential for sparse MoE communication is hindered by three fundamental bottlenecks: (1) Strict execution serialization imposed by coarse-grained Bulk Synchronous Parallel (BSP) orchestration

summary.core_problem: MoE模型在生产级高带宽超级集群（如NVIDIA NVL72/576、华为CloudMatrix384）上部署时，专家并行（EP）通信无法充分利用高带宽互联的潜力，存在三个核心瓶颈：一是粗粒度BSP编排下相互依赖的通信阶段严格串行执行，并行度不足；二是全局同步开销随互联带宽提升而占比激增，成为新的性能瓶颈；三是不规则token流量的距离无关调度导致严重的负载不均衡，集群带宽利用率低。
summary.importance: MoE是当前大模型基座预训练和部署的核心架构方向之一，专家并行的通信效率直接决定了大模型训练与推理的扩展性和单位算力成本。UBEP从通信库底层重构了EP的执行范式，突破了传统BSP架构的三大瓶颈，其设计思路不仅可直接用于MoE推理部署降本提效，对大规模MoE预训练中的通信优化也有重要借鉴价值。
summary.technical_approach:
UBEP（Unified-Bus Expert Parallelism）是面向MoE低延迟推理的通信库，基于三个协同设计的核心机制：
1）内核分解（Kernel Decomposition）：打破传统BSP的串行约束，将加速器内的AIV计算单元分成独立任务组并行执行（如多数AIV负责token发送，少数AIV负责token计数计算与前缀和），用轻量级点对点同步（异步信号轮询共享内存）替代全局屏障，让无依赖的任务重叠执行。通过成本建模推导两组AIV的最优分配比例，在不损失传输带宽的前提下重叠元数据处理延迟。
2）分层token级调度（Hierarchical Token-level Scheduling）：针对超级集群内的层级化延迟差异，用硬件加速的映射器在1微秒内生成最优分配调度，解决不规则token流量的负载不均衡问题。
3）数据即标志（Data-as-Flag）：利用硬件原生的512字节原子加载/存储能力，将控制标志直接嵌入数据 payload，无需单独的控制消息即可实现隐式一致性，消除昂贵的跨NPU全局同步。
三个机制协同作用：内核分解暴露细粒度可并行任务，调度器在集群范围内平衡负载，Data-as-Flag实现无屏障的细粒度同步。
summary.experiments: 当前公开内容中完整实验部分尚未完全呈现。已披露的验证包括：通过成本建模推导了AIV分配的最优比例，并在附录中通过实验验证了模型的准确性；核心机制以dispatch阶段为主要验证场景（全局同步和负载不均衡瓶颈主要集中在该阶段），设计可推广到combine等其他EP原语。方案已适配NVIDIA NVL系列、华为CloudMatrix等生产级超级集群。
summary.reading_guide: 重点精读第3章的三个核心技术设计（3.2内核分解、3.3分层token级调度、3.4 Data-as-Flag），理解三者如何协同突破传统BSP的三大瓶颈。第2章的瓶颈分析部分值得仔细读，能帮助建立对MoE通信问题的系统性认知。附录A的成本建模和附录C的实验验证有细节参考价值。建议先读概述建立整体框架，再深入各机制的设计细节与权衡。
summary.authors_note: 具体作者与所属机构未在提供内容中明确，研究面向NVIDIA NVL系列、华为CloudMatrix等生产级超级集群场景。

summary_en.core_problem: When deploying Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models on production high-bandwidth superpods (e.g., NVIDIA NVL72/576, Huawei CloudMatrix384), expert parallelism (EP) communication fails to fully utilize high-bandwidth fabric potential due to three core bottlenecks: 1) Strict execution serialization from coarse-grained BSP orchestration of interdependent communication phases, limiting parallelism; 2) Prohibitive global synchronization overhead that grows as a share of total latency with increasing interconnect bandwidth, becoming a new performance bottleneck; 3) Severe load imbalance from distance-agnostic scheduling of irregular token traffic, resulting in low cluster bandwidth utilization.
summary_en.importance: MoE is one of the core architectural directions for large language model base pretraining and deployment. EP communication efficiency directly determines the scalability and per-compute cost of large model training and inference. UBEP rearchitects the EP execution paradigm from the communication library level, breaking through three major bottlenecks of traditional BSP architectures. Its design ideas can not only directly reduce costs and improve efficiency for MoE inference deployment, but also have important reference value for communication optimization in large-scale MoE pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
UBEP (Unified-Bus Expert Parallelism) is a communication library for low-latency MoE inference, built on three synergistic core mechanisms:
1) Kernel Decomposition: Breaks the sequential constraint of traditional BSP by partitioning on-accelerator AIV compute units into independent task groups that run in parallel (e.g., most AIVs handle token sending, while a smaller group handles token count computation and prefix sums). Lightweight point-to-point synchronization (asynchronous signal polling of shared memory) replaces global barriers, allowing overlap of independent tasks. Cost modeling derives the optimal allocation ratio between the two groups to overlap metadata processing latency without sacrificing transmission bandwidth.
2) Hierarchical Token-level Scheduling: Addresses hierarchical latency differences within superpods, using a hardware-accelerated mapper to generate optimal allocation schedules within 1 microsecond, resolving load imbalance from irregular token traffic.
3) Data-as-Flag: Leverages hardware-native 512-byte atomic load/store support to embed control flags directly in the data payload, achieving implicit consistency without separate control messages and eliminating expensive cross-NPU global synchronization.
The three mechanisms work synergistically: decomposition exposes fine-grained parallelizable tasks, scheduling balances load across the fabric, and Data-as-Flag enables barrier-free fine-grained synchronization.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental results are not fully presented in the available content.
