Disclosed validation includes cost modeling to derive the optimal AIV allocation ratio, with experimental verification of the model's accuracy in the appendix. Core mechanisms are primarily validated on the dispatch phase (where global synchronization and load imbalance bottlenecks are most concentrated), and the design is generalizable to other EP primitives such as the combine routine. The solution has been adapted for production superpods including NVIDIA NVL series and Huawei CloudMatrix.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus intensive reading on Chapter 3's three core technical designs (3.2 Kernel Decomposition, 3.3 Hierarchical Token-level Scheduling, 3.4 Data-as-Flag) to understand how they collectively break through the three BSP bottlenecks. The bottleneck analysis in Chapter 2 is worth careful reading to build a systematic understanding of MoE communication challenges. Appendix A (cost modeling) and Appendix C (experimental verification) provide detailed reference value. It is recommended to first read the overview to establish the overall framework, then dive into the design details and tradeoffs of each mechanism.
summary_en.authors_note: Specific authors and affiliations are not clearly disclosed in the provided content; the research targets production superpod scenarios such as NVIDIA NVL series and Huawei CloudMatrix.

recommendation.zh: MoE大规模预训练核心通信优化的生产级方案，应立刻在内部MoE训练栈复现验证实际收益。
recommendation.en: Production-grade core communication optimization for large-scale MoE pretraining, should be immediately reproduced in internal MoE training stack for validation.

paper.title: Gemma 4 Technical Report
paper.abstract: We introduce Gemma 4, a new generation of open-weight, natively multimodal language models in the Gemma model family. Designed to advance compute efficiency and reasoning, the Gemma 4 model suite features dense and Mixture-of-Experts architectures, ranging from 2.3B to 31B parameters. Alongside improved vision and audio encoders for all model sizes, we propose a unified, encoder-free architecture for our 12B model, which ingests raw audio and image patches. Furthermore, we integrate a thinking m

summary.core_problem: Gemma 4 解决的是开源权重模型在多模态、推理、长上下文和推理效率之间的联合取舍问题。它不是单点模型更新，而是一套面向不同硬件预算的模型族设计：从 2.3B、4.5B、12B、31B dense，到 26B total / 3.8B activated 的 MoE，同时覆盖文本、图像、音频和 thinking mode。核心问题可以概括为：如何在较小到中等参数规模内，把 multimodal pretraining、long-context efficiency、reasoning post-training 和 serving 友好的结构设计放进同一个可发布体系。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响主要有三点。第一，Gemma 4 把 open-weight 模型的设计重心从“文本 LLM + 外接多模态 encoder”推进到更原生的多模态建模，尤其是 12B 的 encoder-free 方案，直接把图像 patch 和 raw audio chunk 投入 LLM embedding space。这个方向对 unified multimodal LM 有参考意义。第二，报告把长上下文能力放在架构层面处理，而不是只依赖外推技巧：local/global attention ratio、p-RoPE、KV cache sharing、global layer 中 keys-as-values 共同减少 KV cache 压力。第三，Gemma 4 明确把 post-training 的 thinking mode、QAT 量化版本、MTP drafter head 一起纳入发布形态，说明 pretrain、posttrain 和 serving 约束已经被联合优化，而不是串行拼接。
summary.technical_approach: 模型主体仍是 decoder-only Transformer，使用 pre-norm 和 post-norm 的 RMSNorm，并加入 QKNorm。模型族包含 dense 和 MoE 两类；E2B 与 E4B 使用 per-layer embeddings，因此有效参数为 2.3B 和 4.5B，但总参数分别约为 5B 和 8B。长上下文部分沿用局部注意力与全局注意力混合：E2B 是 4:1 local-to-global，其余模型是 5:1。全局层使用 p-RoPE，p=0.25；局部层使用普通 RoPE。全局和局部 RoPE frequency 分别设为 1M 与 10k。除 E2B/E4B 外，global attention layer 复用 keys 作为 values，使全局 KV cache 最多减少 37.5%。E2B/E4B 还使用 KV cache sharing，比例为 20/35 与 18/42。多模态部分有两条路线。多数模型使用冻结的 vision/audio encoder：小模型配 150M ViT，大模型配 550M ViT；音频 encoder 为 305M USM-style Conformer，输入为 40ms Mel filterbank chunk，相比 Gemma 3n 的 680M 音频 encoder 减少 55% 参数。12B 模型采用更激进的 encoder-free 设计：图像输入为 48×48×3 RGB patches，经单个大矩阵投影到 LLM embedding space，投影模块约 35M 参数，并加入 2D coordinate-based positional embeddings；音频直接把 16kHz 下 40ms 的 raw audio chunk，即 640 维向量，投影到 LLM embedding space，不再使用 Conformer encoder。训练数据覆盖 web documents、code、images、audio，截止到 2025 年 1 月；tokenizer 沿用 Gemini 系列 SentencePiece，包含 split digits、preserved whitespace、byte-level encoding，词表为 262k。推理侧提供 MTP drafter head 支持 speculative decoding，并发布 QAT 量化模型以降低参数显存和延迟。
summary.experiments: 报告给出的关键量化信息集中在架构和效率侧。模型规模覆盖 2.3B effective、4.5B effective、12B、31B dense，以及 26B total / 3.8B activated MoE。视觉 encoder 有 150M 与 550M 两档；音频 encoder 从 680M 降到 305M，减少 55%。12B encoder-free 视觉投影模块约 35M，相比 550M ViT encoder 显著降低额外模块体量。长上下文中，global layer 的 keys-as-values 与 p-RoPE 组合使 global KV cache footprint 最多减少 37.5%。视觉输入支持可变长宽比，并把最大 token 数限制在 70、140、280、560、1120 等档位。性能上，报告声称 Gemma 4 在 STEM、多模态、长上下文 benchmark，以及 Arena 类人评中达到接近更大开源前沿模型的水平；但给定内容没有列出具体 benchmark 表格数值，因此更可靠的实验解读应聚焦这些工程可复现设计：KV cache 节省、encoder 参数缩减、MTP drafter、QAT，以及 encoder-free 12B 的质量/效率权衡。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读三块。第一是 Model Architecture，尤其是 local/global attention ratio、p-RoPE、keys-as-values、KV cache sharing 的组合方式。这部分对长上下文预训练和 serving 成本最有直接参考价值。第二是 unified encoder-free 12B。重点看它如何用 48×48 图像 patch、2D coordinate embedding 和 raw audio 40ms chunk 替代重型 encoder；这里的关键不是省参数本身，而是多模态输入是否可以更早进入 LM token space。第三是 tokenizer、data filtering、QAT 和 MTP drafter 的发布策略。它们说明一个可用 open-weight 模型族需要同时考虑训练语料、污染控制、推理路径和部署格式。若时间有限，先读架构表、长上下文设计图表、encoder-free 章节和 benchmark 汇总表；再看 appendix 中 vision encoder 可变长宽比算法和各模型配置表。
summary.authors_note: Gemma Team，来自 Google / Google DeepMind 体系。Gemma 4 延续 Gemma、Gemma 2、Gemma 3、Gemma 3n 的 open-weight 路线，技术背景与 Gemini 系列 tokenizer、多模态训练和端侧部署需求密切相关。

summary_en.core_problem: Gemma 4 addresses a combined design problem: how to build open-weight models that handle text, vision, audio, reasoning traces, long contexts, and efficient inference under realistic hardware budgets. The report is not just a model-size update. It describes a full model family, ranging from 2.3B and 4.5B effective dense models to 12B, 31B, and a 26B-total / 3.8B-activated MoE model, with a consistent set of choices for multimodal pretraining, long-context attention, quantization, and speculative decoding.
summary_en.importance: The main pretraining relevance is the move toward more native multimodal language modeling. Most Gemma 4 models still use frozen vision and audio encoders, but the 12B model removes both heavy encoders and directly projects image patches and raw audio chunks into the LLM embedding space. That makes the report useful for researchers thinking about unified multimodal token streams rather than adapter-style multimodal systems. A second contribution is the long-context recipe: local/global attention patterns, p-RoPE, KV-cache sharing, and reusing keys as values in global layers are combined to reduce inference memory pressure. A third point is the product-shaped training interface: thinking mode, quantization-aware training, and an MTP drafter head are treated as part of the released system rather than as afterthoughts.
summary_en.technical_approach: The backbone remains a decoder-only Transformer with RMSNorm in both pre-norm and post-norm positions, plus QKNorm. The family includes dense and MoE variants. E2B and E4B use per-layer embeddings, giving 2.3B and 4.5B effective parameters out of roughly 5B and 8B total parameters. For long contexts, E2B uses a 4:1 local-to-global attention pattern, while the larger models use 5:1. Global layers use p-RoPE with p=0.25, while local layers use standard RoPE. The RoPE frequencies are 1M for global layers and 10k for local layers. Except for E2B and E4B, global layers reuse keys as values, reducing the global KV-cache footprint by up to 37.5%. E2B and E4B additionally use KV-cache sharing ratios of 20/35 and 18/42. The multimodal design has two paths. Most models use frozen encoders: 150M or 550M ViTs for vision, and a 305M USM-style Conformer audio encoder operating on 40 ms Mel-filterbank chunks. The 12B model is trained from scratch with an encoder-free design. It takes 48×48×3 RGB patches, projects them through a roughly 35M-parameter matrix into the LLM embedding space, and adds coordinate-based 2D positional embeddings. For audio, it segments 16 kHz waveforms into 40 ms chunks, producing 640-dimensional vectors that are directly projected into the LLM embedding space. The training data includes web documents, code, images, and audio with a January 2025 cutoff. The tokenizer is a 262k-entry SentencePiece tokenizer with split digits, preserved whitespace, and byte-level encodings. The release also includes quantization-aware trained variants and an autoregressive multi-token prediction drafter head for speculative decoding.
summary_en.experiments: The most concrete quantitative evidence in the provided content is architectural and efficiency-related. The family spans 2.3B effective, 4.5B effective, 12B, 31B dense, and 26B-total / 3.8B-activated MoE models. Vision encoders come in 150M and 550M sizes. The audio encoder is reduced from 680M in the previous design to 305M, a 55% parameter reduction. The encoder-free 12B replaces the 550M vision encoder with a roughly 35M projection module. The global KV-cache footprint is reduced by up to 37.5% through the combination of p-RoPE and key-as-value reuse in global layers. Vision inputs support variable aspect ratios with maximum token budgets of 70, 140, 280, 560, and 1120. The report states gains across STEM, multimodal, long-context benchmarks, and Arena-style human evaluation, but the supplied text does not expose the exact benchmark tables. The safest reading is to treat the efficiency and architectural numbers as the primary reusable evidence, and then inspect the original benchmark tables for quality trade-offs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the architecture section closely. The most useful details are the local/global attention schedule, p-RoPE placement, key-as-value reuse, and KV-cache sharing. These are directly relevant to long-context pretraining and serving cost. Then read the encoder-free 12B section, especially the image patch projection, coordinate embeddings, and direct raw-audio chunk projection. The main question is whether heavy modality encoders are still necessary when the LM is trained from scratch with multimodal inputs. Finally, inspect the tokenizer, filtering, QAT, and MTP drafter sections. They show how the pretraining recipe connects to deployment constraints. If time is limited, prioritize the model configuration tables, long-context design figures, the encoder-free architecture description, and the benchmark summary tables.
summary_en.authors_note: Gemma Team from the Google / Google DeepMind ecosystem. The work continues the Gemma open-weight line and is closely tied to Gemini-family tokenizer choices, multimodal training infrastructure, and deployment-oriented model design.

recommendation.zh: 应优先读架构、数据配比和消融表；12B encoder-free 多模态若细节扎实，会影响下一轮统一模型 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the architecture, data-mixture, and ablation sections first; the 12B encoder-free multimodal setup could change the next unified-model ablation plan if the details are clean.

institutions: opers and researchers everywhere to build upon

paper.title: Unified Audio Intelligence Without Regressing on Text Intelligence
paper.abstract: Audio intelligence involves understanding, reasoning about, and generating both audio and speech. In this work, we introduce Nemotron-Labs-Audex-30B-A3B (Audex), a unified audio-text LLM built on Nemotron-Cascade-2-30B-A3B, a strong text-only MoE LLM. Audex adopts a simple unified design with a single Transformer decoder: audio inputs are encoded and projected into the text embedding space, while text tokens and quantized audio output tokens are treated uniformly during generation. This architec

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是统一音频-文本模型里的一个实际矛盾：加入音频理解和音频生成后，模型往往在纯文本推理、知识、长上下文和工具使用能力上退化。论文的目标不是单点提升 ASR 或 TTS，而是在一个单解码器 LLM 中同时支持音频输入、文本输出、音频输出，并尽量保持原文本基座的能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在两个方面。第一，它把音频输入和量化音频输出都纳入标准 LLM 训练与推理栈，说明统一多模态生成不一定要依赖复杂的 thinker-talker 或级联系统。第二，它把“保住文本能力”作为核心约束，训练时混入原文本 post-training 数据和大规模音频-文本数据。这对 native multimodal pretraining 很关键：多模态扩展不是只看新模态指标，还要控制对文本表示、推理分布和对齐行为的扰动。
summary.technical_approach: Audex 基于 Nemotron-Cascade-2-30B-A3B 构建，后者是 30B 总参数、约 3B 激活参数的 Mamba2-Transformer hybrid MoE 文本模型。架构上，音频输入先经过音频编码器，再用 MLP 投影到文本 embedding 空间；输出侧则把文本 token 和量化音频 token 统一作为自回归序列生成。这样做的取舍很清楚：保留单 Transformer decoder，减少跨模块接口和训练系统改造，同时让音频与文本在同一残差流里融合。与级联系统相比，它减少了中间错误传播；与 thinker-talker 结构相比，它更接近普通 LLM 的训练、推理和 serving 形态。训练上，论文使用 157.4B audio tokens 和 320.5B text tokens，并把 Nemotron-Cascade 2 使用过的文本 post-training 数据与音频-文本数据混合，核心意图是让音频能力增量学习，而不是覆盖已有文本能力。
summary.experiments: 模型评估覆盖两条线：纯文本能力和音频相关能力。纯文本侧包括推理、知识、alignment、长上下文理解和 agentic performance；音频侧包括 general audio understanding、ASR、speech translation、TTS、audio generation、speech-to-speech generation。主结果显示，Audex 在文本 benchmark 上与 Nemotron-Cascade-2 接近，部分推理任务如 IMO AnswerBench、AIME 2026、HMMT Feb2025 with tool-integrated reasoning 还略高于文本基座。论文强调这一点是因为 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking 相对 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 在推理 benchmark 上有明显回退。需要注意，当前给出的全文片段没有完整表格数值，因此更适合把它看作一个工程 recipe 和训练约束案例，而不是只看单个指标排名。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。优先看 Section 3 的架构设计，重点确认音频 encoder、MLP projection、文本 token 与量化音频 token 的统一生成方式。然后看 Section 4 的数据配比与多阶段训练 recipe，尤其是如何混入原文本 post-training 数据来控制退化。Section 5 和 Table 1 适合对照看：不要只看音频任务提升，要看纯文本 reasoning、long-context、tool-integrated reasoning 是否稳定。值得深挖的是音频 tokenization、audio/text mixture、以及是否存在某些文本能力被平均分掩盖的局部退化。
summary.authors_note: NVIDIA 技术报告。模型基座为 Nemotron-Cascade-2-30B-A3B。文中标注多位作者 equal contribution，并给出 NVIDIA 通讯邮箱；可确认的通讯作者/负责人邮箱前缀包括 zkong、sanggill、jaehyeonk、boxinw、wping。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical failure mode in unified audio-text LLMs: adding audio understanding and audio generation often degrades the original text-only capabilities, especially reasoning, knowledge, long-context behavior, and tool use. The goal is not a narrow ASR or TTS improvement, but a single-decoder LLM that handles audio input, text output, and audio output while preserving the text intelligence of its backbone.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is the training and architecture constraint: multimodal expansion is treated as capability addition under a no-regression requirement on text. Audex keeps the model close to a standard LLM stack, uses unified autoregressive generation over text tokens and quantized audio tokens, and mixes audio-text data with the original text post-training data. This is directly relevant to native multimodal pretraining, where the hard problem is not only acquiring the new modality but also avoiding interference with the text representation and reasoning distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: Audex is built on Nemotron-Cascade-2-30B-A3B, a 30B-parameter Mamba2-Transformer hybrid MoE model with about 3B activated parameters. Audio inputs are processed by an audio encoder and projected through an MLP into the text embedding space. On the output side, text tokens and quantized audio tokens are handled uniformly by the same autoregressive decoder. This design avoids a cascaded pipeline and avoids a separate thinker-talker decomposition. The benefit is compatibility with standard LLM training and inference infrastructure, while allowing audio-text fusion inside a shared residual stream. The training corpus contains 157.4B audio tokens and 320.5B text tokens, and the recipe explicitly reuses the text-only post-training data of the backbone together with audio-text data to reduce regression.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is organized around two axes: text-only capability and audio capability. Text evaluation covers reasoning, knowledge, alignment, long-context understanding, and agentic behavior. Audio evaluation covers general audio understanding, ASR, speech translation, TTS, audio generation, and speech-to-speech generation. The reported main table shows that Audex remains close to Nemotron-Cascade-2 on text benchmarks, with slight gains on some reasoning settings such as IMO AnswerBench, AIME 2026, and HMMT Feb2025 with tool-integrated reasoning. The paper contrasts this with reported reasoning regressions in Qwen3-Omni relative to its text-only backbone. The available text does not expose all table entries, so the safest reading is to treat the result as evidence for a particular architecture-and-data recipe rather than as a metric-only comparison.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30–45 minutes. Start with Section 3 for the unified decoder architecture, especially the audio encoder, MLP projection, and joint treatment of text and quantized audio tokens. Then read Section 4 for the data mixture and multi-stage training recipe. Section 5 and Table 1 are useful for checking whether text reasoning and long-context metrics stay stable while audio capabilities are added. The most important details to inspect are the audio tokenizer, the audio/text mixture, and whether average text scores hide localized regressions.
summary_en.authors_note: NVIDIA technical report. The model is built on Nemotron-Cascade-2-30B-A3B. The paper marks several authors as equal contributors and lists NVIDIA contact prefixes including zkong, sanggill, jaehyeonk, boxinw, and wping.

recommendation.zh: 统一音频建模的扎实工程工作，重点看多阶段训练中纯文本RL+蒸馏补回文本能力的recipe，架构本身沿用现有统一LM设计。
recommendation.en: A solid engineering effort on unified audio-text modeling; focus on the text-only RL + distillation recipe that prevents text regression, as the architecture follows existing unified LM designs.

paper.title: Discrete Diffusion Language Models for Interactive Radiology Report Drafting
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models, which generate text by denoising a token canvas bidirectionally instead of emitting tokens left to right, have become competitive with autoregressive (AR) generation. Medical foundation models, however, remain almost entirely autoregressive. We adapt a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model, DiffusionGemma-26B, and benchmark it against its same-size AR sibling Gemma-4-26B under an identical LoRA recipe on medical visual question answering datasets, scored by a ver

summary.core_problem: 检验离散 diffusion language model 在医学报告草拟和医学 VQA 中是否能替代同规模自回归模型，并利用双向去噪实现任意位置补全文本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是新型语言建模范式的应用验证。虽然场景是放射报告，但关键问题是 diffusion LM 与 AR LM 在同规模、同 LoRA recipe 下的能力、延迟和交互式编辑差异，这对判断非 AR 文本生成路线有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 将 MoE diffusion language model DiffusionGemma-26B 适配到医学任务，并与同尺寸 AR sibling Gemma-4-26B 做对照；两者使用相同 LoRA 微调 recipe。diffusion 模型通过 token canvas 的双向去噪生成文本，因此天然支持固定若干报告片段后在中间任意顺序 infill。
summary.experiments: 在多个 medical VQA 数据集上评测，使用对 verbosity 更稳健的 LLM judge。摘要称 diffusion 模型在所有数据集上匹配或超过同尺寸 AR 模型，微调后 3.8B active 参数模型可与 frontier VLM 竞争，解码速度快 3.5-4.4 倍；未给出具体数据集名称和逐项分数。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether a discrete diffusion language model can match an equal-size autoregressive model for medical report drafting and VQA, while enabling arbitrary-position infilling.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an applied validation of a non-autoregressive language-modeling paradigm. The radiology setting is narrow, but the clean AR-vs-diffusion comparison under the same LoRA recipe is relevant for judging diffusion LMs as practical text generators.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors adapt DiffusionGemma-26B, a mixture-of-experts diffusion LM, and compare it with the same-size autoregressive sibling Gemma-4-26B. Both are finetuned with an identical LoRA setup. Bidirectional denoising over a token canvas gives the diffusion model native any-order infilling for partially fixed reports.
summary_en.experiments: The model is evaluated on medical VQA datasets with a verbosity-robust LLM judge. The abstract reports that diffusion matches or exceeds the AR baseline on all datasets, the finetuned 3.8B-active model is competitive with frontier VLMs, and decoding is 3.5-4.4x faster; per-dataset scores are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看同 recipe 的 AR 对照和 infill demo；医学任务窄，但延迟与任意顺序编辑会改变 diffusion LM 的实用性判断。
recommendation.en: Read the equal-recipe AR comparison and the infill demo; the domain is narrow, but the latency and editing results shift the practical prior on diffusion LMs.

paper.title: Mixture-of-Parallelisms: Towards Memory-Efficient Training Stack for Mixture-of-Experts Models
paper.abstract: This paper showcases a memory-efficient training stack for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. It is a training paradigm that combines and specializes various existing and novel parallelism techniques at different layers and stages of the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model training pipeline. It leverages these techniques to achieve maximal efficiency given the physical constraints of CPU, CPU memory, GPU HBM memory, and the CPU-GPU, GPU-GPU, and node-node communication bandwidth of the GPU cluster. It

summary.core_problem: 现有万亿参数长上下文MoE模型训练普遍采用全局统一的并行策略，无法匹配注意力、MoE前馈、词表投影、优化器状态等不同组件的差异化瓶颈，导致GPU显存、互联带宽、CPU/主机内存等资源利用率低，无法在有限硬件下支撑百万上下文的万亿参数训练。
summary.importance: 打破了全局统一并行策略的设计惯性，提出按组件瓶颈匹配并行方式的系统设计范式，大幅降低了万亿级MoE预训练与微调的硬件门槛；给出了长上下文MoE训练的内存-带宽瓶颈拆解方法，以及三个无损优化的具体实现，为后续大模型训练系统设计提供了可复用的组件级并行方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出混合并行（MoP）训练栈，放弃全局统一并行计划，为MoE模型的每个组件匹配对应瓶颈的分片策略，且所有并行方式在秩级别保持类数据并行特性（每个设备持有不同token分片和对应权重分片），避免3D并行的秩乘法开销。核心包含三个无损优化：1）基于最小负载专家并行（LLEP）的内存高效专家并行，将路由通信与专家计算重叠，降低MoE激活的瞬时内存占用同时保留LLEP的加速效果；2）数据-张量混合分片的词表投影，无需实例化O(NV)规模的logit张量即可计算精确损失和梯度，且满足类数据并行的秩不变性；3）流水线式优化器更新，通过计算-通信重叠压缩优化器步骤的关键路径耗时。所有优化均为无损，不改变训练语义。
summary.experiments: 在120B、600B、1T参数的MoE模型上分别用2、8、12台8×H200节点训练，与最优调参的FSDP2基线相比，MoP的单GPU吞吐量提升4.7~8.2倍，且模型规模越大优势越明显；FSDP2在上下文长度超过64K~128K时即显存耗尽，而MoP可稳定支持最高1M token的上下文训练，且吞吐量随上下文增长几乎保持平稳，万亿参数规模下每步耗时基本由前向/反向计算主导。
summary.reading_guide: 预计阅读时间20-25分钟。重点关注第3.1-3.2节的组件级瓶颈分析与并行策略匹配逻辑、第3.3-3.5节的三个核心无损优化的具体实现、第4节的不同规模模型与上下文长度下的吞吐量/内存对比图表；训练系统方向研究者可深挖附录中通信重叠的实现细节，预训练配方方向研究者可重点关注硬件资源利用率的拆解部分。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing trillion-parameter long-context MoE training relies on uniform global parallelism strategies that fail to match the distinct bottlenecks of different components (attention, MoE feed-forward, vocabulary projection, optimizer state), resulting in underutilization of GPU HBM, interconnect bandwidth, CPU/host memory, and making million-context trillion-parameter training infeasible on limited hardware budgets.
summary_en.importance: Breaks the conventional design inertia of uniform global parallelism, proposes a component-matched parallelism paradigm that drastically reduces the hardware barrier for trillion-scale MoE pretraining and fine-tuning. It also provides a structured memory-bandwidth bottleneck decomposition for long-context MoE training, along with three lossless optimizations that serve as reusable building blocks for future large model training system design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Mixture-of-Parallelisms (MoP), a training stack that abandons uniform global parallel plans and assigns sharding strategies matched to each MoE component's dominant bottleneck. All composed parallelism methods maintain a data-parallel-like rank invariant (each device holds a distinct token shard and corresponding weight shard), avoiding the rank multiplication overhead of 3D parallelism. Three core lossless optimizations are included: 1) A memory-efficient expert parallelism built on Least-Loaded Expert Parallelism (LLEP) that overlaps routing communication with expert computation to reduce transient MoE activation footprint while preserving LLEP speedups; 2) A sharded data-tensor-parallel vocabulary projection that computes exact loss and gradients without materializing the O(NV) logit tensor, while respecting the data-parallel rank invariant; 3) A pipelined optimizer update scheme that compresses critical path time via computation-communication overlap. All optimizations preserve exact training semantics.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 120B, 600B, and 1T parameter MoE models trained on 2, 8, and 12 8×H200 nodes respectively. Compared to the best-tuned FSDP2 baseline, MoP delivers 4.7–8.2× higher per-GPU throughput, with advantages widening as model scale grows. FSDP2 runs out of memory at context lengths beyond 64K–128K, while MoP stably supports up to 1M token context with nearly flat throughput across context lengths; per-step wall time at trillion-parameter scale is essentially bounded by forward and backward compute.
summary_en.reading_guide: Estimated reading time 20-25 minutes. Focus on Sections 3.1–3.2 for component-level bottleneck analysis and parallelism assignment logic, Sections 3.3–3.5 for implementation details of the three core lossless optimizations, and Section 4's throughput/memory comparison plots across model scales and context lengths. For training system researchers, deep dive into appendix communication overlap implementation details; for pretraining recipe researchers, focus on hardware resource utilization breakdowns.

recommendation.zh: 这是典型“系统细节决定能不能做实验”的 paper；先看并行分解和 optimizer step，若 loss 等价性证据干净，内部长上下文 MoE 栈应立刻对照复现。
recommendation.en: This is the kind of paper where systems detail determines whether the experiment is even feasible; read the parallelism decomposition and optimizer-step design first, then verify whether the loss-equivalence evidence is actually clean.

paper.title: Generic Expert Coverage for Pruning SparseMixture-of-Experts Language Models
paper.abstract: Sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models contain substantial structured redundancy among routed experts, but pruning them without downstream calibration data remains challenging. Existing expert-pruning methods typically rely on a single aggregated importance score, which can bias the retained set toward experts favored by dominant calibration patterns. We propose \textbf{Generic TB-Coverage}, a coverage-aware expert pruning method that uses only generic text corpora (WikiText

summary.core_problem: 稀疏MoE大模型在无下游校准数据的场景下做专家剪枝时，现有单聚合重要度分数的排序方法会偏向主导校准模式对应的专家，丢弃那些在特定通用语料上关键但平均得分不高的专家，导致剪枝后模型泛化能力受损。
summary.importance: 提出了一种仅依赖通用文本语料的覆盖感知剪枝方法，无需下游数据和微调，为MoE预训练模型的轻量化压缩提供了更鲁棒的方案，对MoE模型的部署效率优化有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是Generic TB-Coverage方法，流程分为四步：1）在WikiText2和C4两个通用语料上，分别统计每个专家的REAP风格效用分数（结合路由权重与专家输出范数）；2）为每个语料生成独立的专家重要性排名；3）通过轮询规则从各语料排名中交替选择受保护专家，保障跨语料的能力覆盖；4）合并受保护专家集合后，移除排名最低的未受保护专家以达到目标保留比例。整个过程不需要模型微调。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B和DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Base两个开源MoE模型上测试，覆盖25%、50%、75%三种专家保留比例。主指标为6个零样本基准（ARC-Challenge、ARC-Easy、HellaSwag、PIQA、WinoGrande、BoolQ）的平均准确率，辅助测试MMLU、GSM8K、Math500。该方法在所有保留比例下均优于单分数排序的剪枝基线，同时发现单种子随机剪枝基线在稀疏MoE场景下方差大、结果具有误导性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计15分钟。重点关注方法部分的轮询覆盖规则设计，以及实验部分跨模型、跨保留比例的一致性结果。附录中关于随机剪枝方差的分析和不同语料下专家效用分布的对比也值得浏览。

summary_en.core_problem: Expert pruning of sparse MoE language models without downstream calibration data suffers from systematic bias when using single aggregated importance scores: experts critical for specific generic corpora but with moderate average scores tend to be discarded, degrading the pruned model's generalization.
summary_en.importance: A coverage-aware pruning method that relies solely on generic text corpora and requires no fine-tuning provides a more robust approach for post-pretraining MoE compression, with practical value for optimizing MoE deployment efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core is Generic TB-Coverage, a four-step procedure: 1) Compute per-expert REAP-style utility scores (combining router weight and expert output norm) independently on two generic corpora, WikiText2 and C4; 2) Generate separate expert importance rankings for each corpus; 3) Select protected experts via a round-robin rule across corpus-specific rankings to ensure cross-corpus capability coverage; 4) Merge protected experts and remove the lowest-ranked unprotected ones to meet the target retention budget. No model fine-tuning is required.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on two open-source MoE models — Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B and DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Base — at 25%, 50%, and 75% expert retention budgets. The primary metric is average accuracy across six zero-shot benchmarks (ARC-Challenge, ARC-Easy, HellaSwag, PIQA, WinoGrande, BoolQ), with MMLU, GSM8K, and Math500 as auxiliary tests. The method outperforms single-score ranking baselines across all retention ratios. The paper also finds that single-seed random pruning baselines have high variance and can be misleading in sparse MoE settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, ~15 minutes. Focus on the round-robin coverage rule design in the method section, and the consistent cross-model, cross-retention-budget results in experiments. The appendix analysis of random pruning variance and per-corpus expert utility distributions is also worth browsing.

recommendation.zh: MoE剪枝无需下游数据的实用方案，规避了单重要性打分的模式偏差问题，直接看Table 2不同保留率下的零样本对比即可
recommendation.en: Practical downstream-free MoE pruning method that avoids the pattern bias of single importance scores; just check Table 2 for zero-shot comparisons across retention rates

paper.title: CLEAR-MoE: Shared-Basis Expert Extraction from Frozen Vision Transformers via Calibration-Driven Layer Selection
paper.abstract: We present CLEAR-MoE, a four-phase post-training pipeline that converts a frozen pretrained Vision Transformer (ViT) into a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model without updating backbone weights. The pipeline (i) scores feed-forward network (FFN) layers by sparsity, clusterability, and output sensitivity; (ii) decomposes selected layers into a shared low-rank SVD basis and per-cluster residual experts using k-means clustering; (iii) trains lightweight routers supervised by cluster labels; and (

summary.core_problem: 如何在不更新预训练ViT骨干权重的前提下，将稠密模型转换为稀疏MoE结构以提升推理效率，同时最小化精度损失。
summary.importance: 提出了四阶段后训练MoE转换pipeline，发现了post-hoc MoE转换场景下共享基权重的核心作用、路由策略弱影响的经验结论，对MoE架构设计有弱参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 流程分四步：1）按稀疏度、可聚类性、输出敏感性给FFN层打分选择转换层；2）对选中层做SVD分解得到共享低维基，对残差做k-means聚类得到残差专家；3）用聚类标签监督训练轻量路由器；4）适配CUDA稀疏后端。
summary.experiments: 在Imagenette数据集上用DeiT-Small验证，转换后MoE保留原模型99.9%精度（86.70% vs 86.73%）；消融显示不同路由策略精度差异不超过0.06个百分点，共享SVD基是精度保留的核心。

summary_en.core_problem: How to convert a frozen pretrained dense Vision Transformer into a sparse MoE model without updating backbone weights, to improve inference efficiency while minimizing accuracy loss.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a four-phase post-training MoE conversion pipeline, and finds empirical evidence that shared basis weights dominate accuracy preservation while routing strategies have negligible impact in this post-hoc setup, providing weak reference for MoE architecture design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Four-stage pipeline: (1) score FFN layers by sparsity, clusterability, and output sensitivity to select layers for conversion; (2) decompose selected layers into shared low-rank SVD basis and per-cluster residual experts via k-means; (3) train lightweight routers supervised by cluster labels; (4) implement sparse dispatch on CUDA backends.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on Imagenette with DeiT-Small, retains 99.9% of dense model accuracy (86.70% vs 86.73%); ablation shows accuracy varies by less than 0.06% across routing strategies, with shared SVD basis as the primary accuracy preservation factor.

recommendation.zh: 小CV模型上的post-hoc MoE转换实验，路由无用结论仅适用该狭窄场景，作为MoE文献备查，无需读正文。
recommendation.en: Post-hoc MoE conversion on tiny CV models; the 'routing doesn't matter' finding only holds in this narrow setup, keep as literature reference, no need to read full text.

paper.title: COMPASS: Grounding Composition-Intent Guidance in Unified Multimodal Models
paper.abstract: Composition is a high-level visual intent that governs where subjects are placed and how a scene is organized, yet current unified multimodal models remain unreliable at fine-grained composition recognition and struggle to turn such intent into controllable generation. We present COMPASS, the first unified multimodal framework that grounds composition-intent control in a single system spanning both composition perception and composition-guided generation, with a shared expert token $τ_c$ as the

summary.core_problem: 现有统一多模态模型把构图（composition）当作普通美学属性之一被动评估，既缺乏对摄影构图的细粒度结构化感知，也难以把参考图中的构图意图解耦并迁移到新语义下的可控生成；同时构图数据稀缺、构图意图与图像内容高度纠缠，缺少成对训练数据，常规微调或 LoRA 容易破坏模型原有通用能力。
summary.importance: 展示了在统一多模态模型中如何以「最小侵入」方式注入专家能力，并通过一个可复用的意图 token 把感知侧和生成侧绑在一起；对研究统一建模范式下如何按需路由专家知识、如何在缺少配对数据时做自监督结构解耦，有直接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
首先构建 Comp-11 数据集，按 11 类专业构图模式（三分法、引导线、中心构图等）整理大规模指令数据，用于感知和生成训练。

架构上采用 Composition-specific MoE（C-MoE）：在已有 MoE 统一多模态骨干上新增一组专用 MLP 专家，训练时只优化这部分参数，避免覆盖原有通用能力；同时引入一个可学习的专家 token τ_c 作为输出前缀，用构图分类目标监督，使其成为显式的构图意图锚点——在感知端激活专用专家、把推断出的构图意图蒸馏进 τ_c，在生成端复用同一个 τ_c 作为全局条件信号，驱动去噪/生成符合参考构图。

为绕过成对数据不足并打破内容纠缠，提出自监督结构瓶颈：对参考图做像素化和灰度化，仅保留全局布局线索、抑制语义外观；再配合定制注意力掩码，阻止生成侧 query 过度关注被扰动的参考图像 token，并通过交叉注意力精炼增强文本语义忠实度，减少参考图内容泄漏。
summary.experiments: 在构图感知任务（分类、推理、描述）和参考引导生成任务上评估，对比统一多模态 baseline、美学专用模型、以及图像提示/风格迁移方法；COMPASS 在构图识别准确率、生成图像的布局一致性、文本语义忠实度上整体更优，同时在通用多模态基准上的性能下降很小，说明 C-MoE 与 τ_c 机制较好地隔离了专家能力与通用能力。
summary.reading_guide: 先读 Intro 中对「感知-生成闭环」和「构图纠缠」两个难点的拆解，再看 Comp-11 的类目设计和数据构造方式；接着重点理解 C-MoE 的参数隔离策略、τ_c 在感知端与生成端的双重作用，以及输入侧结构瓶颈（像素化/灰度化）+ 模型侧注意力掩码这一套解耦手段；最后看生成部分的条件注入与对齐损失。属于 skim 级工作，约 40–60 分钟，核心在于「专家 token 连接感知与生成」的设计思想，具体视觉指标可根据需要精读。

summary_en.core_problem: Current unified multimodal models treat photographic composition as just one of many aesthetic attributes to be passively assessed. They lack fine-grained structured perception of composition rules, and cannot reliably disentangle compositional intent from a reference image and transfer it to controllable generation under new semantics. The task is further aggravated by the scarcity of composition data, the strong entanglement between layout and content, and the absence of paired training data; standard fine-tuning or LoRA tends to corrupt a model's original general capabilities.
summary_en.importance: The work demonstrates how to inject expert capabilities into a unified multimodal model in a minimally invasive way, and how a single reusable intent token can tightly couple the perception and generation sides. It is directly informative for research on expert-knowledge routing in unified modeling paradigms, and on self-supervised disentanglement of structure from content when paired supervision is missing.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper first builds Comp-11, a large-scale instruction dataset covering 11 professional composition patterns (rule of thirds, leading lines, centered composition, etc.) for both perception and generation training.

On the architecture side, it introduces Composition-specific Mixture-of-Experts (C-MoE): a dedicated set of MLP experts is instantiated on top of an existing MoE-based unified multimodal backbone, and only these new parameters are optimized during training, preserving the model's original general competence. A single learnable expert token τ_c is prepended to the model's response and supervised by a hard composition classification objective, so that it acts as an explicit intent anchor. On the perception side, τ_c activates the specialized experts and distills the inferred compositional intent into itself; on the generation side, the same τ_c is reused as a global conditioning signal that steers denoising / generation to match the reference layout.

To break content-composition entanglement without paired data, a self-supervised structural bottleneck is applied: reference images are pixelated and converted to grayscale to retain only global layout cues while suppressing semantic appearance. This is complemented by model-side mechanisms including a customized attention mask that prevents generation queries from over-attending to the perturbed reference image tokens, and cross-attention refinement for better text faithfulness, which together reduce content leakage from the reference.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations cover both composition perception tasks (classification, reasoning, captioning) and reference-guided generation tasks, comparing against unified multimodal baselines, aesthetic-specialized models, and image-prompt / style-transfer methods. COMPASS consistently improves composition-recognition accuracy, layout consistency of generated images, and semantic faithfulness to the text prompt, while incurring only minimal degradation on general multimodal benchmarks — evidence that C-MoE and the τ_c mechanism effectively isolate expert-specific and general capabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: Begin with the introduction's decomposition of two core difficulties: the perception-generation loop and composition-content entanglement. Then look at Comp-11's taxonomy and data construction. Next focus on the parameter-isolation strategy in C-MoE, the dual role of τ_c on both perception and generation sides, and the full disentanglement stack of input-side structural bottleneck (pixelation / grayscaling) plus model-side attention masking. Finally review how conditioning is injected in the generation path and what alignment losses are used. This is a skim-level work; a 40–60 minute read is sufficient, with emphasis on the design idea of bridging perception and generation via an expert token, while detailed visual metrics can be read selectively.

recommendation.zh: 多模态统一建模中用共享token桥接理解与生成的设计值得参考，重点看§3的τ_c蒸馏与条件注入细节
recommendation.en: The shared intent token bridging perception and generation in unified multimodal modeling is worth referencing; focus on Section 3 for τ_c distillation and conditioning details

paper.title: FlexMoE: One-for-All Nested Intra-Expert Pruning for MoE Language Models
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models scale model ability with sparsely activated experts, making this architecture a standard recipe for modern large models. However, sparse activation does not remove the deployment burden of storing and serving all experts, and the available deployment budget can vary substantially across devices, users, and workloads. Existing MoE compression methods are still largely fixed-budget, typically optimizing one compressed endpoint at each chosen target budget.

summary.core_problem: 把一个已训练好的 MoE 语言模型压缩成多个可部署预算下的嵌套子网络，而不是为每个预算单独训练一个压缩模型。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 MoE 推理与部署压缩方法。稀疏激活降低了每次前向计算量，但没有降低存储全部专家和服务多种硬件预算的负担；FlexMoE 针对的是实际部署中预算连续变化的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 方法先对每个 expert 的 FFN channel 做重要性排序，再让每个 expert 学习离散剪枝动作。训练时逐步增加成本压力，使一次 action-training 可以导出从高预算到低预算的一系列 action mask；这些 mask 对应嵌套在同一个 ranked base model 里的多个子网络。相对固定预算剪枝，它把多端点压缩改成一次训练、多预算导出。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集、baseline 名称或提升幅度。实验目标应是比较不同部署预算下的 MoE 压缩质量，并验证单次训练导出的嵌套子网络是否接近或优于固定预算压缩端点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to convert a pretrained MoE language model into a nested family of deployable subnetworks across different inference and storage budgets.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-side MoE compression contribution. Sparse activation reduces per-token compute, but it does not remove the need to store and serve all experts; FlexMoE targets the practical case where deployment budgets vary by device, user, or workload.
summary_en.technical_approach: FlexMoE ranks FFN channels inside each expert by importance, then trains discrete pruning actions for experts. By gradually increasing cost pressure, a single action-training run exports a sequence of masks from high to low budgets, producing reliable subnetworks nested within the same ranked base model. The main shift is from fixed-budget endpoint compression to one training run that supports many budgets.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The relevant experimental question is whether the nested subnetworks retain quality across budgets compared with separately optimized fixed-budget MoE compression methods.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和预算曲线即可；对预训练的直接反馈有限，但 MoE 部署预算连续化这个 setup 很贴近真实服务。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and budget-quality curves; it is not a pretraining paper, but the continuous-budget MoE setup is close to real serving constraints.

paper.title: GeMoE: Gating Entropy is All You Need for Uncertainty-aware Adaptive Routing in MoE-based Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: With the increase in model parameters and training data, the instruction following and generalization capabilities of Large VisionLanguage Models (LVLMs) have been significantly improved. Based on the Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture, LVLMs expand their parameter capacity while maintaining the inference cost. However, traditional MoE methods employ a Top-k static routing strategy, which fails to account for variations in the input and adaptively select the number of experts, resulting in su

summary.core_problem: 解决 MoE 型大视觉语言模型中 Top-k 静态路由不能按输入难度自适应选择专家数量的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 MoE 路由机制改进。它把动态路由解释为最小描述长度问题，并尝试用 gating entropy 作为不确定性信号，在性能和计算之间做自适应折中。对 LLM 预训练的直接价值有限，但对 MoE 路由的训练和推理行为有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GeMoE，即 Gating Entropy-based Uncertainty-aware Adaptive Routing。方法核心是建立 MDL 与 MoE gating entropy 的联系，用门控分布熵估计 token 路由不确定性，再据此动态调整专家调用，而不是固定 Top-k 或使用手写启发式规则。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型参数量、训练数据、基线列表或提升幅度。可确认实验对象是 MoE-based LVLM，目标是在保持或改善性能的同时减少不必要专家调用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the rigidity of static Top-k routing in MoE-based large vision-language models, where different inputs may require different numbers of experts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an MoE routing mechanism rather than a pretraining recipe. It frames adaptive routing through a Minimum Description Length lens and uses gating entropy as an uncertainty signal to trade off predictive quality and routing cost. The direct impact on LLM pretraining is limited, but the routing signal is relevant to MoE design.
summary_en.technical_approach: GeMoE, or Gating Entropy-based Uncertainty-aware Adaptive Routing, connects MDL-style encoding cost with MoE gate entropy. Tokens with higher routing uncertainty can invoke more expert capacity, while easier tokens avoid unnecessary experts, replacing fixed Top-k or hand-crafted dynamic routing heuristics.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training data, baselines, or numerical gains. The experiments are described as targeting MoE-based LVLMs and evaluating adaptive expert usage under a performance-compute trade-off.

recommendation.zh: 只看路由熵和 MDL 的建模部分；若实验干净，可作为 MoE 动态容量分配的弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the entropy-MDL routing formulation; if the ablations are clean, it is a weak signal for adaptive MoE capacity allocation.

paper.title: TMP: Tree-structured Mixed-policy Pruning for Large-scale Image Generation and Editing
paper.abstract: Modern image generation model rapidly grows their sizes to meet high-fidelity image synthesis. However, they gradually become unaffordable for their enormous parameter consumption and computation budget that lead to massive resources requirement and gpu memory footprint. In this paper, we propose TMP, the first Tree-structured Mixed-policy Pruning framework that generalizes prevalent image tasks (T2I and TI2I) and architectures (Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and Diffusion transformer (DiT)). It could

summary.core_problem: 如何在尽量少损伤生成质量的前提下，把超大规模图像生成/编辑模型压到可负担的推理成本与显存占用。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在推理侧模型压缩：把“结构化剪枝 + 不同子模块混合策略”做成可覆盖 MoE 与 DiT、T2I 与 TI2I 的统一框架，并给出大模型（80B 级）可在单卡消费级 GPU 跑起来的工程落地案例。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Tree-structured Mixed-policy Pruning (TMP)：用树状结构组织剪枝决策，在不同层/模块上采用不同剪枝策略（mixed-policy），声称可同时适配 MoE 与 DiT 架构；定位为 step-distilled 模型的最后阶段压缩，并配合工程优化降低显存与推理开销。
summary.experiments: 在开源 HunyuanImage-3.0 instruct 与 Z-Image turbo 上实验；报告将 HunyuanImage 从 80B 剪到 20B（75% 参数下降）且“有限”质量损失；并声称通过工程技巧使 20B 版本可在单张 24GB RTX 4090 上推理。摘要未给出明确指标/对比细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to compress very large image generation/editing models to affordable inference cost and memory footprint with limited quality degradation.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an inference-side compression contribution: a unified structured pruning framework claimed to cover both MoE and DiT, across T2I and image editing, plus a practical case of running an 80B-class model after pruning on a single consumer GPU.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Tree-structured Mixed-policy Pruning (TMP): organizes pruning decisions in a tree and applies different pruning policies across layers/modules, targeting both MoE and DiT. Positioned as a final-stage compression step for step-distilled models, coupled with engineering optimizations for memory/inference.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on open-source HunyuanImage-3.0 instruct and Z-Image turbo; reports compressing HunyuanImage from 80B to 20B (75% reduction) with limited quality loss, and enabling inference of the pruned 20B model on a single 24GB RTX 4090. The abstract does not provide concrete metrics/baselines.

recommendation.zh: 偏工程的生成模型剪枝落地，和基座预训练关系不大；想借鉴“MoE/DiT 统一剪枝接口”可扫一眼，但质量评估是否干净要打问号。
recommendation.en: Mostly an engineering-oriented pruning story, weakly tied to foundation pretraining; skim only if you care about a unified pruning interface for MoE/DiT, but treat quality claims as weak without clean eval.

paper.title: SARA: Unlocking Multilingual Knowledge in Mixture-of-Experts via Semantically Anchored Routing Alignment
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have emerged as an increasingly influential paradigm as they offer a strategic balance between parameter scalability and computational efficiency. However, low-resource languages, which suffer from a scarcity of high-quality training data, often have their tokens routed to different experts than those predominantly activated by high-resource inputs, which limits cross-lingual expert sharing. This cross-lingual routing divergence consequently hinders

summary.core_problem: SARA 解决的是多语言 MoE 中的路由错配问题：低资源语言和高资源语言表达相同语义时，router 往往激活不同专家，导致低资源语言无法稳定调用高资源语言中已经学到的能力，尤其是推理和知识类能力。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对 MoE 预训练和持续训练有一定启发。它指出多语言能力差距不只来自参数中缺少知识，也可能来自 router 没有把语义等价输入送到同一组高能力专家。贡献量级偏方法增量，但问题定位清楚。它把优化目标从输出 logits 蒸馏转向路由分布对齐，对后续做 multilingual MoE、低资源语言扩展、router regularization 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: SARA 使用高资源语言作为 semantic anchor，显式约束低资源语言输入的路由分布靠近高资源输入的路由分布。流程分三步。第一，构造语义严格对齐的平行指令数据，并用 correctness-based filtering 保证高资源 anchor 的推理结果可靠。第二，对高资源语言样本做离线前向，提取各 MoE 层的 router probability distribution，作为路由先验。第三，在微调时加入 Jensen-Shannon divergence 约束，使低资源语言样本在中间层的路由概率分布接近对应 anchor。它不同于常规 instruction tuning 或 logits distillation：优化对象不是最终 token 分布，而是 MoE 内部的专家选择逻辑。这样做的假设是，模型已经在高资源语言路径中形成较强专家组合，低资源语言主要需要学会触发这些路径。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 2 个 MoE 模型和 3 个多语言 benchmark。文中明确报告，在 Global-MMLU 上，Qwen3-30B-A3B 提升约 0.8 个百分点，Phi-3.5-MoE-instruct 提升约 1.2 个百分点，并优于标准 instruction tuning。结果幅度不大，但方向一致。关键消融应关注 JS 路由对齐相对于普通指令微调的增益、不同中间层施加约束的效果、以及高资源 anchor 质量对最终低资源表现的影响。由于摘要和正文片段给出的数字有限，具体语言维度和任务维度的增益需要在实验表中核对。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计 30 分钟。重点看 Proposed Framework，尤其是 parallel instruction data 的构造、routing prior 的提取方式、JS divergence 约束施加在哪些层。实验部分建议看 Global-MMLU 等 benchmark 的主表，以及 ablation 中关于 router alignment、anchor language、layer selection 的结果。对做 MoE 预训练的人，最值得深挖的是 router 是否应该显式学习跨语言语义不变性，以及这种约束会不会损害专家专化和负载均衡。

summary_en.core_problem: SARA targets routing misalignment in multilingual MoE models. Semantically equivalent inputs in high-resource and low-resource languages often activate different experts, which prevents low-resource inputs from accessing expert pathways that already encode stronger reasoning or knowledge capabilities.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to MoE pretraining and continual adaptation. It frames multilingual degradation as a routing problem, not only a lack of parametric knowledge. The method is incremental in scale, but the diagnosis is useful: improving low-resource language performance may require aligning expert activation patterns, rather than only adding more multilingual data or distilling output logits.
summary_en.technical_approach: SARA treats high-resource languages as semantic anchors. It first builds a semantically aligned parallel instruction corpus and applies correctness-based filtering so that the anchor responses reflect reliable high-resource inference behavior. It then runs offline forward passes on the high-resource samples to collect router probability distributions across MoE layers. During fine-tuning, it adds a Jensen-Shannon divergence loss that pulls the routing distribution of the low-resource counterpart toward the distribution of the high-resource anchor. The main difference from standard instruction tuning or logit distillation is the training signal: SARA regularizes internal expert-selection probabilities rather than only the final output distribution. The underlying assumption is that competent experts already exist, while low-resource inputs fail to trigger them consistently.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses two MoE models and three multilingual benchmarks. The reported gains include about +0.8 percentage points on Qwen3-30B-A3B and +1.2 percentage points on Phi-3.5-MoE-instruct on Global-MMLU, outperforming standard instruction tuning. The gains are modest but consistent with the routing-alignment hypothesis. The most important ablations are the comparison against vanilla instruction tuning, the effect of applying JS alignment at intermediate layers, and the sensitivity to anchor quality. The provided text gives limited per-language details, so the exact distribution of improvements should be checked in the experimental tables.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should take around 30 minutes. Focus on the proposed framework: how the parallel instruction data is filtered, how routing priors are extracted, and where the JS divergence constraint is applied. In the experiments, inspect the main multilingual benchmark tables and ablations on router alignment, anchor language choice, and layer selection. For MoE pretraining work, the main point to examine is whether routers should be explicitly regularized for cross-lingual semantic invariance, and whether such alignment interferes with expert specialization or load balancing.

recommendation.zh: 这类工作值不值钱，全看路由统计是否干净；先看 router entropy、expert overlap 和低资源增益是否同时成立，若成立，值得在 multilingual MoE 里做一次内部复现。
recommendation.en: This is only as good as its routing diagnostics; check expert overlap, router entropy, and low-resource gains together—if all hold, it is worth a direct multilingual MoE ablation.

paper.title: Agentic evolution of physically constrained foundation models
paper.abstract: Artificial intelligence increasingly drives automated scientific discovery, yet contemporary generalist agents lack physical grounding, frequently hallucinating hardware-incompatible designs. Here, we present a physically grounded, multi-agent discovery engine that autonomously architects hardware-compliant computing systems. Anchored by an Evolutionary Knowledge Graph structuring past scientific innovations, the framework extracts an "algorithmic Chain-of-Thought" to transform blind stochastic

summary.core_problem: 用 LLM 多智能体自动发现硬件约束下的模型压缩算法，解决通用智能体在物理系统设计中容易产生硬件不可实现方案、而传统自动搜索又依赖人工限定搜索空间的问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身贡献有限，但对“LLM 辅助算法发现”这一方向有参考价值。其核心意义不在提出新的训练范式，而在于展示如何把历史算法知识组织成可演化记忆，让智能体在强物理约束下搜索量化/压缩策略，从而逼近甚至超过人工启发式方法。对关注模型压缩、部署优化、自动科研的研究者有借鉴意义，但不属于基座预训练核心问题。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了一个分层多智能体发现框架。基础是 Evolutionary Knowledge Graph（EKG），从 164 个主流 LLM 压缩方法中抽取算法结构、适用场景、硬件约束和演化关系，形成机器可读的“算法记忆”。上层是多智能体协作：负责提出假设、改写历史算法路径、构造算法 CoT、再由 AI peer review 做可行性筛选，最后结合硬件反馈闭环迭代。与常见“让 LLM 直接写新算法”的做法不同，这里显式建模已有方法的演化轨迹，把随机搜索改成基于图谱路径的定向变异；同时引入带宽敏感的 Sensitivity Profile，把硬件约束变成直接反馈信号，而不是事后验证。最终系统自动演化出两种方法：面向长上下文 dense 模型的离群值感知量化 Q-Enhance，以及面向 MoE 的专家级精度分配加低秩误差补偿方法 MoE-Salient-AQ。
summary.experiments: 报告结果集中在模型压缩部署场景。Q-Enhance 针对长上下文推理中的离群值导致的精度崩塌问题，可支撑到 128k token 序列长度；MoE-Salient-AQ 在 sub-3-bit 量化区间报告比人工设计基线高 3.7%。更大规模部署实验中，235B 模型可压缩到双 A100 服务器上运行，显存需求从 438GB 降到 108GB，硬件需求降低约 75%，精度损失 0.64%；8B 模型可部署到单张消费级 GPU。论文没有提供预训练 loss、通用能力 scaling、数据效率等基座训练层面的证据，结果主要针对压缩后的推理部署表现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看框架图和 EKG 的组织方式，理解它如何把“算法演化历史”变成可搜索结构。压缩方法细节可以快速浏览，关键判断是：这里的贡献本质是自动化算法设计流程，而不是提出一个改变预训练范式的新方法。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。若关注 AI for Science / 自动算法发现，可重点读多智能体评审和硬件反馈闭环部分；若只关心 LLM 预训练，可直接跳读结果与方法定位。

summary_en.core_problem: Automating the discovery of hardware-aware model compression algorithms with LLM-based multi-agent systems, addressing the failure mode where generalist agents propose physically infeasible designs while classical search methods remain confined to manually specified spaces.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a core pretraining contribution, but it is relevant as a case study in LLM-assisted algorithm discovery. Its main value is in showing how prior algorithmic knowledge can be structured into an evolvable memory so that agents can search under strict hardware constraints and match or exceed hand-designed heuristics. It is of interest to researchers working on compression, deployment, and automated research workflows, rather than on foundation model pretraining itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system is built around a layered multi-agent framework. Its backbone is an Evolutionary Knowledge Graph (EKG) constructed from 164 mainstream LLM compression methods, encoding algorithmic structure, applicability, hardware constraints, and historical relations as machine-readable memory. On top of this, multiple agents perform hypothesis generation, mutation of prior algorithmic trajectories, algorithmic chain-of-thought construction, and AI peer review for feasibility filtering. Rather than asking an LLM to invent algorithms from scratch, the framework explicitly models evolutionary paths over prior methods, converting blind stochastic search into directed structural mutation. A bandwidth-sensitive Sensitivity Profile provides direct hardware feedback instead of deferred validation. The discovered algorithms are Q-Enhance, an outlier-aware quantization scheme for long-context dense models, and MoE-Salient-AQ, which assigns precision at expert granularity and uses adaptive low-rank error compensation for MoE quantization.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results are in compression and deployment. Q-Enhance targets accuracy collapse from long-context outliers and is evaluated up to 128k tokens. MoE-Salient-AQ is reported to outperform human-designed baselines by 3.7% in the sub-3-bit regime. In large-scale deployment tests, a 235B model is compressed onto dual A100 servers, reducing memory requirements from 438 GB to 108 GB, a roughly 75% hardware reduction, with 0.64% accuracy degradation. An 8B model is deployable on a single consumer GPU. No evidence is provided on pretraining loss, scaling behavior, or data efficiency; the empirical claims are limited to post-training compression and inference deployment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the framework figure and the design of the EKG to understand how historical algorithmic knowledge is turned into a searchable structure. The specific compression methods can be read quickly. The main takeaway is an automated algorithm-design pipeline, not a new pretraining paradigm. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes. Readers interested in AI for science or automated discovery should pay attention to the multi-agent review and hardware feedback loop; readers focused strictly on pretraining can skip most implementation details and only check the problem setup and headline results.

recommendation.zh: 自动进化搜出的MoE亚3比特量化策略有工程参考价值，无范式创新，仅看量化方案和部署实验结果即可
recommendation.en: The auto-evolved sub-3-bit MoE quantization schemes have practical engineering value, no paradigm novelty; only read the quantization method and deployment results.

paper.title: Grouped Query Experts: Mixture-of-Experts on GQA Self-Attention
paper.abstract: Self-attention is central to Transformer performance and is often the most expensive part of the Transformer at long context lengths because its pairwise token interactions scale quadratically with sequence length. Standard dense attention also applies the same set of attention heads to every token regardless of token difficulty or information content. This uniform activation can waste compute, especially as sequences grow longer and attention cost increases rapidly. We propose Grouped Query Exp

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是长上下文 Transformer 中注意力计算的条件化问题：GQA 已经降低了 KV-cache 的内存和带宽成本，但仍然对每个 token 激活所有 query heads。作者希望把 MoE 的条件计算从 MLP 挪到注意力块里，让不同 token 只使用一部分 query-head experts，同时保持 GQA 的 KV 路径不变。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在架构和训练动态，而不是单纯推理加速。GQE 给出了一种较干净的 attention-side sparsity 设计：KV 仍然 dense，避免破坏 GQA 的缓存结构；只在 query-head 侧做 routing，减少长上下文下随序列长度增长的注意力计算。它的价值在于把“head 是否应该对所有 token 全量激活”这个问题具体化，并指出 sparse attention-head routing 需要可学习的 router 信号和稳定的 always-on head，否则容易退化。贡献量级目前偏探索性，实验规模为 250M 参数、30B tokens，还不足以说明大规模预训练时的 scaling 行为。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是在每个 GQA group 内放置多个 query-head experts。设总 query expert 数为 N，KV group 数为 G，则每组有 M=N/G 个 query experts；同组 experts 共享同一个 KV head，KV projection 和 KV cache 与普通 GQA 保持一致。每个 token、每个 group 都由 router 对该组 M 个 experts 打分，先做组内 softmax，再选 top-k。被选中的 expert 输出以 hard-concat 的形式进入后续投影，不做加权平均。为了解决 hard top-k 对 router 的梯度信号弱的问题，作者额外加入一个由 selected probabilities 重新归一化得到的 weighted-sum slot，让语言建模 loss 可以通过这个槽回传到 router。另有一个 always-on shared attention head，为所有 token 固定计算，用来稳定训练和兜底。以 16 query heads / 8 KV heads、k=1 为例，每个 token 选择 8 个 routed query experts，再加 1 个 shared head；weighted-sum slot 不额外计算新的 attention head，而是复用 selected expert outputs。最终输出投影 W_O 的输入槽数从 dense GQA 的 16 个 head slots 变为 10 个 slots，因此比较并非完全参数匹配，这是阅读时需要注意的实验边界。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的主要设置是 250M 参数模型，在固定 30B token 预算上训练。主实验中 GQE 在每个 token 上只激活一半 routed query-head experts；若把 shared head 算入实际 attention 计算，则相当于计算 9/16 个 query-attention heads。作者报告该设置在下游准确率上可以匹配全激活 GQA baseline，同时减少 self-attention 计算，并在长上下文场景中体现出速度收益。消融结论中较关键的一点是：仅做 hard routing 不够，router 需要 weighted-sum slot 提供可微学习信号；always-on shared head 对稳定性也重要。由于提供内容中没有完整表格和具体 benchmark 数字，不能判断不同上下文长度、不同模型规模和不同 k 值下的收益曲线。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读方法部分和实验消融，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看三处：第一，GQE 如何嵌入 GQA group，尤其是 KV dense、query sparse 的边界；第二，hard-concat、weighted-sum slot、shared head 三者的分工，这决定了 router 是否能学到有效分配；第三，实验比较是否控制了参数量、FLOPs、KV-cache 和 W_O 形状。需要带着一个问题读：减少 query-side attention 是否真的成为长上下文瓶颈的有效切入点，还是收益主要来自小模型、小规模设置下的结构压缩。若要复现实验，应优先检查 routing 负载均衡、expert 使用分布、loss spike、以及不同 sequence length 下的吞吐曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies conditional computation inside the attention block. GQA already reduces KV-cache cost by sharing keys and values across query groups, but it still evaluates all query heads for every token. The proposed question is whether token-dependent routing can be applied to query heads, so that each token uses only a subset of attention-head experts while preserving the standard GQA KV path.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is architectural. GQE is a concrete attention-side sparsity design rather than an MLP MoE variant. It keeps KV heads dense and unchanged, which preserves the memory and serving advantages of GQA, and sparsifies only the query-head computation. This makes it a useful probe of whether all heads need to be uniformly active for all tokens. The result is still exploratory: the reported scale is 250M parameters and 30B training tokens, so it does not yet establish large-scale pretraining behavior or scaling trends.
summary_en.technical_approach: Within each GQA group, query heads are treated as experts. With N total query experts and G KV groups, each group contains M=N/G experts that attend to the same shared KV head. For each token and each group, a router scores the M experts, applies a group-wise softmax, and selects top-k experts. The selected expert outputs are concatenated as normal hard-routed head slots, not averaged. Because hard top-k gives a weak gradient path to the router, the method adds a router-supervised weighted-sum slot, computed by renormalizing the probabilities of selected experts and summing their outputs. It also adds an always-on shared attention head to stabilize training. In the 16-query-head / 8-KV-head setting with k=1, each token computes 8 routed query experts plus one shared head; the weighted-sum slot reuses selected outputs and does not add another attention computation. The final output projection receives 10 slots rather than the 16 slots of the dense baseline, so the comparison is not strictly parameter-matched in W_O.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiment trains 250M-parameter models for 30B tokens. In the primary configuration, GQE activates half of the routed query-head experts per token; including the always-on shared head, it computes 9 of 16 query-attention heads. The paper reports downstream accuracy comparable to the fully active GQA baseline while reducing self-attention compute, with measured speedups becoming more relevant for longer contexts. The ablations emphasized in the provided text are important: sparse query-head routing only matches the dense baseline when the router receives a useful differentiable learning signal through the weighted-sum slot, and the always-on shared head helps stabilize the layer. The provided content does not include full benchmark tables, so exact per-task gains and length-dependent throughput numbers cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim pass of 20–30 minutes is enough. Focus on the method section that defines routing inside GQA groups, the role of the weighted-sum slot, and the always-on shared head. Then check the experimental setup for parameter accounting, especially the resized output projection. The key technical question is whether query-side sparsity is a robust long-context efficiency lever or whether the observed gains depend on the small-scale setting and projection-size differences. For deeper follow-up, inspect expert utilization, router entropy, training loss stability, and throughput as a function of sequence length.

recommendation.zh: 将 MoE 引入 Attention Query 头的有趣尝试，在长文本场景下有降低计算量的潜力，值得关注其在更大规模模型上的表现。
recommendation.en: An interesting attempt to introduce MoE into Attention Query heads, showing potential for reducing computation in long-context scenarios; worth watching for its performance at larger scales.

paper.title: Does the Same Token Mean the Same State? MoE Routing as Signal for Reasoning Control
paper.abstract: In sparse Mixture-of-Experts language models, does the same token id imply the same router state and the same experts producing it? Holding the emitted token id fixed at repeated anchors, we find it does not: the experts that produce it still separate task context, trajectory history, and reasoning-effort mode. This residual structure supports test-time control: near \emph{boundary} anchors (the final-response transition) and \emph{delimiter} anchors (which open the answer, e.g.\ \texttt{\textba

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：在稀疏 MoE 语言模型里，即便输出的是同一个 token id，它对应的 router state 是否也相同；如果不同，这种 routing 差异能否作为 reasoning rollout 选择信号，而不依赖最终答案字符串。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是核心推进，但对 MoE 内部表征、test-time reasoning control、以及“白盒信号能否替代 answer voting”这个问题有启发。它提示 router 不只是负载均衡模块，还编码了任务上下文、轨迹历史和推理 effort 模式。这对理解 MoE 在推理阶段的内部状态组织方式有价值，也可能反过来影响未来的 MoE 训练目标或辅助监督设计。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两步。先做描述性分析：固定 anchor token id，在不同 rollout 上对齐该位置，比较对应的 sparse routing 向量，考察同 token 是否仍能区分 problem identity、trajectory context 和 reasoning-effort mode。作者定义了 trajectory、boundary、delimiter 三类 anchor，并用不同窗口宽度读取 anchor 附近的 routing。路由表示由各层被选 expert 及其 softmax 权重拼接或聚合而成，再用近邻泄漏率、KNN basin purity 等指标看 routing 空间是否保留 rollout 级结构。

在此基础上提出 RAD（Routing Agreement Decoding）。给定同一题目的多条已完成 rollout，RAD 先通过固定 token id 找到 anchor，再用该 anchor 附近的 routing window 表示每条 rollout，之后在 routing 空间里找最密的 Weighted-Jaccard KNN 邻域，把对应 rollout 作为最终选择。整个选择过程不读取、不规范化、不比较答案字符串；答案文本只在选完之后才被取出。这个设计与 majority voting 的区别不在目标，而在接口：majority 在答案字符串空间找共识，RAD 在 routing 空间找共识。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 10 个 sparse-MoE 配置、6 个数据集，包括 gpt-oss 和 Qwen3-MoE 系列，以及 math、GPQA、LiveCodeBench、SWE-bench Verified 等。主要结果有三类。第一，同一 token id 下的 routing 并不相同，且能明显区分问题和推理 effort；文中提到 cross-problem 和 cross-effort 的最近邻泄漏低于 5%，说明 token identity 不是 router state 的充分统计量。第二，routing neighborhood 与 final-answer basin 有对齐关系，尤其在 answer opening 附近最强；delimiter@16 的 basin purity 最好，marker-only 的 delimiter@marker 也已有信息量。第三，RAD 在数学和 GPQA 这类可做字符串投票的场景里与 textual majority 大致相当，在作者的 rollout 池上略好一些；在代码生成里，由于输出词面差异大、精确字符串投票不稳，RAD 可以直接做选择并报告 pass@1；在 agentic SWE-bench Verified 的可判定子集上，基于 boundary re-anchoring 的选择比随机选高 4–5 个点。

需要注意的是，这些结果更像“可用性证明”而不是普适结论。它依赖模型暴露 router 信号，也依赖 anchor 设计得当。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看引言和 anchor-conditioned routing 的定义，理解作者为什么强调 boundary 和 delimiter anchor，而不是随便取某个重复 token。然后看描述性实验：同 token 不同 route 的可分性，这是后续方法成立的前提。接着看 RAD 的算法定义，重点理解它只在 anchor lookup 时用 token id，真正选择时只用 routing tensor。实验部分优先看 Table 1 一类的 basin purity/selector accuracy 结果，以及 code 和 SWE-bench 的案例，因为这些最能体现“answer-string-free”接口的意义。预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主线；若只关心 MoE 机制分析，读到 routing separability 和 anchor ablation 即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the same emitted token id corresponds to the same router state in sparse MoE language models, and if not, whether routing differences can be used as a reasoning-control signal for selecting among multiple rollouts without looking at answer strings.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant to MoE interpretability and test-time control. The main insight is that the router appears to encode more than token identity: task context, trajectory history, and reasoning-effort mode remain visible even when the emitted token is held fixed. That is useful for understanding what MoE routing is organizing internally, and it may eventually inform auxiliary objectives or training-time diagnostics for sparse models.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper proceeds in two stages. First, it performs a descriptive analysis with anchor-conditioned routing. Repeated anchor token ids are aligned across rollouts, and the corresponding sparse routing vectors are compared to test whether routing still separates problem identity, trajectory context, and effort mode. The authors define three anchor families—trajectory, boundary, and delimiter—and vary the routing readout window around the anchor. Routing representations are built from selected expert ids and router weights across layers, and then analyzed with nearest-neighbor leakage and KNN basin-purity style metrics.

Second, the paper proposes RAD, Routing Agreement Decoding. Given a pool of completed rollouts for one problem, RAD locates a fixed anchor by token id, represents each rollout using the routing window around that anchor, and selects the rollout that lies in the densest Weighted-Jaccard KNN routing neighborhood. During selection, it never parses, normalizes, compares, or executes answer strings. The answer text is only read after the routing-based choice is made. In that sense, RAD is analogous to majority voting in objective, but not in interface: majority aggregates agreement in answer space, while RAD aggregates agreement in routing space.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers 10 sparse-MoE configurations and 6 datasets, including gpt-oss and Qwen3-MoE variants, with math, GPQA, LiveCodeBench, and SWE-bench Verified. The results have three main parts. First, identical token ids do not imply identical routing states: routing still separates problem and effort conditions, with reported cross-problem and cross-effort nearest-neighbor leakage below 5%, suggesting token identity is not a sufficient statistic for router state. Second, routing neighborhoods align with final-answer basins, especially near answer-opening delimiters; delimiter@16 gives the strongest basin purity, while even marker-only delimiter@marker is already informative. Third, RAD is roughly on par with textual majority in math and GPQA, slightly ahead in the authors’ rollout pools, while using no answer-string comparison. Its more distinctive use case is code and agentic settings: on code generation, where lexical variation makes exact string voting awkward, RAD can directly select rollouts and report pass@1; on the decidable subset of SWE-bench Verified, boundary-based re-anchoring improves over random selection by about 4–5 points.

The evidence is best read as a feasibility result rather than a universal selector. It depends on access to router traces and on sensible anchor design.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and the definition of anchor-conditioned routing. The key setup choice is why boundary and delimiter anchors matter more than arbitrary repeated tokens. Then read the descriptive experiments showing separability under fixed token identity; that is the premise for the whole method. After that, read the RAD algorithm section, paying attention to the access boundary: token ids are used only for anchor lookup, while the actual selection uses routing tensors only. In the experiments, prioritize the basin-purity and selector-accuracy tables, plus the code and SWE-bench results, since those best illustrate the value of an answer-string-free interface. About 25–35 minutes is enough to capture the main idea. If your interest is mainly MoE mechanism analysis, the routing separability and anchor ablations are the most useful parts.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和可视化结果即可；若结论稳，MoE router 可作为推理 latent state，值得在内部 MoE 上复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and routing visualizations; if stable, MoE routers are usable reasoning-state probes and should be reproduced on internal MoEs.

paper.title: DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence
paper.abstract: We present a preview version of DeepSeek-V4 series, including two strong Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models -- DeepSeek-V4-Pro with 1.6T parameters (49B activated) and DeepSeek-V4-Flash with 284B parameters (13B activated) -- both supporting a context length of one million tokens. DeepSeek-V4 series incorporate several key upgrades in architecture and optimization: (1) a hybrid attention architecture that combines Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA) and Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA) to

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是单一的“长上下文支持”，而是更具体的三件事同时成立：第一，MoE 基座模型在百万 token 上下文下仍然保持可训练、可推理；第二，长上下文带来的注意力 FLOPs 与 KV cache 膨胀不能把 test-time scaling 的收益吃掉；第三，超长上下文能力不能靠后期补丁式扩窗，而要在预训练阶段原生建立。全文的主线很清楚：DeepSeek 认为 vanilla attention 的二次复杂度已经成为长链路推理、agent 工作流、跨文档分析的结构性瓶颈，因此 V4 不是简单把窗口拉长，而是围绕“1M context 下的效率—能力—稳定性”重做了一套基座 recipe，包括注意力、残差连接、优化器、训练框架和推理系统。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，这是一个较完整的“超长上下文原生预训练”范式样本，不再把 long context 视为后训练或 RoPE 外插问题，而是把架构、优化器、并行和缓存设计一起纳入基座训练。第二，它给出了一个很明确的工程判断：在百万上下文场景里，真正限制 test-time scaling 的不只是模型参数量，而是单 token 推理 FLOPs、KV cache 体积、共享前缀复用方式，以及这些因素与 MoE 激活参数的耦合。第三，它把 Muon、mHC、压缩注意力、FP4 QAT 这些原本分散的技术点，组合成了一条可落地的训练路径。贡献量级上，这更像一次体系化 recipe 升级，而不是单点算法改良。对做 pretrain 的人，价值不在某一个模块绝对新，而在这些模块如何共同把 1M context 从“能跑”推进到“可大规模训练和服务”。
summary.technical_approach: 技术方案可以拆成五部分。1）模型骨架：延续 DeepSeekMoE 和 Multi-Token Prediction。也就是说，V4 并没有放弃 V3 系列已经验证过的 MoE 主干和 MTP 训练信号，而是在此基础上重构长上下文路径。这一点很关键，因为它说明作者追求的是在既有大规模 recipe 上做兼容升级，而不是另起炉灶。2）混合注意力：核心是 CSA 与 HCA 的组合。CSA 先沿序列维压缩 KV cache，再做 DeepSeek Sparse Attention；HCA 则做更激进的 KV 压缩，但保留 dense attention。前者偏向在保留选择性访存能力的同时降低长序列成本，后者偏向进一步压缩缓存与计算。两者混用，说明作者不是押注单一稀疏模式，而是在不同层或路径上平衡信息保真与效率。和标准 full attention 相比，关键变化不是只减少 attention score 计算，而是直接重写了长序列下的状态表示方式。3）表示与优化稳定性：引入 mHC（Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections）替代普通 residual path，并采用 Muon 优化器。这里的信号很明确：当上下文拉到 1M、模型又是超大 MoE 时，训练难点不只是算力，而是深层网络的优化几何与稳定性。mHC 负责改善信息流与表示约束，Muon 负责更快收敛和更稳训练。4）训练系统：他们做了单 fused MoE kernel，把计算、通信、访存尽量重叠；用 TileLang 平衡内核开发效率与性能；提供 batch-invariant、deterministic kernel 保证 bitwise reproducibility；在 autograd 上扩展 tensor-level checkpointing 做细粒度重计算；再配合 hybrid ZeRO、两阶段 contextual parallelism 去管理压缩注意力。这部分不是附属工程，而是方法成立的必要条件，因为 1M context 下很多理论节省如果不能转化为可并行、可复现、可重计算的实现，就无法进入稳定预训练。5）推理与后训练效率：推理侧设计 heterogeneous KV cache 和磁盘存储策略，用于 shared-prefix reuse；后训练阶段对 MoE expert weights 和 indexer QK path 做 FP4 quantization-aware training，继续压缩显存与计算。这里能看出 V4 的设计目标不是“训练时长上下文，推理时再说”，而是从一开始就把 serving 约束纳入基座设计。
summary.experiments: 文中最关键的数字有四组。第一，模型规模：DeepSeek-V4-Pro 为 1.6T 总参数、49B 激活参数；DeepSeek-V4-Flash 为 284B 总参数、13B 激活参数。第二，预训练 token：Flash 训练 32T token，Pro 训练 33T token，都是原生支持 1M context，而不是后续插值扩窗。第三，长上下文效率：在 1M token 场景下，V4-Pro 的单 token 推理 FLOPs 只有 DeepSeek-V3.2 的 27%，KV cache 只有 10%；V4-Flash 进一步降到 FLOPs 10%、KV cache 7%。这组数字是全文最有信息量的结果，因为它说明即便 Pro 的激活参数更多，长上下文路径仍然显著更省。第四，能力结果：作者称 Flash-Base 已在多数 benchmark 上超过 V3.2-Base，Pro-Base 则在 reasoning、coding、long-context、world knowledge 上全面领先 DeepSeek 既有 foundation models。摘要截断后，正文还能看到其后训练采用“两阶段：领域专家独立培养，再用 on-policy distillation 统一整合”的路线，先对数学、代码、agent、指令跟随分别做 SFT，再用 GRPO 类 RL 强化。若从实验解读看，最值得注意的不是单个 benchmark 分数，而是效率收益并没有明显以基础能力退化为代价。对长上下文模型，这一点比单纯扩窗更难做到。另一个值得留意的信号是 FP4 目前在现有硬件上峰值 FLOPs 未必优于 FP8×FP8，但作者明确指出未来硬件上理论上还可再提升约 1/3，这意味着他们在为下一代硬件共设计做铺垫。
summary.reading_guide: 精读时建议按“问题—架构—系统—结果”四段看。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，抓住作者到底在优化什么：不是 abstract 的 1M context 标签，而是 1M 下的单 token FLOPs 与累计 KV cache。然后重点看混合注意力部分，尤其 CSA 与 HCA 各自压缩什么、在哪些路径上保留稀疏或稠密注意力、为什么需要两者并存。这里决定了 V4 的长上下文能力是不是建立在可接受的信息损失之上。接着看 mHC 与 Muon 的章节，判断它们在这个系统里是锦上添花还是训练稳定性的必要条件；如果正文有 loss curve、收敛速度或 spike 对比，这些图要细看。再往后看训练框架与 kernel 设计，这部分对做大规模预训练的人信息密度很高，尤其是 fused MoE kernel、tensor-level checkpointing、two-stage contextual parallelism、deterministic kernels。最后看长上下文效率图和 base model 对比表，重点不是绝对分数，而是“更低 FLOPs / 更小 cache / 更强 base capability”是否同时成立。若时间有限，至少要看 Figure 1、注意力设计章节、系统实现章节、以及 base/long-context 主结果表。值得深挖的点有三个：压缩注意力对预训练分布外长度泛化的影响；mHC 在超深 MoE 上是否改善梯度传播；Muon 在 30T+ token 规模下相对 AdamW 类优化器的稳定性边界。
summary.authors_note: DeepSeek 团队。正文可确认是 DeepSeek 系列基座模型的技术报告；当前给出的片段未完整列出作者名单，无法准确逐一确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not merely about extending context length. It targets a stricter objective: making MoE foundation models trainable and deployable at one-million-token context while preserving base capability and avoiding the prohibitive inference cost of vanilla attention. The central claim is that quadratic attention has become a structural bottleneck for test-time scaling, long-horizon reasoning, agent workflows, and cross-document analysis. DeepSeek-V4 therefore redesigns the long-context stack at the pretraining level rather than treating long context as a post-hoc window extension trick.
summary_en.importance: Its value to pretraining research lies in turning ultra-long context into a full-stack pretraining problem. The contribution is less about a single novel module and more about a coherent recipe: compressed attention, residual-path redesign, optimizer choice, training kernels, parallelism strategy, and inference cache layout are all co-designed. That matters because million-token context is constrained not only by model size, but by per-token inference FLOPs, KV-cache growth, prefix reuse, and how these interact with MoE activation. For researchers working on foundation-model pretraining, this is a concrete example of how long-context capability can be made native to the base model instead of being patched in later.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has five main components. First, the backbone keeps DeepSeekMoE and Multi-Token Prediction, which signals continuity with an already validated large-scale recipe rather than a wholesale paradigm shift. Second, the key architectural change is a hybrid attention design combining Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA) and Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA). CSA compresses KV caches along the sequence dimension and then applies DeepSeek Sparse Attention, aiming to reduce long-sequence cost while retaining selective access. HCA compresses KV more aggressively but keeps dense attention, trading more compression for a simpler attention pattern. The combination suggests that no single compression mode is sufficient across the stack. Third, the model introduces Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) in place of standard residual pathways and adopts the Muon optimizer. This is important because at 1M context and trillion-scale MoE size, optimization geometry and training stability become first-order concerns. Fourth, the training system is heavily engineered: a single fused MoE kernel overlaps compute, communication, and memory access; TileLang is used as a DSL for productivity/performance balance; deterministic, batch-invariant kernels are provided for bitwise reproducibility; tensor-level checkpointing extends autograd for fine-grained recomputation; hybrid ZeRO and two-stage contextual parallelism are used to manage compressed attention efficiently. Fifth, inference and post-training are also co-designed: heterogeneous KV-cache structures with on-disk storage enable shared-prefix reuse, and FP4 quantization-aware training is applied to MoE expert weights and the indexer QK path during post-training to reduce memory and compute.
summary_en.experiments: The most informative numbers are straightforward. DeepSeek-V4-Pro has 1.6T total parameters with 49B activated; DeepSeek-V4-Flash has 284B total with 13B activated. Flash is pretrained on 32T tokens and Pro on 33T tokens, both with native support for 1M context. In the 1M-token setting, V4-Pro uses only 27% of the single-token inference FLOPs of DeepSeek-V3.2 and 10% of its KV-cache size. V4-Flash pushes this further to 10% of the FLOPs and 7% of the KV-cache size. These are the headline results because they show that even the larger activated model can be substantially cheaper on the long-context path. On capability, the paper states that Flash-Base already surpasses DeepSeek-V3.2-Base on most benchmarks, while Pro-Base establishes a stronger foundation model across reasoning, coding, long-context, and world knowledge. The post-training pipeline is also notable: domain-specific experts are first trained independently with SFT and RL, then consolidated through on-policy distillation. The key experimental takeaway is that the efficiency gain does not appear to come with an obvious collapse in base capability, which is the usual risk in aggressive long-context optimization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and Figure 1. The right question is not 'does it support 1M context?' but 'what exactly becomes cheaper at 1M context?' Then read the hybrid attention section carefully: what is compressed in CSA versus HCA, where sparse versus dense attention is retained, and why both are needed. After that, focus on mHC and Muon. The useful question is whether they are optional improvements or necessary stabilizers for trillion-scale long-context training. The systems section is worth close reading if you care about real pretraining: fused MoE kernels, tensor-level checkpointing, contextual parallelism, and deterministic kernels are all practical enablers rather than side notes. Finally, inspect the long-context efficiency plots and the base-model comparison tables. The main thing to verify is whether lower FLOPs, smaller KV cache, and stronger base capability hold simultaneously. If time is limited, read Figure 1, the attention-design section, the systems section, and the main base/long-context result tables.
summary_en.authors_note: DeepSeek team. The available text clearly identifies this as a DeepSeek technical report for the V4 series, but the full author list is not visible in the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 必须读；若 Muon+mHC 在 1.6T MoE 上消融干净，应立刻复现到内部长上下文训练 ablation。
recommendation.en: Must read; if the Muon+mHC ablations are clean at 1.6T MoE scale, they should go straight into internal long-context training ablations.

paper.title: FoMoE: Breaking the Full-Replica Barrier with a Federation of MoEs
paper.abstract: Pre-training Large Language Models (LLMs) typically demands large-scale infrastructure with tightly coupled hardware accelerators. While increasing model and dataset scale remains the dominant driver of performance, Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs) architectures have recently achieved state-of-the-art results by decoupling parameter count from computational cost. This efficiency enables training massive models on constrained compute budgets, yet it typically requires the high-speed interconnects of a s
