summary.core_problem: 让 MoE LLM 预训练跨地理分布、弱互联的数据中心扩展，同时避免每个站点保存完整模型副本。
summary.importance: 贡献是 LLM 预训练系统方向的架构与通信设计。它针对 DiLoCo、Photon 一类低通信数据并行方法的 full-replica 假设，试图把 MoE 的专家稀疏性用于跨站点模型分区，降低内存和通信约束。
summary.technical_approach: FoMoE 提出 federation of MoEs，核心思路是打破每个站点都复制完整模型的范式，将 MoE 的专家或参数分区到不同站点，并设计适合弱连接环境的训练协议；摘要重点强调它利用 MoE 参数量与计算量解耦的特性，避免单数据中心高速互联成为硬约束。
summary.experiments: 摘要片段未给出模型参数量、token 数、集群规模、通信频率或最终 perplexity/下游结果；可确认的实验背景是与 DiLoCo、Photon 等跨数据中心低通信训练方案对比 full-replica 内存和通信开销。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses geographically distributed MoE LLM pretraining under weak interconnects without requiring every site to hold a full model replica.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a pretraining-systems design for LLMs. It targets the full-replica assumption in low-communication data-parallel methods such as DiLoCo and Photon, and tries to exploit MoE sparsity for cross-site model partitioning.
summary_en.technical_approach: FoMoE proposes a federation of MoEs. The central idea is to break the paradigm where each site stores the entire model, partitioning MoE experts or parameters across sites and using a training protocol suitable for weakly connected infrastructure. The approach leverages the MoE separation between parameter count and active compute.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract excerpt does not provide model size, token count, cluster scale, communication frequency, or final perplexity/downstream metrics. The stated comparison point is against DiLoCo- and Photon-style low-communication distributed training, which still requires full replicas at every site.

recommendation.zh: 应读系统模型和通信公式；如果实验足够干净，它会改变“跨机房训练只能低频全副本同步”的默认设定。
recommendation.en: Read the system model and communication equations; if the experiments are clean, this weakens the default assumption that cross-DC training must use full-replica synchronization.

paper.title: Variable-Width Transformers
paper.abstract: Scaling model size, specifically depth and width, has driven significant progress in transformer-based language models. However, most architectures maintain a constant width across all layers, allocating a fixed parameter and computation budget evenly despite different layers potentially playing distinct computational roles. In this work, we empirically investigate nonuniform capacity allocation across network depth by proposing a $\times$-shaped > <former architecture. This design maintains wid

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是一个很具体但长期被默认处理的问题：在固定深度和参数预算下，Transformer 的每一层是否都应该使用相同 hidden width。现有 scaling 研究通常比较深度、宽度、总参数量的全局比例，但很少改变层内宽度随深度的分布。作者发现，均匀宽度不是一个自然最优点；早期层和晚期层保留更大宽度，中间层收窄的 ×-shaped 配置，在相同参数量下更好。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响在于，它把“模型形状”从全局 depth/width ratio 推进到 layer-wise capacity allocation。这个问题直接关系到 dense LM 和 MoE LM 的参数、FLOPs、KV cache 如何分配。论文给出的收益不只是困惑度改善：在 200M–2B dense 和 3B MoE 设置下，×-shaped 结构相对同参数 uniform baseline 约有 3% 相对 perplexity 改善，同时 KV cache 约少 10%，FLOPs 约少 3%。这个量级不算大，但方向清楚，而且与 serving 成本相关。更重要的是，它提示预训练架构搜索不应只搜索总宽度和深度，还应搜索宽度沿深度的 profile。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Variable-Width Transformer，并重点验证一种早晚宽、中间窄的 ×-shaped 结构，称为 > <former。对比的形状包括 growing 的 ∨-shaped、narrowing 的 ∧-shaped、先宽后窄或先窄后宽的其它 profile。关键实现不是简单在层间加 projection，而是维护一个固定的全局 residual stream，宽度等于最宽层。每个 block 只读写 residual stream 的一个 slice；当前层不用的坐标绕过该层，后续需要扩展时从最近一次处理过该坐标的层恢复。收窄时截断到当前层宽度，扩宽时复制此前保存的坐标；如果此前不存在该坐标，则补零。这个设计避免了可学习 projection 带来的瓶颈和额外参数，也尽量保持 residual path 的语义。与只调整 FFN intermediate dimension 的做法不同，这里调整的是整个 block 的模型宽度，因此 attention、MLP、KV cache 和激活搬运都会一起改变。论文还分析了为什么同参数匹配时平均层宽会下降：参数量近似随宽度平方增长，而 attention FLOPs 和 KV cache 更接近随宽度线性增长，所以不均匀宽度可以在保留总参数量的同时降低平均 KV 宽度。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 decoder-only LM，dense 规模从 200M 到 2B 参数，另有 3B 参数 MoE。主结果是 > <former 在参数匹配的 uniform-width baseline 上稳定降低语言建模 perplexity，平均约 3% 相对改善，同时约减少 10% KV-cache size 和约 3% FLOPs。作者还做了多种 shape 对比，结论是早晚层更宽、中间层更窄优于单调增宽、单调收窄等 profile。残差 resize 的消融很关键：固定全局 residual stream 加 slice/copy 的参数无关方案优于可学习 projection 和简单 zero padding，说明收益不是来自额外映射层，而是来自保留绕过中间窄层的残差信息。论文还讨论了 bottleneck width 和 bottleneck location 与模型预算的关系，并给出经验指导：瓶颈不能过窄，位置也不能任意移动；合适的中层收窄能减少 mid-layer representation collapse。表示分析显示，> <former 学到的表示策略不同于 uniform baseline，中间层的表示坍缩程度更低。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读三部分。第一是 Variable-Width Transformer 的 residual resizing 设计，这是能否复现结果的核心；重点看固定 residual stream、slice 读写、截断和复制恢复的定义，以及为什么不用 projection。第二是主实验和 shape 对比，重点确认参数匹配方式、FLOPs/KV cache 计算方式，以及 ×-shaped 相对其它 profile 的稳定性。第三是消融和表示分析，尤其是 resize 策略、bottleneck width/location、mid-layer representation collapse。对做大模型预训练的人，最值得深挖的是两点：一是宽度 profile 是否能与 depth scaling law 联合建模；二是这种结构在长上下文、GQA/MQA、MoE routing、训练稳定性上是否仍保持同样收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a simple architectural assumption that is rarely isolated: under a fixed depth and parameter budget, should every Transformer layer have the same hidden width. Most scaling work varies global depth, width, and parameter count, while keeping width constant across layers. The paper finds that this uniform allocation is not necessarily optimal. A profile with wider early and late layers and narrower middle layers performs better at matched parameter count.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is layer-wise capacity allocation for pretraining-scale decoder LMs. It extends the notion of model shape beyond a global depth-width ratio and makes it a function over depth. The result is relevant to both training and inference: across 200M–2B dense LMs and a 3B MoE LM, the proposed ×-shaped design improves perplexity by about 3% relative to parameter-matched uniform baselines, while reducing KV-cache size by about 10% and FLOPs by about 3%. The gains are modest but operationally meaningful, because they affect both pretraining loss and serving cost. The broader lesson is that architecture scaling laws should not assume uniform width by default.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Variable-Width Transformer changes the model dimension by layer. The best-performing profile is ×-shaped: wide at the bottom, narrow in the middle, and wide again near the top. The implementation detail that matters is the residual stream. Instead of inserting learned projections between layers, the model keeps a fixed global residual dimension equal to the widest layer. Each block reads from and writes to a layer-specific slice of this residual stream. When a layer is narrower, unused coordinates bypass the block. When a later layer expands, those coordinates are restored from the most recent layer that actively processed them; if no such value exists, the coordinate is zero-padded. This parameter-free resizing avoids projection bottlenecks and keeps the skip path closer to a standard residual stream. The design differs from work that only reallocates FFN intermediate width: here the full block width changes, so attention, MLP parameters, KV cache, activation movement, and compute are all affected.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments train decoder-only language models from 200M to 2B dense parameters, plus a 3B-parameter MoE setting. The ×-shaped > <former consistently outperforms parameter-matched constant-width baselines, with roughly 3% relative perplexity improvement. Because parameters scale roughly quadratically with width while attention FLOPs and KV-cache size scale more linearly, parameter matching leads to a lower average layer width; the reported outcome is about 10% smaller KV cache and about 3% fewer FLOPs. Shape comparisons show that the early-and-late-wide profile is better than monotonic growing, monotonic narrowing, and other nonuniform alternatives. Ablations on resizing are important: the fixed-residual slice/copy mechanism beats learned projection and naive zero-padding variants. Additional analyses study bottleneck width and location, and suggest that the architecture uses a different representation strategy while reducing mid-layer representation collapse.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the residual resizing mechanism carefully first; it is the key engineering idea behind the result. Then inspect the main shape-comparison experiments and check how parameter matching, FLOPs, and KV-cache size are computed. The ablations on learned projections, zero padding, bottleneck width, and bottleneck location are the most useful parts for replication. The representation-collapse analysis is also worth reading, because it gives a possible explanation for why narrowing the middle layers does not simply remove useful capacity. For pretraining work, the natural follow-up questions are whether this width profile interacts predictably with depth scaling, long context, GQA or MQA, MoE routing, and loss-spike behavior.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接动到“层宽恒定”这个默认设定；先看 scaling-curve 拟合和 ablation 是否控干净，若成立，内部模型设计该把 width schedule 当一等超参。
recommendation.en: This directly challenges the constant-width default; inspect the scaling-curve fitting and ablation hygiene first, and if it holds, width scheduling should become a first-class architecture hyperparameter.

paper.title: SoftMoE: Soft Differentiable Routing for Mixture-of-Experts in LLMs
paper.abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures enable scaling LLM parameters under a fixed inference budget by activating only a small subset of experts via top-$k$ routing. While this preserves causality and suits autoregressive language models, the discrete top-$k$ operator is not differentiable, forcing a fixed number of active experts per input and resulting in inefficient use of computation. We propose SoftMoE, which replaces discrete routing with a truncated soft top-$k$ LapSum relaxation,

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理的是 MoE 路由里的一个老问题：hard top-k 路由便宜、因果兼容，但选择操作不可微，active expert 数量必须预先固定，模型很难在不同层、不同 token 之间自适应分配计算量。SoftMoE 的目标不是改变 expert 本身，而是把“选哪些 expert、选多少 expert”变成可优化的连续变量，同时保留自回归语言模型需要的 token 独立路由和稀疏计算。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 MoE 训练动态和条件计算分配。标准 sparse MoE 通常把每层 top-k 设成固定超参，再用 load balancing loss 等辅助项缓解专家塌缩和负载不均。SoftMoE 把 k 也纳入可微优化，并加全局 expert budget，使模型可以学习“哪些层更需要专家容量”。如果这一机制在更大规模上稳定，意义在于 MoE scaling 不再只是在 expert 数、top-k、capacity factor 上做静态网格搜索，而可以让计算预算在网络深度上自动重分配。它的量级更接近 MoE routing recipe 的改进，不是完整预训练范式替换。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方案是用 truncated soft top-k LapSum relaxation 替代离散 top-k。给定 gating network 产生的 expert score，hard top-k 输出二值选择向量；SoftMoE 输出连续选择权重，并保持选择权重总和约等于 k。LapSum 把 top-k 选择写成连续 order-statistics 问题，通过 Laplace CDF 的和来求一个平滑阈值。超过阈值的 expert 得到较大权重，低分 expert 权重被压低。关键点是这个阈值可以闭式或近似高效计算，不需要排序或迭代优化，复杂度随 expert 数线性增长。更重要的是，输出对 routing score 和 k 都可微。论文进一步为每个 MoE 层参数化平均 active expert 数，并施加全局预算约束。这样某些层可以用更多 expert，另一些层用更少 expert，总体推理成本保持受控。与 token mixing 型 soft MoE 不同，它仍按 token 独立路由，不引入未来 token 信息，因此适配 autoregressive LM。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 C4、OpenWebText 的语言建模，以及若干下游任务。正文信息显示，SoftMoE 在平均激活 expert 更少的情况下，整体匹配或超过标准 sparse MoE。一个有用观察是 learned expert allocation 呈现稳定结构：后层倾向于使用更多 expert，前层使用较少 expert。这与 dense Transformer 中后层承担更高语义抽象和任务适配的经验一致，也说明固定每层 top-k 可能浪费部分浅层计算。给出的正文片段没有包含完整表格，无法核验具体 perplexity、下游分数、expert 数、模型规模和显存/吞吐数字。需要重点确认大规模训练稳定性、routing entropy、expert load skew，以及 soft routing 在推理时是否需要截断成硬稀疏路径。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。先看方法部分的 LapSum soft top-k 定义，重点理解它为什么同时对 score 和 k 可微，以及为什么不会破坏自回归因果性。然后看全局 expert budget 的参数化方式：预算约束是硬约束、正则项还是重参数化，这会直接影响训练稳定性。实验部分优先看三类图表：平均 active experts 与性能的 trade-off、各层 learned k 的分布、与标准 top-k MoE 的训练 loss 曲线。真正值得深挖的是 learned layer-wise capacity allocation 是否能迁移到更大模型，以及它是否减少了 MoE 训练里常见的 load balancing 辅助损失依赖。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific limitation of sparse MoE routing: hard top-k selection is efficient and causal, but the selection step is non-differentiable and fixes the number of active experts in advance. SoftMoE asks whether expert choice and expert count can be optimized directly while keeping token-wise routing and autoregressive compatibility.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance for pretraining is in MoE routing and compute allocation. Current sparse MoE recipes usually choose a fixed top-k per layer and then rely on auxiliary balancing losses to keep routing usable. SoftMoE makes the effective k differentiable and adds a global expert budget, allowing the model to redistribute conditional compute across depth. If the behavior holds at larger scale, this changes part of MoE design from static hyperparameter selection to learned budget allocation. The contribution is best viewed as a routing and training-recipe improvement rather than a new language modeling objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: SoftMoE replaces the discrete top-k gate with a truncated soft top-k operator based on the LapSum relaxation. Given expert scores from the router, hard top-k produces a binary mask; the proposed relaxation produces continuous expert weights whose total mass corresponds to a possibly non-integer k. The LapSum construction approximates the order-statistics threshold with a smooth function built from Laplace CDFs. This gives a differentiable threshold and avoids sorting or iterative optimization, keeping time and memory linear in the number of experts. A second component parameterizes the mean number of active experts per MoE layer and constrains the global expert budget. Layers can therefore spend more or less expert capacity while the total inference budget remains fixed. Unlike soft-routing methods that mix tokens or let experts select tokens, this design routes each token independently and does not leak future-token information.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments use language modeling on C4 and OpenWebText, plus downstream evaluations. SoftMoE is reported to match or outperform standard sparse MoE while activating fewer experts on average. The most informative empirical observation is the learned allocation pattern: later layers consistently use more experts, while earlier layers use fewer. This suggests that a uniform top-k across all MoE layers may be an inefficient default. The provided body text does not include the full numerical tables, so exact perplexity, benchmark deltas, model sizes, and throughput numbers cannot be verified here. Important checks are routing entropy, expert-load skew, training-loss stability, and whether inference uses the same soft routing path or an additional hard truncation step.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 20–30 minutes. Read the LapSum soft top-k derivation first, focusing on why the operator is differentiable with respect to both router scores and k. Then inspect the global-budget parameterization, since the form of the constraint largely determines whether the method is stable in pretraining. In the experiments, prioritize plots or tables showing performance versus average active experts, learned k by layer, and loss curves against hard top-k MoE. The deeper question is whether learned layer-wise expert allocation remains reliable at frontier-scale MoE training, where load imbalance and routing instability are harder to hide.

recommendation.zh: 可微 MoE 路由是一个有潜力的方向——比离散 top-k 更合理但实现难度更高。读 §3 松弛近似和 §4 容量分配机制即可，实验规模不大结论当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Differentiable MoE routing is a promising direction—more principled than discrete top-k but harder to implement. Read §3 relaxation and §4 capacity allocation; treat results as weak signal given limited scale.

paper.title: RepSelect: Robust LLM Unlearning via Representation Selectivity
paper.abstract: Making large language models (LLMs) deeply forget specific knowledge and values without sacrificing general capabilities remains a central challenge in unlearning. However, current methods are easily reversed by fine-tuning or few-shot prompting, suggesting their forgetting is only shallow. We identify the root cause. Existing methods target representations shared with both the retain set and the subspace recovered by a fine-tuning attacker, making unlearning both disruptive to general capabilit

summary.core_problem: 这项工作关注 LLM unlearning 的“深度遗忘”问题：模型不仅要在目标知识或目标行为上失效，还要保持通用能力，并且不能被少量微调或 few-shot prompt 轻易恢复。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把 unlearning 失败原因落到表示子空间上，而不是只比较输出拒答率或 forget loss。作者指出，常规方法优先打击 forget set 的高方差方向，但这些方向同时和 retain set 共享，也正是攻击者微调时最容易恢复的方向。因此，遗忘、能力保持、抗恢复三者的冲突有可观测的表示机制。这个视角对 open-weight 模型的合规删除、continual pretrain 后的知识移除、以及训练后安全约束是否真正改变模型内部能力，都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 RepSelect。核心做法是在每次 unlearning 更新前，对 forget-set 产生的权重梯度做奇异值分解，识别并压制高方差主成分，只让更新主要发生在更具 forget-set selectivity 的低方差方向上。作者利用 MLP 权重更新的外积分解 ΔW=Σ g_t⊗a_t，把 token 级输入激活 a_t 和输出梯度 g_t 分开分析。常规梯度上升或带 KL retain 正则的方法，会沿着 forget loss 最大的方向更新；这些方向信号强，但与通用语言能力和攻击者可恢复子空间重叠较高。RepSelect 反过来削弱这部分共享方向，牺牲单个方向的 forgetting 强度，换取整体上更少破坏 retain 能力、更难被后续微调恢复的遗忘效果。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两类 unlearning 场景。第一类是 WMDP biology 的生物安全知识删除，作者从 biology 集中过滤出 189 道更适合 targeted unlearning 的多选题，每题生成 3 个 paraphrase 作为 forget corpus；relearning attack 使用其中 94 题的 paraphrase，另外 95 题作为 held-out MCQ 评测。retain set 使用 FineFineWeb 中领域匹配的 biology 数据。第二类是 BeaverTails 的 animal_abuse 行为倾向删除，retain set 通过把有害概念替换成 benign counterpart 构造，以尽量保留上下文分布。模型包括 Llama 3.1 8B、Qwen 3.5 9B、Gemma 4 E4B 和 DeepSeek-V2-Lite，覆盖 dense 与 MoE。所有方法共享 disruption budget：当 WikiText 上 KL(pθ0∥pθ) 超过 0.01 时停止，约对应 0.4% NLL 增长。结果上，在生物危害知识 unlearning 中，RepSelect 在 relearning 后的 answer probability reduction 相比最佳 baseline NPO 高 8–50 倍；在 animal-abuse 场景中，相比 NPO 或 RMU 高 4–15 倍，同时保持相近的通用能力损失。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。重点看表示重叠分析部分和 RepSelect 方法部分，尤其是作者如何定义 forget-set 高方差方向、retain overlap、attacker subspace，以及为什么这些方向会导致可恢复遗忘。实验部分优先看 WMDP biology 的 relearning protocol、KL disruption budget 的设置、以及不同模型族上的一致性结果。附录中数据过滤和 paraphrase/relearning 构造值得扫一遍，因为 unlearning 结果很依赖攻击协议是否合理。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies robust LLM unlearning: removing targeted knowledge or behavioral tendencies while preserving general capability and preventing recovery through fine-tuning or few-shot prompting.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is the representation-level diagnosis of why many unlearning methods remain reversible. The paper argues that standard objectives mostly update high-variance forget-set directions. Those directions are also shared with retain data and overlap with the subspace a fine-tuning attacker can recover. This gives a concrete mechanism behind the tension among forgetting, low disruption, and robustness. The framing is useful for open-weight compliance, post-training safety interventions, and continual-pretraining settings where knowledge must be removed rather than hidden at the surface behavior level.
summary_en.technical_approach: RepSelect applies singular value decomposition to forget-set weight gradients before each unlearning update and suppresses the top principal components. The update is then restricted toward lower-variance directions that carry weaker individual forgetting signals but are less entangled with general capability and less aligned with the attacker’s relearning subspace. The analysis uses the MLP update decomposition ΔW=Σ g_t⊗a_t, separating token-level input activations from output gradients. Compared with gradient ascent, KL-regularized unlearning, NPO, or RMU-style methods, the key change is not a new retain loss but a selection of which representation directions are allowed to drive the unlearning update.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses two scenarios. For biohazardous knowledge, the authors filter WMDP biology to 189 targeted multiple-choice questions, generate three paraphrases per question, use all paraphrases for unlearning, split questions for relearning versus held-out MCQ evaluation, and use domain-matched biology text from FineFineWeb as retain data. For harmful behavioral tendency removal, they use the animal_abuse category from BeaverTails and construct a synthetic retain set by replacing harmful concepts with benign counterparts while keeping surrounding context. The models include Llama 3.1 8B, Qwen 3.5 9B, Gemma 4 E4B, and DeepSeek-V2-Lite, covering dense and MoE families. Methods are compared under a fixed disruption budget: training stops once KL(pθ0∥pθ) on WikiText exceeds 0.01, roughly a 0.4% NLL increase. RepSelect reports an 8–50× larger post-relearning answer-probability reduction than the best baseline, NPO, on biohazardous knowledge, and a 4–15× larger reduction than NPO or RMU on animal-abuse tendencies, while matching general capability preservation.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is enough. Focus on the representation-overlap analysis and the RepSelect algorithm. The most useful details are how the paper defines high-variance forget directions, retain-set overlap, and attacker-recoverable subspaces. In the experiments, prioritize the WMDP biology relearning protocol, the fixed KL disruption budget, and the consistency across dense and MoE models. The appendix details on data filtering and paraphrase-based attacks are worth checking because robust unlearning claims are highly sensitive to the attack setup.

recommendation.zh: 只看表示子空间分析和跨 MoE 结果；若实验干净，它会改变“unlearning 主要是 loss 设计问题”的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the representation-subspace analysis and MoE results; if the setup is clean, it weakens the prior that unlearning is mainly a loss-design problem.

paper.title: Conservation Laws for Modern Neural Architectures
paper.abstract: Understanding gradient descent dynamics is key to explaining the success of over-parameterized models, where implicit bias manifests through conservation laws in gradient flow. While such laws are well understood for linear and ReLU networks, they remain largely unexplored for modern architectures. This work develops a unified framework to characterize conservation laws for contemporary models, including feedforward networks with GELU, SiLU, and SwiGLU activations, multihead attention with sinus

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究现代神经网络在梯度流训练中的守恒量：哪些参数函数会沿优化轨迹保持不变，以及这些守恒量是否已经被完整刻画。重点对象不是早期线性网络或 ReLU MLP，而是当前大模型常用组件，包括 GELU、SiLU、SwiGLU 前馈层，多头注意力、正弦位置编码、RoPE，以及不同门控形式的 MoE。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在训练动态和隐式偏置，而不是直接给出新的训练 recipe。守恒律描述了优化器和架构共同施加的几何约束。它能解释为什么某些参数组合从初始化到收敛始终受限，也为分析 loss spike、参数尺度漂移、专家路由稳定性提供一套较干净的理论语言。贡献量级偏基础理论：它把 Marcotte 等人关于线性、ReLU、ResNet、单头 Transformer 的框架推进到更贴近 LLM 的模块，尤其补上了多头注意力和 MoE。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，论文把守恒律刻画为一组偏微分方程的求解问题。给定模型参数 θ 和梯度流动力学，如果某个光滑函数 C(θ) 在所有训练轨迹上保持不变，就要求 C 的梯度与训练损失诱导的向量场正交。作者沿用并扩展 Marcotte 系列工作的框架，在一定损失和数据假设下给出完整性结果，即证明列出的守恒量不只是一些例子，而是穷尽了所有满足条件的光滑守恒律。具体覆盖三类模块：第一，带 GELU、SiLU、SwiGLU 的前馈网络，处理平滑激活和门控激活相对于 ReLU 同质性的变化；第二，多头注意力，并进一步考虑正弦位置编码和 RoPE，回应此前单头分析之外的开放问题；第三，MoE，包括 dense MoE、sparse top-k 路由、softmax gating、sigmoid gating 和 normalized sigmoid gating。区别于只列举不变量的经验观察，这篇工作的重点是完整刻画和证明边界条件。
summary.experiments: 实验用于验证理论预言的守恒量，而不是追求下游性能。论文在所考虑的前馈、注意力和 MoE 架构上跟踪对应不变量，比较 full-batch gradient descent 和 SGD 情况。全文说明实验覆盖小规模和较大规模的多模态数据设置。可核验的主结论是：理论给出的不变量在全批量训练中按预期保持，在 SGD 下也表现出可观的近似保持；这支持了守恒律作为训练动态诊断工具的可用性。提供内容中没有可核验的参数量、数据 token 数或具体数值幅度，因此不应把它解读为有直接工程收益的实验论文。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 30 到 45 分钟。先看 Section 3，理解作者如何把守恒律问题转成 PDE；这里决定了后面所有定理的形式。再看 Section 4 的三个子部分：4.1 对 GELU、SiLU、SwiGLU 的处理，4.2 对多头注意力和位置编码的完整刻画，4.3 对 MoE 门控的分类。对 LLM 预训练研究员，4.2 和 4.3 最值得停留，因为它们贴近 Transformer 和 MoE 的实际结构。Section 5 适合看证明思路和限制条件，避免把梯度流下的严格结果直接外推到 AdamW、大 batch、混合精度和复杂并行训练。Section 6 可快速查看不变量是否在 SGD 中仍有经验意义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which quantities remain invariant along gradient-flow training trajectories in modern neural architectures, and whether these invariants can be characterized completely. The target is not the classical linear or ReLU setting, but modules used in current large models: GELU, SiLU and SwiGLU feed-forward blocks, multi-head attention, sinusoidal positional encodings, RoPE, and MoE layers with different gating mechanisms.
summary_en.importance: The value for pretraining research is in training dynamics and implicit bias, not in an immediate recipe change. Conservation laws describe geometric constraints imposed jointly by the architecture and the optimizer. They can help reason about parameter-scale constraints, stability, and routing dynamics. The contribution is mainly theoretical: it extends the Marcotte-style characterization framework from simpler networks and single-head attention to components that are much closer to LLM practice, especially multi-head attention and MoE.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formulates conservation-law discovery as a system of partial differential equations. For a smooth function C(θ) to be conserved under gradient flow, its gradient must be orthogonal to the vector field induced by the training loss. Under assumptions inherited from prior characterization work, the authors prove completeness: the listed invariants exhaust the admissible smooth conservation laws, rather than being isolated examples. The analysis covers three families. First, feed-forward networks with smooth and gated activations, including GELU, SiLU, and SwiGLU. Second, multi-head attention, with extensions to sinusoidal positional encodings and rotary embeddings. Third, MoE architectures under dense and sparse regimes, including softmax, sigmoid, and normalized-sigmoid gating. The main distinction from earlier work is the move from illustrative invariants to complete characterizations for architectures used in modern large-scale models.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments validate the predicted invariants rather than optimize task performance. The paper tracks the relevant conserved quantities for the considered feed-forward, attention, and MoE architectures under both full-batch training and SGD. The described experimental suite includes small and larger multimodal datasets. The verifiable takeaway is that the invariants behave as predicted under full-batch gradient descent and remain approximately meaningful under SGD. The provided content does not contain reliable numeric details on model size, data scale, or measured drift, so the result should be read as theoretical validation with empirical checks rather than as an engineering benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30 to 45 minutes. Start with Section 3 to understand the reduction from conservation laws to PDE constraints. Then read the three parts of Section 4: feed-forward blocks with modern activations, multi-head attention with positional encodings, and MoE gating. For LLM pretraining, Sections 4.2 and 4.3 are the most relevant. Section 5 is worth reading for proof ideas and limitations, especially before extrapolating gradient-flow results to AdamW, large batches, mixed precision, and distributed training. Section 6 can be read quickly to check whether the invariants remain empirically visible under SGD.

recommendation.zh: 训练动态机制的扎实理论工作，重点关注MoE和RoPE部分的守恒律推导，可用于解释预训练中的隐式正则化现象，读§3-§4即可。
recommendation.en: Solid theoretical work on training dynamics; focus on MoE and RoPE conservation law derivations to explain implicit regularization in pretraining, read §3-§4 only.

paper.title: Nemotron 3 Ultra: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
paper.abstract: We introduce Nemotron 3 Ultra, a 550 billion total and 55 billion active parameter Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Attention language model. We pre-trained Nemotron 3 Ultra on 20 trillion text tokens, then extended the context length to 1M tokens, and post-trained using Supervised Fine Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning (RL), and Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD). Nemotron 3 Ultra is our most capable model yet, employing multiple key technologies - LatentMoE, Multi Token Prediction (

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是大模型在 agentic reasoning 场景下的精度、长上下文能力和推理吞吐之间的取舍。Nemotron 3 Ultra 试图用 550B total / 55B active 的 MoE hybrid Mamba-Attention 架构，在保持公开模型可比精度的同时，显著降低 attention 成本和 KV cache 压力，并把预训练、长上下文扩展、低精度训练、RL 后训练和推理加速串成一条完整 recipe。
summary.importance: 这是一份对预训练研究有直接参考价值的系统报告。贡献不只在模型分数，而在若干可复用的训练和系统选择：第一，550B 规模上使用 NVFP4 预训练并保持稳定，给低精度预训练提供了大规模证据；第二，hybrid Mamba-Attention 与 MoE 结合，展示了用状态空间层降低长输出场景推理成本的路线；第三，LatentMoE、MTP、WSD 学习率、两阶段数据配比、1M context extension、SFT/RLVR/MOPD 被放在同一模型中验证，提供了一个较完整的 open recipe；第四，报告释放 base、post-trained、NVFP4 checkpoint，以及部分预训练和后训练数据，对复现实验和消融研究有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach:
模型是 550B 总参数、每 token 激活 55B 参数的 Mixture-of-Experts hybrid Mamba-Attention LM。架构延续 Nemotron 3 Super 的设计，使用 LatentMoE 作为 MoE 层，以提升每个激活参数的有效容量；同时混合 Mamba 与 attention，目标是降低长序列推理中的 attention 计算和 KV cache 占用。模型还原生加入 Multi-Token Prediction。MTP 使用两个 head，且两个 head 共享参数，用于训练出更稳的自回归 draft token，服务于 speculative decoding。每个 MTP head 由一个 attention layer 和一个 MoE layer 组成。

预训练使用 20T text tokens，采用 Warmup-Stable-Decay 学习率计划。数据分两阶段：前 15T tokens 强调多样性和领域覆盖，后 5T tokens 强调高质量数据，用于提升模型精度。这种安排接近大规模训练中的“先覆盖、后打磨”：前段用广覆盖保证能力底座，后段用更干净、更高价值的数据降低噪声并改善 benchmark 表现。

低精度训练是报告的重点之一。Nemotron 3 Ultra 使用 NVFP4 预训练，NVFP4 层采用 E2M1 数据类型，对权重做二维 block quantization；wgrad 输入使用 Random Hadamard Transform；梯度使用 stochastic rounding。为了稳定性，最后 15% 网络，也就是 16 层，以及 Mamba output projection、latent projection、QKV 和 attention projection、MTP layers、embedding layers 保持更高精度。这个选择反映了一个工程判断：不是所有矩阵都适合压到 FP4，靠近输出端、注意力投影和嵌入相关层对数值误差更敏感。

后训练路径包括 curated SFT、统一 RLVR、多教师 on-policy distillation。RLVR 覆盖 reasoning、agentic、code、safety、usability、chat 等多类环境。团队还训练了十多个领域教师模型，包括沿专门 agentic SFT 路径训练的教师。MOPD 在学生自己生成的 rollout 上提供 dense token-level guidance，把多个教师的能力合并到 Ultra。模型还支持 reasoning effort control，用于在推理时调节准确率和计算量之间的取舍。
summary.experiments:
关键规模和结果包括：模型为 550B total / 55B active；预训练数据量为 20T text tokens；上下文扩展到 1M tokens；开放 BF16 base、BF16 post-trained、NVFP4 post-trained checkpoint。推理吞吐方面，在 8K input / 64K output 设置下，相比 GLM-5.1-754B-A40B、Kimi-K2.6-1T-A32B、Qwen-3.5-397B-17B，分别达到 5.9×、4.8×、1.6× 的更高吞吐，并声称精度大体可比。

NVFP4 稳定性通过 BF16 分支实验监控：团队从 5T、10T、16T token 的 checkpoint 分支出来，把所有 tensor 切到 BF16，并继续训练 74B tokens。NVFP4 主训练相对这些 BF16 segment 的训练损失差距平均低于 0.4%。这说明在该 recipe 下，FP4 量化误差没有明显破坏优化轨迹。

base model 被报告为强于若干公开 base model，包括 DeepSeek v3.2、Mistral Large 3、Kimi-K2、GLM-4.5。给定内容没有提供完整分项表格，无法逐项列出 benchmark 数值。数据消融方面，报告提到在 Nemotron 3 Nano 上加入 Nemotron-Pretraining-Legal-v1 synthetic legal datasets 后，proxy LegalBench 平均准确率从 64.6 提升到 74.7。释放的数据还包括 173B tokens 的 fresh GitHub code 数据，以及 specialized synthetic pretraining data 和 post-training data。
summary.reading_guide:
建议精读 Pretraining 部分，尤其是 architecture、NVFP4 recipe、data mixture、training instability monitoring。Figure 2 和 Table 1 应该用于理解 layer pattern、Mamba/attention/MoE 的具体排布；Figure 3 值得看，因为 BF16 branch loss gap 是判断 NVFP4 是否可靠的关键证据。

第二优先级是 Post-training 部分。重点看 RLVR 环境如何统一、MOPD 如何在 on-policy rollout 上做 token-level distillation、reasoning budget control 如何实现。这里的价值在于 pretrain 和 posttrain 的接口：base model 的结构选择、MTP、长上下文、低精度训练，最后都要服务于 agentic inference 的吞吐和稳定性。

Inference 部分建议快速读，但要关注 8K/64K 设置下的吞吐定义、batching 策略、硬件配置、KV cache 口径，以及 hybrid Mamba-Attention 对长输出的实际收益。如果想复现或迁移，最值得深挖的是 NVFP4 哪些层保持高精度、MTP head 共享参数的消融、15T+5T 数据阶段划分、以及 1M context extension 的训练长度和数据构造。
summary.authors_note: NVIDIA Nemotron 团队。给定内容未列出完整作者名单；背景是 Nemotron 3 系列的开放模型、训练 recipe、数据和推理栈报告。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the accuracy-throughput-context trade-off for large models used in long-horizon agentic reasoning. Nemotron 3 Ultra combines a 550B-total, 55B-active MoE model with a hybrid Mamba-Attention architecture, aiming to match the accuracy of strong public models while reducing attention cost and KV-cache pressure during long-output inference.
summary_en.importance: The report is important for pretraining research because it exposes a full large-scale recipe rather than only final benchmark numbers. The notable pieces are NVFP4 pretraining at 550B scale, a hybrid Mamba-Attention MoE architecture, LatentMoE for active-parameter efficiency, native Multi-Token Prediction for speculative decoding, a 20T-token WSD pretraining run, 1M-context extension, and an agent-focused SFT/RLVR/MOPD post-training pipeline. The release of base, post-trained, and NVFP4 checkpoints, plus training recipes and datasets, makes the work useful for studying low-precision training and architecture-system co-design.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Nemotron 3 Ultra is a 550B total-parameter MoE language model with 55B active parameters per token. It follows the Nemotron 3 Super hybrid Mamba-Attention design, scaled up and combined with LatentMoE. The motivation is direct: MoE improves accuracy per active parameter, while replacing part of full attention with Mamba-style sequence modeling reduces inference cost and KV-cache footprint for long contexts and long outputs.

The model includes native Multi-Token Prediction with two shared-parameter heads. The heads are trained to produce autoregressive draft tokens and are used for speculative decoding. Each MTP head consists of one attention layer followed by one MoE layer.

Pretraining uses 20 trillion text tokens with a Warmup-Stable-Decay learning-rate schedule. The first 15T tokens emphasize diversity and broad domain coverage. The last 5T tokens emphasize higher-quality data to refine accuracy. This is a practical data schedule: broad coverage first, lower-noise refinement later.

A central technical point is NVFP4 pretraining. NVFP4 layers use the E2M1 datatype with two-dimensional block quantization on weights. Random Hadamard Transforms are applied to inputs for weight-gradient computation, and gradients use stochastic rounding. The recipe keeps numerically sensitive parts in higher precision: the final 15% of the network, corresponding to 16 layers, plus Mamba output projections, latent projections, QKV and attention projections, MTP layers, and embeddings. This selective precision policy is likely as important as the FP4 datatype itself.

Post-training starts with curated SFT, then applies unified RLVR over reasoning, agentic, code, safety, usability, and chat environments. More than ten specialized teacher models are trained, including agentic teachers from a dedicated agentic SFT path. Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation then gives dense token-level supervision on rollouts generated by the student model. The final model also supports reasoning effort control, allowing inference-time adjustment of the compute-accuracy trade-off.
summary_en.experiments:
The main scale numbers are 550B total parameters, 55B active parameters, 20T pretraining tokens, and 1M-token context extension. The paper reports 5.9×, 4.8×, and 1.6× higher inference throughput than GLM-5.1-754B-A40B, Kimi-K2.6-1T-A32B, and Qwen-3.5-397B-17B respectively under an 8K input / 64K output setting, while maintaining broadly comparable accuracy.

For NVFP4 training health, the team branches from checkpoints at 5T, 10T, and 16T tokens, switches tensors to BF16, and continues training for 74B tokens. The relative training-loss gap between the NVFP4 run and the BF16 continuation averages below 0.4%. This is the key evidence that the FP4 recipe tracks a high-precision training trajectory closely enough at this scale.

The base model is reported to outperform several public base models, including DeepSeek v3.2, Mistral Large 3, Kimi-K2, and GLM-4.5, though the provided text does not include the full benchmark tables. One concrete data ablation is given: adding the Nemotron-Pretraining-Legal-v1 synthetic legal datasets to Nemotron 3 Nano improves a proxy LegalBench average from 64.6 to 74.7. The release also includes 173B tokens of fresh GitHub code data, specialized synthetic pretraining datasets, and post-training datasets.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read the pretraining section carefully, especially the architecture, NVFP4 recipe, data schedule, and instability-monitoring subsections. Figure 2 and Table 1 should clarify the Mamba/attention/MoE layer pattern. Figure 3 is important because the BF16-branch loss gap is the main evidence for stable NVFP4 training.

Then read the post-training section for the interface between pretraining choices and agentic behavior. The key details are the unified RLVR environment mix, the construction of specialized teachers, token-level MOPD on student rollouts, and reasoning effort control.

The inference section can be read more selectively, but check the exact throughput setup: hardware, batching, sequence lengths, KV-cache accounting, and the 8K-input/64K-output measurement. For researchers trying to reuse the recipe, the most useful details are the selective high-precision layer policy, the shared-parameter MTP heads, the 15T plus 5T data schedule, and the 1M-context extension procedure.
summary_en.authors_note: NVIDIA Nemotron team. The provided content does not list the full author names. The work is part of the Nemotron 3 open model, recipe, data, and inference stack.

recommendation.zh: 这类 paper 要读 recipe，不要只看榜单；若 ablation 干净，它会直接改变你对“混合状态空间 + MoE + 低精度预训练”能否在大规模上稳定落地的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read it for the recipe, not the leaderboard; if the ablations are clean, it materially updates the prior on whether hybrid SSM+MoE+low-precision pretraining is stable at frontier scale.

paper.title: Tying the Loop -- Tied Expert Layers in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures efficiently scale Large Language Models (LLMs) by activating only a small fraction of their experts per token, yet the full parameter count - dominated by the expert parameters - must be held in training and inference memory. To address this, we introduce Expert Tying, an architectural modification that shares expert parameters across consecutive transformer layers while preserving independent, layer-wise routing and attention.   We evaluate this approach a

summary.core_problem: MoE架构通过每token仅激活少量专家FFN，实现了总参数量与每token计算量的解耦，成为大模型扩展的主流方案；但当前开源MoE的每token激活参数占比仅3%-10%，训练和推理时仍需加载全部专家参数，显存几乎被闲置参数主导，这与近期追求“单参数计算效率最大化”的趋势（如循环深度模型、OpenAI Parameter Golf挑战）直接矛盾。此外，现有MoE跨层参数共享工作未通过控制变量实验系统分析各组件（专家FFN、路由、注意力、归一化）共享的质量代价，无法指导最优共享策略设计。
summary.importance: 提供了可直接落地的MoE参数效率优化方案，无需修改现有训练/推理基础设施即可大幅降低显存占用。通过系统的控制变量实验厘清了MoE各组件跨层共享的质量代价差异，为后续参数高效MoE、循环深度架构设计提供了实证依据。提出的异构宽度扩展思路将专家绑定从单纯的压缩技术，拓展为MoE深度-宽度权衡的新设计维度。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方案为Expert Tying（专家绑定）：将连续g层Transformer中所有MoE专家FFN的gate/up/down投影参数通过Python级指针别名实现跨层共享，仅需优化器正确处理绑定参数在多个使用位置的梯度累积，无需修改其他训练/推理基础设施；同时保留每层独立的路由、注意力投影与RMSNorm参数，确保隐藏状态仍经过g个不同的层算子变换。通过控制变量消融验证了该方案的可行性：每层独立的注意力是维持层间差异的核心（而非路由），因此共享参数量最大的专家FFN的质量代价极低，而共享注意力的质量损失会高出一个数量级。补充两个关键设计规则：1）模型首尾各2层不参与绑定（2+2的非绑定首尾段），该设计带来最大的单架构性能增益；2）异构宽度扩展：将专家绑定节省的参数重新投入到中间绑定层，增加专家数量，可在同参数量下稳定超过未绑定基线。此前的MoE跨层共享研究未开展跨架构、多粒度的控制变量分析，本工作的系统实验覆盖了这一缺口。
summary.experiments: 实验分为两阶段：1）小模型控制实验：采用32层解码器-only Transformer（d_model=512，8注意力头，序列长512，32专家top-8激活）验证组件共享代价；2）大规模预训练实验：覆盖OLMoE、Qwen3-MoE、DeepSeekMoE三种主流生产级MoE架构，最大参数量达7B。核心结果：当绑定组大小g=4时，总参数量最多降低52%，验证困惑度与下游任务精度几乎无退化，训练 wall-clock 速度最高提升23.7%。组件消融显示：解绑注意力带来的loss改善幅度比仅解绑路由高出一个数量级，验证了注意力是维持层差异的核心；异构宽度扩展方案在三种架构、同参数量设置下均超过未绑定基线；2+2非绑定首尾段的设计带来消融实验中最大的单架构性能增益。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看Introduction部分对MoE显存开销与参数效率趋势矛盾的问题定义，再重点阅读Section 3的组件消融实验（核心结论：注意力是维持层差异的核心，专家FFN可安全共享，首尾层不宜绑定），以及Section 4的跨架构大规模预训练结果，尤其是异构宽度扩展的实验设计。预计阅读时间30-40分钟，重点关注组件消融的对比图表与跨架构性能对比表。

summary_en.core_problem: MoE architectures decouple total parameter count from per-token compute by activating only a small subset of expert FFNs per token, but require storing all expert parameters in memory during training and inference. For current open-source MoEs, only 3%-10% of parameters are active per token, so memory is dominated by idle parameters, creating a direct tension with recent parameter-efficiency trends (e.g., looped-depth models, OpenAI's Parameter Golf challenge) that maximize compute per unique parameter. Prior cross-layer parameter sharing work for MoEs lacks controlled, systematic analysis of the quality cost of sharing different components (expert FFNs, routers, attention, normalization), so no clear guidance exists for optimal sharing strategies.
summary_en.importance: Delivers a production-ready parameter efficiency optimization for MoEs that cuts memory footprint without meaningful quality loss, requiring no changes to existing training or inference infrastructure. Provides empirical evidence on the cost of sharing different MoE components across layers, informing future designs of parameter-efficient MoEs and looped-depth architectures. The proposed heterogeneous width expansion strategy reframes expert tying from a pure compression technique into a new design axis for MoE depth-width tradeoffs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Core method is Expert Tying: share gate/up/down projection weights of all MoE expert FFNs across a group of g consecutive Transformer layers via Python-level pointer aliasing. Only optimizer logic needs adjustment to correctly accumulate gradients from tied parameters across multiple use sites; no other training or inference infrastructure changes are required. Per-layer routers, attention projections, and RMSNorm parameters remain independent, so hidden states still pass through g distinct layer operators. Controlled component ablations confirm the feasibility of this design: per-layer attention (not routing) is the primary source of layer distinctiveness, so sharing the large expert FFN parameter pool incurs minimal quality cost, while sharing attention causes order-of-magnitude larger degradation. Two key design rules are validated: 1) leave the first 2 and last 2 layers untied (2+2 prelude/coda), which delivers the single largest architectural performance gain; 2) heterogeneous width expansion: reinvest parameters saved by tying into more experts in middle tied layers, which consistently outperforms untied baselines at iso-parameter count. Unlike prior MoE cross-layer sharing work that either ties full layer blocks or a single fixed component, this work provides controlled, cross-architecture, multi-granularity analysis of sharing costs.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are split into two stages: 1) Small-scale controlled experiments on a 32-layer decoder-only Transformer (d_model=512, 8 attention heads, sequence length 512, 32 experts with top-8 activation) to validate component sharing costs; 2) Large-scale pretraining across three production MoE architectures (OLMoE, Qwen3-MoE, DeepSeekMoE) with up to 7B total parameters. Key results: with group size g=4, total parameter count is reduced by up to 52%, with negligible degradation in validation perplexity and downstream task accuracy, and wall-clock training speed improved by up to 23.7%. Component ablations show untying attention improves loss by an order of magnitude more than untying routers alone, confirming attention as the core of layer distinctiveness. Heterogeneous width expansion outperforms untied baselines across all three architectures at matched parameter count. The 2+2 untied prelude/coda delivers the largest single architectural gain in ablation studies.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction first to grasp the core tension between MoE memory overhead and parameter-efficiency goals. Focus on Section 3's component ablations (the key finding that attention preserves layer distinctiveness, while expert FFNs can be shared safely, and first/last layers should remain untied) and Section 4's cross-architecture large-scale pretraining results, especially the heterogeneous width expansion experimental design. Expected reading time: 30-40 minutes; prioritize component ablation comparison charts and cross-architecture performance comparison tables.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得做内部复现：它在碰 MoE 一个很少被认真挑战的 prior——专家必须逐层独立；先看 tied depth 设计和 perplexity 曲线，再决定是否改自家 MoE 模板。
recommendation.en: This is worth an internal replication: it challenges a rarely questioned MoE prior—that experts must be layer-specific. Read the tied-depth design and perplexity curves before touching your MoE template.

paper.title: How to Score Experts for One-Shot MoE Expert Pruning: A Unified Formulation and Selection Principle
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models reduce per-token computation through sparse expert activation, yet deployment still requires storing the full expert pool, making one-shot expert pruning a practical approach for reducing memory usage. Although effective, existing criteria are largely heuristic, and no single criterion is universally optimal. Thus, establishing a principle for selecting pruning criteria suited to different deployment objectives remains an important yet largely underexplor

summary.core_problem: 解决 MoE 语言模型部署时虽然每 token 只激活少量专家，但仍需存储完整专家池，导致显存占用高的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 MoE 压缩和部署方法分析。它不是提出新的 MoE 架构，而是把 one-shot expert pruning 的打分准则统一到同一公式下，并给出面向不同部署目标的选择原则。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一个由三类因素构成的统一专家打分形式：routing frequency、gate weighting、activation strength。基于该形式，论文主张任务无关剪枝应偏向 routed-token-averaged、gate-free 的 activation-based 准则；任务特定剪枝则可以保留路由频率和 gate 权重信息。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 MoE 模型、参数规模、数据集和数值结果。实验应围绕 one-shot expert pruning 对不同打分准则的比较，目标是在减少专家存储的同时保持任务性能；论文声称统一公式还能推导出新准则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the memory cost of deploying MoE language models: sparse activation reduces per-token compute, but the full expert pool still has to be stored.
summary_en.importance: This is a MoE compression and deployment analysis contribution. Rather than proposing a new MoE architecture, it unifies one-shot expert-pruning scoring rules and derives a criterion-selection principle for different deployment objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The unified formulation decomposes expert scores into routing frequency, gate weighting, and activation strength. It argues that task-agnostic pruning should favor routed-token-averaged, gate-free activation-based criteria, while task-specific pruning can benefit from preserving routing-frequency and gate-weight information.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify MoE model sizes, datasets, or numerical results. The experiments appear to compare one-shot expert-pruning criteria under memory reduction while preserving task performance, and the formulation is said to yield additional criteria.

recommendation.zh: 读准则统一公式和任务无关/任务特定分界即可；对 MoE serving 有用，但不会改变预训练路由设计。
recommendation.en: Read the unified scoring formula and the task-agnostic versus task-specific split; useful for MoE serving, unlikely to change pretraining router design.

paper.title: Circuit Tracing in Autoregressive Protein Language Models
paper.abstract: Protein language models (pLMs) can generate novel protein sequences with properties beyond those observed in nature, yet the mechanisms underlying protein generation remain poorly understood. Existing mechanistic interpretability methods based on sparse autoencoders and transcoders primarily focus on protein representation learning models and do not capture the computation required for autoregressive generation. Here, we introduce ProGenMech, a mechanistic interpretability framework for generati

summary.core_problem: 如何对自回归蛋白语言模型的“生成计算”做机制可解释性分析，而不是只解释表征。
summary.importance: 把稀疏特征/转码器路线从“表示解释”推进到“生成过程电路追踪”，并且落在MoE+AR+infilling的真实生成模型上；对通用LLM的mechanistic interpretability方法迁移有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ProGenMech：将cross-layer transcoders(CLTs)用于ProGen3，通过“用来自所有前序层的稀疏潜变量重构当前层”来更忠实地恢复跨层计算；再做zero-shot circuit discovery，从稀疏潜变量中挖掘与蛋白生成/fitness预测相关的稀疏电路。
summary.experiments: 对象为ProGen3（稀疏MoE，支持causal generation与span infilling）；评估CLT对各层重构保真度，以及发现的电路对生成与fitness预测的关联（摘要未给出具体层数、稀疏度、重构误差与定量提升幅度）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to do mechanistic interpretability for the *generative computation* of autoregressive protein language models, beyond representation-focused analyses.
summary_en.importance: Extends sparse-feature/transcoder-style interpretability from representations to generation-time circuits, demonstrated on a real MoE AR+infilling model; potentially transferable to general LLM mechanistic analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProGenMech applies cross-layer transcoders (CLTs) to ProGen3: reconstruct each layer using sparse latent variables drawn from all preceding layers to better capture inter-layer computation; then performs zero-shot circuit discovery to identify sparse latent circuits linked to protein generation and fitness prediction.
summary_en.experiments: Studied on ProGen3 (sparse MoE trained for causal generation and span infilling); evaluates reconstruction fidelity and links discovered circuits to generation/fitness prediction (no concrete quantitative details in the provided abstract).

recommendation.zh: CLT把“跨层稀疏重构”用来追生成电路，这点比常见SAE逐层解释更接近真实计算；只看方法与电路发现流程，别纠结蛋白域指标。
recommendation.en: CLTs for cross-layer sparse reconstruction target *generative* circuits, closer to real computation than layerwise SAEs; read the method and circuit-discovery pipeline, ignore protein-specific metrics.

paper.title: LoMC: Localized Multidirectional Correction for Refusal Suppression in Routed Foundation Models
paper.abstract: We study controlled post-training refusal suppression in routed MoE and hybrid-MoE foundation models, aiming to increase non-refusal target-response behavior while preserving general capability under a compact intervention footprint. Existing broad direction-based edits can perturb general-purpose computation, whereas support-only expert edits often lack sufficient capacity to correct heterogeneous refusal representations. To address this limitation, we introduce Localized Multidirectional Corre

summary.core_problem: 论文研究 routed MoE 和 hybrid-MoE foundation model 中的拒答抑制编辑：在较小干预 footprint 下，提高 harmful prompt 上的非拒答比例 TCR，同时尽量保持通用能力 GCA。这里的 TCR 是 refusal rate 的补集，不等同于经过 judge 验证的 harmful compliance。
summary.importance: 这篇论文与基座预训练的关系偏间接，主要价值在 routed 模型的 post-training 可编辑性分析。它讨论了一个 MoE 特有问题：拒答相关表示可能分布在 residual 表示和 routed expert/component 中。粗粒度 direction edit 容易影响通用计算，只选 expert support 又可能校正不足。这个视角对 MoE 安全行为、专家路由与对齐信号耦合的机制研究有参考价值，但它不是预训练 recipe 或数据方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Localized Multidirectional Correction，简称 LoMC。核心是 support-gated correction，并严格采用 support-then-correction 的执行顺序。第一阶段在原 checkpoint 上选择 edit support，也就是允许修改的 layer、expert 和 component 位置；文中把可编辑 MoE component 设为 normalized gate/up interface 和 moe.down_proj branch。第二阶段重新加载原 checkpoint 和固定 support，在这些 fixed-support layer 上聚合多个 prototype correction direction，得到 layer-wise correction direction。最终部署时仍然是 rank-one layer-wise correction，并且只通过 support mask 生效。这样做的取舍是：用多个 prototype 提高 correction signal 的表达能力，但不增加独立 update operator，也不扩大 support footprint。
summary.experiments: 论文在 text-only 和 multimodal safety benchmark 上评估，并覆盖四个 routed backbone。指标包括 harmful prompt 上的 TCR、通用能力平均分 GCA、干预 footprint，以及 search-time benign drift 诊断；文中还使用原模型与编辑后模型预测分布之间的差异作为漂移诊断。结果报告 LoMC 在 TCR 与 GCA 的权衡上优于更宽泛的 direction edit 和只做 support selection 的方案。消融实验主要隔离两个因素：edit-support size 和 prototype direction count。给出的全文片段没有包含完整数值表，因此不补写具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 TCR 的定义，避免把非拒答率误读成 harmful compliance。再看 Method 的两阶段流程：support selection 如何定义可编辑位置，multi-prototype direction aggregation 如何在固定 support 内产生 rank-one correction。实验部分优先看 TCR-GCA trade-off、footprint 指标和两个消融：support size 与 prototype count。若只关心预训练，可跳过具体安全 benchmark 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies refusal suppression for routed MoE and hybrid-MoE foundation models. The goal is to increase Target Compliance Rate, defined as the complement of refusal rate, while preserving a General Capability Average under a compact intervention footprint. The metric should not be read as judge-verified harmful compliance; it measures whether the response is classified as a refusal.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining research is indirect but nontrivial for routed models. The paper treats refusal behavior as something that can be distributed across residual representations and routed components. Broad direction edits may disturb general computation, while support-only expert edits may not be expressive enough. This framing is useful for studying how safety behavior interacts with MoE routing, expert specialization, and post-training edits, although the paper is not a pretraining method or data recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: LoMC, or Localized Multidirectional Correction, is a support-gated editing method. It first selects an edit support: the set of layers, experts, and component locations where intervention is allowed. The editable MoE components include a normalized gate/up interface and the moe.down_proj branch. The method then reloads the original checkpoint with the fixed support and aggregates several prototype correction directions into a layer-wise correction direction. The deployed edit is still a rank-one layer-wise correction and is applied only through the support mask. The design tries to improve the correction signal through multiple prototypes without expanding the structural footprint of the intervention.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers text-only and multimodal safety benchmarks and four routed backbones. The main metrics are TCR, GCA, intervention footprint, and benign-behavior drift diagnostics, including distributional change between the original and edited models. The reported result is an improved TCR-GCA trade-off under a compact footprint compared with broader direction edits and support-only alternatives. The ablations focus on support size and the number of prototype directions. The provided full-content excerpt does not include the numerical result tables, so exact gains should be checked in the experimental section of the paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient for most pretraining researchers. Spend about 20 to 30 minutes on the problem formulation, the TCR definition, and the two-stage method. The most useful parts are the support-then-correction execution order, the support mask definition over routed components, and the ablations on support size and prototype count. The benchmark-specific safety details can be skipped unless the reader is working on MoE alignment or model editing.

recommendation.zh: MoE后训练对齐的精细方案，对pretrain研究员的启示在于MoE的稀疏激活结构允许更精准的能力编辑，看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: A fine-grained MoE post-training alignment approach. Key takeaway for pretrain researchers: MoE's sparse activation structure enables more precise capability editing. Read the method section only.

paper.title: Adaptive Nucleus Truncation for Long-Form Reasoning
paper.abstract: Sampling plays an important role in long-form language-model reasoning. Over thousands of decoding steps, small changes in the candidate token set can compound into different reasoning trajectories, stability profiles, and final answers. Existing truncation methods such as top-$p$, min-$p$, and fixed top-$nσ$ sampling improve over unrestricted sampling, but they rely on fixed thresholds that cannot adapt to changes in entropy, task difficulty, training stage, or generation budget. We introduce A

summary.core_problem: 现有截断采样方法（top-p、min-p、fixed top-nσ）使用固定阈值，无法适应长程推理中熵、任务难度、训练阶段或生成本钱的动态变化。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次将 top-nσ 采样扩展为自适应 rollout 控制机制，在数千步解码中通过动态调整截断宽度稳定推理轨迹。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Adaptive Nucleus Truncation Sampling (ANTS)，在温度缩放前选取最大 logit 的标准化邻域，使用熵条件控制器自适应调整截断宽度，并保留无截断 fallback 分支以稳定训练。
summary.experiments: 在 33B 总参数 / 4B 激活参数的稀疏 MoE 推理模型上进行测试。摘要被截断，完整实验结果未呈现。
summary.authors_note: 单作者 Ousmane Amadou Dia，机构信息未在元数据中明确给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing truncation sampling methods (top-p, min-p, fixed top-nσ) use fixed thresholds that cannot adapt to changes in entropy, task difficulty, training stage, or generation budget over long decoding trajectories.
summary_en.importance: Methodological novelty: extends top-nσ sampling into an adaptive rollout-control mechanism for long-form generation, with an entropy-conditioned controller.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Adaptive Nucleus Truncation Sampling (ANTS), which selects standardized neighborhoods around the maximum logit before temperature scaling, adapts truncation width via an entropy-conditioned controller, and retains a no-truncation fallback arm.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on a 33B-total / 4B-active sparse MoE reasoning model. Abstract is truncated; full experimental results not available.
summary_en.authors_note: Single author Ousmane Amadou Dia; institutional affiliation not explicitly stated in metadata.

recommendation.zh: 摘要被截断，难以判断完整贡献；作者不熟悉，MoE 推理模型实验细节缺失。只看方法概念即可，不值得读正文。
recommendation.en: Abstract truncated, full contribution unclear; unknown author, MoE model experiment details missing. Skim method concept only, not worth reading in full.

paper.title: Redesign Mixture-of-Experts Routers with Manifold Power Iteration
paper.abstract: Router is the cornerstone component to the Mixture-of-Experts models. Serving as expert proxies, the rows of the router matrix compute their similarity to the MoE inputs to determine which subset of experts is activated. Ideally, each router row is designed to encode the expert matrix into this representative vector, such that its dot-product with token can better reflect token-expert affinity. However, there exists no design principles to enforce this condensation. In this paper, we propose to

summary.core_problem: 传统MoE的线性路由器缺乏显式约束让每行（专家代理向量）编码对应专家权重矩阵的核心特征，导致token-专家亲和度估计不准，拖累训练收敛、下游性能与负载均衡。
summary.importance: 为MoE路由器设计提供了线性代数层面的耦合原则，无需修改标准MoE接口即可提升大参数量MoE预训练的收敛速度与模型质量，对MoE预训练的组件优化有实用参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是将每个路由器行向量对齐到对应专家权重矩阵的主奇异方向（矩阵信息密度最高的压缩表示）；为避免全SVD的高成本，采用每训练步1次的在线幂迭代近似求解主奇异向量，再加流形回缩步骤正则化路由器权重L2范数以防止数值异常，形成“幂迭代+回缩”的MPI路由器；理论证明该更新等价于最小更新原则下的最陡上升优化，强制路由器行收敛到专家主奇异方向。
summary.experiments: 在最大11B参数的多规模MoE模型上开展数十亿token预训练，MPI路由器可稳定加快训练收敛、提升下游任务表现、改善负载均衡，且效果对模型特征变化鲁棒，收益完全来自路由器设计改进。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先看Introduction中路由器与专家耦合缺失的动机，再看Methodology中MPI的“幂迭代+回缩”核心流程与理论等价性证明，最后浏览实验中的收敛曲线与负载均衡指标，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional linear MoE routers lack explicit constraints to align each row (the expert proxy vector) with core features of the corresponding expert's weight matrix, leading to inaccurate token-expert affinity estimation that impairs training convergence, downstream performance, and load balancing.
summary_en.importance: It provides a linear-algebraic coupling principle for MoE router design, which improves convergence speed and model quality of large-scale MoE pretraining without modifying the standard MoE interface, offering practical reference for component optimization in MoE pretraining workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core design aligns each router row with the principal singular direction of the corresponding expert's weight matrix — the most information-dense compressed representation of a matrix. To avoid the prohibitive cost of full SVD, one step of online power iteration is applied per training step to approximate the principal singular vector, followed by a manifold retraction step that regularizes the L2 norm of router weights to prevent numerical explosion or collapse, forming the "Power-then-Retract" MPI router. Theoretical analysis confirms this update rule is equivalent to steepest ascent optimization under the minimal update principle, driving router rows to converge to the experts' principal singular directions.
summary_en.experiments: Pretraining runs cover MoE models of multiple scales (up to 11B parameters) with billions of tokens. MPI routers consistently accelerate training convergence, improve downstream task performance, and enhance load balancing. Gains are robust to shifts in model features and entirely attributed to the router redesign.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, first review the motivation about missing router-expert coupling in Introduction, then check the core power iteration + retraction pipeline and theoretical equivalence proof in Methodology, finally browse convergence curves and load balancing metrics in Experiments. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: router 终于不再只是黑盒打分器，这个视角值得看；先读方法动机和与标准 router 的 ablation，若收益只在小模上成立就当结构先验参考。
recommendation.en: It is worth reading because it stops treating the router as a pure black-box scorer; focus on the motivation and router ablations, and treat it as a structural prior unless the gains survive at scale.

institutions: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: Kwai Keye-VL-2.0 Technical Report
paper.abstract: We introduce Kwai Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B, an open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) multimodal foundation model designed to advance long-video understanding and agentic intelligence. To address the challenges of ultra-long contexts, information redundancy, and prohibitive computational costs inherent in hour-level videos, Keye-VL-2.0 is the first to adapt DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) to GQA-based multimodal architectures, enabling lossless 256K context processing while capturing critical frames an

summary.core_problem: 论文从短视频理解扩展到长视频理解和 Agent 能力时遇到两个核心瓶颈：(1) 小时级视频的 256K 超长上下文导致 KV cache 爆炸式增长和计算墙，现有模型被迫通过大幅帧采样牺牲时间连续性；(2) 多模态对齐与工具使用能力的联合训练会引发灾难性遗忘，导致基础 STEM / 数学 / 语言推理能力退化。
summary.importance: 这是首个将 DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) 适配到 GQA 多模态架构的工作，证明稀疏注意力可以无损处理 256K 视频上下文；提出的 Cross-Modal MOPD 蒸馏方案有效解决了多模态与基础推理能力的模态冲突。对长视频 VLM 预训练和多模态 MoE 具有参考价值。30B MoE 仅 3B 激活参数，部署效率高，是开源社区有竞争力的长视频 VLM 方案。
summary.technical_approach: 模型为 30B 参数 MoE 多模态基座（仅 3B 激活参数），基于 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking LLM + Keye-VL-1.5 ViT。核心创新两点：(1) Multimodal DSA：将 DeepSeek V3 的稀疏注意力扩展到视觉领域，与 GQA 兼容，结合全局 MQA 索引和分组 GQA 聚合，通过压缩和稀疏化视频特征聚合约束 KV cache 线性增长，实现 256K 无损上下文；(2) Cross-Modal MOPD（Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation）：采用多教师模型在策略滚动中对不同模态和任务的学生生成轨迹提供逐 token 稠密反馈，隔离任务特有知识再蒸馏回统一 MoE 骨干，避免端到端联合优化的不稳定性。后续进一步用 Context-RL 和 Video-RL（带桶优势缩放）稳定长序列决策树并减少视觉幻觉。训练基础设施包括可扩展视频 I/O、异构 ViT-LM 并行、定制 DSA 内核。
summary.experiments: 在 TimeLens benchmark（ActivityNet、QVHighlights、Charades）的细粒度时间定位上取得顶级成绩，在多个时间定位设置上显著超过 Gemini-3-Flash；在 Video-MME-v2 和 LongVideoBench 等超长上下文评测上表现出非线性能力提升，证明处理大量时序信息的鲁棒性。同时在 Code / Tool Use / Web Search 等原生 Agent 能力上大幅提升，而基础推理基线保持完好。
summary.reading_guide: 精读 Introduction 中关于 DSA 适配到视觉模态的动机分析（为什么标准注意力在长视频中失效）和 MOPD 解决灾难性遗忘的思路；Architecture 章节的 GQA-compatible DSA 设计细节（全局 MQA 索引 + 分组 GQA 聚合）是核心创新；Training 和 Post-training 章节的 MOPD 动态路由机制和 Context-RL / Video-RL 的桶优势缩放值得关注；图 1 的整体性能对比。大约 30-45 分钟精读技术核心。
summary.authors_note: 快手 Kuaishou Keye-VL 团队（Kwai），继 Keye-VL 和 Keye-VL-1.5 之后的迭代工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Two core bottlenecks emerge when scaling from short-video to long-video understanding and agentic capabilities: (1) 256K extreme context from hour-long videos causes catastrophic KV cache expansion and computational walls, forcing existing models to sacrifice temporal continuity via aggressive frame subsampling; (2) joint training of multimodal alignment and tool-use capabilities induces catastrophic forgetting, degrading foundational STEM, mathematical, and linguistic reasoning.
summary_en.importance: First work to adapt DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) to GQA-based multimodal architectures, demonstrating that sparse attention enables lossless 256K video context processing. The proposed Cross-Modal MOPD effectively resolves the modality conflict between multimodal skills and base reasoning. Valuable reference for long-video VLM pretraining and multimodal MoE design. With 30B total params and only 3B active, it offers strong deployment efficiency and is a competitive open-source long-video VLM.
summary_en.technical_approach: 30B-parameter MoE multimodal foundation (3B active), built on Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking LLM + Keye-VL-1.5 ViT. Two core innovations: (1) Multimodal DSA: extends DeepSeek V3 sparse attention to the visual domain, GQA-compatible, combining global MQA-based indexing with grouped GQA aggregation; compresses and sparsifies video feature aggregation to bound linear KV cache growth, enabling lossless 256K context. (2) Cross-Modal MOPD (Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation): uses specialized teacher models to provide dense token-level feedback on student-generated trajectories across modalities and tasks during on-policy rollouts; isolates task-specific expertise then distills it back into the unified MoE backbone, avoiding instability of end-to-end co-optimization. Post-training further applies Context-RL and Video-RL with bucket advantage scaling to stabilize long-sequence decision trees and reduce visual hallucinations. Infrastructure includes scalable video I/O, heterogeneous ViT-LM parallelism, and custom DSA kernels.
summary_en.experiments: Top-tier results on TimeLens benchmarks (ActivityNet, QVHighlights, Charades) for fine-grained temporal localization, substantially outperforming Gemini-3-Flash on several temporal grounding settings. Non-linear capability scale-up on Video-MME-v2 and LongVideoBench, demonstrating robustness for extensive temporal information. Simultaneously achieves large gains on native agent capabilities (Code, Tool Use, Web Search) while preserving general-purpose reasoning baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the Introduction for the motivation on why standard attention fails in long video and how MOPD addresses catastrophic forgetting. The Architecture section on GQA-compatible DSA design (global MQA indexing + grouped GQA aggregation) is the core innovation. Pay close attention to the MOPD dynamic routing mechanism and bucket advantage scaling in Context-RL / Video-RL under the Training and Post-training sections. Study Figure 1 for the overall performance landscape. Estimated 30-45 min for a deep technical read.
summary_en.authors_note: Kuaishou Keye-VL team (Kwai). Iterative work following Keye-VL and Keye-VL-1.5.

recommendation.zh: DSA 稀疏注意力适配到 GQA 多模态 + 256K 长视频 + MOPD 对齐这一组合值得立刻跟进，重点看 DSA kernel 与多教师 on-policy 蒸馏如何缓解遗忘。
recommendation.en: The combination of DSA sparse attention on GQA multimodal, 256K long-video support, and MOPD alignment is worth immediate follow-up—focus on the DSA kernel details and how multi-teacher on-policy distillation mitigates forgetting.

paper.title: From Observation to Intervention: A Causal Audit of Expert Importance in Mixture-of-Experts Models
paper.abstract: Interpretability methods routinely use population-level summary statistics over observed model behaviour to license claims about the effects of targeted interventions on specific computations; in Pearl's terms, they treat rung-1 associational evidence as if it supported rung-2 interventional conclusions, a move whose validity is rarely tested. We examine one concrete instance: the use of routing statistics in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) pruning, where utilization rates, activation norms, and routin

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章要解决的问题很明确：MoE 剪枝里常用的 expert importance 指标，究竟是在描述“看起来常被用到的专家”，还是在预测“把这个专家拿掉后模型会不会真的变”。现有文献大量使用 utilization、activation norm、routing weight 分布这类观测统计来排序专家，再据此剪枝并微调恢复能力。但这些指标属于关联层面的证据，默认它们能外推到干预层面，即预测某个 expert 被消融后的功能损失。作者直接检验这个假设，问的是一个因果问题：观测到的路由统计，能否预测 token 级别的 expert ablation 效应。
summary.importance: 对预训练和模型设计研究，这篇工作的价值很高，原因有两层。第一，它不是单纯做 interpretability 争论，而是直接打到了 MoE 训练后分析和压缩方法的一个常用前提：很多 pruning pipeline 之所以看起来有效，未必是因为它们真的找到了不重要的 expert，而可能只是因为高冗余层里删谁都差不多。这个结论会影响 MoE 的容量利用、冗余分析、专家 specialization 评估，以及后续的稀疏化和蒸馏策略。第二，它把“观测统计”和“可干预功能”之间的断裂讲得很清楚。对做训练动态、路由机制、专家分工的人，这意味着不能再把 population-level routing summary 当成 expert causal importance 的替代品。量级上，这不是一个小修小补的负结果，而是对一类方法学假设的系统审计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计很干净。作者选了三类高冗余 MoE 语言模型：OLMoE-1B-7B-0924、Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B、DeepSeek-V2-Lite，覆盖了当下 MoE 设计中的几个主要维度，包括不同的 load balancing 目标、不同 top-k 激活比例、从头训练与 dense upcycling、以及是否有 shared experts。然后在每个模型的五个代表层上，针对四个经典观测指标做审计：expert utilization rate、activation norm、active 时的平均 routing weight、activation standard deviation。这些指标都先在语料上按 expert 聚合，属于典型的 population-level summary。真正的因果测量则是 token-aware per-expert ablation：对某个 token t 上被激活的 expert i，把该 expert 输出置零，测量该 token 位置的 loss change ΔL_i^(t)=L_t^(-i)-L_t，以及 residual stream displacement，也就是 gap norm δ_i^(t)=||y_t-y_t^(-i)||_2。前者衡量功能重要性，后者衡量表征层面的扰动。为了排除“统计量没信号只是因为实验功效不够”，作者还做了一个更强的 control：不用 population 平均指标，而是直接用该 token 上的 routing weight g_i(x_t) 作为排序依据。这个量是 token-conditioned 的，等于给 routing-derived family 一个更有利的上界测试。整个设计的关键在于把比较单位固定在同一 token、同一层、同一 expert 激活事件上，从而真正检验 observational ranking 是否能预测 interventional effect。
summary.experiments: 主结果很硬：在三个模型、五个层位、四类观测指标组成的 60 个 metric-layer 组合上，没有任何一个达到 Bonferroni 校正后的显著性。效应量整体都很小，Cohen's d 全部低于 0.17，而且不同层之间连符号都不稳定。这说明 utilization、activation norm、平均 routing weight、activation std 这些常见指标，对 token 级 expert ablation 的功能影响几乎没有预测力。作者还用 routing weight control 证明这不是样本量不足导致的假阴性：在完全相同的实验 machinery 和 n 下，token-conditioned routing weight 至少在一个设置里能恢复显著信号。具体是 OLMoE 的最后一个 MoE 层，d=+0.231，p=0.0013；而且该层 expert ablation 引起的 residual stream 位移大约是早期层的 40 倍。Qwen 和 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 没有出现类似的后层集中效应。文章还做了 progressive ablation，结论是现有 pruning 方法之所以常能工作，更多是因为早层冗余高，导致大多数选择准则彼此可替代，而不是因为这些观测指标真的识别出了可删专家。这个解释很关键，因为它把“pruning 有效”与“importance metric 有效”拆开了。
summary.reading_guide: 精读时先抓住引言里的两个结论边界：一个是 general 的 observational null，另一个是 narrow 的 OLMoE late-layer token-conditioned effect。然后重点看 setup 部分对两个因变量的定义：loss change 和 gap norm 分别回答什么问题，它们为什么都要报。实验部分建议按顺序看三类内容。第一，看主表和显著性检验，确认四个观测指标在三模型五层上的系统性失效。第二，看 routing weight control，判断作者是否充分排除了统计功效不足。第三，看 progressive ablation，理解为什么很多剪枝工作在经验上仍然能成功。若要深挖，值得关注的是 OLMoE 最后 MoE 层为什么出现集中效应：可能和 shared experts、训练 recipe、负载均衡目标、或后层 specialization 程度有关，但文章很克制，没有过度归因。图表上优先看 metric-layer 相关性/效应量图、late-layer residual displacement 对比，以及 progressive ablation 曲线。对做 MoE 的人，这篇最好连附录一起看，因为实验控制和统计处理决定了结论是否站得住。
summary.authors_note: 文中可确认的模型与机构背景包括 AllenAI 的 OLMoE、阿里的 Qwen1.5-MoE、DeepSeek 的 DeepSeek-V2-Lite。论文作者与所属机构在给定内容中未完整列出，无法可靠确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise causal question in MoE pruning: do standard expert-importance statistics identify experts whose removal actually matters, or do they merely describe experts that appear active in observational data? The pruning literature commonly ranks experts by utilization, activation norm, or routing-weight summaries, removes the lowest-ranked ones, and then fine-tunes. That workflow assumes associational routing statistics can predict the effect of an intervention. This paper tests that assumption directly at the token level.
summary_en.importance: This matters well beyond interpretability rhetoric. For pretraining and model-design work, it challenges a widely used premise behind MoE compression and redundancy analysis. If pruning pipelines succeed mainly because early MoE layers are highly redundant, rather than because the ranking metric truly identifies dispensable experts, then many conclusions about expert specialization, capacity allocation, and routing quality need to be revisited. The paper is valuable because it separates two claims that are often conflated: pruning can work, yet the importance metric used to choose experts can still be causally invalid. That is a meaningful methodological correction for anyone studying MoE training dynamics or expert specialization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The audit is clean and well targeted. The authors study three high-redundancy MoE LMs: OLMoE-1B-7B-0924, Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B, and DeepSeek-V2-Lite. These models span major MoE design choices: different load-balancing objectives, different top-k activation ratios, scratch training versus dense upcycling, and the presence or absence of shared experts. At five representative layers per model, they evaluate four standard observational metrics: utilization rate, activation norm, mean routing weight when active, and activation standard deviation. These are corpus-level expert summaries. They then compare them against token-level interventional effects using router-aware ablation. For an expert active at token t, they zero that expert’s output and measure the resulting next-token loss change, ΔL_i^(t), as the functional-importance target. They also report residual-stream displacement, the gap norm, as a representation-level effect size. To rule out lack of statistical power, they add a stronger control: instead of using population-averaged routing summaries, they use the token-conditioned routing weight g_i(x_t) itself. This gives routing-derived signals their best possible chance. The key design choice is that the comparison is made on the same token, layer, and active-expert event, so the paper is genuinely testing whether observational rankings predict interventional consequences.
summary_en.experiments: The main result is a strong null. Across 60 metric-layer combinations—four observational metrics, five layers, three models—none reaches Bonferroni-corrected significance. Effect sizes remain small throughout, with Cohen’s d below 0.17, and even the sign is not stable across layers. In other words, standard observational metrics have essentially no predictive value for token-level expert ablation effects in these models. The routing-weight control shows this is not a power issue: under the same machinery and sample size, token-conditioned routing weight recovers one Bonferroni-significant effect. It appears only in OLMoE, at the final MoE layer, with d = +0.231 and p = 0.0013. In that setting, expert ablation moves the residual stream by roughly 40 times more than in early layers. Qwen and DeepSeek-V2-Lite do not show a comparable late-layer concentration. The progressive-ablation analysis is also important: it suggests many pruning methods work because early layers are redundant enough that many selection criteria are interchangeable, not because the metrics truly identify causally unimportant experts.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction carefully first, because it draws a useful boundary between two findings: a general observational null and a narrow late-layer effect in OLMoE under direct token conditioning. Then go to the setup and make sure the two targets are clear: loss change measures functional importance, while gap norm measures representational disturbance. In the experiments, focus on three pieces. First, the main significance and effect-size tables showing the failure of all four observational metrics across models and layers. Second, the routing-weight control, which is the paper’s answer to the obvious power objection. Third, the progressive-ablation results, which explain why pruning can still appear effective in practice. If you want to dig deeper, the most interesting open question is why OLMoE’s final MoE layer behaves differently. The paper is appropriately cautious there. For MoE researchers, this is worth reading closely, including the appendix, because the conclusion depends on careful intervention design and statistical treatment.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper explicitly studies models from AllenAI/OLMoE, Alibaba/Qwen, and DeepSeek. The full author list and affiliations are not recoverable from the provided text alone.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻对内部 MoE pruning 指标复现；若成立，utilization-based expert importance 基本只能当监控信号，不能当剪枝依据。
recommendation.en: This should be replicated on internal MoE pruning metrics; if it holds, utilization-based expert importance is only a monitoring signal, not a pruning criterion.

paper.title: Variational Proximal Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback via Proximal Policy Optimization often suffers from policy mode collapse, brittle exploration loops, and distribution drift. This paper introduces Variational Proximal Policy Optimization (\(\textsc{VP}_2\textsc{O}\)), a particle-based variational inference framework that maps policy optimization to Stein Variational Gradient Descent within a Mixture-of-Experts architecture. By leveraging functional kernels over localized expert prototypes alongside an

summary.core_problem: 解决RLHF中PPO算法普遍存在的策略模式崩溃、探索脆弱、分布漂移问题
summary.importance: 方法创新贡献，首次将粒子变分推理与PPO结合，改进RLHF的策略优化稳定性
summary.technical_approach: 提出VP2O框架，将策略优化映射为MoE架构下的Stein变分梯度下降，引入局部专家原型的泛函核和专家正交损失，替代固定裁剪和KL调度的近端约束
summary.experiments: 在33B/4B稀疏MoE模型上验证，Codeforces上ELO提升179，AIME数学推理任务token数减少32%

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the common problems of policy mode collapse, brittle exploration, and distribution drift in PPO for RLHF
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation contribution, the first framework combining particle variational inference with PPO to improve policy optimization stability in RLHF
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose VP2O framework, map policy optimization to Stein Variational Gradient Descent under MoE architecture, introduce functional kernels over local expert prototypes and expert orthogonalization loss to replace fixed clipping and KL schedules for proximal control
summary_en.experiments: Validated on 33B/4B sparse MoE models, achieving +179 ELO gain on Codeforces and 32% token reduction on AIME mathematical reasoning tasks

recommendation.zh: 用变分推理改进PPO的近端约束设计，在推理任务上收益明显，重点看§3的专家正交损失和泛函核设计即可
recommendation.en: Improves PPO's proximal constraint design with variational inference, showing clear gains on reasoning tasks; focus on §3 for expert orthogonalization loss and functional kernel design.

paper.title: Closure-Validated Circuit Discovery in Attention Heads: Co-activation Proposes, Ablation Disposes
paper.abstract: Interpretability increasingly treats groups of components, not individual units, as the basic object, and proposes to find them by clustering co-activation statistics. We ask whether such a cheap signal actually identifies an attention-head circuit. Adapting a sparse-autoencoder clustering recipe to attention heads -- but validating by causal ablation rather than reconstruction -- we cluster heads and then run a closure test: ablate the discovered community and compare per-example damage to matc

summary.core_problem: 解决“基于共激活聚类发现的 attention head 社区，是否真的对应可因果验证的功能电路”这个可解释性问题。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作，价值在于给廉价电路发现信号加上因果 closure 检验，并指出在 MoE 和训练过程中，表面上的结构信号可能与真实功能脱钩。对做训练动态、路由分析、可解释性评估的人有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把稀疏自编码器启发的聚类配方迁移到 attention heads：先按共激活统计聚类，再用因果消融做 closure test，比较消融整个社区与匹配随机对照在逐样本损失上的差异。进一步在 OLMoE 上做 route-conditional clustering，并沿训练过程跟踪 attention-target selectivity 与 participation ratio，检查这些代理指标是否真能反映功能。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个 1B 级稠密模型 Pythia-1B、OLMo-1B，以及一个 MoE 模型 OLMoE-1B-7B，并在两种输入分布上测试。结果是：稠密模型中的社区能通过 closure；MoE 中 route-conditional clustering 虽有统计信号，但不通过 closure，甚至消融后 loss 改善；跨训练阶段看，attention-target selectivity 和 participation ratio 都会与真实功能双向脱钩。这里的贡献不是刷指标，而是给出负结果和更干净的验证框架。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether attention-head communities discovered from co-activation statistics actually correspond to causally valid functional circuits.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism/interpretability paper with a useful methodological point: cheap circuit-discovery signals need causal closure tests. The negative results in MoE and across training are relevant if you analyze routing, training dynamics, or interpretability proxies.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper adapts a sparse-autoencoder-inspired clustering recipe to attention heads: cluster heads by co-activation, then validate with a closure test based on causal ablation, comparing per-example damage against matched-random controls. It further studies route-conditional clustering in OLMoE and tracks attention-target selectivity plus participation ratio over training.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses two dense 1B models, Pythia-1B and OLMo-1B, plus the MoE model OLMoE-1B-7B, across two input distributions. Dense-model communities pass closure. In the MoE model, route-conditional clustering yields a statistically real signal that fails closure, with ablation improving loss. Across training, attention-target selectivity and participation ratio decouple from function in both directions. The contribution is less about benchmark wins and more about a cleaner validation protocol and informative negative results.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改训练 recipe，但会改你看 interpretability proxy 的口径：先看 closure test 设计和 MoE 负结果，很多漂亮聚类图到这里就站不住了。
recommendation.en: It will not change your training recipe, but it should change how seriously you take interpretability proxies; read the closure test and the MoE negative result first.

paper.title: Value-and-Structure Alignment for Routing-Consistent Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts Models
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale foundation models efficiently by activating only a subset of experts for each token, but their large number of expert parameters still makes quantization essential for practical deployment.
