Pretraining follows a three-phase curriculum over roughly 10.6T tokens. The data mix shifts from broad web-heavy data to more curated code and math, with code ratio increasing from 23% to 42% to 59%. Batch size doubles across phases, and the final stage uses an extended capability-sharpening phase with linear decay of the learning rate to zero. The optimizer is Muon, training uses hybrid FP8 mixed precision, and the LR schedule is Warmup-Hold-Decay. The report frames this as a production-scale MoE recipe rather than a one-off experiment.

For long-context extension, the pretrained base is continued to 131,072 tokens using a layer-selective scaling recipe similar to Gemma 3 and OLMo 3, with YaRN for positional scaling. The report also mentions empirical observations on data-mixture transfer and MoE router dynamics during this stage. Post-training then branches into Instruct and Thinking variants, both further refined with RLVR on math and executable coding tasks.
summary_en.experiments:
The key configuration is 12B total parameters, 2.5B active parameters per token, 64 experts with 8 active, about 10.6T pretraining tokens, and a 128K context extension. The report claims throughput matching or exceeding Qwen2.5-7B on a single H100 while remaining competitive with open-weight models in the 4–14B range on code, math, reasoning, tool use, knowledge, and safety benchmarks.

The most informative experiments are the architecture ablations. One explicit result is that using 2 active experts gives about 1.5x lower latency than using 8 active experts, but quality drops enough that 8/64 is chosen as the better quality-latency trade-off. The report also states that under the same latency budget, MoE can scale total parameter count into roughly the 15B feasible region, whereas dense alternatives cannot deliver the same knowledge capacity.

Serving-oriented measurements are another important part. The report highlights KV-head count as the dominant factor for high-concurrency throughput, which makes the 4-KV-head design a systems-driven choice rather than a cosmetic tweak. If the full report includes throughput curves across concurrency regimes, those are worth close attention.

The training and long-context sections appear to contain observations on Muon+FP8 stability at MoE scale, as well as router behavior during 128K extension. Even without all numbers in the provided excerpt, these analyses are likely more useful than the headline benchmark scores. A careful reader should look for loss stability, load balancing, short-context regression after long-context extension, and ablations isolating the contribution of MTP to both training and inference.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in three passes: architecture choices, pretraining recipe, and long-context extension. Start with the architecture section and focus on three decisions: why dense was rejected, why MLA was not adopted, and why 8 active experts plus 4 KV heads became the final operating point. Then move to the pretraining section for the staged data mix, Muon+FP8 setup, LR schedule, and any explicit stability notes. Finally, read the long-context section for layer-selective scaling, YaRN, and any evidence of router drift or data-transfer effects.

For a quick assessment, the introduction, architecture summary tables, main ablation figures, training recipe tables, and inference benchmarks are enough in about 30–40 minutes. For a deeper read, prioritize the dual use of MTP, the exact SWA layer pattern, and the context-extension stage, since those are the most transferable engineering decisions.
summary_en.authors_note: JetBrains technical report for the Mellum 2 open-weight coding model line. The full author list is not visible in the provided excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 不是范式突破，但 recipe 很像认真做过取舍的工程稿；重点看多 token prediction 兼作 draft model、滑窗层配比和三阶段数据课程，适合拿来对照内部代码 MoE 设定。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but it looks like a carefully tuned engineering report; read it for the MTP-as-draft-model trick, sliding-window layer ratio, and the three-stage data curriculum.

paper.title: PithTrain: A Compact and Agent-Native MoE Training System
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become the dominant architecture for frontier language models. To meet this demand, production frameworks have built optimized MoE training stacks over years of engineering effort. Yet evolving these stacks for new architectures and system optimizations remains expensive. With the rise of AI coding agents, they could automate parts of training-framework development and accelerate this evolution. But applying them to these existing frameworks carries hidden costs, inv

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的不是新的 MoE 算法，而是一个训练系统设计问题：现有大规模 MoE 训练框架主要为人类工程师和吞吐优化，代码规模大、层次深、依赖大量隐式注册和编译扩展，导致 AI coding agent 很难高效理解、操作和扩展。作者把这类成本定义为 agent-task efficiency，简称 ATE，并提出一个问题：能不能从一开始就把训练框架设计成 agent-native，在不明显牺牲训练效率的前提下，显著降低 agent 完成真实训练系统任务的时间、token 消耗和试错成本。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接算法贡献不大，但对训练基础设施和研究迭代效率有现实意义。MoE 已经是主流基座架构之一，而训练框架的可修改性直接影响新并行策略、新路由器、新 kernel 接口、新监控信号能否快速落地。PithTrain 的启发不在于它比 Megatron 或 DeepSpeed 更全面，而在于它提出了一个新的优化目标：除了吞吐，还要考虑框架对 agent 的可读性、可追踪性和可扩展性。如果未来大量系统开发由 agent 参与，这个目标会变得实际。对研究团队而言，这篇工作提醒了一点：代码结构本身会改变实验迭代速度，而这已经不只是人类工程效率问题。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分成两部分：一是构建一个紧凑的、端到端的 MoE 训练框架 PithTrain；二是提出 ATE-Bench 来测量不同框架对 coding agent 的友好程度。

PithTrain 的设计围绕四条原则展开。第一，compact codebase。作者有意放弃生产框架那种广覆盖、多后端、多模型族支持，转而把问题收缩到一个紧凑的 MoE 训练栈，总代码量约 11K 行。这样做的目的不是省代码本身，而是降低 agent 的搜索空间和上下文负担。第二，Python-native。尽量减少 C++/CUDA 扩展链条，把关键逻辑保留在 Python 层，便于静态阅读、修改和调试。第三，no implicit indirection。避免 registry、plugin、动态分发等隐式跳转，让 agent 在一个 call site 上能直接看出实际执行路径。第四，task-specific agent skills。把训练系统里反复出现的任务，如 profile、插桩、配置修改、日志检查等，封装成 agent 可调用的技能，减少通用 agent 在复杂代码库里盲目探索。

ATE-Bench 的设计也比较清楚。现有 agent benchmark 通常固定代码库、比较 agent 能力；这里反过来，固定 agent，改变框架，任务则选真实训练系统工作负载，包括理解代码问答、运行与 profile、以及新增功能实现。这样可以把差异更多归因到框架设计，而不是 agent 本身。指标除了常见成功率，还看 Agent Turns、Output Tokens、Active GPU Time 等，更贴近真实开发成本。

与现有训练框架相比，PithTrain 不是追求功能覆盖，而是明确选择另一条 trade-off 曲线：牺牲一部分通用性，换取更低的 agent 操作成本。这个思路和传统“框架越大越全越好”不同，也和单纯做更强 coding agent 不同。它把问题从‘提升 agent 能力’转成‘降低环境复杂度’。
summary.experiments:
实验主要验证两件事：训练效率没有明显掉队，以及 agent-task efficiency 确实改善。

训练效率方面，作者在 NVIDIA H100 和 B200 上比较了 PithTrain 与生产级框架在一系列 MoE 模型和训练设置下的吞吐，结论是可以达到可比水平。正文可见的表述是“matches the throughput of production frameworks”，说明它至少在作者选取的配置上没有因为 Python-native 和紧凑设计而明显牺牲训练性能。这里需要注意，这种可比通常依赖具体模型规模、并行配置和 kernel 选择，不能自动外推到所有大规模生产场景。

ATE-Bench 方面，结果更具体。对于最难的新功能任务，固定同一个 coding agent 时，PithTrain 相比生产框架可减少最多 62% 的 Agent Turns，以及 64% 的 Active GPU Time；其他指标如 output tokens 等也有相近下降。这个结果说明 agent 在 PithTrain 上更少迷路、更少反复读无关代码，也更快完成闭环验证。论文还做了 skills ablation 和定性 case study，用来说明收益不只是来自代码量小，还来自显式技能和更直接的调用结构。

从研究者视角，最值得看的不是绝对百分比，而是 benchmark 任务构成和控制变量是否合理。比如：是否固定了 agent 版本、prompt、工具权限；任务是否覆盖真实训练框架开发中的高频操作；吞吐对比是否在相同并行策略和 kernel 条件下完成。这些决定了结论能否成立。
summary.reading_guide:
如果只想抓住主线，先看 Figure 1 和 Table 1。Figure 1 讲清楚了 PithTrain 的双目标：训练效率 + agent-task efficiency；Table 1 则把它和 Megatron-LM、DeepSpeed、TorchTitan 的设计差异压缩得很直观，尤其是代码量、Python-native 程度和隐式间接层。

然后看 ATE 的定义和 ATE-Bench 任务设计。这里是论文真正的新意所在。重点不是“agent 能不能写代码”，而是“什么样的框架结构会系统性降低 agent 成本”。读这部分时要特别注意作者如何控制 agent 变量，以及为什么选 Agent Turns、Output Tokens、Active GPU Time 这些指标。

接着看系统实现部分，尤其是作者如何在 11K 行代码里覆盖端到端 MoE 训练栈。这里值得关注的是哪些功能被刻意省略，哪些路径被保留为最小闭环。因为这决定了它到底是一个研究原型，还是一个可持续扩展的基础框架。

实验部分建议重点看 hardest new-feature tasks、skills ablation 和 case study。预计 30-45 分钟可以读完主干。若你关心团队内部训练框架重构，值得再花时间看附录里的 benchmark protocol 和任务定义；若你只关心预训练算法，这篇可以停留在泛读层面。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper is not about a new MoE algorithm. It addresses a training-systems question: current large-scale MoE frameworks are optimized for human engineers and throughput, but their size, indirection, and compiled-extension stacks make them costly for AI coding agents to understand, operate, and extend. The authors call this missing dimension agent-task efficiency (ATE). The central question is whether one can design an MoE training framework to be agent-native from the start, while still preserving competitive training throughput.
summary_en.importance: The direct impact on pretraining methodology is limited, but the systems implication is real. MoE is now a mainstream foundation-model architecture, and the speed at which researchers can modify routing, parallelism, kernels, instrumentation, and training recipes depends heavily on framework structure. The paper’s main contribution is to elevate a new optimization target: not just throughput, but also how readable, traceable, and extensible the framework is for coding agents. If agent-assisted systems work becomes common, this becomes a practical concern rather than a side note. For research teams, the broader lesson is that code structure itself can shape iteration speed.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two parts: building PithTrain, a compact end-to-end MoE training framework, and introducing ATE-Bench, a benchmark for measuring how framework design affects coding-agent efficiency.

PithTrain is organized around four design principles. First, compactness: instead of broad production-style coverage, it deliberately narrows scope to a compact MoE training stack, around 11K lines of code. The point is not minimalism for its own sake, but reducing the search space and context burden for agents. Second, Python-native implementation: the framework minimizes dependence on deep C++/CUDA extension chains so that key logic remains easy to inspect and modify. Third, no implicit indirection: it avoids registry-heavy or plugin-heavy composition, making execution paths easier to infer from local reading. Fourth, task-specific agent skills: recurring framework tasks such as profiling, instrumentation, config edits, and log inspection are exposed as reusable skills so the agent does less blind exploration.

ATE-Bench flips the usual benchmark setup. Instead of fixing a codebase and comparing agents, it fixes the agent and varies the framework. Tasks are drawn from realistic training-framework work: code understanding Q&A, operating and profiling runs, and implementing new features. Metrics include not only completion but also Agent Turns, Output Tokens, and Active GPU Time, which better reflect real development cost.

Relative to existing frameworks, PithTrain is not trying to win on breadth. It chooses a different point on the trade-off curve: less generality, lower agent cost. That is distinct both from the standard “bigger, more complete framework” philosophy and from the separate line of making coding agents themselves stronger.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments aim to establish two claims: PithTrain does not fall far behind on training efficiency, and it materially improves agent-task efficiency.

On training throughput, the paper compares PithTrain against production frameworks on NVIDIA H100 and B200 across a range of MoE models and training settings. The reported conclusion is throughput parity on the tested configurations. That matters because the framework’s Python-native and compact design could have introduced a systems penalty; the paper argues that, at least for the chosen setups, it does not. Still, such parity is configuration-dependent and should not be overgeneralized to every production-scale regime.

On ATE-Bench, the results are more concrete. For the hardest new-feature tasks, using the same coding agent, PithTrain reduces Agent Turns by up to 62% and Active GPU Time by 64% relative to production frameworks, with similar reductions on other cost metrics such as output tokens. The interpretation is that agents get lost less often, read less irrelevant code, and close the edit-run-verify loop faster. The paper also includes a skills ablation and a qualitative case study, which suggest that the gains come not only from smaller code size but also from explicit skills and more direct execution structure.

From a research perspective, the most important thing to inspect is not the headline percentages but the benchmark design: whether the agent, prompts, and tool permissions are controlled; whether the tasks reflect real training-framework work; and whether throughput comparisons use matched kernels and parallel settings.
summary_en.reading_guide:
If you only want the main idea, start with Figure 1 and Table 1. Figure 1 lays out the dual objective—training efficiency plus agent-task efficiency—while Table 1 makes the design differences versus Megatron-LM, DeepSpeed, and TorchTitan immediately visible, especially in code size, Python nativeness, and indirection.

Then read the ATE definition and the ATE-Bench setup carefully. That is where the paper is most original. The key question is not whether agents can code, but which framework properties systematically lower agent cost. Pay attention to how the paper controls the agent side and why it chooses metrics like Agent Turns, Output Tokens, and Active GPU Time.

Next, read the implementation section to understand what an 11K-line end-to-end MoE stack actually includes. The useful question here is what was intentionally omitted and what was preserved as the minimal closed loop. That determines whether PithTrain is merely a research prototype or a plausible extensible base.

In the experiments, prioritize the hardest new-feature tasks, the skills ablation, and the case study. A solid first pass should take 30–45 minutes. If you are considering framework refactoring for an internal training stack, spend extra time on the benchmark protocol and task definitions. If your focus is strictly pretraining algorithms, a skim is enough.

recommendation.zh: 不是在改 pretrain 算法，而是在改“研究迭代速度”的瓶颈；先看 ATE 定义和 benchmark 设计，吞吐结论先别全信，系统规模与任务覆盖要细查。
recommendation.en: This is less about a new pretraining recipe and more about changing the bottleneck of research iteration; read the ATE definition and benchmark design first, and treat throughput claims cautiously until the scale and task coverage are clear.

paper.title: Leveraging Routing Dynamics in Mixture-of-Experts Models for Efficient Language Adaptation
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are widely used to scale language models, yet their expert routing behavior and adaptation in a multilingual setting remain underexplored. In this work, we study multilingual routing dynamics during continual pre-training of an English-centric MoE model on a multilingual corpus, analyzing how expert usage varies across languages. We find that continual multilingual pre-training leads to diffused, language-agnostic routing in early and middle layers, with language

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理两个相连的问题。第一，英语主导预训练得到的 MoE 语言模型，在继续做平衡多语 continual pretraining 之后，expert routing 到底会不会形成稳定的语言分工，以及这种分工出现在哪些层。第二，如果这种分工确实存在，能否据此做低资源语言适配，只更新极少一部分 expert 而不是整模型。论文的关键点不只是“观察到语言专门化”，而是把 routing 动态、词表重叠、层间功能分化和参数高效适配连成了一条因果链：先分析 multilingual routing 的真实形态，再据此决定该更新哪些 expert。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。其一，它给 multilingual MoE 的内部组织提供了较清楚的经验图景：在 balanced multilingual continual pretraining 下，早中层 routing 更趋于扩散和语言无关，真正明显的语言专门化主要集中在后几层。这一点对“MoE 是否天然按语言切分”给出了更克制的答案。其二，它说明语言间 token/vocabulary overlap 会显著影响 expert 共享方式，这对 tokenizer 设计、跨语种数据配比、以及新语言接入策略都有直接启发。其三，它提出的 SSFT 说明 MoE 的模块化并不意味着只调 language-specific experts 就够了；共享 experts 同样承载跨语言迁移所需的公共能力。对 continual pretrain 和 parameter-efficient adaptation 来说，这比常见的“找专属模块单独调”更接近真实训练动力学。贡献量级偏中等，属于把机制分析转成可操作 recipe 的工作，而不是改写 MoE 基本范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两部分。第一部分是 routing dynamics 分析。作者以 OLMoE-Base 为底座，这是一个 decoder-only MoE LM，每层 64 个 experts、top-8 routing，原始预训练约 5T、以英语为主。随后在一个 35B token、7 种语言、相对平衡的多语语料上做 continual pretraining。分析时，他们在各层收集 held-out 文档的 post-softmax routing probabilities，比较不同语言在每层对 experts 的使用分布，并跟踪训练前后变化。论文关注的不是单个 token 被路由到哪个 expert，而是语言级别的 routing mass 分布、层间分化程度，以及不同语言之间 routing 相似性如何随训练演化。全文给出的结论是：继续多语训练后，早层和中层的 routing 变得更 diffuse，语言之间更共享；后层才出现更清楚的语言偏置。作者还把这种偏置与语言间词表重叠联系起来：共享 subword 越多，routing 越容易重合，说明 tokenizer 层面的耦合会传导到 expert specialization。

第二部分是基于上述观察设计参数高效适配。作者提出 SSFT，Selective and Shared Expert Finetuning。核心思想不是只更新某个目标语言最常用的“专属 experts”，而是在最后几层同时更新两类模块：一类是对目标语言 routing 质量较高、使用更集中的 language-specific experts；另一类是跨多语言普遍高频使用的 shared experts。这样做的理由很直接：如果后层同时承载语言特异信息和跨语言抽象，单调 language-specific experts 容易丢掉迁移所需的公共表征。SSFT 与几种自然基线形成对比：全参数微调、只调语言专属 experts、只调共享 experts、以及更常见的参数高效方法。论文的主张是，MoE 适配的关键不是“更新得越少越好”，而是“更新与 routing 结构匹配的那一小部分参数”。
summary.experiments:
实验底座是 OLMoE-Base，继续训练数据规模 35B tokens，覆盖 7 种语言。模型结构上每个 MoE 层 64 experts、top-8 选择。routing 分析显示，多语 continual pretraining 后，早层到中层的 expert 使用更分散、语言间更接近；显著语言专门化主要出现在最终几层。论文还报告语言间 routing 相似性与 token-level vocabulary overlap 有明显关系，这个结果很重要，因为它把“语言相近性”从抽象概念落到了 tokenizer 可观测统计上。

适配实验的核心结论是：只更新最后几层中少量 language-specific experts 效果不如同时加入 shared experts；SSFT 在更新参数占比低于 2% 的情况下，能取得最好的性能-效率折中，并且稳定优于只调 specialized experts 的方案。摘要里没有给出完整任务分数，全文主结果强调的是相对趋势而非单一 benchmark 的绝对值：混合更新策略 consistently better，且在低资源语言适配上接近更重的微调方式。阅读时建议重点看消融：1）不同层选择是否真的只在后层有效；2）shared experts 数量变化对性能的影响；3）language similarity / vocabulary overlap 与适配收益是否一致。如果这些消融成立，SSFT 的说服力主要来自“为什么必须同时调 shared + specialized”，而不是来自某个单点分数。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议控制在 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction，明确作者不是单纯做一个 PEFT 技巧，而是先做 routing 机制分析，再把分析转成适配策略。然后直接看第 3 节的 routing 结果，重点关注不同层的语言分化图、训练前后 routing entropy 或相似度变化，以及词表重叠和 routing 相似性的对应关系。这部分决定了后面的 SSFT 是否站得住。接着看第 4 节方法和消融，重点不是公式，而是 expert 选择规则：哪些 experts 被定义为 language-specific，哪些被定义为 shared，为什么只选 final layers。最后看 adaptation 主表，比较 SSFT、只调 specialized experts、以及更重微调方案的差距。若时间更少，只看三处：routing 层间分布图、vocabulary overlap 分析图、SSFT 主结果表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles two linked questions. First, when an English-centric MoE LM undergoes balanced multilingual continual pretraining, does expert routing become language-specialized, and if so, where in the network does that specialization actually emerge? Second, can those routing patterns be turned into a practical adaptation recipe for low-resource languages, so that only a tiny subset of experts needs updating? The interesting part is that the work does not stop at descriptive analysis. It tries to connect routing dynamics, vocabulary overlap, layerwise specialization, and parameter-efficient adaptation into one coherent story.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is moderate but real. It gives a more precise picture of multilingual MoE organization: early and middle layers remain largely diffuse and language-agnostic even after multilingual continual pretraining, while clearer language specialization appears mainly in the final layers. That matters because it pushes back against the simplistic view that MoE experts naturally partition by language throughout the stack. The paper also shows that token-level vocabulary overlap is a strong driver of routing similarity, which makes tokenizer design and multilingual data composition more central than they may appear. Finally, the adaptation result is useful: updating only language-specific experts is not enough; shared experts in late layers also carry transferable multilingual structure. For continual pretraining and PEFT on MoEs, that is a practical lesson grounded in observed training dynamics rather than heuristic module selection.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has two components. The first is a routing analysis built on OLMoE-Base, a decoder-only MoE model with 64 experts per MoE layer and top-8 routing, originally pretrained on roughly 5T mostly English tokens. The authors continue pretraining it on a balanced 35B-token multilingual corpus covering seven languages. They then collect post-softmax routing probabilities on held-out documents and analyze how routing mass is distributed across experts, layers, and languages. The focus is not merely which expert wins top-1 routing for a token, but how language-level routing distributions evolve, how similar those distributions are across languages, and where specialization concentrates in depth. The main empirical finding is that multilingual continual pretraining makes routing more diffuse and shared in early and middle layers, while language-specific structure emerges primarily in the final layers. They further relate routing similarity to token-level vocabulary overlap, suggesting that shared subword structure materially shapes expert sharing.

The second component is a parameter-efficient adaptation method, Selective and Shared Expert Finetuning (SSFT). The key design choice is to update both language-specific experts and shared experts in the final layers, rather than only the experts most associated with the target language. The rationale is straightforward: if late layers encode both language-specific behavior and cross-lingual abstractions, adapting only specialized experts leaves useful shared capacity untouched. SSFT is therefore a routing-informed adaptation strategy. Its real contribution is not a new optimization trick, but a better answer to the question of which MoE parameters should move during low-resource language adaptation.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental setup uses OLMoE-Base and a 35B-token multilingual continual pretraining corpus spanning seven languages. Architecturally, each MoE layer has 64 experts with top-8 routing. The routing analysis shows that after multilingual continual pretraining, expert usage in early and middle layers becomes more diffuse and more language-agnostic, while clear language specialization is concentrated in the final layers. Another important result is that routing similarity tracks token-level vocabulary overlap across languages, which ties multilingual MoE behavior back to tokenizer statistics rather than treating language relatedness as a purely abstract notion.

For adaptation, the main result is qualitative but consistent: finetuning only language-specific experts underperforms a hybrid strategy that also updates shared experts. SSFT achieves the best efficiency-performance trade-off while updating less than 2% of model parameters, and it consistently beats specialized-only expert tuning. The abstract and visible text emphasize the trend more than a single headline benchmark number. When reading the full results, the most informative parts are the ablations: whether final-layer selection is truly necessary, how many shared experts are needed, and whether gains correlate with language similarity or vocabulary overlap. Those details determine whether SSFT is a robust recipe or just a dataset-specific heuristic.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough to extract the main ideas. Start with the introduction to see that the paper is structured as analysis first, adaptation second. Then go straight to the routing section and inspect the layerwise plots: how routing entropy or concentration changes with multilingual continual pretraining, where language separation appears, and how routing similarity relates to vocabulary overlap. That section is the foundation of the whole paper. After that, read the SSFT method and the adaptation ablations, focusing on the expert selection rule rather than implementation details. The key question is why final-layer language-specific experts alone are insufficient, and why adding shared experts helps. If time is limited, prioritize three items: the layerwise routing figures, the vocabulary-overlap analysis, and the main adaptation table.

recommendation.zh: 只看路由分析部分就够了；末层语言专门化如果复现，会影响多语 MoE 继续训练的专家冻结策略。
recommendation.en: Read the routing analysis rather than the adaptation recipe; if final-layer language specialization holds up, it changes how multilingual MoE continual training should freeze experts.

paper.title: ConMoE: Expert-Pool Consolidation via Prototype Reassignment for MoE Compression
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models reduce per-token computation but still require storing and serving all experts, making deployment memory-intensive. Existing post-training compression methods mainly shrink this cost by pruning experts or merging their weights. We formulate post-training MoE compression as expert-pool consolidation: retaining a smaller set of pretrained experts as reusable prototypes and deterministically remapping each original expert reference to one selected prototype.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 MoE 部署里的一个很具体但常被混在一起的问题：稀疏激活降低了每 token 计算量，但并没有降低专家参数的存储和服务成本，因为整套 expert pool 仍然必须可寻址。作者把 post-training MoE 压缩重新表述为“expert-pool consolidation”：不是直接剪掉专家，或把多个专家做权重融合，而是在给定预算下保留一部分预训练专家作为 prototype，再把原始每个 expert slot 确定性地重映射到某个 prototype。这样把两个决策拆开了：一是保留哪些参数，二是原 router 看到的 expert 引用如何被表示。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身的直接影响有限，因为它不改变训练目标、路由学习或 MoE 扩展规律，主要是部署侧的后处理压缩方法。但它对 MoE 基座研究仍有两个启发。第一，它说明很多 expert 冗余并不需要通过再训练才能利用，单靠“保留+重映射”就能在一定压缩率下维持性能，这反过来提示预训练阶段可能存在较强的专家同质化。第二，它把“参数池”和“路由接口”解耦，这个视角对以后做可压缩 MoE、共享专家设计、局部跨层专家复用有参考价值。贡献量级更像是一个清晰的问题重述加一个稳健的 train-free 基线，而不是改变 MoE 训练范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是一个不训练的 prototype remapping 框架。作者先在单层或局部相邻层组成的 scope 内，把所有 routed experts 看成待压缩对象；给定压缩比例 rho，从原专家集合里选出一个较小的 prototype pool P，再为每个原始专家 e 指定一个映射 m(e) 到某个 prototype。压缩后的模型不改 router，不改 top-k 逻辑，也不改共享模块；只是当 router 选中原 expert slot 时，实际调用其对应 prototype。这样可以保持原有 router interface，不需要重新学习门控。

从 formulation 看，这接近一个带权代表点选择问题：每个原专家有重要性权重 w_e，每个原专家到候选 prototype 有表示代价 d(e,p)，目标是在预算约束下最小化总重映射代价。论文默认 prototype 必须来自已有 pretrained experts，而不是新合成专家；默认也不做权重更新或压缩后微调。作者把 post-hoc weight fusion 只作为诊断性分析，而不是主流程，这一点很重要，因为它让结果更能说明“纯重映射”本身的效果。

ConMoE 的设计还有两个边界条件。其一，允许 local cross-layer sharing，即相邻层在一个有限 scope 内共享 prototype，但不做全模型范围共享，原因是跨太远层的功能错配更严重。其二，预算可以在 scope 内非均匀分配，而不是每层硬性等比例压缩，这给了方法一定灵活性。论文的关键不在复杂算法，而在这个表示层面的拆分：压缩后逻辑上的 expert slot 数量不变，但物理存储的 prototype 数量减少；要真正拿到内存收益，需要 checkpoint 或 runtime 支持 prototype 共享去重。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段看，实验结论主要是定性的：在多个预训练 MoE 语言模型上，ConMoE 在匹配的 logical routed-expert budget 下，可以作为 pruning 和 merging 之外的可行替代；确定性重映射是最稳定的组成部分；更激进的跨层共享和事后权重融合则明显更依赖模型。论文还特别区分了“逻辑压缩”和“物理内存节省”：如果一个 prototype 被多个原 expert slot 复用，逻辑上只算一次，但实际节省内存要靠实现层支持。

由于提供的全文内容被截断，具体实验数字、模型规模、压缩比例下的困惑度或下游性能变化没有完整暴露，无法可靠复述。阅读时应重点核对：1）比较对象是否包含简单的 layer-wise pruning / merge baselines；2）不同 rho 下的 loss 或 benchmark 退化曲线；3）单层重映射与局部跨层共享的差异；4）prototype 选择准则和距离度量 d(e,p) 对结果的敏感性；5）是否在 Mixtral、DeepSeekMoE、Qwen-MoE、OLMoE 等不同架构上都保持一致趋势。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先看 Introduction 和 Problem Formulation，理解作者为什么坚持把“保留哪些专家”和“如何表示原 expert slot”拆开。再看方法部分里 prototype selection、reassignment cost、scope 设计这三块，判断它到底是一个新视角还是只是换名的聚类压缩。最后看实验表和消融，重点盯三件事：压缩率-性能曲线、跨层共享是否真的有益、weight fusion 为什么只适合作为诊断项。预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主线；如果你做 MoE serving 或可压缩架构设计，再花时间看实现假设和 logical/physical saving 的区别。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific deployment bottleneck in MoE models: sparse routing reduces per-token FLOPs, but not the storage and serving cost of the expert pool, since all experts must remain addressable. Instead of treating post-training compression as pruning or weight merging, the authors recast it as expert-pool consolidation: keep a smaller subset of pretrained experts as prototypes, then deterministically remap every original expert slot to one retained prototype. This separates two decisions that are usually entangled: which expert parameters are stored, and how the router-facing expert references are represented after compression.
summary_en.importance: Its direct impact on pretraining is modest, since it does not change the training objective, routing dynamics, or MoE scaling behavior. Still, it is relevant to foundation-model research for two reasons. First, it suggests that a nontrivial amount of expert redundancy can be exploited without retraining, which is indirect evidence that pretrained MoE experts may be more interchangeable than their parameter count suggests. Second, the paper cleanly decouples the parameter pool from the routing interface, a useful perspective for future work on compressible MoE design, expert sharing, and local cross-layer reuse. The contribution is best viewed as a strong train-free compression framing and baseline, not as a new MoE training paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ConMoE is a train-free prototype remapping framework. Within a layer or a bounded local scope of neighboring MoE layers, the routed experts are treated as the compressible object. Given a reduction ratio rho, the method selects a smaller prototype pool P from the original pretrained experts, then assigns each original expert e to a prototype m(e). The router is left unchanged: when it selects an original expert slot, execution is redirected to the assigned prototype. This preserves the original router interface and avoids relearning gating.

Formally, the setup resembles a weighted representative selection problem. Each original expert has an importance weight w_e, and each expert-prototype pair has a reassignment cost d(e,p). Under a budget on the number of retained prototypes, the goal is to minimize total weighted reassignment cost. In the default setting, prototypes must be existing pretrained experts rather than synthesized experts, and there is no post-compression finetuning. Post-hoc weight fusion is only used as a diagnostic sensitivity study, which is an important design choice because it isolates the effect of remapping itself.

Two design boundaries matter. First, the method allows local cross-layer sharing inside a bounded scope, but avoids model-wide sharing because distant layers are more likely to have incompatible expert functions. Second, the compression budget can be allocated non-uniformly across layers within a scope. The main novelty is not algorithmic complexity but the representational split: the logical set of router-visible expert slots stays intact, while the physically stored expert pool shrinks. Actual memory savings therefore depend on checkpoint or runtime support for deduplicated shared prototypes.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the main empirical claims are qualitative rather than fully numeric: across multiple pretrained MoE language models, ConMoE is a viable alternative to pruning and merging under matched logical routed-expert budgets; deterministic reassignment is the most stable component; broader cross-layer sharing and post-hoc weight fusion are more model-dependent. The paper also explicitly distinguishes logical compression from physical memory reduction: if one prototype serves multiple original expert slots, it only counts once logically, but real memory savings require implementation support.

Because the supplied content is truncated, the exact model sizes, compression ratios, perplexity changes, and downstream benchmark numbers are not fully available here. When reading the paper, the key checks are: whether the baselines include simple layer-wise pruning and merge methods; how performance degrades as rho increases; whether local cross-layer sharing helps consistently; how sensitive results are to the prototype selection rule and the distance metric d(e,p); and whether the trends hold across Mixtral-, DeepSeekMoE-, Qwen-MoE-, and OLMoE-style models.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the Introduction and Problem Formulation. The main value is the reframing: separating expert retention from router-facing representation. Then read the method section around prototype selection, reassignment cost, and scope design to see whether this is genuinely different from clustering-style compression. Finally, inspect the main tables and ablations with three questions in mind: the compression-performance curve, whether cross-layer sharing actually helps, and why weight fusion is treated as diagnostic rather than default. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. Spend more time only if you work on MoE serving or architecture design for compressibility.

recommendation.zh: 无需训练的MoE压缩是部署友好方向，ConMoE的原型重映射思路比简单剪枝更优雅。做MoE推理优化的团队应评估此方法。
recommendation.en: Train-free MoE compression is deployment-friendly; ConMoE's prototype remapping is more elegant than simple pruning. Teams doing MoE inference optimization should evaluate this approach.

paper.title: Laguna M.1/XS.2 Technical Report
paper.abstract: We present Laguna M.1 and Laguna XS.2, two Mixture-of-Experts foundation models built for long-horizon, agentic coding: M.1 has $225.8$B total parameters ($23.4$B activated per token) and XS.2 has $33.4$B total ($3$B activated). Both models were trained from scratch end-to-end inside the same internal system that we refer to as our Model Factory: a tightly-integrated stack of versioned data, training, evaluation, and inference components that turn model development into an industrial process. We

summary.core_problem: 如何高效、稳定地从头预训练并后训练具备强大 Agentic 编程能力的大规模 MoE 模型，同时解决长周期、多步骤任务的泛化问题。
summary.importance: 详细披露了 Poolside 训练 225B 和 33B MoE 模型的全流程技术细节，特别是其“Model Factory”工程化理念，展示了如何在 5 周内完成从头预训练到发布的极速迭代。这对于理解大规模 MoE 训练动态、数据配比以及工程基础设施建设具有极高的参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 架构：采用 MoE 架构（M.1 225B/激活23B，XS.2 33B/激活3B）。2. 数据：使用超过 30T token 的混合数据（Web、代码、合成数据），并进行了精细的去重和过滤。3. 训练基础设施：构建了“Model Factory”，将所有实验配置代码化，使用 Dagster 进行 DAG 任务编排，实现端到端的数据血缘追踪和自动化实验管理。4. 后训练：分为模仿学习和强化学习阶段，强调数据格式对训练稳定性的关键作用。5. 量化：采用混合精度量化策略（MoE 层 FP8/INT4/NVFP4，KV Cache FP8）以支持低显存部署。
summary.experiments: M.1 和 XS.2 在 SWE-bench 系列和 Terminal-Bench 2.0 等 Agentic 评测上表现出色。例如，M.1 在 SWE-bench Verified 上达到 79.6%，XS.2 达到 73.4%，均与同级别 SOTA 模型（如 Qwen3.5、DeepSeek-V4-Flash）相当甚至更优。
summary.reading_guide: 强烈建议精读 Section 2（Model Factory 理念，了解其工程化实践）、Section 3（预训练细节，特别是 MoE 训练的稳定性和数据混合策略）以及 Section 4（后训练配方）。这些部分包含了大量一线实战经验和踩坑记录。
summary.authors_note: Poolside 团队。该机构专注于构建具备软件工程能力的 AI 模型。

summary_en.core_problem: How to efficiently and stably pre-train and post-train large-scale MoE models from scratch with strong agentic coding capabilities, while addressing generalization in long-horizon, multi-step tasks.
summary_en.importance: Provides a detailed disclosure of the end-to-end technical details for training 225B and 33B MoE models by Poolside, particularly highlighting their 'Model Factory' engineering philosophy, demonstrating how to achieve rapid iteration from scratch to release in just 5 weeks. Highly valuable for understanding large-scale MoE training dynamics, data mixing, and engineering infrastructure.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Architecture: MoE architecture (M.1 225B/23B active, XS.2 33B/3B active). 2. Data: Trained on over 30T tokens of mixed data (web, code, synthetic) with meticulous deduplication and filtering. 3. Infrastructure: Built a 'Model Factory' where all experiment configurations are codified, using Dagster for DAG task orchestration, enabling end-to-end data lineage tracking and automated experiment management. 4. Post-training: Divided into imitation learning and reinforcement learning stages, emphasizing the critical role of data formatting in training stability. 5. Quantization: Adopted a mixed-precision quantization strategy (FP8/INT4/NVFP4 for MoE layers, FP8 for KV Cache) to support low-VRAM deployment.
summary_en.experiments: M.1 and XS.2 perform exceptionally well on agentic benchmarks like the SWE-bench suite and Terminal-Bench 2.0. For instance, M.1 achieves 79.6% on SWE-bench Verified, and XS.2 achieves 73.4%, both competitive with or superior to peer SOTA models (e.g., Qwen3.5, DeepSeek-V4-Flash).
summary_en.reading_guide: Highly recommend deep diving into Section 2 (Model Factory philosophy for engineering practices), Section 3 (Pre-training details, especially MoE training stability and data mixing strategies), and Section 4 (Post-training recipes). These sections contain extensive frontline practical experience and lessons learned.
summary_en.authors_note: Poolside team. The organization focuses on building AI models with software engineering capabilities.

recommendation.zh: 应读训练流程和数据/评测闭环部分；分数本身不是重点，3B activated MoE 做 agentic coding 的 setup 值得复现对照。
recommendation.en: Read the training pipeline and data-eval loop; the scores are secondary, but the 3B-activated MoE setup for agentic coding is worth benchmarking internally.

paper.title: Pruning and Distilling Mixture-of-Experts into Dense Language Models
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is now the dominant architecture for frontier language models, yet it requires all expert parameters to be loaded in memory, making it less preferable for memory-constrained deployment. Existing compression methods reduce the number of experts but the output remains an MoE model with the same fundamental limitation. We present the first systematic framework for converting a trained MoE into a standard fully dense architecture: experts are scored, selected, and grouped, t

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 MoE 模型部署里的一个结构性矛盾：MoE 每个 token 只激活少数 expert，所以活跃参数量低、训练和推理算力效率高；但部署时通常仍要把所有 expert 常驻显存，内存占用接近总参数量，而不是活跃参数量。已有压缩方法大多还是把大 MoE 压成小 MoE，问题没有根治。作者要回答的是：能不能把一个已经训练好的 MoE 系统性地转成标准 dense 架构，同时尽量保留 MoE 的能力，并且比从 dense teacher 出发做剪枝蒸馏更划算。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在模型族构建和 teacher 选择，而不是新预训练范式。MoE 已经是前沿大模型的主流架构之一，但实际产品常常还要配套发布小 dense 模型。传统做法要么单独训练 dense，要么先有一个大 dense teacher 再做 dense-to-dense 压缩，成本高，也没有利用好 MoE teacher 的知识结构。这篇文章给出了一条比较完整的 MoE-to-dense 路线，并且实验表明，在相同学生规模下，直接从 MoE teacher 蒸馏出来的 dense 学生优于 dense-to-dense 剪枝蒸馏。这一点很有现实意义：如果成立，未来模型家族不一定需要同时维护一条大 dense 主线和一条大 MoE 主线，MoE 旗舰模型本身就可以成为 dense 子模型的上游来源。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三步，逻辑很清楚。

第一步是 expert selection。对每层的 E 个 expert 打分，选出 top-K。这里 K 是转换时保留的 expert 数，k 是原 MoE 路由的 top-k 激活数，两者不同。作者系统比较了 7 种打分方法，结论是打分方法远比后续 grouping 更重要。论文最核心的新点是 diversity-aware scoring：不是只看某个 expert 被路由得多不多、激活强不强，而是同时考虑重要性和互补性。具体做法是构造 importance-weighted Gram matrix，用 log-determinant 做 D-optimal 选择准则，鼓励选出的 expert 既强又不冗余。文中最优方法叫 DO-ACP。

第二步是 grouping / merging / densification。若 K>k，就把选出的 expert 分成 k 组，在组内做加权平均；若 K=k，则直接保留，不做 merge。然后把得到的 k 个 expert 沿中间维拼接，形成一个标准 dense FFN。由于 MoE 的输出原本是 router 权重加权和，而 dense FFN 是直接拼接后统一下投影，作者还讨论了 down-projection scaling，用来校正输出幅值，避免转换后激活尺度失真。

第三步是 distillation。结构转换后会有能力损失，作者用 teacher MoE 对 dense 学生做知识蒸馏恢复性能。全文里一个重要设计点是，他们先用大规模网格搜索在较短蒸馏预算下找 recipe，再在更长蒸馏 token 数上验证最优配置是否仍然成立。这比只报单一 recipe 更扎实。

方法上最值得注意的判断有两个。其一，expert selection 比 grouping 更关键，说明 MoE 压缩里“选谁”比“怎么合”更决定上限。其二，最优配置往往是 pure pruning，即选出多样化 expert 后直接拼成 dense，而不是先合并再拼接。这意味着很多 MoE expert 之间并不是简单可平均的冗余副本；如果选得足够多样，merge 反而会抹掉专长。
summary.experiments:
实验设计相当完整。主实验基于 Qwen3-30B-A3B，系统评估了 7 种 expert scoring、5 种 grouping、2 种 down-projection scaling，以及不同 K 取值，总共 350 个配置。然后又在 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 和 GPT-OSS-20B 上做了验证。

最重要的结果有四个。

第一，scoring method 是主导因素。最好和最差的打分方法在平均下游准确率上相差 5.7 个百分点，而 grouping 策略的影响只有约 1 个点。这说明如果只在 merge 细节上做文章，而 selection 没做好，收益很有限。

第二，最佳 recipe 是 diversity-aware scoring 加 pure pruning。也就是用 DO-ACP 选出多样化 expert，且不做 weight averaging。相反，基于频率的打分更容易选到相似 expert，因此才会从 merging 中受益。这个结果很有解释力：merge 不是天然有用，它更多是在弥补 selection 的冗余。

第三，MoE-to-dense 明显优于 dense-to-dense pruning。在一个控制实验里，教师规模都在约 30B，学生都是约 3B，经过约 4B token 蒸馏后，MoE-to-dense 最优配置比 dense-to-dense pruning 高 6.3 个百分点，同时训练 wall-clock 快 1.6 倍。这个结果是全文最有分量的结论之一，因为它不只是证明“能转”，而是证明“从 MoE teacher 出发更合算”。

第四，作者先在约 0.3B token 蒸馏预算下筛 recipe，再在更长训练上验证优势仍然存在，说明结论不是短训偶然现象。摘要中没有展开所有 benchmark 名称和逐项分数，但从全文结构看，评测覆盖了多任务平均表现，而不是只看 perplexity。

需要补一句边界：这篇文章比较的是压缩路线，不是从头训练同规模 dense 学生的最优上限，也不是研究 MoE teacher 在预训练阶段为什么更适合蒸馏。因此它给出的更多是工程决策证据，而不是机制层面的最终解释。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议按“结论驱动”来读。

先看方法总览图和 Section 3 的转换流程，弄清楚 K 与 k 的区别，以及为什么 MoE 的 active parameter count 可以对应到 dense FFN 的中间维度。这个映射关系如果没看明白，后面的结果会显得像经验技巧。

然后重点看 expert scoring 部分。尤其是 diversity-aware 的 Gram log-det 目标，这是全文最有新意的地方。要关注它为什么能同时编码 importance 和 diversity，以及它和简单 activation frequency、router probability、weight norm 这类指标的差别。

接着看 Section 4.2 和 4.4 一类的主结果：350 个配置的比较、scoring 与 grouping 的相对影响、MoE-to-dense 对 dense-to-dense 的控制实验。这几部分决定这篇文章是否只是“又一个压缩 recipe”，还是在 teacher 选择上给出更强证据。

最后看 extended distillation 和 cross-model validation。若最优 recipe 只在短训或单模型上成立，价值会打折；作者专门补了这部分，值得确认。

预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。若时间更少，优先看 Figure 1、scoring 方法、主表格和 dense-to-dense 对比实验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a structural deployment issue of MoE language models. MoEs are compute-efficient because only a few experts are active per token, but they are still memory-heavy at inference because all experts must remain resident. Prior compression work mostly turns a large MoE into a smaller MoE, which preserves the same memory limitation. The central question here is whether a trained MoE can be systematically converted into a standard dense model while retaining as much capability as possible, and whether this route is better than starting from a dense teacher and doing dense-to-dense pruning/distillation.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for foundation-model research is in model-family construction and teacher choice rather than a new pretraining paradigm. Frontier labs increasingly train MoE flagships but still release smaller dense models for deployment. Those dense models are often trained separately or distilled from a large dense teacher, which is expensive and does not exploit the MoE teacher already available. This work presents a fairly complete MoE-to-dense pipeline and shows that, at matched student size, a dense student distilled from an MoE teacher can outperform a dense student obtained through dense-to-dense pruning. If that result holds broadly, it changes a practical design choice: a flagship MoE may be sufficient as the upstream source for both sparse and dense descendants.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three stages.

First is expert selection. For each layer, all E experts are scored and the top-K are retained. Here k is the original router top-k, while K is the number of experts selected for conversion. The paper evaluates seven scoring methods and finds that scoring dominates the final outcome. The main technical novelty is a diversity-aware criterion: instead of selecting experts only by frequency or activation strength, it jointly rewards importance and non-redundancy. Concretely, the authors build an importance-weighted Gram matrix and use a log-determinant objective, a D-optimal selection criterion, to favor experts that are both strong and diverse. Their best variant is called DO-ACP.

Second is grouping, merging, and densification. If K > k, the selected experts are assigned to k groups and merged within each group by score-weighted averaging; if K = k, they are copied directly without merging. The resulting k experts are then concatenated along the intermediate dimension to form a standard dense FFN. Because an MoE output is originally a router-weighted sum while a dense FFN uses a single down projection after concatenation, the paper also studies down-projection scaling to preserve output magnitude after conversion.

Third is knowledge distillation from the MoE teacher to recover quality lost in the structural conversion. A useful part of the experimental design is that the authors first search over recipes under a short distillation budget, then verify whether the best recipe remains best under longer distillation. That makes the conclusions more credible than a single hand-picked configuration.

Two takeaways stand out. First, expert selection matters much more than grouping, which means the upper bound is mostly determined by which experts are kept, not by how they are merged. Second, the best configuration is often pure pruning: select diverse experts and concatenate them directly, without averaging. That suggests many experts are specialized rather than trivially mergeable; averaging can erase useful specialization if selection is already good.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental study is broad. The main sweep is on Qwen3-30B-A3B, covering 7 expert-scoring methods, 5 grouping strategies, 2 down-projection scaling choices, and multiple K values, for a total of 350 configurations. The best findings are then validated on DeepSeek-V2-Lite and GPT-OSS-20B.

Four results matter most.

First, scoring is the dominant factor. The gap between the best and worst scoring methods is 5.7 percentage points in average downstream accuracy, while grouping contributes only about 1 point. That is a strong signal that selection quality is the real bottleneck.

Second, the best recipe is diversity-aware scoring plus pure pruning. In other words, DO-ACP selects a diverse set of experts and direct concatenation works better than weight averaging. Frequency-based scoring tends to pick redundant experts, so it benefits more from merging. This is an informative result: merging is not inherently helpful; it mainly compensates for poor selection.

Third, MoE-to-dense beats dense-to-dense pruning in a controlled comparison. With roughly matched teacher size (~30B) and student size (~3B), the best MoE-to-dense configuration outperforms dense-to-dense pruning by +6.3 points after about 4B distillation tokens, while being 1.6x faster in wall-clock training time. This is one of the strongest claims in the paper because it argues not just that conversion is possible, but that the MoE teacher is a better starting point.

Fourth, the recipe selected under a short distillation budget (~0.3B tokens) remains strong under extended distillation, and the trend transfers across three model families. The provided excerpt does not include every benchmark name and score, but the evaluation is clearly broader than a single perplexity comparison.

A boundary to keep in mind: the paper compares compression pipelines, not the absolute best dense student obtainable from scratch, and it does not fully explain why MoE teachers are better distillation sources at the representation level. The evidence is strong for engineering choice, less complete for mechanism.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good skim should be conclusion-driven.

Start with the overview figure and the conversion pipeline in the method section. Make sure the distinction between K and k is clear, and understand why the active parameter budget of an MoE maps naturally to the intermediate width of a dense FFN. Without that mapping, the rest can look like a collection of heuristics.

Then focus on expert scoring. The diversity-aware Gram log-det objective is the most novel part of the paper. Pay attention to why it captures both importance and diversity, and how it differs from simpler signals such as routing frequency, router probability, or weight magnitude.

Next, read the main comparison sections: the 350-configuration sweep, the relative impact of scoring versus grouping, and the controlled MoE-to-dense versus dense-to-dense experiment. Those sections determine whether the paper is merely another compression recipe or a stronger statement about teacher choice.

Finally, check the extended-distillation and cross-model validation results. If the best recipe only worked under short training or on one architecture, the practical value would be much weaker.

A useful skim takes 25–35 minutes. If time is limited, prioritize the overview figure, the scoring section, the main result tables, and the dense-to-dense comparison.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 方法，但如果你在想 MoE 是否真学到不可压缩的专家分工，只看打分消融和 matched-budget 对比就够，能直接指导内部 MoE→dense 备份线。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if you care whether MoE specialization is truly irreducible, read the scoring ablations and matched-budget comparisons; they directly inform any internal MoE-to-dense fallback path.

paper.title: Extracting Small Translation Specialists from LLMs by Aggressively Pruning Experts
paper.abstract: Modern large language models (LLMs) achieve state-of-the-art machine translation performance, but they do so as broad generalists largely trained for many tasks and capabilities unrelated to translation. Thus, they are heavily overparameterized for this task, resulting in excessive memory and compute requirements. In this paper, we present a method for aggressively pruning experts from modern mixture-of-experts LLMs while incurring negligible degradation in translation quality. Our approach expl

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 MoE LLM 在机器翻译场景中过度参数化的问题。通用 MoE 模型具备大量与翻译无关的能力，部署翻译服务时仍要携带完整专家集合，导致显存和计算成本过高。论文目标是在不重新训练或只做少量恢复训练的情况下，从通用 MoE LLM 中抽取小型翻译专用子网。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的价值主要在 MoE 专家专门化和能力可分解性。它说明某些语言能力可以通过专家路由统计定位，并以模块化方式裁剪。这对预训练阶段的 MoE 设计有反馈意义：如果能力在专家空间中可分离，训练时的路由正则、专家容量、语言/任务混合比例可能影响后续模型切片、专用化部署和持续训练成本。论文不是通用压缩方法的完整答案，因为实验聚焦翻译，但它给出了一个清晰的诊断工具：看任务在 MoE 专家上的 routing mass 分布。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很直接：用翻译校准集运行预训练 MoE 模型，记录每层每个专家的 router 权重，并按 token 求平均得到 routing mass，作为专家对翻译任务的重要性估计。论文也比较了 REAP 这类结合专家输出 L2 norm 与路由权重的更复杂指标。随后按层分配保留专家数，删除低重要性专家。由于 MoE 的 FFN 专家是模块化组件，删除专家不需要修改注意力层，也不需要从头训练。一个关键经验是中间层可以更激进地裁剪，而对首尾层更保守，这符合语言建模中早期表征和后期生成控制更敏感的常见观察。论文还区分多语言通用裁剪和特定语言方向裁剪：前者保留更宽的翻译能力，后者压缩更强但泛化风险更高。
summary.experiments: 实验主要使用 GPT-OSS-20B 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B。GPT-OSS-20B 每个 MoE 层有 32 个专家、每个 token 激活 4 个；Qwen3-30B-A3B 每层 128 个专家、激活 8 个。目标语言包括德语、日语、孟加拉语和埃及阿拉伯语，并在俄语、西班牙语、中文上测试未参与裁剪语言的泛化。校准集来自 FLoRes，评测使用 FLoRes devtest、WMT-24++ 以及若干领域数据集；主指标为 xCOMET-XL，并单独统计过度裁剪导致的生成或格式退化。结果显示，无需重训练即可裁剪约一半专家，翻译质量几乎不下降；在短时 supervised fine-tuning 恢复训练后，约 75% 压缩率下也能恢复到接近原模型的翻译水平。论文还发现简单 routing mass 已经很有效，说明 router 本身携带了较强的任务相关性信号。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25 到 35 分钟。优先看实验设置中模型规格、语言选择和评测指标，再看 pruning methodology 中 routing mass 的定义、校准数据构造和 layer-wise allocation。实验表格里重点看三个问题：无训练裁剪到 50% 时质量下降多少；75% 压缩后恢复训练能补回多少；语言方向专用裁剪和多语言裁剪在未见语言上的差异。若关心 MoE 预训练，可以重点看专家使用分布和中间层更可裁剪这一现象，它比具体翻译分数更有迁移价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses over-parameterization of MoE LLMs for machine translation. General-purpose MoE models carry many capabilities that are not needed for translation, yet deployment still requires storing and serving the full expert set. The goal is to extract compact translation specialists from pretrained MoE LLMs with no retraining, or with only a short recovery fine-tuning stage.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance for foundation-model research is its evidence on expert specialization and capability separability in MoE models. Translation ability appears to occupy a subset of experts that can be identified from routing statistics. This has implications for MoE pretraining: router behavior, expert capacity, task mixture, and language mixture may determine how easily capabilities can later be sliced, specialized, or continually trained. The result is task-specific, but the diagnostic idea is broadly useful: routing mass can expose which parts of an MoE model a capability relies on.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method runs a pretrained MoE model on translation calibration data and records router weights for every expert at every layer. These weights are averaged over tokens to produce routing mass, an importance score for each expert. The paper also compares a more complex alternative, REAP, which combines router weights with the L2 norm of expert outputs. Low-importance experts are then pruned, with a layer-wise allocation strategy for how many experts to keep. Because MoE FFN experts are modular, pruning can be done without changing attention blocks or retraining the whole model. A notable design choice is to prune middle layers more aggressively while keeping early and late layers more intact. The paper studies both multilingual pruning and language-direction-specific pruning, trading generality for compression.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use GPT-OSS-20B and Qwen3-30B-A3B. GPT-OSS-20B has 32 experts per MoE layer and activates 4 per token; Qwen3-30B-A3B has 128 experts per layer and activates 8. Target languages include German, Japanese, Bengali, and Egyptian Arabic, with Russian, Spanish, and Mandarin used as unseen languages for generalization checks. Calibration uses FLoRes, while evaluation covers FLoRes devtest, WMT-24++, and several domain-specific translation datasets. The main metric is xCOMET-XL, with degenerate generation or formatting failures counted separately. The key result is that around half of the experts can be removed with negligible translation degradation and no retraining. With short supervised recovery tuning, about 75% compression can be reached while recovering translation quality close to the original model. Simple routing mass is already competitive, suggesting that the router provides a strong task-relevance signal.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. Start with the experimental setup to understand the model sizes, expert configurations, languages, and metrics. Then read the pruning methodology for routing mass, calibration construction, and layer-wise expert allocation. In the results, focus on three comparisons: quality loss at 50% pruning without training, recovery after 75% compression, and multilingual versus language-direction-specific pruning on unseen languages. For MoE pretraining research, the most useful material is the expert-usage analysis and the observation that middle layers are more aggressively prunable than boundary layers.

recommendation.zh: 值得看，因为它直接碰 MoE 的一个硬问题：专家到底有多可分离；先看 pruning 准则和无重训结果，若 setup 干净，内部应复现。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it probes a hard MoE question—how separable experts really are; start with the pruning criterion and no-retraining results, and replicate internally if the setup is clean.

paper.title: Dense2MoE: Pushing the Pareto Frontier of On-Device LLMs via Unified Pruning and Upcycling
paper.abstract: The Mixture of Experts MoE architecture is highly promising for resource constrained on device deployments yet training these models from scratch incurs prohibitive costs Current methods attempt to alleviate this by upcycling dense models into MoEs however they often introduce parameter redundancy that degrades inference efficiency Alternatively standard layer pruning mitigates redundancy but inevitably compromises model accuracy To resolve this dilemma we propose Dense2MoE a novel framework tha

summary.core_problem: 端侧LLM部署面临推理效率与模型精度的固有权衡：从头训练MoE模型成本过高，现有稠密模型转MoE方案存在参数冗余，标准结构化剪枝会丢弃作为LLM知识核心的MLP模块导致精度损失，现有方案均无法有效突破推理内存墙约束。
summary.importance: 提供了复用预训练稠密模型生成高效端侧MoE的工业级可落地方案，大幅降低端侧大模型的部署和训练成本，其层间冗余分析、跨层参数复用的思路也为预训练阶段的架构设计、训练动态优化提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出统一剪枝与MoE升级的Dense2MoE框架，通过结合层间输出相似度与MLP输入特征匹配的双约束指标识别冗余解码器层，仅剪去冗余层的高带宽注意力模块，通过层融合升级（LF-UC）技术保留冗余层的预训练MLP作为异构专家集成到保留层中，仅需少量持续预训练即可完成架构适配，无额外推理延迟开销。
summary.experiments: 在MMLU、ARC、代码生成等9项基准上测试，在推理延迟-精度的帕累托前沿上优于稠密基线、现有压缩方法和标准MoE升级方案；适配0.5B到7B参数量范围，兼容Qwen2.5、LLaMA2等主流架构；仅需225B token的持续预训练，计算成本不足从头训练同规模MoE的1%。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读引言部分的现有方案缺陷分析、层融合升级的核心架构设计、帕累托优化相关的实验结果，预计阅读时间15分钟，不需要深入研究硬件Roofline建模细节。

summary_en.core_problem: On-device LLM deployment faces an inherent trade-off between inference efficiency and model accuracy. Training MoE models from scratch is prohibitively expensive, existing dense-to-MoE upcycling methods introduce parameter redundancy, and standard structured pruning discards MLP modules — the core knowledge repository of LLMs — leading to accuracy degradation, with no existing scheme effectively breaking the inference memory wall.
summary_en.importance: Provides a practical industrial-grade recipe for repurposing pre-trained dense LLMs into efficient MoE models, drastically reducing deployment and training costs for on-device large models. Its inter-layer redundancy analysis and cross-layer parameter reuse logic also offer insights for pre-training architecture design and training dynamic optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Dense2MoE framework that unifies structured pruning and MoE upcycling. It identifies redundant decoder layers via a dual-constraint metric combining layer-wise output similarity and MLP input feature matching. Only bandwidth-heavy attention modules of redundant layers are pruned; pre-trained MLPs from pruned layers are preserved and integrated as heterogeneous experts into retained layers via the Layer-Fusion Upcycling (LF-UC) technique. Only lightweight continual pre-training is required for architecture adaptation, with no additional inference latency overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across 9 benchmarks including MMLU, ARC, and code generation, it advances the Pareto frontier of inference latency vs accuracy over dense baselines, existing compression methods, and standard MoE upcycling schemes. It works across model scales from 0.5B to 7B parameters, and is compatible with Qwen2.5, LLaMA2 and other architectures. It only requires 225B tokens of continual pre-training, consuming less than 1% of the compute cost of training a comparable MoE from scratch.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize the analysis of limitations of existing solutions in the introduction, the core LF-UC architecture design, and experimental results on Pareto optimization. Estimated reading time is 15 minutes; no need to dive deep into hardware roofline modeling details.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和消融即可；若 numbers 干净，Dense→MoE 加剪 attention 是值得内部复现的端侧 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if the numbers are clean, dense-to-MoE plus attention pruning is worth reproducing as an on-device recipe.

paper.title: VEN-VL: A Visual Ensemble MoE Framework for Effective and Efficient Multi-Modal Understanding
paper.abstract: Despite the remarkable progress achieved by recent efficient methods in accelerating multimodal understanding, they still suffer from noticeable performance degradation. Their emphasis on the high compression ratio of a single visual clue and reliance on the heuristic pruning strategy with coarse attention alignment incurs a bottleneck on the information capacity and density of visual tokens. Addressing this limitation, we propose VEN-VL, a visual ensemble MoE framework for effective and efficie

summary.core_problem: 在多模态理解中减少视觉 token 计算，同时避免高压缩率和启发式剪枝带来的性能损失。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 推理效率与视觉 token 表示压缩方法。它关注一个预训练研究员也会遇到的问题：视觉信息不是均匀冗余的，粗糙剪枝会损害模型对细粒度视觉线索的使用。
summary.technical_approach: VEN-VL 采用“先丰富、再压缩”的 visual ensemble MoE 框架：先融合不同视角的视觉表示以提高信息容量，再用自适应 router 分配到专门的视觉 expert 中逐步压缩；同时加入显式视觉监督，让压缩后的结构保留原始视觉编码器的重建能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在多模态理解实验中取得更好的效率-效果折中，并优于现有效率方法；但当前摘要没有给出具体模型规模、训练数据、benchmark 名称或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets visual-token efficiency in multimodal understanding without the degradation caused by aggressive single-cue compression and heuristic pruning.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency and visual representation compression contribution for VLMs. The useful signal for pretraining researchers is that visual token redundancy is structured, and naive pruning can remove capacity needed for fine-grained perception.
summary_en.technical_approach: VEN-VL follows an enrich-then-compact design. It first ensembles visual representations from multiple perspectives, then uses adaptive routers and specialized visual experts to compact the representation. An explicit visual supervision term is added to preserve information from the vanilla visual pathway.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports better effectiveness-efficiency trade-offs over existing efficient multimodal methods, but the provided text does not expose model sizes, datasets, benchmarks, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 增量但方向对：只看 MoE router 怎样做视觉 token 压缩，别把结果当成预训练级结论。
recommendation.en: Incremental but on the right axis; read the router-based visual-token compaction design, not the headline gains.

paper.title: The MiniMax-M2 Series: Mini Activations Unleashing Max Real-World Intelligence
paper.abstract: We introduce the MiniMax-M2 series, a family of Mixture-of-Experts language models built around the principle that mini activations can unleash maximum real-world intelligence. The flagship M2 contains 229.9B total parameters with only 9.8B activated per token. Designed end-to-end for agentic deployment, the M2 series rests on three components: (i) agent-driven data pipelines producing large-scale, verifiable trajectories across agentic coding and agentic cowork, each grounded in an executable w

summary.core_problem: MiniMax-M2 系列试图解决一个很现实的问题：长上下文 agent 任务需要强模型能力，但线上训练和推理成本不能按稠密大模型的方式增长。论文把问题拆成两层：预训练阶段用低激活量 MoE 扩大容量，后训练阶段用可验证的长轨迹 RL 构建真实 agent 能力。
summary.importance: 这篇对基座研究的价值较高。它不是单一模型报告，而是把 MoE 架构、长上下文预训练、MTP 推测解码、agent 数据管线、RL 系统和生产部署约束放在同一个设计闭环里。最值得关注的是两个点。第一，229.9B 总参数但每 token 只激活 9.8B，说明小激活量 MoE 仍可承载强 agent 能力，前提是路由、专家粒度和训练系统足够稳定。第二，论文把 post-train 的 reward 可信度和轨迹执行环境放到核心位置，说明 base model 潜力能否释放，不只取决于预训练 loss，也取决于后续 RL 信号是否可验证、是否贴近真实任务。
summary.technical_approach: M2 是 62 层 decoder-only Transformer，总参数 229.9B，每 token 激活 9.8B。隐藏维度为 3072，词表大小 200,064，预训练 token 数为 29.2T，原生上下文长度 192K。注意力采用全层 full attention，而不是混合注意力；每层使用 GQA，48 个 query heads、8 个 key-value heads，并使用 RoPE。FFN 部分采用 MoE，包含 256 个细粒度专家，每 token 激活 8 个专家。细粒度专家提高了路由组合多样性，也降低单个专家负载波动。路由使用 sigmoid gating 和可学习的 expert-specific bias，以改善负载均衡，并减少对 auxiliary load-balancing loss 的依赖。预训练除 next-token prediction 外加入 MTP 模块；继续预训练时通过权重复制扩展该模块，使其在推理阶段可作为多步 speculative decoding 的 draft path。后训练部分围绕 agent-native RL 展开。数据管线覆盖 agentic coding、agentic cowork、reasoning 和 general knowledge，每个任务尽量配套静态或运行时环境、可验证 reward 或可信反馈。Forge 系统把 training、inference 和 agent scaffold 解耦，支持 white-box 和 API-only black-box agent 进入同一训练循环。系统侧用 windowed-FIFO 调度吸收长轨迹长度差异，用 prefix-tree merging 合并共享前缀，用推理 kernel 和部署栈协同降低 RL rollout 成本。M2.7 还展示了早期自我演化流程：模型可以 triage 失败训练、修改 agent scaffold，并在 ML engineering 任务上做多轮自改进评测。
summary.experiments: 关键数字集中在模型规模、训练规模和 agent benchmark。M2 预训练使用 29.2T tokens，模型为 229.9B 总参数、9.8B 激活参数、192K 原生上下文。M2.7 在 agentic coding 上达到 SWE-bench Pro 56.2、SWE-bench Multilingual 76.5、Multi-SWE-bench 52.7、Terminal-Bench 2.0 57.0。在 agentic cowork 上达到 MM Claw 62.7、BrowseComp 77.8、GDPval-AA 50.0、Toolathlon 46.3。在 reasoning 和 knowledge 上，AIME 2026 为 94.2，GPQA-Diamond 为 89.8。论文还强调 M2 到 M2.5 再到 M2.7 的系列内增益，说明能力提升主要来自 agent 数据、reward 质量、RL 系统和自我改进流程的共同迭代。给定内容中没有展开所有架构消融的具体表格数字，但明确提到细粒度专家、sigmoid gating、full attention 和 MTP 都经过设计空间比较；这些消融应是精读时的重点。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看第 2 节预训练架构，重点关注 MoE 颗粒度、sigmoid gating、expert bias、full attention 取舍、MTP 如何同时服务训练和推理。再看 agent 数据管线和 Forge 系统部分，重点是 reward 如何定义、轨迹如何执行验证、长轨迹 RL 如何调度，以及 training-inference-agent 解耦带来的工程边界。最后看第 8 节 benchmark 和 M2/M2.5/M2.7 的系列内对比，不要只看最终分数，要看哪些能力来自 base architecture，哪些来自 RL-time scaling。值得深挖的点包括：9.8B 激活量下的专家容量是否足以覆盖长上下文 agent 任务；192K full attention 的训练和推理成本如何被系统吸收；MTP 作为预训练辅助目标和 speculative decoding draft path 是否存在目标不一致；可验证 reward 在 coding 与 cowork 任务中的质量差异。
summary.authors_note: MiniMax；给定内容未提供完整作者列表。背景上，这是一篇模型系列技术报告，覆盖预训练架构、长上下文 MoE、agent 数据、RL 系统和部署相关优化。

summary_en.core_problem: The MiniMax-M2 series addresses a practical scaling problem: long-horizon agentic workloads require strong model capability, but training and serving costs cannot grow like dense frontier models. The solution is split into two layers: use low-activation MoE pretraining to increase capacity under a small per-token compute budget, then use verifiable long-trajectory RL to build real agentic behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is highly relevant for foundation-model researchers because it connects architecture, pretraining scale, long context, MTP-based speculative decoding, agent data construction, RL infrastructure, and deployment constraints in one system. Two points matter most. First, a 229.9B-parameter model with only 9.8B activated parameters per token can still support strong agentic performance, if expert granularity, routing, and training stability are handled carefully. Second, the report treats reward credibility and executable environments as central ingredients, showing that the value of a base model is strongly mediated by the quality of post-training signals, not only by pretraining loss.
summary_en.technical_approach: M2 is a 62-layer decoder-only Transformer with 229.9B total parameters and 9.8B activated parameters per token. It uses a hidden size of 3,072, a vocabulary of 200,064 tokens, 29.2T pretraining tokens, and a native 192K context length. Attention is full attention in all layers rather than a hybrid pattern. It uses GQA with 48 query heads and 8 key-value heads, together with RoPE. The feed-forward blocks are MoE layers with 256 fine-grained experts and 8 activated experts per token. The fine-grained design increases routing combinatorics and reduces utilization variance. Routing uses sigmoid gating plus learnable expert-specific biases, improving load balance while reducing dependence on auxiliary load-balancing losses. The pretraining objective includes standard next-token prediction plus an MTP module. During continued pretraining, the MTP module is expanded through weight copying and later reused as a multi-step speculative-decoding draft path. The post-training stack is agent-native. Data pipelines cover agentic coding, agentic cowork, reasoning, and general knowledge, with static or runtime environments, verifiable rewards, or credible feedback. Forge decouples training, inference, and the agent scaffold, and supports both white-box and API-only black-box agents in one loop. It uses windowed-FIFO scheduling to handle trajectory-length variance, prefix-tree merging to share common prefixes, and inference kernels aligned with the serving stack to reduce rollout cost. M2.7 also shows an early self-evolution setup, where the model triages failed training runs, edits its own agent scaffold, and is evaluated through multi-round self-improvement on ML-engineering tasks.
summary_en.experiments: The key reported numbers include 29.2T pretraining tokens, 229.9B total parameters, 9.8B activated parameters, and a 192K native context window. On agentic coding, M2.7 scores 56.2 on SWE-bench Pro, 76.5 on SWE-bench Multilingual, 52.7 on Multi-SWE-bench, and 57.0 on Terminal-Bench 2.0. On agentic cowork, it reaches 62.7 on MM Claw, 77.8 on BrowseComp, 50.0 on GDPval-AA, and 46.3 on Toolathlon. On reasoning and knowledge, it reports 94.2 on AIME 2026 and 89.8 on GPQA-Diamond. The report emphasizes within-series progress from M2 to M2.5 to M2.7, attributing the gains to co-evolution of agent data, reward quality, RL infrastructure, and self-improvement. The provided content does not expose all ablation numbers, but it clearly identifies fine-grained experts, sigmoid gating, full attention, and MTP as design choices benchmarked against alternatives.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read closely. Start with the pretraining architecture section, especially expert granularity, sigmoid gating, expert bias, the choice of full attention, and the dual role of MTP in training and inference. Then read the agent data and Forge sections, focusing on reward definition, executable verification, long-trajectory scheduling, and the engineering boundary created by decoupling training, inference, and the agent. Finally, read the benchmark section and the M2/M2.5/M2.7 progression. The most useful questions are: how far 9.8B activated parameters can go for long-context agentic workloads; how the system absorbs the cost of 192K full attention; whether MTP as an auxiliary pretraining objective aligns cleanly with its use as a speculative draft path; and how reward reliability differs between coding and cowork tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: MiniMax; the provided content does not include the full author list. The work is a model-series technical report spanning pretraining architecture, long-context MoE, agent data pipelines, RL systems, and deployment-oriented optimization.

recommendation.zh: 这类报告会直接影响你对 pretrain↔RL 接口的设计：先看数据验证链路和 Forge 调度，指标先别太信，recipe 比分数更值钱。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on the pretrain↔RL interface: read the verifiable data pipeline and Forge scheduling first; trust the recipe more than the headline scores.

paper.title: Hy-MT2: A Family of Fast, Efficient and Powerful Multilingual Translation Models in the Wild
paper.abstract: Hy-MT2 is a family of fast-thinking multilingual translation models designed for complex real-world scenarios. It includes three model sizes: 1.8B, 7B, and 30B-A3B (MoE), all of which support translation among 33 languages and effectively follow translation instructions in multiple languages. For on-device deployment, with AngelSlim 1.25-bit extreme quantization, the 1.8B model requires only 440 MB of storage and improves inference speed by 1.5x. Multi-dimensional evaluations show that Hy-MT2 de

summary.core_problem: 面向真实业务场景，构建一个支持 33 种语言、能跟随翻译指令且便于端侧部署的多语翻译模型族。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是工程型模型发布和部署优化，不是通用 LLM 预训练方法；对预训练研究员的价值在于观察专用翻译模型、多语数据覆盖、MoE 规模和极低比特量化之间的取舍。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 1.8B、7B 和 30B-A3B MoE 三个规模的 Hy-MT2 系列，并使用 AngelSlim 1.25-bit 极端量化压缩 1.8B 模型，用于端侧存储和推理加速。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖通用翻译、真实业务、领域翻译和多语指令跟随。摘要称 7B 和 30B 模型在 fast-thinking 模式下超过 DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Kimi K2.6 等开源模型，1.8B 量化后仅 440 MB、推理速度提升 1.5x，并在整体翻译评测中超过 Microsoft、Doubao 等商业 API。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds a multilingual translation model family that supports 33 languages, follows translation instructions, and targets real-world and on-device deployment.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an engineering model release and deployment recipe rather than a general LLM pretraining method. Its relevance is in the trade-off between specialized multilingual translation capability, MoE scaling, and ultra-low-bit quantization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Hy-MT2 includes 1.8B, 7B, and 30B-A3B MoE variants. The 1.8B model is compressed with AngelSlim 1.25-bit quantization for storage reduction and faster inference on device.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans general translation, real-world business cases, domain translation, and multilingual instruction-following translation. The abstract reports that the 7B and 30B variants outperform open-source systems such as DeepSeek-V4-Pro and Kimi K2.6 in fast-thinking mode, while the 1.8B model uses 440 MB after quantization, runs 1.5x faster, and is claimed to beat commercial APIs such as Microsoft and Doubao overall.

recommendation.zh: 翻译专模加极低比特量化的工程包，预训练启发有限；只看量化和多语评测设置，别把榜单当通用能力信号。
recommendation.en: This is a specialized MT-plus-quantization package; skim the quantization and multilingual eval setup, but do not treat the leaderboard claims as general LLM evidence.

paper.title: Diagnosing Overhead in Dispatch Operations: Cross-architecture Observatory
paper.abstract: AlltoAll dispatch is the dominant bottleneck of MoE expert parallelism, and the interconnect community has responded with four families of mitigations: predictive sample placement, adaptive expert relayout, hierarchical collectives, and EP-aware topology. All four rest on two assumptions about the workload. The first is that routing imbalance is correctable by the system layer. The second is that the mock-token benchmarks evaluating them faithfully represent production routing. We introduce DODO

summary.core_problem: MoE 训练中 AlltoAll 调度开销占据前向传播约一半时间，现有四类系统级优化（预测性样本放置、自适应 expert 重排、层次化 collectives、EP 感知拓扑）都基于两个未被检验的假设：(A) 路由不平衡可以通过系统层纠正；(B) mock-token 基准测试能忠实代表生产环境的路由行为。论文通过跨架构实证测量检验这两个假设。
summary.importance: 这是 MoE 系统优化方向的一项基础性实证研究。其发现直接挑战了当前大部分 MoE 调度优化论文的评估方法论和基本假设。对预训练研究的具体影响：(1) EP 扩缩不是解决路由不平衡的杠杆——改变专家在哪些 rank 上，不改变模型把 token 发给哪些专家；(2) mock 数据系统性高估路由不平衡，且差距随 batch size 扩大——这意味着大量基于 synthetic data 的系统论文结论需要重新审视；(3) 架构类型（attention/sequence mixer 设计）对路由模式有决定性影响，可分为 data-resilient（MHA, Mamba-2）和 persistently concentrated（MLA, GDN）两大类，系统设计应基于此分类而非单一工作负载模型。
summary.technical_approach: 构建了 DODOCO（Dispatch Overhead Diagnostics Observatory）测量框架，在 5×6 因子实验设计中测试 5 种 MoE 架构 × 6 种数据条件，配合 EP 从 4 到 32 ranks 的受控扫描和 global batch size 扫描。在 4 节点 H100（NVLink 节点内，InfiniBand 节点间）上运行。5 个 checkpoint 均使用官方发布的路由配置：DeepSeek-V2-Lite (MLA)、DeepSeek-MoE-16B (MHA)、Qwen3-30B (GQA)、Nemotron-30B (Mamba-2)、Qwen3.5-35B (GDN)。其中 MLA 和 MHA 共享相同 MoE 配置（64 expert, top-6, 相同 gating/LB），仅 attention 不同，构成控制变量对。
summary.experiments: 关键发现：(Q1) EP 从 16 倍增到 32，per-expert max/mean token ratio 基本不变——MLA 变化 5.0%，MHA 2.8%，GDN 0.3%，Mamba-2 4.4%，GQA 4.4%，均≤5%，且无单调趋势。EP 缩放改变的是 expert 的物理位置，不是路由偏好本身。(Q2) mock token 在小 batch 时高估 routing Gini 达 2.35 倍，差距随 batch size 扩大而增大（mock Gini 随 GBS 上升，真实数据 Gini 基本平坦）；用 Dirichlet α 衡量时 Nemotron 上 mock-to-real 差距达 47 倍。(Q3) 架构间差异显著：MHA 和 Mamba-2 在真实文本下 per-rank Gini 最低（0.105 和 0.150），属于 data-resilient；MLA 和 GDN 即使在最好真实数据下 Gini 仍高于 0.24，mock 时升至 0.29-0.38，属于 persistently concentrated；GQA 居中。per-layer 视角进一步显示：data-resilient 架构在每层 MoE block 开始时接近均匀，随深度逐渐集中；persistent 架构从第一层就集中。
summary.reading_guide: 精读建议：(1) 第 1 节的三个研究问题和两个假设，理解研究框架；(2) 第 III 节实验设计，注意 5×6 因子设计和控制变量选择（MLA/MHA 受控对）；(3) 第 IV 节三个问题的结果图表，重点关注 Fig.2（EP 缩放效果）、Fig.3（mock vs real 对比）、Fig.4（架构间对比）和 Fig.6（per-layer 演化）；(4) 第 V 节的两类架构分类论是全文结论的升华。核心创新在于：这是第一个系统性检验 MoE 社区两个基本假设的实证研究，方法本身简单（测量而非算法创新），但发现具有范式冲击性。值得深挖的点：MLA（DeepSeek 的核心创新）为什么属于 persistently concentrated 类？这对端到端训练效率的实际影响是什么？
summary.authors_note: 论文作者及机构信息未在提供的全文中标注。从内容和研究风格看，这是一篇系统性基础设施测量论文，可能来自大学或研究机构的系统组。

summary_en.core_problem: AlltoAll dispatch overhead consumes roughly half the forward-pass time in MoE training. Four families of system-level mitigations (predictive sample placement, adaptive expert relayout, hierarchical collectives, EP-aware topology) all rest on two untested assumptions: (A) routing imbalance is correctable by the system layer; (B) mock-token benchmarks faithfully represent production routing behavior. This paper empirically tests both assumptions via cross-architecture measurements.
summary_en.importance: This is a foundational empirical study in MoE system optimization. Its findings directly challenge the evaluation methodology and basic assumptions of most current MoE scheduling optimization papers. Concrete impacts on pretrain research: (1) EP scaling is not a lever for routing balance—changing which rank holds which expert does not change which experts the model routes tokens to; (2) mock data systematically overestimates routing imbalance, with the gap growing with batch size—meaning conclusions of many systems papers based on synthetic data need re-examination; (3) architecture type (attention/sequence mixer design) has a decisive effect on routing patterns, falling into two categories: data-resilient (MHA, Mamba-2) and persistently concentrated (MLA, GDN). System design should be based on this taxonomy rather than a single workload model.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built DODOCO (Dispatch Overhead Diagnostics Observatory) measurement framework, testing 5 MoE architectures × 6 data conditions in a 5×6 factorial design, plus controlled EP scans from 4 to 32 ranks and global batch size sweeps. Ran on 4 H100 nodes (NVLink intra-node, InfiniBand inter-node). All 5 checkpoints use their officially released routing configurations: DeepSeek-V2-Lite (MLA), DeepSeek-MoE-16B (MHA), Qwen3-30B (GQA), Nemotron-30B (Mamba-2), Qwen3.5-35B (GDN). MLA and MHA share identical MoE configurations (64 experts, top-6, same gating/LB), differing only in attention mechanism, forming a controlled pair.
summary_en.experiments: Key findings: (Q1) Doubling EP from 16 to 32 leaves per-expert max/mean token ratio essentially flat—MLA varies 5.0%, MHA 2.8%, GDN 0.3%, Mamba-2 4.4%, GQA 4.4%, all ≤5% with no monotonic trend. EP scaling changes expert physical location, not routing preference itself. (Q2) Mock tokens overestimate routing Gini by up to 2.35× at small probe batches, and the gap grows with batch size (mock Gini drifts upward with GBS while real-data Gini is flat); measured by fitted Dirichlet α, the mock-to-real gap reaches 47× on Nemotron. (Q3) Inter-architecture differences are sharp: MHA and Mamba-2 achieve the lowest per-rank Gini under real text (0.105 and 0.150) → data-resilient; MLA and GDN stay above 0.24 even on best real data, rising to 0.29–0.38 on mock → persistently concentrated; GQA is intermediate. Per-layer view reveals: data-resilient architectures start near-uniform at each MoE block and concentrate with depth, while persistent architectures are concentrated from the first layer.
summary_en.reading_guide: Close reading guidance: (1) Section I: the three research questions and two assumptions—understand the framework; (2) Section III: experimental design, note the 5×6 factorial design and controlled variable selection (MLA/MHA controlled pair); (3) Section IV: result figures for all three questions—focus on Fig.2 (EP scaling effect), Fig.3 (mock vs real comparison), Fig.4 (cross-architecture comparison), and Fig.6 (per-layer evolution); (4) Section V: the two-class taxonomy is the paper's culminating conclusion. The core innovation is that this is the first systematic empirical study testing two fundamental assumptions in the MoE community—the methodology is simple (measurement, not algorithmic innovation), but the findings carry paradigm-shifting implications. Worth digging deeper: why does MLA (DeepSeek's flagship innovation) fall into the persistently concentrated category? What are the practical implications for end-to-end training efficiency?
summary_en.authors_note: Author and institution information not specified in the provided full text. The research style suggests a systems group from a university or research institute.

recommendation.zh: 直接推翻MoE系统层可修正路由不平衡的共识，做MoE预训练的架构和系统设计必须立刻复现这个结论
recommendation.en: Directly overturns the consensus that system layer can correct MoE routing imbalance, MoE pretraining architecture and system designs must replicate this finding immediately

paper.title: PALS: Power-Aware LLM Serving for Mixture-of-Experts Models
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference has become a dominant workload in modern data centers, driving significant GPU utilization and energy consumption. While prior systems optimize throughput and latency by batching, scheduling, and parallelism, they largely treat GPU power as a static constraint rather than a controllable resource. In this paper, we present a power-aware runtime for LLM serving, PALS, that treats GPU power caps as a first-class control knob and jointly optimizes them with softw

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM serving 中 GPU 功耗被当作静态约束的问题，尤其面向 dense 与 MoE 模型的吞吐、延迟和能效联合优化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统优化。它把 GPU power cap 作为运行时控制变量，与 batch size 等软件参数一起调度，目标是在满足吞吐需求的同时提高能效。
summary.technical_approach: PALS 在 vLLM 中实现，无需模型重训或 API 改动。系统先离线构建轻量级 power-performance 模型，再用反馈控制器根据吞吐目标选择 power cap、batch size 等配置。
summary.experiments: 在多 GPU 系统上测试 dense 与 MoE LLM。摘要报告 PALS 最高提升 26.3% 能效，并减少 QoS violation；具体模型规模、硬件配置和完整 baseline 需看正文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Boston University 和 Harvard University，工作落点是数据中心 LLM serving 的能耗控制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the fact that GPU power is usually treated as a static constraint in LLM serving, especially for dense and MoE models where throughput, latency, and energy efficiency interact.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-system optimization. It makes GPU power caps a runtime control knob and jointly tunes them with software parameters such as batch size to meet throughput targets while improving energy efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: PALS is implemented inside vLLM without model retraining or API changes. It combines lightweight offline power-performance models with a feedback controller that selects power caps, batch sizes, and related configurations under a throughput target.
summary_en.experiments: The system is evaluated on multi-GPU setups with both dense and MoE LLMs. The abstract reports up to 26.3% energy-efficiency improvement and reduced QoS violations; exact model sizes, hardware, and full baselines require the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Boston University and Harvard University, with the work focused on energy-aware LLM serving in data centers.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练只给间接信号；读系统设计和 MoE serving 曲线即可，别把能效结论外推到训练侧。
recommendation.en: It gives only indirect signal for pretraining; read the system design and MoE serving curves, but do not extrapolate the energy claims to training.
