paper.title: TIDE: Efficient and Lossless MoE Diffusion LLM Inference with I/O-aware Expert Offload
paper.abstract: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) have emerged as a competitive alternative to autoregressive (AR) models, offering better hardware utilization and bidirectional context through parallel block-level decoding. However, as dLLMs continue to scale up with mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, their deployment on resource-constrained devices remains an open challenge. Existing AR-based methods often incur either prohibitive I/O overhead or significant compute bottlenecks. In this work, we pr

summary.core_problem: MoE结构的Diffusion LLM在资源受限设备上部署时，现有AR导向的offload方法面临极高I/O开销或计算瓶颈问题。
summary.importance: 系统/工程创新：针对Diffusion LLM这一新兴方向的推理优化，利用diffusion特有性质（expert activation时间稳定性）设计了I/O感知的expert offload策略。
summary.technical_approach: 提出TIDE系统，利用diffusion推理过程中block内expert activation的时间稳定性，设计基于间隔的expert刷新策略，将推理调度建模为数学规划问题以实现最优性能。
summary.experiments: 摘要未详述具体实验规模和性能数据。
summary.authors_note: University of Central Florida + Rice University，无特别知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Deploying MoE Diffusion LLMs on resource-constrained devices faces prohibitive I/O overhead or compute bottlenecks with existing AR-oriented offload methods.
summary_en.importance: System/engineering innovation: inference optimization for the emerging diffusion LLM direction, leveraging diffusion-specific properties (temporal stability of expert activations) for I/O-aware expert offload.
summary_en.technical_approach: TIDE system leverages temporal stability of expert activations within blocks during diffusion inference, introduces an interval-based expert refresh strategy, and formulates inference scheduling as a mathematical programming problem for optimal performance.
summary_en.experiments: Specific experimental scales and performance numbers not detailed in abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Central Florida + Rice University, no particularly well-known authors.

recommendation.zh: Diffusion LLM推理方向的工程工作，利用expert激活的时间稳定性做offload。关注Diffusion LLM部署的工程师可 glance，预训练研究员暂无需深入。
recommendation.en: An engineering work for diffusion LLM inference that offloads experts based on temporal activation stability. Deployment engineers focusing on diffusion LLM may glance; pretraining researchers need not dive deep for now.

paper.title: HELLoRA: Hot Experts Layer-Level Low-Rank Adaptation for Mixture-of-Experts Models
paper.abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) dominates parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models, yet most variants target dense architectures. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale parameters at near-constant per-token compute, and their sparse activation patterns create untapped opportunities for more efficient adaptation. We propose Hot-Experts Layer-level Low-Rank Adaptation (HELLoRA), which attaches LoRA modules only to the most frequently activated experts at each layer. This simple mechanism

summary.core_problem: 现有LoRA等参数高效微调方法直接应用于MoE模型时，会给所有专家都添加适配器，造成参数和计算浪费，还可能破坏预训练阶段学习到的专家专业化特性，引入噪声梯度。
summary.importance: 利用MoE模型的稀疏激活特性设计适配的高效微调方案，同时实现参数效率、计算效率和下游性能提升，为大参数量MoE模型的低成本下游适配提供了实用方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出HELLoRA层级热专家低秩适配方法，首先用10%左右的目标任务数据做轻量warm-up，统计每个MoE层中各专家的激活频率，仅选择激活频率最高的top-k热专家添加LoRA适配器，冷专家保持冻结；还可结合LoRI方法进一步冻结LoRA的A矩阵，仅更新热专家适配器B矩阵的10%参数，进一步压缩参数预算。
summary.experiments: 在OlMoE-1B-7B、Mixtral-8×7B、DeepSeekMoE三个MoE backbone，数学推理、代码生成、安全对齐三类任务上测试，HELLoRA在参数数量、适配器FLOPs、训练吞吐量均优于标准LoRA、DoRA、LoRI、LoRAMoE等基线，同时下游任务表现更优，即使随机选择专家适配也略优于全专家LoRA。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看引言部分的MoE专家激活偏斜现象观察、方法部分的HELLoRA两阶段流程、表4的消融实验结果；预计阅读时间12分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: When existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA are directly applied to MoE models, adapters are added to all experts, resulting in parameter and computation waste, and may also damage the expert specialization learned in the pre-training stage, introducing noisy gradients.
summary_en.importance: It designs an adapted efficient fine-tuning scheme leveraging the sparse activation property of MoE models, achieving simultaneous improvement in parameter efficiency, computation efficiency and downstream performance, and provides a practical solution for low-cost downstream adaptation of large-parameter MoE models.
summary_en.technical_approach: HELLoRA (Hot Experts Layer-level Low-Rank Adaptation) is proposed. First, a lightweight warm-up is performed with about 10% of the target task data to count the activation frequency of each expert in each MoE layer. LoRA adapters are only added to the top-k hot experts with the highest activation frequency, and cold experts remain frozen. It can also be combined with the LoRI method to further freeze the A matrix of LoRA and only update 10% of the parameters of the B matrix in hot expert adapters to further reduce the parameter budget.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on three MoE backbones (OlMoE-1B-7B, Mixtral-8×7B, DeepSeekMoE) and three task families (math reasoning, code generation, safety alignment), HELLoRA outperforms baselines including standard LoRA, DoRA, LoRI, LoRAMoE in parameter count, adapter FLOPs and training throughput, while achieving better downstream task performance. Even random expert selection slightly outperforms full-expert LoRA.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the observation of skewed expert activation in MoE models in the introduction, the two-stage pipeline of HELLoRA in the method section, and the ablation results in Table 4; estimated reading time 12 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 利用 MoE 路由倾斜特性的 PEFT 方法，'只微调热点专家' 的思路很直觉，可作为 MoE post-training 的 baseline 参考。
recommendation.en: A PEFT method exploiting MoE routing skewness; the idea of 'only fine-tuning hot experts' is intuitive and serves as a good baseline reference for MoE post-training.

paper.title: How to Scale Mixture-of-Experts: From muP to the Maximally Scale-Stable Parameterization
paper.abstract: Recent frontier large language models predominantly rely on Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures. Despite empirical progress, there is still no principled understanding of how hyperparameters should scale with network width $N$, expert width $N_e$, number of experts $M$, sparsity $K$, and depth $L$ to ensure both stability and optimal performance at scale. We take a principled step toward resolving this gap by analyzing three different scaling regimes: (I) co-scaling $N\asymp N_e$, (II) co-sca

summary.core_problem: 在混合专家（MoE）架构中，随着网络宽度、专家宽度、专家数量、稀疏度和深度的扩展，如何设置超参数以保证训练的稳定性和最优性能，目前缺乏原则性的理解。传统的 $\mu$P 参数化在 MoE 中无法可靠地实现学习率迁移和性能随规模的单调提升。
summary.importance: 为 MoE 模型的扩展提供了一套完整的理论框架和参数化方案。通过引入动态平均场理论（DMFT）分析不同协同扩展机制，提出了最大尺度稳定参数化（MSSP），解决了 MoE 扩展中的超参数迁移难题，对训练千亿级 MoE 模型具有直接的指导意义。
summary.technical_approach: 研究了三种 MoE 协同扩展机制：(I) 宽度与专家宽度同比例扩展；(II) 宽度、专家数量和稀疏度同比例扩展（细粒度专家机制）；(III) 所有维度同比例扩展。针对每种机制，利用 DMFT 分析了极限训练动态，发现 $\mu$P 在 MoE 中存在尺度依赖性。为此，提出了 MSSP，通过对 $\mu$P 进行结构性修正（如机制 I 中的零路由初始化、机制 II 中的放大专家输出初始化方差、机制 III 中的共享专家权重初始化），实现了跨尺度的学习率迁移和性能单调提升。
summary.experiments: 在 MLP 和 Transformer MoE 上验证了 MSSP 的有效性。实验表明，在所有三种扩展机制下，MSSP 都能稳健地恢复学习率迁移，并使性能随规模单调提升。相比之下，传统的 $\mu$P 在大规模 MoE 中表现出不稳定性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Introduction 中对三种扩展机制的定义，以及 MSSP 针对不同机制提出的具体修正方案（如初始化策略的调整）。DMFT 的理论推导较为复杂，可先关注其得出的结论，即 $\mu$P 在 MoE 中失效的原因。实验部分重点关注 MSSP 与 $\mu$P 在学习率迁移和性能扩展上的对比图表。

summary_en.core_problem: There is a lack of principled understanding on how to scale hyperparameters in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures alongside network width, expert width, number of experts, sparsity, and depth to ensure stability and optimal performance. The standard $\mu$P fails to reliably deliver learning rate transfer and monotonic performance improvement with scale in MoEs.
summary_en.importance: Provides a comprehensive theoretical framework and parameterization scheme for scaling MoE models. By introducing Dynamical Mean Field Theory (DMFT) to analyze different co-scaling regimes, the authors propose the Maximally Scale-Stable Parameterization (MSSP), solving the hyperparameter transfer challenge in MoE scaling, which is highly relevant for training 100B+ parameter MoEs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors study three MoE co-scaling regimes: (I) width and expert width scale proportionally; (II) width, number of experts, and sparsity scale proportionally (fine-grained experts); (III) all dimensions scale proportionally. Using DMFT to analyze the limiting training dynamics for each regime, they find that $\mu$P exhibits scale-dependence in MoEs. To address this, they propose MSSP, which applies structural corrections to $\mu$P (e.g., zero router initialization in Regime I, amplified expert-output initialization variance in Regime II, and shared expert weights at initialization in Regime III) to achieve cross-scale learning rate transfer and monotonic performance improvement.
summary_en.experiments: Validated MSSP on MLP and Transformer MoEs. Experiments show that across all three scaling regimes, MSSP robustly recovers learning rate transfer and restores monotonic performance improvement with scale. In contrast, standard $\mu$P exhibits instability in large-scale MoEs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the definitions of the three scaling regimes in the Introduction and the specific corrections proposed by MSSP for each regime (e.g., adjustments to initialization strategies). The DMFT derivations are complex; it is advisable to first grasp the conclusions regarding why $\mu$P fails in MoEs. In the experiments, pay close attention to the charts comparing MSSP and $\mu$P on learning rate transfer and performance scaling.

recommendation.zh: 应优先读推导和缩放实验；若结论稳，MoE sweep 不能再直接套 dense μP 当安全默认值。
recommendation.en: Prioritize the derivation and scaling experiments; if robust, dense-model μP should no longer be the safe default for MoE sweeps.

institutions: Gatsby Computational Neuroscience Unit, University College London
University of Tübingen, Tübingen AI Center

paper.title: EnergyLens: Predictive Energy-Aware Exploration for Multi-GPU LLM Inference Optimization
paper.abstract: We present EnergyLens, an end-to-end framework for energy-aware large language model (LLM) inference optimization. As LLMs scale, predicting and reducing their energy footprint has become critical for sustainability and datacenter operations, yet existing approaches either require production-level code and expensive profiling or fail to accurately capture multi-GPU energy behavior. As a result, practitioners lack tools for deciding which optimizations to prioritize and for selecting among existi

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM推理能耗评估方法存在明显局限：直接 profiling 需要GPU资源和大量工程实现成本，TDP等粗粒度方法会高估解码阶段能耗最高达60%，LLMCO2不支持算子融合与MoE架构，内核级预测器无法捕捉多GPU并行、计算通信重叠等分布式部署的核心能耗特征，导致从业者无法高效探索推理优化的能耗-延迟权衡空间。
summary.importance: 为LLM推理优化阶段的能耗评估提供了轻量级工具，不需要实际部署或GPU访问即可快速对比不同并行策略、融合方案、重叠设置的能耗表现，可降低部署前的优化探索成本，对数据中心级别的LLM部署能效规划有实际参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出基于einsum的接口，开发者仅需几行代码即可定义LLM的架构、算子融合、并行策略和计算通信重叠设置；框架解析配置后提取GEMM维度、计算强度和通信内核信息，结合经验驱动的通信能耗模型、考虑负载不平衡的MoE建模，以及计算通信重叠的聚合逻辑，输出端到端的能耗拆解和能耗-延迟帕累托前沿。
summary.experiments: 在Llama3-70B和Qwen3-MoE上验证，多GPU能耗预测的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）为9.25%-13.19%，计算通信重叠场景的MAPE为12.97%，该误差范围足够支撑筛选出最优部署配置；对比测试中，遍历Llama3-70B预填充阶段的2种融合设置、7种批量大小和32种输入长度，传统 profiling 需8卡服务器运行12小时加大量工程工作，EnergyLens仅需15分钟即可生成结果和可视化。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3章的分布式能耗建模栈设计，包括MoE负载不平衡建模和计算通信重叠的聚合逻辑；附录的误差来源分析可帮助理解模型的适用边界，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM inference energy evaluation methods have notable limitations: direct profiling requires GPU resources and substantial engineering implementation costs, coarse-grained methods like TDP overestimate decode phase energy by up to 60%, LLMCO2 does not support operator fusion or MoE architectures, and kernel-level predictors fail to capture core energy characteristics of distributed deployment such as multi-GPU parallelism and compute-communication overlap, leaving practitioners unable to efficiently explore the energy-latency trade-off space of inference optimizations.
summary_en.importance: It provides a lightweight tool for energy evaluation during LLM inference optimization, enabling quick comparison of the energy performance of different parallel strategies, fusion schemes, and overlap settings without actual deployment or GPU access. It can reduce the cost of optimization exploration before deployment and has practical reference value for energy efficiency planning of LLM deployment at the data center level.
summary_en.technical_approach: An einsum-based interface is proposed, where developers only need a few lines of code to define the LLM architecture, operator fusion, parallel strategies, and compute-communication overlap settings. After parsing the configuration, the framework extracts GEMM dimensions, arithmetic intensity, and communication kernel information, combines empirically driven communication energy modeling, load-imbalance-aware MoE modeling, and aggregation logic for compute-communication overlap, and outputs end-to-end energy breakdowns and energy-latency Pareto fronts.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on Llama3-70B and Qwen3-MoE, the mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) for multi-GPU energy prediction is 9.25%-13.19%, and the MAPE for compute-communication overlap scenarios is 12.97%. This error range is sufficient to support screening for optimal deployment configurations. In comparative tests, traversing 2 fusion settings, 7 batch sizes, and 32 input lengths for the Llama3-70B prefill phase required 12 hours of running on an 8-GPU server plus extensive engineering work for traditional profiling, while EnergyLens only takes 15 minutes to generate results and visualizations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 3's distributed energy modeling stack design, including MoE load imbalance modeling and compute-communication overlap aggregation logic; the appendix's error source analysis helps understand the model's applicable boundaries. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练目标无关，但 MoE 多 GPU 能耗建模值得扫；重点看 MoE imbalance 和通信能耗部分。
recommendation.en: Not about training objectives, but the MoE multi-GPU energy model is worth skimming; focus on imbalance and communication-energy sections.

paper.title: Dense vs Sparse Pretraining at Tiny Scale: Active-Parameter vs Total-Parameter Matching
paper.abstract: We study dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) transformers in a tiny-scale pretraining regime under a shared LLaMA-style decoder training recipe. The sparse model replaces dense feed-forward blocks with Mixtral-style routed experts. Dense baselines are modestly width-resized to tightly match either active or total parameter budgets, while tokenizer, data, optimizer, schedule, depth, context length, normalization style, and evaluation protocol are held fixed. Our best sparse recipe uses four expert

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的是一个很具体但常被混淆的问题：在极小规模预训练条件下，MoE 相比 dense 到底有没有真实建模收益，以及比较 dense 与 sparse 时应当按 active parameters 还是 total parameters 做公平匹配。作者把系统、数据、tokenizer、优化器、训练日程都固定，只替换 FFN 为 Mixtral 风格的 routed experts，试图把“条件计算本身的建模价值”从大规模分布式训练的工程因素里剥离出来。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义在于，它把 dense-vs-sparse 讨论里最容易混在一起的两种公平性标准拆开了。若按每 token 实际激活的参数量比较，MoE 在 tiny scale 已经能带来明确收益；若按总存储参数量比较，dense 仍略强，但差距不大且会随训练缩小。这个结论不大，却很干净。它说明 sparse 的优势并不只存在于超大规模集群和高系统优化场景，至少在建模层面，条件计算在小模型上已经可见；但同时也说明，若总参数预算固定，MoE 并不会自动胜出。对做 scaling、架构搜索和小规模先导实验的人，这种区分很有用，因为它直接影响实验结论该如何外推。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计相当克制。基础模型是 decoder-only、LLaMA 风格训练栈，数据用 TinyStories，保持 tokenizer、数据管线、优化器、schedule、depth、context length、normalization 和评测协议一致。稀疏化只发生在 FFN：把 dense FFN 换成 Mixtral 风格 MoE 模块。主配方是 4 experts、top-2 routing、dropless dispatch、Switch 风格 load balancing，并可选 router z-loss。作者明确不用 token dropping 或 capacity truncation，目的是避免把执行路径上的近似技巧混进建模比较。损失函数由三部分组成：next-token cross-entropy、负载均衡辅助项 L_bal，以及可选的 router z-loss L_z；最佳稀疏配方里 λ_bal=1e-2，λ_z=1e-3。公平性上做了两组 dense baseline：active-match dense 把宽度调到与 MoE 的每 token 激活参数量接近；total-match dense 则把总参数量调到与完整 MoE 接近。文中给出的 headline 配置是：dense active-match 约 14.89M 参数；MoE 总参数约 21.06M、active 参数约 14.77M；dense total-match 约 21.06M。active 匹配误差小于 1%，total 匹配误差小于 0.1%。这使得结论更容易解释：如果你关心的是每 token 实际动用了多少容量，MoE 的条件路由有优势；如果你关心的是总存储容量，dense 仍然很有竞争力。
summary.experiments: 关键结果有三层。第一，naive sparse 在 tiny scale 并不自然成立。top-1 routing 且不加 balancing 时，训练几乎立刻 collapse，多数层把几乎所有 token 都路由到单一 expert。第二，稳定训练的关键不是单一技巧，而是一个小组合：加入 Switch-style balancing 可以先消除立即塌缩；在此基础上，从 top-1 改到 top-2 带来主要质量提升；router z-loss 更多改善路由行为和稳定性诊断，而不是最终验证损失的主要来源。第三，headline 数字很清楚：三种 full-data、三随机种子的比较中，dense active-match 的最佳验证 loss 为 1.6545 ± 0.0012，MoE 为 1.5788 ± 0.0020，dense total-match 为 1.5608 ± 0.00x（摘要截断了最后一位，但可确定略优于 MoE）。也就是说，MoE 相比 active-match dense 明显更好，但相比 total-match dense 仍略差。作者还强调，这个 sparse gain 伴随着健康的 routing diagnostics，而不是靠病态专家使用换来的假收益。主指标是 held-out validation loss 和 perplexity，吞吐与单 GPU dispatch 优化只放在附录，不作为核心论据。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议很明确。先看 Introduction 和 Method，把两种 fairness 定义记牢：active-parameter matching 回答的是“同等每 token 激活容量下，条件计算是否更有效”；total-parameter matching 回答的是“同等总存储容量下，稀疏化是否值得”。然后直接看 Results 里关于 top-1 collapse、load balancing、top-2 改善、z-loss 作用的几组表和图。若只花 20 到 30 分钟，最值得抓住的是 headline loss 对比和 routing diagnostics，因为这两部分共同决定结论是否可信。若要进一步深挖，可看附录中的 dispatch 实现、吞吐分析，以及不同层 expert usage 的分布图，判断这些结论在更大规模上哪些可能保持、哪些可能被系统因素改写。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper isolates a specific question that is often blurred in dense-vs-sparse discussions: at tiny pretraining scale, does MoE provide a real modeling benefit over dense transformers, and should fairness be defined by active parameters or total parameters? To answer that, the authors keep the tokenizer, data, optimizer, schedule, depth, context length, normalization, and evaluation fixed, and only replace dense FFNs with Mixtral-style routed experts. The goal is to separate the modeling value of conditional computation from large-scale distributed systems effects.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is conceptual cleanliness rather than scale. The paper separates two fairness criteria that often get conflated. Under active-parameter matching, MoE already shows a clear advantage even at tiny scale. Under total-parameter matching, dense remains slightly better, though the gap is small and narrows during training. That is useful for pretraining research because it sharpens what a dense-vs-sparse result actually means. If the question is per-token active capacity, sparse routing helps. If the question is total stored capacity, dense is still highly competitive. For scaling studies, architecture search, and small pilot runs, this distinction matters because it changes how one should extrapolate conclusions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup is deliberately controlled. The base stack is a decoder-only, LLaMA-style transformer trained on TinyStories. Everything is held fixed except the FFN module, which is replaced by a Mixtral-style MoE block in the sparse variants. The main sparse recipe uses 4 experts, top-2 routing, dropless dispatch, Switch-style load balancing, and optional router z-loss. The authors explicitly avoid token dropping and capacity truncation so that the comparison stays focused on routing behavior rather than execution shortcuts. The training objective combines next-token cross-entropy with a load-balancing auxiliary loss and an optional router z-loss; the best sparse recipe uses lambda_bal = 1e-2 and lambda_z = 1e-3. Fairness is evaluated in two ways. The active-match dense baseline is width-resized to approximately match the MoE’s per-token active parameter count. The total-match dense baseline is resized to match the MoE’s full stored parameter count. The headline configurations are: dense active-match at about 14.89M parameters, MoE at about 21.06M total and 14.77M active parameters, and dense total-match at about 21.06M parameters. Matching is tight, with less than 1% error for active counts and less than 0.1% for total counts. This makes the interpretation straightforward: if fairness means active routed capacity, MoE wins; if fairness means total capacity, dense still has a slight edge.
summary_en.experiments: There are three main empirical takeaways. First, naive sparse training does not work automatically at tiny scale. Top-1 routing without balancing collapses almost immediately, with most layers sending nearly all tokens to one expert. Second, stable sparse training comes from a small recipe rather than a single trick: Switch-style balancing removes the immediate collapse, top-2 routing delivers the main quality gain over top-1, and router z-loss mostly improves routing behavior and stability diagnostics rather than being the main source of validation-loss improvement. Third, the headline numbers are clean. In the three-seed, full-data comparison, the dense active-match model reaches a best validation loss of 1.6545 ± 0.0012, the MoE reaches 1.5788 ± 0.0020, and the dense total-match model reaches 1.5608 ± 0.00x, slightly better than the MoE. So MoE clearly beats the active-matched dense baseline, but still trails the total-matched dense baseline by a small margin. The paper also shows that the sparse gain comes with healthy routing diagnostics rather than pathological expert collapse. The primary metrics are held-out validation loss and perplexity; throughput and single-GPU dispatch optimizations are treated as appendix-side support rather than core evidence.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the introduction and method and make sure the two fairness definitions are clear. Active-parameter matching asks whether conditional computation is better given the same per-token active capacity. Total-parameter matching asks whether sparsity is better given the same stored capacity. Then go straight to the result tables and figures covering top-1 collapse, the effect of load balancing, the gain from top-2 routing, and the role of z-loss. If you only spend 20 to 30 minutes, focus on the headline validation-loss comparison and the routing diagnostics, because together they determine whether the conclusion is trustworthy. If you want more depth, inspect the appendix for dispatch implementation details, throughput analysis, and layerwise expert-usage plots to judge which findings are likely to survive at larger scale and which may change once systems constraints dominate.

recommendation.zh: 值得看实验设计而非结论外推；active-match 赢、total-match 输，会逼你重新写 MoE ablation 的公平性说明。
recommendation.en: Read it for the experimental design, not scale extrapolation; active-match wins and total-match loses force cleaner fairness claims in MoE ablations.

paper.title: MinT: Managed Infrastructure for Training and Serving Millions of LLMs
paper.abstract: We present MindLab Toolkit (MinT), a managed infrastructure system for Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) post-training and online serving. MinT targets a setting where many trained policies are produced over a small number of expensive base-model deployments. Instead of materializing each policy as a merged full checkpoint, MinT keeps the base model resident and moves exported LoRA adapter revisions through rollout, update, export, evaluation, serving, and rollback, hiding distributed training, serving

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是大规模后训练和在线服务中的模型变体管理问题：当一个基座模型上存在大量 LoRA 策略、RL 实验分支、租户定制版本和回滚点时，传统复制完整 checkpoint 或合并 LoRA 后再服务的流程会在存储、带宽、调度和复现上变得很重。
summary.importance: 它不是预训练算法论文，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有实际启发。随着 RL、在线数据回流和持续训练变成常态，基座模型不再只是一次性训练产物，而是多个策略版本共享的 resident base。MinT 的核心价值在于把 LoRA adapter 作为可训练、可导出、可服务、可回滚的策略单元，减少训练到服务之间移动的对象大小，并让多策略 RL 可以共享同一基座部署。这类基础设施会影响后训练实验速度、reward 迭代频率和策略版本可追踪性。
summary.technical_approach: MinT 采用 adapter-centered workflow。基座模型常驻训练或推理引擎，行为差异由 LoRA adapter 表示。训练完成后，系统不导出完整模型，也不强制合并 LoRA，而是生成 serving-compatible adapter revision。这个 revision 包含固定训练步的 LoRA 权重、服务端张量布局、与 resident base 的兼容性信息、rollout 记录、评测和服务归因信息。系统层面包含队列、准入、放置、故障恢复、adapter 生命周期管理、冷加载调度和回滚。训练侧支持单 worker PEFT 和分布式 Megatron 路径，可在共享基座上 time-slice 多个 LoRA RL 会话。服务侧基于 shared-base vLLM，多 adapter 通过 CPU/GPU hot working set 管理，持久策略命名空间与实际引擎驻留集合分离。对 MoE LoRA，工作使用 packed tensor 表示减少大量小对象加载带来的开销。
summary.experiments: 报告给出三条扩展轴上的系统结果。Scale Up：支持 frontier-scale dense 和 MoE 架构，验证到超过 1T total parameters；还报告了 235B-A22B 规模训练和 1T-class MoE countdown-task 路径。Scale Down：adapter-only handoff 避免完整 checkpoint materialization；在 4B dense 模型上 handoff 步骤减少 18.3×，在 30B MoE 上减少 2.85×；在相同 resident-base allocation 下，并发 multi-policy GRPO 将 wall time 分别缩短 1.77× 和 1.45×，且不增加 peak memory。Scale Out：支持 10^6 级可寻址 policy catalog，单引擎扫过 100K entries，集群级支持 thousand-adapter active waves；packed MoE LoRA tensors 将 live engine loading 提升 8.5–8.7×。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 35–45 分钟。先看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解 MinT 与 full fine-tuning、merge-based LoRA 的边界差异。然后看 adapter revision 的定义和生命周期，这部分决定了复现、回滚和在线服务如何接在一起。系统实现部分可重点看 scheduler、serving residency、cold loading 和 packed MoE LoRA 表示。实验部分重点记住 18.3×/2.85× handoff、1.77×/1.45× multi-policy GRPO、8.5–8.7× MoE adapter loading 这几组数字。若只关心预训练，可把它作为持续训练和 RL 实验平台设计的参考，而不是建模方法。
summary.authors_note: 机构显示为 Mind Lab；给定内容未包含作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses infrastructure for managing very large numbers of post-trained LLM variants. When many LoRA policies, RL branches, tenant-specific behaviors, and rollback points share the same base model, moving full checkpoints or serving merged LoRA checkpoints creates heavy storage, bandwidth, scheduling, and reproducibility costs.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to the interface between base models and continuous post-training. Modern RL and online training pipelines need fast iteration over policy populations that share a resident base model. MinT treats LoRA adapters as first-class policy units that can be trained, exported, served, evaluated, attributed, and rolled back. That changes the operational cost of RL loops and makes policy versioning more explicit.
summary_en.technical_approach: MinT uses an adapter-centered workflow. The base model stays resident in training or inference deployments, while behavior changes are represented by LoRA adapters. After training, MinT exports a serving-compatible adapter revision instead of a full checkpoint or a merged model. A revision contains the frozen LoRA payload at a specific step, serving tensor layout, compatibility checks against the resident base, rollout records, evaluation and serving attribution, and rollback state. The system includes queueing, admission control, placement, fault tolerance, adapter lifecycle management, cold-load scheduling, and revision visibility. Training supports both single-worker PEFT and distributed Megatron paths, with time-sliced LoRA RL sessions over shared resident bases. Serving uses shared-base vLLM engines, separates durable policy addressability from CPU/GPU hot working sets, and schedules first-touch adapter loading. For MoE LoRA, packed tensors reduce small-object fanout during live loading.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results are system-scale measurements. On the Scale Up axis, MinT is validated on dense and MoE deployments beyond 1T total parameters, including a 235B-A22B-scale training path and a 1T-class MoE countdown-task path. On Scale Down, adapter-only handoff avoids full-checkpoint materialization; the measured handoff step is reduced by 18.3× on a 4B dense model and 2.85× on a 30B MoE model. With the same resident-base allocation, concurrent multi-policy GRPO reduces wall time by 1.77× and 1.45× respectively without increasing peak memory. On Scale Out, the system supports 10^6-scale addressable policy catalogs, single-engine sweeps through 100K entries, and thousand-adapter active waves at cluster scale. Packed MoE LoRA tensors improve live engine loading by 8.5–8.7×.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 35–45 minutes. Start with Figures 1 and 2 to understand how MinT differs from full fine-tuning and merge-based LoRA deployment. Then read the adapter revision lifecycle, because that is where training, serving, evaluation, rollback, and reproducibility meet. In the system sections, focus on scheduling, serving residency, cold loading, and the packed MoE LoRA representation. The key numbers to retain are 18.3× and 2.85× handoff reduction, 1.77× and 1.45× multi-policy GRPO speedup, and 8.5–8.7× faster MoE adapter loading.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution shown in the provided content: Mind Lab. The author list is not included.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统设计和 ablation 数字即可；它提醒预训练团队别把 LoRA-RL 的瓶颈误判成训练算子问题。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and ablation numbers; it is a useful reminder that LoRA-RL bottlenecks can be lifecycle and data-movement issues, not just kernels.

paper.title: DisagMoE: Computation-Communication overlapped MoE Training via Disaggregated AF-Pipe Parallelism
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures enable trillion-parameter LLMs with sparsely activated experts. Expert parallelism (EP) is a widely adopted MoE training strategy, but it suffers from severe all-to-all communication bottlenecks, which is exaggerated by the limited inter-node network bandwidth as the growing model size requires distributing experts across GPU nodes. Prior work focused on overlapping these all-to-all communications with feed-forward network (FFN) and self-attention computati

summary.core_problem: 大规模MoE大模型训练采用的专家并行（EP）存在严重的跨节点all-to-all通信瓶颈，在64张H800 GPU上测试时通信耗时占单步训练时间的最高比例达50%。此前的通信-计算重叠方法要么受FFN计算窗口限制，要么受注意力与FFN天然的计算-通信比不平衡约束（注意力耗时随序列长度平方增长，FFN和通信耗时近似线性增长）无法实现完全重叠；现有注意力-FFN拆分的训练方案内存开销高，仅能支撑40亿左右参数规模，无法适配数百亿级以上MoE的高效训练需求。
summary.importance: 解决了大规模MoE预训练的第一级性能瓶颈，大幅压低跨节点通信开销，将数百亿参数MoE的训练吞吐量最高提升1.81倍，直接降低大模型预训练的算力成本和周期；提出的组件拆分+自适应联合调度框架，也为更大规模MoE、混合模态MoE的并行训练优化提供了可复用的设计范式。
summary.technical_approach: 核心有三项区别于现有方案的设计：1. 组件级拆分部署：将Transformer的注意力层和MoE FFN层拆分到不同的worker组，注意力组复制密集组件、按微批次拆分数据，FFN组分片存储专家、按路由结果处理token；单组可承载多层同类型组件，在显存约束下最大化设备利用率，解决了此前拆分方案要求单组存储所有层对应组件参数导致的OOM问题。2. AF-Pipe多阶段流水线：将组间多对多token交换作为独立的流水线阶段，与注意力计算、FFN计算对齐阶段边界，系统实现通信与两类计算的同时重叠，替代了传统EP中位于关键路径的all-to-all通信。3. 自适应资源分配：基于轻量的计算-通信屋顶线模型，动态调整注意力组和FFN组的规模，以及两组的网卡带宽分配，适配不同序列长度、top-k路由策略、EP规模下的计算-通信不平衡，扩大有效重叠窗口，压低关键路径通信耗时。
summary.experiments: 实验采用128张H800 GPU，在4K到32K序列长度下对数百亿参数规模的MoE模型开展预训练测试。相比Megatron的1F1B交错重叠方案，吞吐量最高提升1.81倍；相比此前性能最优的MoE重叠系统，吞吐量最高提升1.34倍。消融实验显示，当序列长度从4K升到32K时，自适应资源分配模块相比固定分组配置额外带来27%的吞吐量提升。
summary.reading_guide: 精读第3章的AF-Pipe流水线调度设计，配合图4、图6的不平衡性分析和重叠窗口对比理解与基线方案的核心差异；精读第4章的自适应资源分配算法和屋顶线模型推导；重点关注第5章扩展性实验中的图14，即与HeterMoE等基线的显存占用对比，理解实际缩放特性；附录的流水线调度时序细节可作为工程实现参考。

summary_en.core_problem: Expert parallelism (EP) for large-scale MoE LLM training suffers from severe inter-node all-to-all communication bottlenecks, accounting for up to 50% of per-step training time on 64 H800 GPUs. Prior communication-computation overlap methods are limited by either the FFN computation window or the inherent imbalance between attention (quadratic scaling with sequence length) and FFN/communication (near-linear scaling), which prevents full overlap. Existing attention-FFN disaggregation training schemes incur high memory overhead and only scale to around 4B parameters, failing to support efficient training of MoE models with hundreds of billions of parameters.
summary_en.importance: This work addresses the first-order performance bottleneck of large-scale MoE pretraining, significantly reducing inter-node communication overhead and delivering up to 1.81x higher throughput for hundred-billion-parameter MoE training, which directly cuts the computing cost and cycle time of large LLM pretraining. The joint component placement and adaptive scheduling framework also provides a reusable design paradigm for future scaling of even larger MoE and multimodal MoE models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three core innovations differentiate DisagMoE from prior work: 1. Disaggregated component placement: Attention layers and MoE FFN layers are assigned to separate worker groups. Attention groups replicate dense components and split data by micro-batch, while FFN groups shard experts and process tokens according to routing results. Each group can host multiple layers of the same component type, maximizing device utilization under memory constraints and eliminating the OOM issue of prior disaggregation schemes that required each group to store all layers of their assigned component. 2. AF-Pipe multi-stage pipeline: Inter-group many-to-many token exchange is treated as an independent pipeline stage, aligned with attention and FFN computation stage boundaries to enable systematic overlap of communication with both types of computation, replacing the on-critical-path all-to-all communication in conventional EP. 3. Adaptive resource allocation: A lightweight compute-communication roofline model guides dynamic adjustment of attention/FFN group sizes and NIC bandwidth allocation between groups, adapting to imbalance across different sequence lengths, top-k routing policies, and EP scales to expand the effective overlap window and reduce critical-path communication time.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on 128 H800 GPUs for pretraining MoE models with hundreds of billions of parameters, across sequence lengths from 4K to 32K. DisagMoE achieves up to 1.81x higher throughput than Megatron-1F1B interleaved overlap, and up to 1.34x higher throughput than best-performing prior MoE overlap systems. Ablation studies show the adaptive resource allocation module delivers an additional 27% throughput gain when sequence length increases from 4K to 32K, compared to fixed group configurations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for AF-Pipe pipeline scheduling design, paired with Figure 4 and Figure 6 for imbalance analysis and overlap window comparison with baselines. Read Section 4 for the adaptive resource allocation algorithm and roofline model derivation. Section 5's scaling experiments, especially Figure 14's memory footprint comparison with HeterMoE and other baselines, are critical for understanding practical scaling properties. Appendix details on pipeline scheduling timelines can serve as an implementation reference.

recommendation.zh: 改变对MoE并行训练架构的认知，应立刻在内部MoE预训练系统中做ablation验证。
recommendation.en: Changes the understanding of MoE parallel training architecture, should immediately run ablation validation in internal MoE pre-training systems.

paper.title: Slicing and Dicing: Configuring Optimal Mixtures of Experts
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have become standard in large language models, yet many of their core design choices - expert count, granularity, shared experts, load balancing, token dropping - have only been studied one or two at a time over narrow configuration ranges. It remains an open question whether these choices can be optimized independently, without considering interactions. We present the first systematic study of over 2,000 pretraining runs spanning models up to 6.6B total pa

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 MoE 预训练配置中一个很实际的问题：专家数量、专家粒度、共享专家、异构专家、负载均衡、token dropping 这些设计项能否独立优化，还是存在强交互。过去很多 MoE 结论来自少量配置或单因素实验，很难指导真实训练配方。论文用超过 2000 次预训练实验，把专家总数和专家粒度拆开控制，试图给出更可复用的 MoE 配置原则。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的影响主要在 MoE 配方选择，而不是提出一个新路由器。最有用的结论是：在相同 active parameter 规模下，增加总 MoE 参数通常持续带来收益，即使 total FFN 参数相对 active FFN 参数的比例达到 128；异构专家和 shared generalist 没有超过调好的同构 MoE；负载均衡超参在合理范围内不需要过度调，dropless routing 有小而稳定的收益。这会改变 MoE sweep 的优先级：先定 active scale 下的专家粒度，再按显存和并行约束增加专家总数，而不是把大量预算花在共享专家或复杂异构结构上。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 MoE 设计空间拆成几个可控变量。专家粒度 g 定义为 expert FFN intermediate dimension 与 dense FFN intermediate dimension 的比值。为了 FLOP-match dense FFN，active expert count 设为 k=1/g，使每个 token 激活的 expert 参数量大致保持不变。总专家数 n 独立变化，activation sparsity 定义为 s=n·g，也就是 total FFN 参数相对 active FFN 参数的扩张倍数。这个定义很关键，因为它把“每个专家多大”和“一共有多少专家”分开了。论文还测试了同一层内不同粒度混合的 heterogeneous expert pools，以及 always-active 的 shared generalist expert。路由方面覆盖负载均衡机制、负载均衡权重和 token dropping/dropless routing。与很多已有 MoE 研究不同，这里不是只比较 top-1/top-2 或专家数，而是在固定计算预算下系统扫描容量、稀疏度、粒度和路由稳定性。
summary.experiments: 实验规模覆盖约 10M 到 6.6B total parameters，总计超过 2000 次预训练 run。核心结果有四点。第一，在所有研究过的 active parameter scale 上，增加 total MoE parameters 都能持续改善性能，activation sparsity 到 128 时仍然没有看到明确饱和。第二，专家粒度需要随 active scale 调整；fine-grained experts 的价值不是单独来自更小专家，而是来自在同等 active compute 下可以激活更多专家并扩大总专家池。第三，heterogeneous expert sizing 没有稳定超过 homogeneous MoE，说明让同层专家大小更灵活并不自动带来更好 specialization；shared generalist expert 反而持续伤害性能，可能因为它削弱了路由专家承担通用建模负载的压力，同时占用了固定计算预算。第四，负载均衡超参在合理区间内表现相对鲁棒，dropless routing 比 token dropping 有小幅但一致的提升。给出的内容没有包含每个 benchmark 的具体 loss 或 accuracy 表格，因此不应臆造单项数值。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读三部分。第一，方法部分关于 granularity、active expert count、activation sparsity 的定义，这是理解所有实验公平性的基础。第二，专家数量与粒度的二维 sweep 图表，重点看在 fixed active parameters 下 total experts 增加是否仍改善 loss，以及不同 g 在不同 scale 下的交叉点。第三，heterogeneous experts、generalist experts 和 routing ablation，价值在负结果：复杂结构没有赢过简单同构配置。真正值得深挖的是这些结论和系统约束的关系，例如 expert parallelism、显存放置、all-to-all 通信是否会改变最优点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical configuration problem in MoE pretraining: whether expert count, expert granularity, shared experts, heterogeneous expert sizes, load balancing, and token dropping can be tuned independently. Prior evidence was usually based on narrow one-factor studies, which makes it hard to turn the results into a reliable pretraining recipe.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a large empirical map of the MoE design space rather than a new router. The main finding is actionable: at a fixed active-parameter scale, increasing total MoE parameters consistently improves quality, even when total FFN parameters are 128 times the active FFN parameters. Heterogeneous experts and always-on generalist experts do not beat a well-configured homogeneous MoE, and shared generalists consistently hurt. Load-balancing hyperparameters are relatively robust within reasonable ranges, while dropless routing gives a small consistent gain. For pretraining practice, this shifts the sweep budget toward expert granularity and total expert count, rather than complex expert mixtures or heavy load-balancing tuning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study separates expert size from expert count. Expert granularity g is defined as the ratio between an expert FFN intermediate dimension and the dense FFN intermediate dimension. To match dense FFN compute, the number of active experts is set to k=1/g, keeping active expert parameters roughly fixed per token. The total number of experts n is varied independently, and activation sparsity is defined as s=n·g, the ratio between total FFN parameters and active FFN parameters. This setup makes it possible to ask whether gains come from smaller experts, more active experts, or a larger inactive expert pool. The paper also evaluates mixed-granularity expert pools within a layer, always-active shared generalist experts, load-balancing variants, load-balancing weights, and token dropping versus dropless routing.
summary_en.experiments: The study reports more than 2,000 pretraining runs, ranging from roughly 10M to 6.6B total parameters. Four results matter most. First, quality improves monotonically with total MoE parameters across all active-parameter scales studied, with improvements still visible at activation sparsity 128. Second, expert granularity must be chosen relative to active scale; fine-grained experts help because they allow more experts to be activated under the same active compute and make a larger expert pool feasible. Third, heterogeneous expert sizes do not provide a stable advantage over homogeneous experts, and shared generalist experts consistently degrade performance. Fourth, routing quality is not overly sensitive to load-balancing hyperparameters in reasonable ranges, while dropless routing gives a small but repeatable benefit. The supplied content does not expose per-benchmark loss or accuracy tables, so exact task-level numbers should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the definitions of granularity, active expert count, and activation sparsity first; they determine whether the comparisons are compute-matched. Then focus on the two-dimensional sweeps over expert count and granularity, especially the curves at fixed active parameters. The ablations on heterogeneous experts, shared generalists, and routing are worth careful attention because the negative results simplify the MoE design space. A useful follow-up question is how these empirical optima interact with systems constraints such as expert parallelism, memory placement, and all-to-all communication.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该认真读：它可能把 MoE 配置搜索从“总参数直觉”改成“active 参数主导”的设计 prior，先看主结论图和各 knob 的交互表，再决定内部 sweep 怎么改。
recommendation.en: This is worth real attention: it may shift MoE design from total-parameter intuition to an active-parameter-centric prior; read the main scaling plots and interaction tables before planning your next sweep.

institutions: Paul G Allen School of Computer Science, University of Washington
Paul G Allen School of Computer Science

paper.title: Fast MoE Inference via Predictive Prefetching and Expert Replication
paper.abstract: The Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture has become a fundamental building block in state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs), improving domain-specific expertise in LLMs and scaling model capacity without proportionally increasing their computational overhead. However, MoE inference often suffers from suboptimal GPU utilization, load imbalance, and elevated latency arising from multiple tokens waiting on the same experts for their computation which arises from sparsity of expert activation

summary.core_problem: MoE 模型推理时由于 expert 激活稀疏导致的拥塞与负载不均：部分 expert 被大量 token 同时请求而排队，造成 GPU 利用率低、延迟高。论文要解决的是在不改 MoE 计算语义（不牺牲精度）的前提下，降低 token 等待与 all-to-all 路由带来的尾延迟。
summary.importance: 偏推理系统与 serving 优化，对“预训练方法/数据/训练动态”直接影响有限。但如果你在做 MoE 预训练并关心训练-推理一致性或线上成本，它提供了一个思路：把 expert 选择当作可预测信号，提前做资源调度与复制，缓解热点 expert 的排队问题。
summary.technical_approach:
两件事：
- Predictive prefetching：用一个轻量预测器（文中用 SRU）快速预测接下来 token 会路由到哪些 experts，从而提前准备计算与数据搬运。
- Dynamic expert replication：对预测会过载的 experts 做“深度物理复制”（不是权重共享的逻辑副本，而是可并行执行的副本），让同一 expert 的不同请求在不同副本上并发处理，减少等待；并提出在 GPU 容量约束下对复制数量做上限控制。
整体类比分布式系统的 MPMC（多生产者多消费者）队列：路由产生请求，复制的 expert 副本消费请求，以降低拥塞。
summary.experiments: 全文片段未给出完整实验表与具体数字。引言声称 MoE 推理在一些设置下可比 dense 慢到 15×（语言建模）或 3×（机器翻译），并指出当 expert 数量很大时路由/通信开销可占推理时间的 72%+。论文的核心实验应当是：在固定模型与精度下，对比无复制/静态复制/其动态复制策略的吞吐、GPU 利用率与 P50/P95 延迟；以及预测器准确率与复制开销的消融。需要以正文实验章节的具体数据为准。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读即可，目标是抓住系统设计点：
- 先看方法部分对“预测什么、提前多久、如何触发复制、复制的内存/带宽代价”的定义。
- 再看实验里关于 tail latency、负载均衡与 GPU 利用率的指标与消融，确认收益是否来自减少等待还是仅仅增加并行占用。
- 预计阅读时间：20–30 分钟（方法+关键实验图表）。

summary_en.core_problem: MoE inference suffers from expert hotspots: sparse routing makes many tokens contend for the same few experts, causing queueing, low GPU utilization, and high (especially tail) latency. The paper targets reducing token waiting and routing/communication overhead without changing MoE semantics or accuracy.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an inference/serving optimization rather than a pretraining contribution. It can still matter operationally for MoE-based foundation models: if expert usage is predictable, you can schedule resources ahead of time and replicate hotspot experts to reduce tail latency and improve utilization.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Two main components:
- Predictive prefetching: a lightweight predictor (SRU) forecasts which experts upcoming tokens will hit, enabling earlier preparation.
- Dynamic expert replication: physically replicate predicted-overloaded experts so multiple replicas can process queued tokens concurrently; replication is capped by GPU capacity constraints. The framing borrows from MPMC queueing: routing produces requests, replicated experts consume them to mitigate congestion.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include the detailed results tables. The introduction cites large slowdowns for MoE inference (up to 15× vs dense for LM in some settings) and claims routing/communication overhead can exceed 72% of inference time with many experts. The key evidence to verify in the experiments section is: throughput and P50/P95 latency improvements under fixed accuracy, predictor accuracy vs overhead, and ablations comparing no replication vs static vs dynamic replication.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim for system design clarity:
- Focus on how prediction is trained/used online, the lookahead window, and the replication trigger policy.
- Check the latency (especially tail) and utilization plots plus ablations to see whether gains come from reduced queueing rather than simply higher parallel occupancy.
- Time budget: ~20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看调度策略和 replication 开销实验；它不改预训练范式，但能约束 MoE 路由与专家规模的工程 prior。
recommendation.en: Read only the scheduling design and replication-overhead ablations; it does not change pretraining, but it constrains practical priors for MoE routing and expert scale.

paper.title: ROMER: Expert Replacement and Router Calibration for Robust MoE LLMs on Analog Compute-in-Memory Systems
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) with mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures achieve remarkable scalability by sparsely activating a subset of experts per token, yet their frequent expert switching creates memory bandwidth bottlenecks that compute-in-memory (CIM) architectures are well-suited to mitigate. However, analog CIM systems suffer from inherent hardware imperfections that perturb stored weights, and its negative impact on MoE-based LLMs in noisy CIM environments remains unexplored. In this

summary.core_problem: 解决 MoE LLM 部署到模拟型 compute-in-memory 硬件时，模拟噪声扰动权重与路由决策，导致专家负载失衡和性能下降的问题。
summary.importance: 这是硬件噪声下的 MoE 鲁棒性与部署校准工作。对做基座预训练的人，价值主要在于提醒 router/expert 结构对噪声很敏感，以及 clean-trained routing 在新硬件分布下可能失效；但它不是预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先用真实芯片测量校准噪声模型，系统分析模拟 CIM 噪声对 MoE LLM 的影响；随后提出 ROMER 后训练校准框架，包括两步：用高频专家替换低激活专家以恢复负载平衡，以及通过基于 percentile 的 router logit 归一化重新校准路由决策，从而适配 noisy hardware。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模，但强调是首个在真实芯片校准噪声模型下系统研究 MoE LLM 的工作。实验重点应包括：不同噪声强度下的 perplexity/accuracy 退化、专家负载分布变化、clean-trained router 的失配程度，以及 ROMER 相对未校准和其他校准基线的恢复幅度。对预训练研究员而言，最值得看的是负载平衡被噪声破坏的分析图。
summary.authors_note: 来自北航集成电路学院，偏硬件-系统交叉。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the degradation of MoE LLMs on analog compute-in-memory hardware, where analog noise perturbs weights and routing decisions, causing expert imbalance and quality loss.
summary_en.importance: This is a robustness/deployment calibration paper for MoE under hardware noise. For foundation-model researchers, the main value is the reminder that router/expert structures are highly noise-sensitive and that clean-trained routing can fail under shifted hardware distributions; it is not a pretraining-method paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first build a noise model calibrated from real chip measurements and systematically analyze how analog CIM noise affects MoE LLMs. They then propose ROMER, a post-training calibration framework with two components: replacing underactivated experts with high-frequency ones to restore load balance, and recalibrating router logits via percentile-based normalization to adapt routing under noisy hardware.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, but it claims to be the first systematic study of MoE LLMs under a real-chip-calibrated noise model. The key experiments likely include perplexity/accuracy degradation under varying noise levels, shifts in expert load distribution, the mismatch of clean-trained routers, and recovery from ROMER versus uncalibrated or alternative baselines. For pretraining researchers, the most useful part is the analysis of how noise breaks load balance.
summary_en.authors_note: From the School of Integrated Circuit Science and Engineering, Beihang University, with a hardware-systems orientation.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不大，但如果你做 MoE 路由，这篇提醒你 router 学到的是硬件条件分布；只看噪声如何打坏 load balance 的图表即可。
recommendation.en: Not very relevant to pretraining, but if you work on MoE routing, this is a useful reminder that the router learns a hardware-conditioned distribution; just read the figures on load-balance collapse under noise.

institutions: The School of Integrated Circuit Science and Engineering, Beihang University

paper.title: Qwen-Scope: Turning Sparse Features into Development Tools for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models have achieved remarkable capabilities across diverse tasks, yet their internal decision-making processes remain largely opaque, limiting our ability to inspect, control, and systematically improve them. This opacity motivates a growing body of research in mechanistic interpretability, with sparse autoencoders (SAEs) emerging as one of the most promising tools for decomposing model activations into sparse, interpretable feature representations. We introduce Qwen-Scope, an op

summary.core_problem: 这项工作把 sparse autoencoder 从事后解释工具推进到模型开发接口：不仅用 SAE 分解 Qwen 系列模型的内部激活，还尝试用这些稀疏特征做 steering、评测分析、数据构造和后训练干预。
summary.importance: 它对基座研究的价值主要在机制分析和训练闭环。SAE 特征如果足够稳定，可以成为一种表示层 API：帮助定位模型行为来源，分析 benchmark 覆盖和冗余，筛选或合成训练数据，并给 SFT/RL 提供更细粒度的训练信号。它不是预训练算法论文，但对模型调试、数据治理、post-train 反馈 pretrain 的流程有实用参考。
summary.technical_approach: Qwen-Scope 释放了覆盖 Qwen3 与 Qwen3.5 的 SAE 组件，共 7 个模型变体、14 组 SAE，包含 dense 和 MoE 架构。SAE 通过过完备稀疏字典重构模型激活，使每个输入只激活少量 latent feature，从而把高维 hidden state 拆成可检查、可干预的方向。应用层面包括四类：推理时 feature steering，用于控制语言、概念和偏好；用 feature coverage 分析评测集能力覆盖、冗余和表示集中；用 SAE 特征做多语 toxicity 分类与安全数据合成；在后训练中加入特征级约束，例如 SFT 时压制语言特定特征以减少 code-switching，RL 时 steering 重复相关特征来合成少见的负样本 rollout。
summary.experiments: 给出的内容强调应用验证而非单一 benchmark 数字。主要结果包括：feature-level intervention 可以在不改模型权重的情况下改变输出行为；feature coverage 可用于分析评测集之间的重叠和冗余；SAE 特征可迁移到数据分类与安全数据合成；在 SFT 中加入抑制语言特定特征的辅助损失可减少 code-switching；在 RL 中利用重复相关特征合成负例，为 endless repetition 提供更明确的训练信号。具体指标、层选择、字典规模、稀疏度和消融数字需要看正文表格和附录。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 分钟，若准备复现实验则再细读训练细节。优先看 Section 2，确认 SAE 覆盖的模型、层、训练数据、稀疏约束和重构质量。然后选择性阅读 Section 3 的 steering、Section 4 的 feature coverage 评测分析、Section 7–8 的 SFT/RL 应用。对预训练研究员更有用的是 feature coverage 能否成为数据覆盖代理指标，以及特征级辅助损失是否会引入能力副作用。

summary_en.core_problem: The work turns sparse autoencoders from a post-hoc interpretability tool into a practical interface for developing Qwen-family language models. It aims to use sparse features not only to inspect activations, but also to steer behavior, analyze evaluations, build data workflows, and guide post-training.
summary_en.importance: The relevance is mainly in mechanistic analysis and the pretrain-posttrain feedback loop. If SAE features are stable and reusable, they can serve as a representation-level API for model debugging: identifying behavioral causes, measuring benchmark coverage, filtering or synthesizing data, and creating more targeted SFT or RL signals. This is not a new pretraining method, but it is useful infrastructure for model development.
summary_en.technical_approach: Qwen-Scope releases 14 groups of SAEs across 7 Qwen3 and Qwen3.5 variants, covering both dense and mixture-of-experts backbones. Each SAE learns an overcomplete sparse dictionary that reconstructs internal activations with a small number of active latent features. The paper then demonstrates four use cases: inference-time feature steering for language, concepts, and preferences; feature coverage as a proxy for benchmark overlap and redundancy; data-centric workflows such as multilingual toxicity classification and safety-oriented data synthesis; and post-training interventions, including an SFT auxiliary loss that suppresses language-specific features to reduce code-switching and an RL workflow that steers repetition-related features to create rare negative rollouts.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content describes a broad application suite rather than a single numerical result. The reported findings are that feature-level interventions can steer behavior without changing weights, feature coverage can expose redundancy and representational concentration in evaluation sets, SAE features can support data classification and safety data synthesis, and feature-guided losses or rollouts can be used in SFT and RL. Exact metrics, dictionary sizes, sparsity settings, reconstruction losses, and ablation results should be checked in the corresponding tables and appendices.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30 minutes. Start with Section 2 to inspect the released SAE coverage, training setup, activation sites, sparsity choices, and reconstruction quality. Then read Section 3 for steering, Section 4 for feature coverage over benchmarks, and Sections 7–8 for SFT and RL applications. For pretraining researchers, the most relevant questions are whether feature coverage can act as a proxy for data or benchmark coverage, and whether feature-level auxiliary objectives introduce hidden capability trade-offs.

recommendation.zh: 更像工具链论文，不会直接改你的 pretrain prior；但如果你在做 SAE/feature steering，只看资源覆盖、MoE 支持和几个开发用例就够了。
recommendation.en: This is more tooling than new science, so it will not shift your pretraining prior; still, if you care about SAEs or feature steering, check the asset coverage, MoE support, and a few concrete development use cases.

paper.title: When Are Experts Misrouted? Counterfactual Routing Analysis in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models route each token to a small subset of experts, but whether the routes selected by a trained top-$k$ router are good ones is rarely evaluated directly. Holding the model fixed, we compare each standard route against sampled equal-compute alternatives for the same token and score each by the next-token probability it assigns to the realized token in a verified reasoning trajectory. The result is sharply token-conditional: the standard router is well-aligned

summary.core_problem: 验证MoE LLM现有top-k路由选择的路径是否为最优，揭示路由训练机制的结构性缺陷
summary.importance: 原理分析+范式修正类贡献，首次通过反事实对比实验验证了MoE路由在难推理token上的普遍失效，直指现有路由训练的核心问题
summary.technical_approach: 固定MoE模型所有参数，对每个token对比标准路由选择的路径和相同计算量的采样路径，用下一个token的预测概率作为路径效用的评价指标，量化路由选择的优劣
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B、GPT-OSS-20B、DeepSeek-V2-Lite、OLMoE-1B-7B四个主流MoE模型上验证：高置信度token的路由选择与效用对齐度高，而支撑难推理的脆弱token上，标准路由未选择最优路径，存在等计算量下损失更低的路径；该问题源于现有路由训练仅评估已执行路径的损失，负载均衡仅依赖聚合路由统计的结构性缺陷
summary.authors_note: POSTECH与微软亚洲研究院联合研究，MSRA Wei Chen为核心作者，其为大模型预训练领域资深研究员

summary_en.core_problem: Verify whether the paths selected by existing top-k routers in MoE LLMs are optimal, and reveal structural defects of routing training mechanisms
summary_en.importance: Principle analysis + paradigm correction contribution, first verifies the universal failure of MoE routing on hard reasoning tokens via counterfactual comparison experiments, pointing directly to the core problem of existing routing training
summary_en.technical_approach: Fix all parameters of the MoE model, compare the path selected by standard routing with sampled paths of equal compute cost for each token, use the next token prediction probability as the evaluation metric of path utility to quantify the quality of routing selection
summary_en.experiments: Verified on four mainstream MoE models: Qwen3-30B-A3B, GPT-OSS-20B, DeepSeek-V2-Lite, OLMoE-1B-7B: routing selection for high-confidence tokens is well aligned with utility, while for fragile tokens supporting hard reasoning, standard routing does not select the optimal path, and paths with lower loss under equal compute cost exist; this problem stems from the structural defect that existing routing training only evaluates the loss of executed paths, and load balancing only relies on aggregate routing statistics
summary_en.authors_note: Joint research from POSTECH and Microsoft Research Asia, core author Wei Chen from MSRA is a senior researcher in large model pretraining field
