paper.title: EMO: Pretraining Mixture of Experts for Emergent Modularity
paper.abstract: Large language models are typically deployed as monolithic systems, requiring the full model even when applications need only a narrow subset of capabilities, e.g., code, math, or domain-specific knowledge. Mixture-of-Experts (MoEs) seemingly offer a potential alternative by activating only a subset of experts per input, but in practice, restricting inference to a subset of experts for a given domain leads to severe performance degradation. This limits their practicality in memory-constrained se

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很具体、也很少被正面处理的 MoE 预训练问题：现有 MoE 虽然推理时每个 token 只激活少量 expert，但在一个完整任务或文档上，路由会把几乎所有 expert 都逐步用到，因此模型在部署上仍然接近“必须加载整模型”。这使 MoE 的稀疏激活优势难以转化为真正的模块化使用能力。作者要做的不是再提高 MoE 的平均性能，而是让 expert 子集能够被独立使用、还能彼此组合成完整通用模型。难点在于，若直接按人工定义的领域去切 expert，会引入标签依赖、限制泛化，也容易伤害整体能力；若沿用标准 token-level routing，expert 又会自然分化到标点、介词等低层模式，无法形成可部署的语义模块。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把“模块化”从后处理或部署技巧，前移成预训练目标本身，讨论的是 MoE 应该学出什么结构，而不只是如何更省 FLOPs。第二，它给出一个不依赖人工 domain label 的自监督方案，只用 document boundary 作为弱监督，就让 expert specialization 从词法/句法层面转向更高层的主题和领域层面，这对理解 MoE 路由到底在学什么很有价值。第三，它把 MoE 的一个长期痛点讲清楚了：标准 MoE 的稀疏性不等于可裁剪性，而 Emo 试图让“稀疏激活”进一步变成“可独立部署的子模型”。如果这个方向成立，后续会直接影响内存受限部署、按能力增量扩展、定向继续训练、可解释调试等一整串问题。贡献量级上，它不是在已有 MoE 上做小修小补，而是在预训练目标和路由约束上提出了新的设计点，并且在 1T token、14B total/1B active 这个量级上验证。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把 document 作为路由共享单位，而不是让每个 token 在全体 expert 上自由选择。具体做法是：模型总共有很多 expert，例如 128 个，总激活数 top-k 为 8；但对同一篇 document，router 先为它选出一个共享 expert pool，例如 32 个 expert，文档内所有 token 只能在这 32 个里再做 top-k 选择。这样做的目的不是硬编码“这篇文档属于某个领域”，而是利用一个较弱但普遍成立的假设：同一文档中的 token 往往在语义上更一致，因此应该依赖相近的 expert 子集。

这个设计和标准 MoE 的关键区别有两点。第一，标准 MoE 的路由粒度是 token 级、候选空间是全局 expert 集合，容易让不同 token 因局部词法特征走向不同 expert，最终一个任务会覆盖大量 expert；Emo 先加了文档级共享池约束，把路由自由度从“全局任意选”收缩到“文档内共享候选集”，从而鼓励 recurring expert subsets 在训练语料中反复出现。第二，和 FlexOlmo、BTX 这类显式按领域切分 expert 的方法不同，Emo 不需要预定义 math/code/biology 之类标签，也不把 expert 绑定到固定人工类别，而是让模块结构从数据里自发形成。

从机制上看，这个约束改变了 expert specialization 的压力来源。标准 MoE 中，expert 更容易因为高频局部模式而分工，例如标点、功能词、位置相关模式，因为这些模式在 token 级 routing 下最稳定、最容易被 router 捕捉。Emo 把文档内 token 的候选 expert 集合绑定在一起后，单个 token 的局部差异不再足以驱动完全不同的路由，router 更有动力按文档级统计规律组织 expert，于是 specialization 更可能落在 topic/domain 这类跨 token 持续存在的高层因素上。论文强调，这种更高语义粒度的 specialization 正是 modularity 的来源。

从训练目标上，Emo 仍然保持 MoE 语言模型的主干训练方式，重点不是改 loss 形式，而是改 routing constraint。也就是说，它试图在不牺牲 full-model 通用性能的前提下，给 MoE 增加一个结构归纳偏置：同域 token 共享更相近的 expert 子空间。这个取舍很重要，因为如果模块化是靠强监督硬切出来的，往往会损失组合后的整体能力；Emo 的目标是 full model 仍然强，同时子集也可用。
summary.experiments:
实验规模是这篇工作的一个重要支点：作者训练了一个 14B total、1B active 的 Emo，并在 1 trillion tokens 上预训练，同时给出同数据、同规模的标准 MoE baseline。主结果有两部分。

第一，作为完整模型使用时，Emo 的整体性能与标准 MoE 基本匹配。这一点很关键，因为它说明文档级共享 expert pool 并没有明显破坏 MoE 作为通用基座模型的能力。若 full-model 性能明显掉点，这个方法就更像部署特化模型，而不是通用预训练方案。

第二，也是论文最核心的结果：在只保留部分 expert 的受限部署设置下，Emo 的性能下降显著更小。作者在 MMLU 和 MMLU-Pro 的领域子集上做 expert subset identification 与部署，例如数学、物理、生物、社会科学等。结果显示，只保留 25% 的 expert 时，Emo 仅约 1 个百分点绝对性能下降；只保留 12.5% expert 时，下降约 3 个百分点。对照的标准 MoE 在相同约束下分别下降约 10 和 15 个百分点。这个差距已经不是轻微改进，而是说明两类模型的 expert 组织方式完全不同：标准 MoE 的 expert 子集不可独立用，Emo 的子集则在相当程度上可独立部署。

论文还做了路由分析，结论是 Emo 的 expert subset 更倾向于按高层语义主题聚类，例如 math、code 等，而标准 MoE 更容易出现低层 syntactic/lexical specialization，例如 prepositions、punctuation。这个分析不是装饰性的，它直接解释了为什么标准 MoE 在裁掉大部分 expert 后会崩：因为它的能力分散在很多细碎、跨任务共享的低层 expert 上；而 Emo 把同域能力更集中地组织进可复用的子集。

从摘要可见的数字之外，阅读正文时应特别留意作者如何定义“最相关 expert”的选择方式，以及 subset selection 是基于开发集统计、路由频率还是其他启发式。如果选择过程很复杂，部署价值会打折；如果选择过程简单且稳定，方法的实用性会更强。另一个值得看的是不同 pool size、top-k、expert 总数对 modularity 与 full-model performance 的权衡，这类消融通常能说明模块化究竟来自文档约束本身，还是来自更强的容量瓶颈。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先抓三处。第一是 Introduction 和方法图，重点看作者如何把“MoE 稀疏但不可裁剪”这个问题定义清楚，以及 document-level shared pool 为什么比人工 domain partition 更合理。第二是方法部分里关于 shared expert pool 的正式定义，尤其要看 pool size、token-level top-k、load balancing 之类训练细节如何兼容；这里决定了方法到底是轻量约束还是几乎改写了整个路由机制。第三是实验中 subset deployment 的主表和 routing analysis 图，这两部分共同回答“有没有模块化”和“模块化来自哪里”。

精读时建议带着三个问题看。1）full-model 几乎不掉性能，靠的是什么：是 pool 仍然足够大，还是训练中保留了足够的 token-level灵活性；2）expert subset 的识别是否需要任务标签或额外搜索，如果需要很多人工参与，模块化价值会下降；3）Emo 学到的是稳定的语义模块，还是只是在特定 benchmark 上碰巧可裁剪。若正文里有跨数据集、跨任务的 subset transfer 结果，那部分尤其值得深挖。

预计值得花较多时间读方法和分析章节，而不是只看主结果表。真正有启发的地方不在“保留 25% expert 还能跑”，而在作者如何通过一个很弱的结构约束，把 expert specialization 从低层模式推向高层语义组织。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode of current MoE pretraining: sparse activation at the token level does not translate into modular deployability at the task level. In standard MoEs, different tokens within the same document or task route to many different experts, so serving a narrow capability still requires loading nearly the whole expert set. The goal here is not merely to improve average benchmark performance, but to pretrain an MoE whose expert subsets can be used independently for a domain and still compose into a strong general-purpose model. The challenge is that explicit domain partitioning requires human labels and can overconstrain learning, while unconstrained token-level routing tends to produce low-level lexical/syntactic specialization rather than reusable semantic modules.
summary_en.importance: This matters for pretraining research in three ways. First, it treats modularity as a pretraining objective rather than a downstream deployment trick. That is a meaningful shift in how MoEs are designed. Second, it offers a self-supervised route to semantic expert organization using only document boundaries as weak supervision, avoiding manually defined domains such as math or code. Third, it clarifies an important distinction: sparsity is not the same as subset usability. Standard MoEs are sparse in compute, but not naturally decomposable into independently deployable capability blocks. Emo is an attempt to close that gap. If this line of work holds up, it has implications for memory-constrained serving, targeted extension training, continual capability updates, and interpretability of expert specialization. The contribution is substantial because it changes the routing structure during pretraining and validates the idea at 1T-token scale with a 14B-total / 1B-active model.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core idea is to make routing partially document-conditioned rather than fully token-global. In a standard MoE, each token selects its top-k experts from the full expert set. In Emo, each document first gets a shared expert pool, and every token in that document can only choose its active experts from that pool. For example, with 128 total experts and top-8 activation, a document may be assigned a pool of 32 experts, and all tokens in that document must select their 8 active experts from those 32. Different documents can use different pools.

This changes the inductive bias of routing. Standard token-level routing has enough freedom that experts often specialize in frequent local patterns such as punctuation, function words, or other low-level lexical cues. Those are easy for the router to detect and reward, but they do not produce deployable modules. Emo constrains that freedom by tying the candidate expert set across all tokens in a document. Since documents tend to be semantically coherent, the router is pushed to organize experts around document-level regularities rather than token-local quirks. Recurrent expert subsets can then emerge across the corpus without any explicit domain labels.

This is different from prior domain-partitioned MoEs such as approaches that assign experts to predefined categories like code or biology. Those methods rely on human priors and fixed taxonomies. Emo instead uses document boundaries as weak supervision and lets the modular structure emerge from data. The training objective remains that of an MoE language model; the main intervention is the routing constraint, not a fundamentally new LM loss. That design choice is important: the method tries to preserve full-model generality while inducing subset-level modularity, rather than trading one for the other through hard specialization.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental setup is large enough to make the claims meaningful: the authors train a 14B-total, 1B-active Emo model on 1 trillion tokens, alongside a matched standard MoE baseline trained on the same data. The first key result is that as a full model, Emo matches the baseline MoE in overall performance. This is essential, because it shows the document-level shared-pool constraint does not significantly damage the model’s utility as a general-purpose pretrained LM.

The second and central result is subset deployment. On domain-specific subsets of MMLU and MMLU-Pro, including areas such as math, physics, biology, and social sciences, the authors identify relevant expert subsets and evaluate the model while retaining only a fraction of experts. Emo loses only about 1 absolute point when keeping 25% of experts, and about 3 points when keeping 12.5%. The matched standard MoE drops by roughly 10 and 15 points under the same constraints. That gap is large enough to indicate a qualitative difference in how expertise is organized, not just a mild robustness improvement.

The routing analysis is also important. Emo’s experts appear to specialize at higher semantic granularity, such as topic or domain, whereas standard MoE experts are more associated with low-level syntactic or lexical patterns like punctuation and prepositions. This analysis directly supports the modularity claim: if expertise is concentrated into semantically coherent subsets, partial deployment becomes viable; if it is scattered across many low-level experts, it does not.

When reading the full paper, it is worth checking how the “relevant experts” are selected at evaluation time. If subset identification depends on heavy supervision or expensive search, the deployment story weakens. If it is simple and stable, the practical value is much stronger. The ablations around pool size, number of active experts, and total expert count are also likely to be informative, because they reveal whether modularity comes from the document-level constraint itself or from a stronger capacity bottleneck.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the main method figure. The paper is strongest when it explains why standard MoEs are sparse yet still not modular in a deployable sense. Then read the formal method section carefully, especially the definition of the shared expert pool and how it interacts with token-level top-k routing and standard MoE training machinery such as balancing. That is where the actual design trade-off lives.

After that, go straight to the subset-deployment results and the routing-analysis figures. Those two parts answer the two central questions: whether modularity is achieved, and what kind of specialization supports it. While reading, keep three questions in mind. First, why does full-model performance remain intact despite the routing restriction? Second, how much supervision or search is needed to identify the right expert subset at inference time? Third, do the learned subsets transfer beyond the exact evaluation domains used in the paper?

The most valuable sections are not the headline tables alone, but the mechanism and analysis sections. The real contribution is the shift in expert specialization from low-level token patterns to higher-level semantic organization under a weak document-level routing constraint.

recommendation.zh: EMO提出的文档级专家约束是MoE训练中一个简洁有力的想法——如果效果成立，可能同时解决MoE推理时的专家子集可用性和专家可解释性两个问题。建议在内部MoE ablation中验证此约束。
recommendation.en: The document-level expert constraint in EMO is a simple but powerful idea for MoE training — if it holds, it could simultaneously address both expert subset usability at inference and expert interpretability. Worth testing in internal MoE ablations.

paper.title: UniPool: A Globally Shared Expert Pool for Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Modern Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures allocate expert capacity through a rigid per-layer rule: each transformer layer owns a separate expert set. This convention couples depth scaling with linear expert-parameter growth and assumes that every layer needs isolated expert capacity. However, recent analyses and our routing probe challenge this allocation rule: replacing a deeper layer's learned top-k router with uniform random routing drops downstream accuracy by only 1.0-1.6 points across

summary.core_problem: UniPool 解决的是 MoE 的专家容量分配问题：标准 MoE 把专家绑定到每一层，层数增加会线性增加专家参数，但深层专家和路由可能存在明显冗余。论文把问题从“每层该放多少专家”改成“整个网络共享一个专家预算，哪些层按需访问这些专家”。核心挑战不在共享本身，而在共享后如何避免专家死亡、路由尺度不稳、以及不同层争抢同一专家池导致训练退化。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对 MoE 预训练有直接参考价值。它挑战了一个默认设计：专家必须是 layer-private。结果显示，专家容量可以作为全局预算管理，而不必和深度线性绑定。这个贡献的量级不只是压缩参数；它给 MoE scaling 提供了一个新的自由度：在固定激活 FLOPs 下，可以把参数预算从“随层均匀铺开”改成“跨层复用”。如果结果在更大 token 量和更大模型上成立，MoE 的参数扩展曲线会从按层线性增长转向更接近子线性增长。对基座预训练来说，这会影响模型深度、专家数、激活专家数、路由负载均衡 loss 的联合设计。
summary.technical_approach: UniPool 用一个全局共享专家池替代每层私有专家集合。每个 MoE 层仍然保留独立 router，因此不同深度可以学习不同的路由策略；但所有 router 都从同一批专家中选择 top-k 专家。这个设计保留了层条件化 routing，同时允许同一个专家在多个深度被复用。关键改动有两点。第一是 pool-level auxiliary loss。标准 MoE 的负载均衡 loss 在每层内部计算，目标是让该层的私有专家都被使用。共享专家池后，这个目标会变得不合适：某个专家不被某层使用，不代表它是死专家；强迫每一层都覆盖全部共享专家，反而会破坏跨层复用和层级特化。UniPool 改为跨层聚合 token-to-expert 分配，在全局专家池粒度上做负载均衡，只约束专家整体不被饿死。第二是使用 NormRouter。普通 softmax router 在不同层面对同一个大专家池时，hidden state 尺度差异会变成 routing sharpness 差异，训练中容易出现某些层路由过尖或过平。NormRouter 采用 L2 normalization 加 ReLU scoring，并带 learnable scale。归一化降低层间尺度差异，ReLU 在大专家池中提供稀疏竞争，learnable scale 让每层可调节路由强度。与后验专家剪枝或专家合并不同，UniPool 是训练时架构改动，不是训练后的压缩补丁。
summary.experiments: 论文先给出一个重要动机实验：在 Qwen1.5-MoE、DeepSeek-V2-Lite、Qwen3-30B-A3B 三个生产级 MoE 上，把深层某一个 MoE 层的 learned top-k router 替换成 uniform random routing，并在 deep-half 层逐层扫描。平均下游准确率只下降 1.0 到 1.6 个点。这个结果说明，至少在深层同层专家之间，router 对专家身份的精细选择没有预期中那么关键。主实验覆盖五个模型规模，每个模型训练 30B tokens。UniPool 相比 vanilla layer-wise MoE 持续更好；更重要的是，缩小共享专家池后，只使用 vanilla expert-parameter budget 的 41.6% 到 66.7%，仍能匹配或超过标准 MoE。论文还强调 pool-level balancing 与 NormRouter 是配套设计：如果仍使用层内均衡，会强迫每层使用所有共享专家；如果使用普通 softmax router，跨层共享池会放大不同层 logit scale 的不一致。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读三处。第一，动机部分和 Table 1：routing randomization probe 是判断这篇工作是否成立的关键证据，需要看它如何选择层、任务和平均方式。第二，方法部分中 pool-level auxiliary loss 的定义：重点看统计量是如何跨层聚合的，是否按 token、层数或 batch 做归一化，以及它和 capacity factor、top-k dispatch 的关系。第三，NormRouter 与共享专家池的消融：这决定 UniPool 是单纯共享参数有效，还是必须依赖 routing/co-design 才稳定。实验部分建议重点看五个 scale 的曲线、减少专家池大小后的质量-参数权衡、每层实际访问专家子集的可视化。如果有路由熵、专家利用率、跨层专家重用矩阵，这些图比单点 benchmark 分数更能说明机制。值得深挖的问题是：共享专家是否学到跨层通用变换，还是只是被不同层以不同输入分布复用；以及在更长训练、更大 token 预算下，共享池是否会出现早期优势消失或专家过度耦合。

summary_en.core_problem: UniPool addresses expert-capacity allocation in MoE Transformers. Standard MoE assigns a private expert set to every layer, so expert parameters grow linearly with depth. The paper argues that this rule is unnecessarily rigid, especially when deeper-layer routing and same-layer experts show substantial redundancy. The goal is to turn expert capacity into a global budget that all layers can access, while keeping layer-specific routing decisions.
summary_en.importance: The work is directly relevant to MoE pretraining design. Its main contribution is not just parameter reduction; it changes a default scaling assumption. Expert capacity does not have to be owned by depth. A shared expert pool creates another scaling axis: depth, active FLOPs, number of routers, and total expert parameters can be adjusted more independently. If the result holds at larger training budgets, it suggests a path toward sublinear expert-parameter growth with depth, which is important for training and serving large sparse models.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniPool replaces layer-private expert sets with a single globally shared expert pool. Each MoE layer still has its own router, so routing remains depth-conditioned, but all routers select from the same pool. Two design choices make this viable. First, the auxiliary load-balancing loss is moved from the layer level to the pool level. In conventional MoE, each layer balances its own private experts to avoid dead experts. With a shared pool, that objective is misaligned: an expert can be unused by one layer but heavily used by others. UniPool aggregates token-to-expert assignments across layers and balances utilization at the level where parameters are actually owned, namely the global pool. Second, the model uses NormRouter rather than a standard softmax router. Since routers at different depths compete over the same larger pool, layer-dependent hidden-state scales can create inconsistent routing sharpness. NormRouter uses L2 normalization, ReLU scoring, and a learnable scale, which reduces scale sensitivity, encourages sparse competition, and lets each layer tune routing strength during training. This differs from post-hoc expert pruning or merging because the sharing is built into pretraining.
summary_en.experiments: The paper first motivates the design with a routing-randomization probe on Qwen1.5-MoE, DeepSeek-V2-Lite, and Qwen3-30B-A3B. Replacing the learned top-k router in a single deep-half MoE layer with uniform random routing reduces downstream accuracy by only 1.0 to 1.6 points on average. This indicates that, in deeper layers, the exact choice among same-layer experts is less critical than the standard architecture assumes. The main experiments train five model scales on 30B tokens. UniPool consistently improves over vanilla layer-wise MoE. Reduced-pool variants using only 41.6% to 66.7% of the vanilla expert-parameter budget still match or outperform the layer-wise baseline. The reported ablations point to a co-design effect: pool-level balancing is needed because layer-level balancing conflicts with cross-layer reuse, while NormRouter stabilizes routing into a shared large pool.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the motivation and Table 1 carefully first. The routing-randomization probe is the empirical basis for questioning layer-private experts. Then focus on the formulation of the pool-level auxiliary loss: how assignments are aggregated across layers, how normalization is handled, and how it interacts with top-k dispatch and capacity constraints. The NormRouter ablation is the next important part, because it separates parameter sharing from routing stability. In the experiments, prioritize the five-scale training results, reduced-pool comparisons, expert-utilization statistics, routing entropy, and any cross-layer expert-reuse visualizations. The most useful follow-up questions are whether shared experts learn genuinely reusable transformations across depth, whether longer training changes the reuse pattern, and whether large-scale MoE pretraining sees expert coupling or specialization collapse.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看 router probe 和共享池消融；若结果站得住，会改变“每层必须有私有专家”的默认架构 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the router probe and shared-pool ablations first; if clean, this weakens the default prior that every MoE layer needs private experts.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Federation of Experts: Communication Efficient Distributed Inference for Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Mixture of experts has emerged as the primary mechanism for making Large Language Models (LLMs) computationally efficient. However, in distributed settings, communicating token embeddings between experts is a significant bottleneck.   We present the novel Federation of Experts (FoE) architecture. FoE restructures the MoE block of a transformer layer into multiple MoE clusters. Each cluster is responsible for only one of the KV heads and expert parallelism is applied between those experts. Betwee

summary.core_problem: 在分布式 MoE 推理中，expert parallelism 需要 all-to-all dispatch/collect，跨节点网络带宽成为主要瓶颈；目标是在不明显损伤生成质量的前提下，把高代价的 all-to-all 通信结构性地限制在更小的局部范围内，从而降低 TTFT/TBT 并提升吞吐。
summary.importance: 这是推理系统/并行策略层面的工作，不属于预训练方法，但对“MoE 架构如何与硬件拓扑共设计”很有现实价值。它给出一种结构性改造：把 MoE block 拆成多个与 KV head 绑定的专家簇，用更便宜的跨簇同步替代全局 all-to-all。对做大规模 MoE 训练/推理的人来说，启发在于：路由空间不必全局共享；把路由约束到局部子空间，可能换来显著的通信收益，而质量损失可控。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Federation of Experts (FoE)：
- 将一个 transformer layer 的注意力与 MoE FFN 重构为 H 个相互独立的 MoE groups/clusters。
- 每个 group 拥有 1/H 的 KV heads 与 1/H 的 experts，并在该 group 内做 expert parallelism；token 在每个 group 内独立选择 k/H 个 experts（per-group routing），而不是在全体 experts 上做一次全局 top-k。
- 各 group 的 post-attention residual 通过一次相对轻量的跨组 all-reduce 求和/同步，形成下一层路由所需的共享输入；但最昂贵的 dispatch/combine（与 k 成正比的 all-to-all）被严格限制在 group 内。
- 设计目标是提高 Local Activation Rate（专家选择在本地 GPU/本节点内解决的比例），尤其在多节点 InfiniBand 场景下减少跨节点 token 迁移。
从实现角度看，它相当于把“专家维度的并行”与“注意力 KV head 的分片”绑定，并用结构约束换取通信可预测性与负载均衡。
summary.experiments:
论文报告在 LongBench 上做端到端推理评测：
- forward-pass latency 最多降低 5.2×
- TTFT 最多降低 3.62×
- TBT 最多降低 1.95×
并声称在相同规模与训练配置下，生成质量与标准 MoE 相当。
摘要与引言还提到：单机可完全消除 all-to-all（因为每组专家都落在同一 GPU 内），多机将 all-to-all 限制在组内，从而把跨节点通信压到更小。精读时需要核对：对比基线的 MoE 具体实现（路由、capacity factor、top-k）、硬件拓扑（节点数/链路）、batch/seq 长度设置，以及“质量相当”的量化指标。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
1) 先看架构图与并行/通信分析：FoE 如何把全局 all-to-all 变成组内 all-to-all + 组间 all-reduce。
2) 再看实验设置：单机 vs 多机的通信量分解、TTFT/TBT 的测量方法、LongBench 的上下文长度与 batch 策略。
预计 20–30 分钟可判断是否适合自家 MoE serving；若要落地，需要进一步看实现细节（路由约束对负载/质量的影响、与现有 EP/TP/PP 的组合方式）。

summary_en.core_problem: Distributed MoE inference is dominated by all-to-all token dispatch/collect in expert parallelism, especially across nodes where network bandwidth is far below intra-node interconnect. The goal is to restructure MoE so expensive communication is localized while preserving generation quality.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference/parallelism paper rather than a pretraining-method contribution, but it is highly relevant for anyone operating large MoE models. The key takeaway is architectural co-design with topology: you can constrain routing to local subspaces (instead of global top-k over all experts) and trade a small structural restriction for large, predictable communication savings.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Federation of Experts (FoE) partitions a transformer layer into H independent MoE clusters:
- Each cluster owns 1/H of the KV heads and 1/H of the experts.
- Routing is performed per cluster: each token selects k/H experts within every cluster, replacing a single global top-k over all experts.
- After attention, clusters synchronize post-attention residuals via a relatively cheap cross-cluster all-reduce (sum), which then feeds routing for the next MoE block.
- The expensive k-proportional all-to-all dispatch/combine is confined within each cluster, increasing the Local Activation Rate and reducing cross-node traffic.
Conceptually, it binds expert partitioning to KV-head partitioning and uses structural constraints to enforce locality and load balance.
summary_en.experiments: On LongBench, they report up to 5.2× reduction in end-to-end forward-pass latency, 3.62× improvement in time-to-first-token, and 1.95× improvement in time-between-tokens, with comparable generation quality to a standard MoE model under the same size/training configuration. For a serious evaluation, you’d want to verify: baseline MoE implementation details (routing, capacity), hardware topology and node count, batch/sequence settings, and how “comparable quality” is quantified.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in this order: (1) the architecture/communication diagrams and the argument turning global all-to-all into intra-cluster all-to-all + inter-cluster all-reduce; (2) the communication breakdown and TTFT/TBT measurement methodology; (3) the quality comparison protocol. ~20–30 minutes to assess fit for a serving stack; more time if you plan to integrate with existing EP/TP/PP setups.

recommendation.zh: MoE推理通信优化的聪明架构方案，将KV头分组与专家路由解耦设计值得一读，对大规模MoE推理部署有实际参考价值
recommendation.en: Clever architecture for MoE inference communication optimization; the KV-head grouping decoupled from expert routing design is worth reading, with practical value for large-scale MoE inference deployment

paper.title: LAWS: Learning from Actual Workloads Symbolically -- A Self-Certifying Parametrized Cache Architecture for Neural Inference, Robotics, and Edge Deployment
paper.abstract: We introduce LAWS (Learning from Actual Workloads Symbolically), a self-certifying inference caching architecture that builds a growing library of certified expert functions from deployment observations. Each expert covers a region of input space defined by a node in the Probabilistic Language Trie (PLT) of the base model and carries a formal error bound holding uniformly over all inputs. The central result is a self-certification theorem: for any input x, the LAWS approximation error is bounded

summary.core_problem: 解决神经网络推理中如何利用真实部署流量构建可验证缓存，以减少重复计算并控制近似误差的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理缓存架构和形式化误差分析。论文试图把 MoE、KV prefix caching 和部署期专家函数学习放在同一框架下，对推理系统设计有参考意义，但摘要层面的主张偏理论化，需要看实验是否支撑。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LAWS，通过部署观测逐步构建一组带误差证书的 expert functions。每个 expert 覆盖由基础模型 Probabilistic Language Trie 节点定义的输入区域，并给出误差界 epsilon_fit + 2*Lambda(W)*C_E，其中 Lambda(W) 是 Lipschitz 常数，C_E 是最大 embedding diameter。它声称在部署时无需 ground truth 即可检查误差证书。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要给出定理性结果：self-certification theorem、monotone hit rate theorem，以及 LAWS 对 MoE 和 KV prefix caching 的泛化关系。未提供具体 LLM、机器人或边缘部署实验规模和速度/质量数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how neural inference can reuse actual deployment workloads through certified caches while bounding approximation error.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-caching and formal-analysis contribution. It attempts to unify MoE-style specialization, KV prefix caching, and online expert construction, which is conceptually relevant to serving systems, though the abstract reads more theorem-heavy than empirically grounded.
summary_en.technical_approach: LAWS builds a growing library of certified expert functions from deployment observations. Each expert covers an input region represented by a node in the base model's Probabilistic Language Trie and carries a checkable error bound, epsilon_fit + 2*Lambda(W)*C_E, based on fitting error, a Lipschitz constant, and embedding diameter.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports theoretical results, including a self-certification theorem, a monotone hit-rate theorem, and claims that LAWS generalizes MoE and KV prefix caching. It does not provide concrete LLM sizes, workloads, latency numbers, or quality trade-offs.

recommendation.zh: 概念有意思但像未落地的系统理论；只看误差界和 MoE/KV-cache 泛化声明即可。
recommendation.en: Conceptually interesting but theory-forward; read only the error bound and the claimed MoE/KV-cache generalization.

paper.title: ZeRO-Prefill: Zero Redundancy Overheads in MoE Prefill Serving
paper.abstract: Production LLM workloads increasingly serve discriminative tasks, such as classification, recommendation, and verification, whose answers are read from the logits of a single prefill pass with no autoregressive decoding. Serving these prefill-only workloads on mixture-of-experts (MoE) models is bottlenecked not by compute but by the distributed execution required to fit the model: existing parallel strategies (tensor, expert, and pipeline parallelism) trade memory pressure for redundant computat

summary.core_problem: 现有MoE模型部署仅需单轮前向的判别类任务（分类、内容审核、推荐等）时，解码时代遗留的专家放置与同步激活路由耦合设计，会产生计算、内存、通信三类冗余，8卡A100上MFU（模型FLOPs利用率）低于16%，多卡扩展时性能甚至出现下降。
summary.importance: 1. 首次明确生产集群中prefill-only任务占总服务输入token的65.3%，填补了MoE预训练后部署适配不同负载的认知空白；2. 提出的AsyncEP范式打破了传统专家并行的设计惯性，为大参数MoE的部署优化提供了全新方向；3. 硬件适配范围扩大4倍，吞吐量提升35%以上，直接降低大MoE模型的落地成本。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是异步专家并行（AsyncEP），将每层激活路由的同步AllToAll通信替换为后台专家权重的AllGather操作，与计算流程重叠，可选支持CPU-DRAM卸载。基于硬件、负载、模型配置推导饱和阈值T作为单卡batch规则，前端实现前缀感知路由、真实FLOPs计算跟踪，前后端协同消除三类冗余：计算冗余（路由不均衡拖尾、GEMM算子不饱和）、内存冗余（全量专家权重驻留、前缀KV缓存重复）、通信冗余（每层同步AllToAll开销）。
summary.experiments: 基于vLLM实现，在8×A100 BF16、8×H100 BF16/FP8、8×H200 FP8四类硬件配置上，对比vLLM支持的5种分布式MoE策略：1. 真实prefill负载下端到端吞吐量比最优基线高1.35~1.37倍，长上下文合成负载下最高达1.59倍；2. Qwen3-235B-A22B的部署门槛从≥4卡降低到1~8卡，硬件适配范围扩大4倍；3. 单卡MFU稳定在29.8%~36.2%，远高于基线的16%以下水平。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注§3 prefill-only负载特征分析、§4 MoE预填充瓶颈量化分析、§6 AsyncEP核心设计章节，以及图1生产负载占比统计、§8不同硬件下的性能对比图表。可深挖的方向包括AsyncEP与预训练阶段MoE路由设计的协同优化空间、多任务混合负载下的适配方案。

summary_en.core_problem: When deploying MoE models for prefill-only discriminative tasks (classification, content moderation, recommendation, etc.), the legacy design coupling expert placement and synchronous activation routing inherited from the decoding era causes three types of redundancy in computation, memory and communication, leading to MFU below 16% on 8×A100, and even performance regression when scaling to more GPUs.
summary_en.importance: 1. It first reports that prefill-only workloads account for 65.3% of total served input tokens in production clusters, filling the gap of understanding MoE workload adaptation for post-pretraining deployment; 2. The proposed AsyncEP paradigm breaks the inertia of traditional expert parallelism design, providing a new direction for deployment optimization of large parameter MoE models; 3. It expands hardware compatibility by 4x and improves throughput by more than 35%, directly reducing the deployment cost of large MoE models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core is Asynchronous Expert Parallelism (AsyncEP), which replaces per-layer activation AllToAll communication with background expert weight AllGather, overlapped with computation and optionally supports CPU-DRAM offloading. A saturation threshold T derived from hardware, workload and model configurations is used as the per-GPU batching rule. The frontend implements prefix-aware routing and true-FLOPs compute tracking, co-designed to eliminate three types of redundancy: computation redundancy (routing imbalance stragglers, unsaturated GEMMs), memory redundancy (full resident expert weights, duplicated prefix KV caches), communication redundancy (synchronous per-layer AllToAll overhead).
summary_en.experiments: Implemented on top of vLLM, tested across 4 hardware/precision configurations (8×A100 BF16, 8×H100 BF16/FP8, 8×H200 FP8), compared with 5 distributed MoE strategies supported by vLLM: 1. End-to-end throughput on real-world prefill workloads is 1.35~1.37x higher than the strongest baseline, up to 1.59x on long-context synthetic workloads; 2. The deployment requirement of Qwen3-235B-A22B is reduced from ≥4 GPUs to 1~8 GPUs, expanding hardware compatibility by 4x; 3. Per-GPU MFU stays at 29.8%~36.2%, far above the baseline level below 16%.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on §3 workload characterization of prefill-only tasks, §4 quantitative analysis of MoE prefill bottlenecks, §6 core design of AsyncEP, Figure 1 production workload distribution, and §8 performance comparison across hardware setups. Worth exploring points include co-optimization space between AsyncEP and MoE routing design during pre-training, adaptation for mixed workloads.

recommendation.zh: 把MoE路由从“必须AllToAll同步激活”这个旧prior里解放出来；只看通信重叠证据和端到端吞吐表就值回票。
recommendation.en: It breaks the old prior that MoE routing must be synchronous activation AllToAll; read the comm-overlap evidence and end-to-end throughput tables.

paper.title: RouteHijack: Routing-Aware Attack on Mixture-of-Experts LLMs
paper.abstract: Safety alignment is critical for the responsible deployment of large language models (LLMs). As Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures are increasingly adopted to scale model capacity, understanding their safety robustness becomes essential. Existing adversarial attacks, however, have notable limitations. Prompt-based jailbreaks rely on heuristic search and transfer poorly, model intervention methods require privileged access to internal representations, and optimization-based input attacks rema

summary.core_problem: 研究 MoE LLM 的安全对齐是否集中在少数专家上，以及攻击者能否通过操控路由来绕过安全行为。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更偏安全攻击，但对做 MoE 预训练和后训练的人有一个具体启发：安全能力可能不是均匀分布在模型中，而是被路由机制局部化。若这一点成立，会影响 MoE 的对齐、鲁棒性和专家专门化理解。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 RouteHijack，一种 routing-aware jailbreak。核心思路是先通过 response-driven expert localization 找到与安全行为强相关的专家，再通过输入优化影响路由决策，尽量避开这些安全关键专家。论文的技术点在于把 MoE 的离散路由当作攻击面，而不是只做输出层面的 prompt jailbreak 或需要内部梯度访问的模型干预。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型、参数规模和攻击成功率数字，但声称现有方法在 MoE 上受限于非可微路由，而本文通过 routing-aware 方法实现更有效攻击。实验应主要比较 prompt-based jailbreak、需要内部访问的方法以及本文方法在 MoE 模型上的攻击效果与迁移性。由于缺少定量细节，当前只能作为机制线索而非强结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Bristol。不是一线大厂 MoE 技术报告，但问题设定与当前大规模采用 MoE 的趋势相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether safety alignment in MoE LLMs is concentrated in a small subset of experts, and whether routing can be manipulated to bypass those safety behaviors.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a safety attack paper, but it carries a concrete implication for MoE pretraining and post-training: safety capabilities may be localized rather than uniformly distributed across experts. If true, that matters for alignment, robustness, and how we think about expert specialization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose RouteHijack, a routing-aware jailbreak attack. The key idea is to first localize experts associated with safety behavior using response-driven expert localization, then optimize inputs to influence routing decisions so the model avoids those safety-critical experts. The novelty is treating discrete MoE routing itself as the attack surface, rather than relying only on prompt jailbreaks or privileged internal interventions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model names, parameter counts, or attack success rates, but claims existing attacks are limited on MoE models because routing is non-differentiable, while the proposed routing-aware method is more effective. The experiments likely compare against prompt-based jailbreaks, internal-access methods, and output-centric optimization attacks on MoE models. Without quantitative details, this is more of a mechanism signal than a firm empirical conclusion.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Bristol. This is not a flagship MoE report from a major lab, but the problem setting is relevant given the growing adoption of MoE architectures.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练主线，但如果你做 MoE 对齐或路由分析，看看它对“安全专家局部化”的证据；结论可能成立，外推到通用能力则要很谨慎。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but if you work on MoE alignment or routing analysis, inspect the evidence for safety-expert localization; plausible signal, but be careful extrapolating it to general capability structure.

paper.title: RaMP: Runtime-Aware Megakernel Polymorphism for Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: The optimal kernel configuration for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference depends on both batch size and the expert routing distribution, yet production systems dispatch from batch size alone, leaving 10-70% of kernel throughput unrealized. We present RaMP, a routing-aware dispatch framework. A performance-region analysis derives, from hardware constants alone, when each optimization helps, correctly predicting all 8 tested architectures, including 3 unseen. A four-parameter wave cost model select

summary.core_problem: 现有生产环境的MoE融合内核调度仅基于batch size选择配置，忽略运行时动态变化的专家路由分布，导致10%~70%的内核吞吐量损失。
summary.importance: 融合FFN内核是MoE模型推理的核心延迟热点，该框架可直接集成到现有推理栈提升MoE服务效率，同时为后续MoE推理动态优化提供了基于硬件特性的成本建模思路。
summary.technical_approach: 首先提出性能区域分析方法，基于硬件常数推导计算密度、L2压力、wave利用率、K归约深度4个性能变量，可适配无先验知识的未知架构；随后设计四参数wave成本模型，基于运行时的专家路由直方图选择最优内核配置，模型仅依赖CTA网格几何参数，与具体内核实现无关，无需修改内核源码即可适配第三方实现。
summary.experiments: 在8种测试架构（含3种未见过的全新架构）上，调度策略与穷举搜索相比平均后悔率仅0.93%，单模型一次性profile耗时仅10~24分钟；集成到vLLM后，在OLMoE上比Triton FP8实现快1.3倍，比DeepGEMM快1.41倍，比FlashInfer CUTLASS实现快1.13倍；无修改适配第三方Alpha-MoE内核时，比其自带JIT调度快1.14倍。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第三章的静态调度性能损失量化分析、第四章的成本模型设计，附录可跳过，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing production MoE fused kernel dispatch systems select configurations solely based on batch size, ignoring runtime dynamic expert routing distributions, leaving 10% to 70% of potential kernel throughput unrealized.
summary_en.importance: The fused FFN kernel is the critical latency hot path for MoE inference. The proposed framework can be directly integrated into existing inference stacks to improve MoE serving efficiency, and provides a hardware-grounded cost modeling methodology for future dynamic MoE inference optimizations.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, a performance region analysis is proposed, deriving four hardware-constant-based performance variables (compute density, L2 pressure, wave utilization, K-reduction depth) that generalize to unseen architectures without prior knowledge. A four-parameter wave cost model is then introduced to select the optimal kernel configuration based on runtime expert routing histograms. The model only depends on CTA grid geometry, so it is kernel-agnostic and requires no source code modification of existing kernels.
summary_en.experiments: The dispatch framework achieves 0.93% mean regret versus exhaustive search across 8 tested architectures (including 3 unseen ones), with only 10-24 minutes of one-time profiling per model. When integrated into vLLM, it delivers 1.30x speedup over Triton FP8, 1.41x over DeepGEMM, 1.13x over FlashInfer CUTLASS on OLMoE. When applied to the third-party Alpha-MoE kernel with no modification, it outperforms its native JIT dispatch by 1.14x.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the quantitative analysis of static dispatch performance loss, and Section 4 for the cost model design. Appendices can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: MoE serving 相关值得扫 §性能模型和实验表；它不改训练，但会影响路由设计的真实成本假设。
recommendation.en: For MoE serving, scan the performance model and tables; it does not change training, but it changes the real cost model behind routing choices.

paper.title: DORA: A Scalable Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning System for Language Model Training
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a critical paradigm for LLM post-training, yet the rollout phase -- accounting for 50--80% of total step time -- is bottlenecked by skewed generation: long-tailed trajectories indispensable for model performance block the entire training pipeline. Asynchronous training offers a natural remedy by overlapping generation with training, but introduces a fundamental tension between efficiency and algorithmic correctness. We identify three constraints in asynchro

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是 LLM 强化学习训练中的 rollout 吞吐瓶颈。同步训练会被最长生成样本卡住，而数学、代码和长 CoT 任务的生成长度分布很偏，99 分位长度可比中位数高一个数量级以上。直接异步化又会引入 stale trajectory，破坏 PPO/GRPO 等算法依赖的策略一致性。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏 post-training system，但对预训练研究员仍有用。原因是大规模 RL 已经成为推理模型训练的重要阶段，rollout 效率会决定可扩展的数据规模、长 CoT 保留率和训练稳定性。DORA 的价值在于把系统吞吐问题写成受算法约束的调度问题：不能为了消除气泡而丢掉长轨迹，也不能让同一条轨迹跨多个 policy version 生成。这个约束视角对 RL pretrain、continual RL、以及大规模 agent 数据生成都有借鉴意义。
summary.technical_approach: DORA 提出 multi-version streaming training。系统同时在 rollout 实例上维护多个 policy version，按轨迹级别流式送入训练，而不是等待整个 batch 的最长样本结束。它显式满足三个约束：C1，同一条 trajectory 必须由同一个 policy version 生成，保留 PPO/GRPO 所需的 intra-trajectory policy consistency；C2，不丢弃长尾轨迹，避免长度偏置采样，尤其是避免丢掉长 CoT；C3，用滑动窗口限制 rollout policy 与训练 policy 之间的版本滞后。系统侧引入集中式 Load-Balancing Orchestrator，动态重分配不同 policy version 的资源，并在实例之间迁移请求。一个关键设计点是：只要 C1 被保留，同一 policy version 下的 KV cache 在数学上等价，因此迁移请求时可以避免重新 prefill。这和 partial rollout 方法不同，后者把长轨迹切到多个权重版本上，能消除气泡，但放松了 C1，并带来 re-prefill 开销；在 MoE 和长上下文下，这个开销会更明显。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的动机数字是：rollout 通常占 RL step 时间的 50%–80%；在数学和代码任务中，99 分位输出长度可超过中位数一个数量级。实验部分应围绕三类指标解读：端到端训练吞吐、rollout 设备利用率和收敛质量。真正需要关注的是 DORA 是否在不丢弃长轨迹、不跨版本生成单条轨迹的前提下减少同步等待；还要看 bounded staleness 的窗口大小如何影响 reward 曲线、KL、policy loss 稳定性和最终任务表现。若实验包含与 one-step off-policy、replication-based over-generation、partial rollout 的比较，重点应放在长尾样本保留率和 re-prefill 开销，而不是只看 token/s。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–40 分钟。先读 Section 3.1 的三个约束 C1–C3，这是整篇的判断框架。再看 Section 3.3 对已有异步方案的拆解，重点比较 one-step off-policy、replication-based 和 partial rollout 的取舍。方法部分重点看 multi-version streaming training、滑动 staleness window、orchestrator 调度和 zero-re-prefill migration。实验部分优先看吞吐-收敛的联合曲线；如果只有吞吐提升而没有 reward/KL 稳定性，结论要谨慎。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the rollout bottleneck in RL training for language models. Synchronous training is blocked by the longest generation in a batch, while math, coding, and long-CoT workloads have heavily skewed length distributions. Naive asynchronous execution improves utilization but creates stale trajectories and can violate policy-consistency assumptions used by PPO and GRPO.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training systems paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model training because large-scale RL now controls the amount and quality of reasoning data a model can learn from. DORA frames asynchronous RL as a constrained systems problem: improve rollout utilization without discarding long trajectories, without generating a single trajectory under multiple policy versions, and without allowing unbounded policy lag. That framing is useful for RL pretraining, continual RL, and large-scale agent-data generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: DORA introduces multi-version streaming training. Rollout workers host multiple policy versions concurrently and stream completed trajectories to training without a batch-level barrier. The design enforces three constraints: C1, each trajectory is generated entirely by one policy version; C2, trajectories are retained rather than dropped, including long-tail CoT samples; and C3, a sliding window bounds staleness between rollout and training policies. A centralized load-balancing orchestrator reallocates resources across policy versions and migrates requests to keep rollout workers utilized. Preserving C1 also enables an important systems optimization: KV-cache states are equivalent across workers hosting the same policy version, so migration can avoid re-prefill. This differs from partial-rollout methods, which split long trajectories across weight updates and reduce waiting time at the cost of relaxing intra-trajectory consistency and adding re-prefill overhead, especially under MoE or long-context settings.
summary_en.experiments: The motivation section reports that rollout often takes 50%–80% of an RL step, and that the 99th-percentile output length in math and coding workloads can exceed the median by more than an order of magnitude. The key experimental questions are end-to-end throughput, rollout utilization, and convergence quality under bounded staleness. The most important comparisons are against one-step off-policy pipelines, replication-based over-generation, and partial-rollout systems. The useful metrics are not only token throughput, but also long-tail trajectory retention, re-prefill overhead, reward curves, KL behavior, and policy-loss stability.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good skim takes about 30–40 minutes. Start with Section 3.1 for the three constraints C1–C3, since they define the algorithmic contract. Then read the comparison of asynchronous strategies to understand why over-generation and partial rollout make different tradeoffs. In the method section, focus on multi-version streaming, the staleness window, orchestration, and zero-re-prefill migration. In the experiments, prioritize plots that show throughput and convergence together; throughput alone is not enough to validate the training method.

recommendation.zh: 异步 RL 不是新点，但把“正确性约束”讲清并围绕长尾轨迹做编排是可落地的；只看三条约束定义+他们如何控 staleness。
recommendation.en: Async RL isn’t new, but the explicit correctness constraints plus long-tail-aware orchestration are actionable; read the constraint definitions and how they bound staleness.

paper.title: Marco-MoE: Open Multilingual Mixture-of-Expert Language Models with Efficient Upcycling
paper.abstract: We present Marco-MoE, a suite of fully open multilingual sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. Marco-MoE features a highly sparse design in which only around 5\% of the total parameters are activated per input token. This extreme sparsity, combined with upcycling from dense models, enables efficient pre-training on 5T tokens. Our models surpass similarly-sized competitors on English and multilingual benchmarks, achieving a best-in-class performance-to-compute ratio. We further post-train these

summary.core_problem: 构建开放的多语言 sparse MoE 语言模型，并验证极高稀疏度、dense-to-MoE upcycling 和长 token 训练能否同时带来 compute efficiency 与多语言能力。
summary.importance: 这是预训练架构与训练配方贡献。关键点不是又发布一个多语言模型，而是把约 5% activated parameters 的高稀疏 MoE、dense upcycling、5T token 训练和语言扩展分析放在同一套开放模型中，对多语言 MoE 的容量分配和路由行为有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Marco-MoE 从 dense 模型 upcycle 到 sparse MoE，采用极高稀疏设计，每个 token 只激活总参数约 5%。论文进一步分析 expert activation patterns：相关语言共享结构化路由模式，语言孤立度较高的语种则使用更专门化的专家。后续还训练了 Marco-MoE-Instruct 版本。
summary.experiments: 模型在 5T tokens 上继续预训练。摘要称其在英文和多语言 benchmark 上超过同等规模竞争模型，并获得较好的 performance-to-compute ratio；Instruct 版本超过 activated parameters 多 3-14 倍的竞争模型。论文还报告 MoE 支持可扩展语言扩充，并缓解 dense multilingual models 常见的语言间干扰。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds open multilingual sparse MoE language models and tests whether extreme sparsity, dense-to-MoE upcycling, and long-token pretraining can jointly improve compute efficiency and multilingual capability.
summary_en.importance: This is a pretraining architecture and recipe contribution. The useful part is not merely the model release, but the combination of roughly 5% activated parameters, dense upcycling, 5T-token training, and analysis of multilingual expert specialization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Marco-MoE upcycles dense models into sparse MoEs, with only about 5% of total parameters activated per token. The paper studies expert activation patterns, finding shared routing among related languages and more specialized utilization for linguistically isolated languages. It also post-trains Marco-MoE-Instruct variants.
summary_en.experiments: The models are pretrained on 5T tokens. The abstract reports stronger English and multilingual benchmark performance than similarly sized competitors and a favorable performance-to-compute ratio. The instruction-tuned variants outperform models with 3-14x more activated parameters, and the analysis suggests scalable language expansion with less interference than dense models.

recommendation.zh: 应看 MoE upcycling 和语言路由分析；若 5% 激活仍稳，内部多语言 MoE ablation 该补这个稀疏度点。
recommendation.en: Read the upcycling recipe and routing analysis; if 5% activation is stable, internal multilingual MoE sweeps should include that sparsity point.

paper.title: Mixture of Heterogeneous Grouped Experts for Language Modeling
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) based on Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) are pivotal in industrial applications for their ability to scale performance efficiently. However, standard MoEs enforce uniform expert sizes,creating a rigidity that fails to align computational costs with varying token-level complexity. While heterogeneous expert architectures attempt to address this by diversifying expert sizes, they often suffer from significant system-level challenges, specifically unbalanced GPU utilization an

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 MoE 里一个很实际但常被简化的问题：不同 token 的建模难度并不一样，但传统 MoE 强制所有 expert 同构同尺寸，导致容量分配过于僵硬；而完全异构 expert 虽然更灵活，却会带来 GPU 负载不均、路由失衡、参数利用率差等系统问题。作者想解决的是，如何在不把训练和部署复杂度推高到不可用的前提下，让 MoE 具备按 token 难度分配不同 expert 容量的能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 MoE 设计空间，而不是结论性突破。它提出了一种介于“全同构 MoE”和“全异构 MoE”之间的折中结构：组内同构、组间异构。这个方向有意义，因为工业级 MoE 的瓶颈往往不是理论容量，而是路由可控性和系统可训练性。若方法成立，它说明 expert heterogeneity 不必以完全自由的形式出现，可以通过分组把容量层级离散化，从而兼顾表达力和并行效率。对做大规模稀疏预训练的人，这比单纯讨论更大 expert 或更多 expert 更接近真实约束。
summary.technical_approach: MoHGE 的核心是三件事。第一，heterogeneous grouped experts：把所有 expert 分成多个 group，同一组内 expert 尺寸相同，不同组的 hidden size 按预设层级递增。这样小组负责轻量模式，大组负责更复杂 token。相比 fully heterogeneous expert，这种设计把容量选择离散成若干档，便于部署和负载管理。第二，two-level routing：先做 group-level gating，选出 top-Kg 个候选组；再在组内做 expert-level gating，选具体 expert。这样路由先决定‘用多大容量’，再决定‘用哪个 expert’，比传统单层 gating 更适合异构结构，也比直接在所有异构 expert 上竞争更稳定。第三，负载均衡机制分成两层：Group-Wise Auxiliary Loss 用来调节不同容量组的选择分布，使模型学会把更复杂 token 送到更大组，但又不至于塌到某一组；Intra-Group Experts Auxiliary Loss 则平衡组内 expert 使用率。系统层面，作者提出 All-size Group-decoupling Allocation，把每个 group 的 expert 均匀拆到所有 GPU 上，避免大 expert 集中在少数卡上造成显存和算力热点。和已有方法相比，MoDSE 更接近完全异构但路由约束较硬，HMoE 提到混合异构/同构方向但没有把分组结构和系统分配机制完整做出来；MoHGE 的贡献在于把架构、路由和并行分配一起设计。
summary.experiments: 从正文可见，作者的实验目标有两个：一是验证在更少总参数下能否保持接近传统 MoE 的语言建模精度；二是验证 GPU 利用率是否更均衡。摘要明确给出的结论是，MoHGE 在 accuracy 上与 conventional MoE 相当，同时减少 total parameters；并且 routing analysis 显示辅助损失确实能调节不同组和组内 expert 的激活模式，GPU utilization 更平衡。全文片段没有给出完整的模型规模、训练 token 数、具体 perplexity 或下游分数，因此不能安全填写具体数字。可以确认的实验重点包括：1）与同等计算或相近性能的标准 MoE 对比；2）对 two-level routing、Group-Wise Auxiliary Loss、Intra-Group loss、以及 allocation strategy 的消融；3）路由分布分析，用来证明不同容量组确实承担了不同复杂度 token；4）系统指标分析，关注显存占用和各 GPU 工作负载方差。若后续拿到表格，最值得看的是‘参数减少多少、吞吐损失多少、负载方差下降多少’这三组数字。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看方法图。要先理解为什么作者不做 fully heterogeneous experts，而是做 grouped heterogeneity。随后看 two-level routing 的公式和伪代码，确认 group gate 与 expert gate 的耦合方式，以及 top-Kg 的选择如何影响计算量。再看两个 auxiliary loss 的定义，重点不是公式本身，而是它们分别在约束哪一层的负载。实验部分建议优先看三类图表：主结果表、routing distribution 可视化、GPU load balance 统计。阅读时要特别留意一个问题：模型是否真的学到了‘难 token 用大 expert’，还是只是人为正则把流量分散了。如果没有 token difficulty 的外部定义，作者如何证明容量匹配而非随机分流，这是判断方法说服力的关键。预计 25–35 分钟可以完成有效泛读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical limitation in MoE language models. Standard MoEs use experts with identical size, which makes capacity allocation too rigid for tokens of varying difficulty. Fully heterogeneous experts are a natural alternative, but they create serious systems problems: uneven GPU utilization, poor parameter efficiency, and unstable routing behavior. The paper asks whether one can introduce expert-size heterogeneity without paying the full deployment and training cost of a fully heterogeneous design.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining researchers, the contribution is mainly about the MoE design space. The paper proposes a middle ground between homogeneous MoE and fully heterogeneous MoE: experts are homogeneous within a group but heterogeneous across groups. That matters because large-scale sparse pretraining is often constrained less by theoretical model capacity than by routing controllability and systems balance. If this grouped heterogeneity works, it suggests that capacity scaling can be discretized into a small number of expert tiers, making heterogeneity more trainable and more compatible with distributed execution.
summary_en.technical_approach: MoHGE combines architectural, routing, and systems ideas. First, experts are partitioned into groups; experts within the same group share the same size, while different groups have different hidden dimensions. This creates a tiered capacity structure, where smaller groups can handle easier patterns and larger groups can absorb harder contexts. Second, routing is hierarchical. A group-level gate first selects the top candidate groups, and an expert-level gate then chooses experts within those groups. This is better aligned with heterogeneous capacity than a single flat gate over all experts, because the model first decides how much capacity to use and only then which expert instance to activate. Third, the paper introduces two balancing losses. The Group-Wise Auxiliary Loss regulates how often different capacity groups are selected, aiming for a better match between token complexity and expert size while avoiding collapse to a single group. The Intra-Group Experts Auxiliary Loss balances usage among experts inside each group. On the systems side, the All-size Group-decoupling Allocation strategy spreads experts from every group across all GPUs, instead of concentrating large experts on a subset of devices. Compared with prior work, the novelty is not just heterogeneous experts, but the joint design of grouped heterogeneity, two-level routing, and hardware-aware allocation.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental story appears to have two targets: maintain language-model quality with fewer total parameters, and improve GPU load balance. From the abstract and visible body text, the main claim is that MoHGE reaches accuracy comparable to conventional MoE while reducing total parameters. The routing analysis further suggests that the auxiliary losses successfully shape activation patterns across groups and within groups, and that GPU utilization becomes more balanced during training and inference. The provided text does not include the full numeric tables, so it is not safe to state exact parameter counts, token budgets, or perplexity gains. The most relevant experiments seem to be: comparisons against standard MoE baselines, ablations on two-level routing and both auxiliary losses, routing-distribution analysis to show differentiated use of expert groups, and systems measurements such as memory balance and workload variance across GPUs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the method figure and understand why the authors choose grouped heterogeneity instead of fully free-form heterogeneous experts. Then read the two-level routing section carefully: the key question is how group selection and expert selection interact, and how top-K group routing changes the compute pattern. After that, inspect the two auxiliary losses with a simple lens: one balances traffic across capacity tiers, the other balances traffic within a tier. In the experiments, prioritize three things: the main quality-vs-parameter table, the routing-distribution visualizations, and the GPU load-balance statistics. The most important reading question is whether the model truly learns capacity matching—harder tokens going to larger experts—or whether the regularization merely spreads traffic more evenly without meaningful specialization. A useful skim should take about 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看，因为它碰的是 MoE 里一直没解决干净的异构专家落地问题；先看两级路由和 group-wise loss，若负载曲线不漂亮，就把它当工程折中而非新范式。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it hits the unresolved practical problem of heterogeneous experts in MoE; inspect the two-level router and group-wise loss first, and treat it as an engineering tradeoff unless the load curves are genuinely clean.

institutions: Data Science & Artificial Intelligence Research Institute, China Unicom

paper.title: Transformer as an Euler Discretization of Score-based Variational Flow
paper.abstract: Despite the Transformer's dominance across machine learning, its architecture remains largely heuristic and lacks a unified theoretical foundation. We introduce Score-based Variational Flow (SVFlow), a continuous-time dynamical system for representation learning in which the state evolves according to a variational posterior-weighted average of conditional log-likelihood scores, and provide a principled basis for regularization through variational consistency. We show that forward Euler discreti

summary.core_problem: 给 Transformer 的关键组件（多头注意力、FFN/MoE、残差+归一化）提供一个统一的连续时间动力系统解释：把层更新视为在球面流形上的“变分后验加权的条件 score 场”做前向 Euler 离散，从而解释注意力的隐式正则、自校准行为，以及 MoE 为什么更容易塌缩并需要额外平衡损失。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的直接价值不在于给出可立刻替换的训练目标，而在于提供一个可操作的分析框架：
1) 把注意力看成对“后验加权 score”的核平滑估计，给出注意力为何常表现出自正则/不易塌缩的机制解释；
2) 给出一组由 SVFlow 诱导的可观测量（marginal likelihood、divergence、concentration），并在真实预训练 LM 上验证它们与困惑度/校准的相关性，作为诊断表示质量与层功能分化的工具；
3) 统一了“注意力像核方法/梯度动力学”“残差像 ODE”“归一化像几何投影”等碎片化解释，便于把训练稳定性、校准、MoE 辅助损失等问题放到同一套动力学语言里讨论。
局限也明确：更多是解释与度量，而非新的可验证 scaling law 或显著改进训练配方。
summary.technical_approach:
核心构造是 Score-based Variational Flow (SVFlow)。设观测表示 x、离散潜变量 z（可理解为注意力选择的 token/专家等），给定条件似然 p(x|z;θ) 与变分后验 q(z|x;ϕ)，定义连续时间 ODE 的向量场为：对每个 z 的条件 score ∇x log p(x|z) 做 q(z|x) 加权平均。直觉上是“在不确定的离散选择下，沿着条件对数似然上升方向做动态滤波”。

把该框架落到 Transformer：
- 几何：由于 LayerNorm/RMSNorm 使表示近似定范数，作者把状态空间放到球面流形 S^{d-1}，并讨论切空间更新与 retraction（近似指数映射）。
- 离散化：对球面 SVFlow 做 forward Euler 离散，得到“x_{l+1}=Retract(x_l + step * v(x_l))”形式；对应到实现上就是残差连接 + RMSNorm 近似 retraction。
- 注意力对应：多头注意力被解释为用 von Mises–Fisher (vMF) 核对后验 q(z|x) 做平滑，从而近似 SVFlow 的向量场；多头则是多个核/子空间的并行近似。
- FFN/MoE 对应：FFN/MoE 被解释为对同一向量场的“松弛的网络近似”（不再显式核平滑/后验结构），因此更依赖额外约束；这也被用来解释 MoE 需要 load-balancing 等辅助损失以避免专家塌缩。
- 正则化与一致性：SVFlow 自带一个变分一致性（variational consistency）视角，作者用它来解释注意力后验的隐式自正则，并提出可用于探针分析的度量（marginal likelihood、divergence、concentration）。

整体上，这篇文章的“创新点”主要是：把 Transformer 的模块级结构与一个具体的连续时间变分 score 流严格对齐（至少在球面+Euler 离散设定下），并给出一套可落地的内部度量来做实证分析，而不是停留在类比。
summary.experiments:
实验以“前缀打乱（prefix-shuffling）逐步破坏上下文”的干预方式，在预训练语言模型上观察注意力层的 SVFlow 诱导度量与外部性能指标的关系。作者报告的关键结论包括：
- marginal likelihood 与预测困惑度、校准指标呈强相关，可作为表示质量的代理信号；
- 深层注意力对上下文破坏更敏感，显示出明显的深度分工/专门化；
- divergence 与 concentration 的组合刻画了注意力内部动力学的不同工作区间，并对应到不同模型的校准差异。

论文在你给的全文片段里没有出现完整的数值表格（如具体 PPL/相关系数/模型规模/数据规模），因此无法在不臆测的情况下复述精确数字；若要抓数字，建议直接定位实验章节的相关性图与校准对比表。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 40–60 分钟）：
1) 先看方法主线：SVFlow 定义（向量场=后验加权条件 score）以及为什么要上球面流形；把“z 是离散潜变量”与“注意力选择 token / MoE 选择专家”的对应关系想清楚。
2) 再看“Euler 离散→Transformer 组件”的对齐段落：注意力为何对应 vMF 核平滑、RMSNorm+残差为何对应 retraction。
3) 最后看实验：重点看 prefix-shuffling 的设计、marginal likelihood 与 PPL/校准的相关性图，以及 divergence/concentration 划分出的 regimes。读到这里基本能判断这些度量是否能迁移到你自己的训练诊断里。

如果只想拿走可用的东西：优先关注 SVFlow 诱导的度量定义与它们在层间/模型间的可解释差异，而不是几何推导的全部细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Provide a unified continuous-time dynamical interpretation of core Transformer blocks—MHA, FFN/MoE, residual + normalization—by introducing Score-based Variational Flow (SVFlow) on a spherical manifold and showing that a forward Euler discretization recovers the Transformer update structure. The goal is to explain implicit regularization in attention, calibration behavior, and why MoE tends to collapse without auxiliary balancing losses.
summary_en.importance:
The main value for foundation-model pretraining is diagnostic and mechanistic rather than an immediately deployable new objective:
- It turns several partial stories (attention as kernels, residuals as ODEs, normalization as projection) into one coherent dynamical system.
- It proposes SVFlow-induced observables (marginal likelihood, divergence, concentration) and empirically links them to perplexity and calibration under controlled context corruption, suggesting practical probes for representation quality and depth-wise specialization.
- It offers a concrete explanation for the asymmetry between attention (often self-regularizing) and MoE (often requiring explicit load-balancing).
The limitation is that it is primarily an interpretability/analysis framework; it does not, from the provided content, establish new scaling laws or a training recipe with clear downstream gains.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SVFlow defines an ODE whose vector field is a variational-posterior-weighted average of conditional score functions. With a discrete latent z and likelihood p(x|z;θ), plus variational posterior q(z|x;ϕ), the flow direction at x is E_{q(z|x)}[∇_x log p(x|z)]. Intuitively, it is likelihood-ascent under uncertain discrete selection.

Mapping to Transformers:
- Geometry: because LayerNorm/RMSNorm keeps representations near constant norm, the state is modeled on a sphere S^{d-1}; updates live in the tangent space and are mapped back via a retraction.
- Discretization: forward Euler on spherical SVFlow yields a residual-style step followed by a relaxed retraction, aligning with residual + RMSNorm blocks.
- Attention: MHA is interpreted as approximating the SVFlow vector field via a von Mises–Fisher kernel-smoothed posterior; multi-head corresponds to multiple such approximations in parallel subspaces.
- FFN/MoE: FFN/MoE approximates the same vector field in a more relaxed, network-based manner, which motivates why MoE may need explicit balancing to avoid degenerate posterior/expert usage.
- Regularization lens: a variational-consistency view is used to argue for implicit self-regularization in attention posteriors and to derive internal metrics (marginal likelihood, divergence, concentration) for probing model dynamics.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical validation uses a prefix-shuffling intervention that progressively degrades context in pretrained LMs, then studies how SVFlow-induced metrics track external quality measures.
Reported takeaways:
- SVFlow marginal likelihood correlates strongly with predictive perplexity and calibration, acting as a proxy for representation quality.
- Deeper attention layers are substantially more sensitive to context disruption, consistent with depth-dependent specialization.
- The interaction of divergence and concentration reveals distinct internal regimes that align with calibration differences across models.

Exact numeric results (model sizes, correlation coefficients, PPL deltas) are not present in the provided excerpt; extracting them requires checking the experiment section figures/tables directly.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (40–60 min):
1) Read the SVFlow definition carefully (posterior-weighted conditional scores) and the role of the discrete latent z.
2) Focus on the “Euler discretization on the sphere → Transformer blocks” correspondence: vMF smoothing for attention; residual+RMSNorm as relaxed retraction.
3) Jump to experiments: understand prefix-shuffling, then inspect plots linking marginal likelihood to PPL/calibration and the divergence–concentration regime analysis.

If you only want actionable content, prioritize the metric definitions and how they behave across layers/models under controlled context corruption.

recommendation.zh: 理论味较重，先看 SVFlow 到 attention 的等价推导；若假设太强，就只当架构解释备查。
recommendation.en: Skim the derivation from SVFlow to attention first; if the assumptions are too strong, treat it as architectural interpretation rather than training guidance.

paper.title: Towards Adaptive Continual Model Merging via Manifold-Aware Expert Evolution
paper.abstract: Continual Model Merging (CMM) sequentially integrates task-specific models into a unified architecture without intensive retraining. However, existing CMM methods are hindered by a fundamental saturation-redundancy dilemma: backbone-centric approaches face parameter saturation and representation interference within fixed capacities, whereas Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants resort to indiscriminate expansion, incurring expert redundancy and a routing bottleneck reliant on additional data-driven

summary.core_problem: 解决持续模型合并中固定骨干容量饱和、表示干扰，以及 MoE 式扩展带来的专家冗余和路由开销问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是模型合并与持续适配方法改进。它不直接讨论 LLM 预训练，但触及一个现实问题：多个任务模型如何在少量或无重训条件下整合到统一模型中，对 continual post-training 和模型资产复用有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MADE-IT，即 Manifold-Aware Dynamic Expert Evolution and Implicit Routing。核心做法是用投影式子空间亲和度度量专家之间的内在表示关系，再用分布感知的自适应阈值决定专家演化、合并或扩展，以控制专家多样性和参数规模。论文还声称通过隐式路由绕过额外数据驱动路由优化，但摘要未给出完整细节。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型规模、任务集、baseline 名称和量化提升。可确认的是论文面向 sequential task-specific model merging，而不是端到端预训练；实验可信度需要看是否覆盖强模型合并 baseline、任务顺序扰动和容量受限设置。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港理工大学 Department of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence；Kay Chen Tan 是进化计算和智能优化方向的知名学者，但该背景并非 LLM 基座预训练主线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses capacity saturation and representation interference in continual model merging, as well as expert redundancy and routing overhead in MoE-style merging.
summary_en.importance: This is a continual adaptation and model-merging contribution rather than a pretraining paper. It is relevant mainly as a possible tool for reusing task-specific checkpoints without expensive retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: MADE-IT uses manifold-aware expert evolution. It measures expert affinity through projection-based subspace similarity and applies a distribution-aware adaptive threshold to decide when experts should evolve, merge, or remain separate. The abstract also claims an implicit routing mechanism to avoid additional data-driven router training, but the details are not visible from the provided text.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The key thing to verify in the paper is whether the method is tested under realistic task sequences, strong merging baselines, and constrained-capacity regimes.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from the Department of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. Kay Chen Tan is well known in evolutionary computation and intelligent optimization, but this is not a core LLM pretraining group.

recommendation.zh: 作为模型合并备查即可；如果隐式路由不依赖 held-out 数据，§方法细节值得扫一眼。
recommendation.en: Useful as model-merging background; skim the method only if implicit routing truly avoids held-out routing data.

summary.core_problem: 在保持顶尖推理与通用能力的同时，如何大幅降低大模型长上下文（1M tokens）的计算与显存成本，实现经济高效的规模化部署。
summary.importance: 标志着长上下文能力从“昂贵的特殊功能”走向“默认标配”。DeepSeek-V4 证明了通过底层注意力机制的创新，可以在不牺牲性能的前提下，将百万级上下文的成本降至极低，对开源生态和商业 API 定价具有强烈的冲击力。
summary.technical_approach: 核心创新在于引入了新型注意力机制：Token-wise compression 结合 DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA)。这种设计在算法层面大幅削减了长序列处理时的计算复杂度和 KV-cache 显存占用，从而实现了“低成本 1M 上下文”。模型提供两个版本：1.6T 总参数/49B 激活参数的 Pro 版（对标闭源 SOTA），以及 284B 总参数/13B 激活参数的 Flash 版（主打极致性价比）。
summary.experiments: V4-Pro 在数学、STEM、代码等推理任务上击败了当前所有开源模型，比肩顶尖闭源模型；在 Agentic Coding benchmark 上达到开源 SOTA；世界知识仅次于 Gemini-3.1-Pro。V4-Flash 激活参数仅 13B，但推理能力逼近 Pro 版，且在简单 Agent 任务上表现相当。全系默认支持 1M 上下文和双模式（Thinking / Non-Thinking）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注技术报告中关于 Token-wise compression 和 DSA (DeepSeek Sparse Attention) 的具体实现细节，这是理解其长上下文低成本核心的关键。同时，对比 Pro 和 Flash 版本的参数分配与性能差异，有助于理解其在不同场景下的部署策略。
summary.authors_note: DeepSeek 团队。

summary_en.core_problem: How to drastically reduce the compute and memory costs of processing long contexts (1M tokens) while maintaining top-tier reasoning and general capabilities, enabling cost-effective deployment at scale.
summary_en.importance: Marks the transition of long-context capabilities from an 'expensive premium feature' to a 'default standard'. DeepSeek-V4 demonstrates that through fundamental innovations in attention mechanisms, the cost of million-token contexts can be minimized without sacrificing performance, significantly impacting the open-source ecosystem and commercial API pricing.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core innovation lies in a novel attention mechanism: Token-wise compression combined with DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA). This design algorithmically slashes the computational complexity and KV-cache memory footprint associated with long sequences, achieving 'cost-effective 1M context'. The model is released in two variants: the Pro version (1.6T total / 49B active params) targeting closed-source SOTA, and the Flash version (284B total / 13B active params) optimized for extreme efficiency.
summary_en.experiments: V4-Pro outperforms all current open models in Math, STEM, and Coding, rivaling top closed-source models. It achieves open-source SOTA in Agentic Coding benchmarks and ranks second only to Gemini-3.1-Pro in world knowledge. V4-Flash, with only 13B active parameters, closely approaches Pro's reasoning capabilities and performs on par in simple Agent tasks. Both models natively support 1M context and dual modes (Thinking / Non-Thinking).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the technical report's details regarding Token-wise compression and DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), as these are crucial for understanding the low-cost long-context mechanism. Additionally, analyzing the parameter allocation and performance trade-offs between the Pro and Flash versions provides insights into deployment strategies.
summary_en.authors_note: DeepSeek Team.

recommendation.zh: 这类发布必须跟进，但别停在博客：直接去读 tech report，重点看 active/total 比例、1M context 机制和训练成本表，才能判断它是否真的改写开源 MoE 的性价比边界。
recommendation.en: This release is worth tracking, but the blog is not the artifact—go straight to the tech report and inspect active/total ratio, 1M-context mechanism, and cost tables before updating your MoE priors.

paper.title: DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence
paper.abstract:
We present a preview version of DeepSeek-V4 series, including two strong Mixture-of- Experts (MoE) language models — DeepSeek-V4-Pro with 1.6T parameters (49B activated) and DeepSeek-V4-Flash with 284B parameters (13B activated) — both supporting a context length of one million tokens. DeepSeek-V4 series incorporate several key upgrades in architecture and op- timization: (1) a hybrid attention architecture that combines Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA) and Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA) to improve long-context efficiency; (2) Manifold- Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) that enhance conventional residual connections; (3) and the Muon optimizer for faster convergence and greater training stability. We pre-train both models on more than 32T diverse and high-quality tokens, followed by a comprehensive post-training pipeline that unlocks and further enhances their capabilities. DeepSeek-V4-Pro- Max, the maximum reasoning effort mode of DeepSeek-V4-Pro, redefines the state-of-the-art for open models, outperforming its predecessors in core tasks. Meanwhile, DeepSeek-V4 series are highly efficient in long-context scenarios. In the one-million-token context setting, DeepSeek- V4-Pro requires only 27% of single-token inference FLOPs and 10% of KV cache compared with DeepSeek-V3.2. This enables us to routinely support one-million-token contexts, thereby making long-horizon tasks and further test-time scaling more feasible. The model checkpoints are available at https://huggingfa

1. Introduction
The emergence of reasoning models (DeepSeek-AI, 2025; OpenAI, 2024c) has established a
new paradigm of test-time scaling, driving substantial performance gains for Large Language
Models (LLMs). However, this scaling paradigm is fundamentally constrained by the quadratic
computational complexity of the vanilla attention mechanism (Vaswani et al., 2017), which
creates a prohibitive bottleneck for ultra-long contexts and reasoning processes. Concurrently,
the emergence of long-horizon scenarios and tasks — from complex agentic workflows to
massive cross-document analysis — has also made efficient support for ultra-long contexts
critical for future progress. While recent open-source efforts (Bai et al., 2025a; DeepSeek-AI,
2024; MiniMax, 2025; Qwen, 2025) have advanced general capabilities, this core architectural
inefficiency in handling ultra-long sequences remains a key impediment, limiting further gains
from test-time scaling and hindering further exploration into long-horizon scenarios and tasks.
In order to break the efficiency barrier in ultra-long contexts, we develop the DeepSeek-V4
series, including the preview versions of DeepSeek-V4-Pro with 1.6T parameters (49B activated)
and DeepSeek-V4-Flash with 284B parameters (13B activated). Through architectural innova-
tions, DeepSeek-V4 series achieve a dramatic leap in computational efficiency for processing
ultra-long sequences. This breakthrough enables efficient support for a context length of one
million tokens, ushering in a new era of million-length contexts for next-generation LLMs. We
believe our capability to efficiently handle ultra-long sequences unlocks the next frontier of
test-time scaling, paves the way for deeper research into long-horizon tasks, and establishes a
necessary foundation for exploring future paradigms like online learning.
Compared with the DeepSeek-V3 architecture (DeepSeek-AI, 2024), DeepSeek-V4 series
retain the DeepSeekMoE framework (Dai et al., 2024) and Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) strategy,
while introducing several key innovations in architecture and optimization. To enhance long-
context efficiency, we design a hybrid attention mechanism combining Compressed Sparse
Attention (CSA) and Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA). CSA compresses the KV caches
along the sequence dimension and then performs DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) (DeepSeek-
AI, 2025), whereas HCA applies more aggressive compression to the KV caches but keeps
dense attention. To strengthen modeling capability, we incorporate Manifold-Constrained
Hyper-Connections (mHC) (Xie et al., 2026) that upgrade conventional residual connections.
Additionally, we introduce the Muon (Jordan et al., 2024; Liu et al., 2025) optimizer to the
training of DeepSeek-V4 series, leading to faster convergence and improved training stability.
To enable efficient training and inference for DeepSeek-V4 series as well as productive de-
velopment, we introduce several infrastructure optimizations. First, we design and implement
a single fused kernel for MoE modules that fully overlaps computation, communication, and
memory access. Second, we employ TileLang (Wang et al., 2026), a Domain-Specific Language
(DSL) to balance development productivity and runtime efficiency. Third, we provide efficient
batch-invariant and deterministic kernel libraries to ensure bitwise reproducibility across train-
ing and inference. Fourth, we incorporate FP4 quantization-aware training for MoE expert
weights and the indexer QK path to reduce memory and computation. Fifth, for the training
framework, we extend the autograd framework with tensor-level checkpointing for fine-grained
recomputation control; and we enhance training efficiency with a hybrid ZeRO strategy for the
Muon optimizer, cost-effective mHC implementations via recomputation and fused kernels, and
two-stage contextual parallelism to manage compressed attention. Finally, for the inference
framework, we design a heterogeneous KV cache structure with on-disk storage strategies to
enable efficient shared-prefix reuse.
4

By employing hybrid CSA and HCA, along with precision optimizations on computation
and storage, DeepSeek-V4 series achieve significantly lower inference FLOPs and a substantially
reduced KV cache size compared with DeepSeek-V3.2, especially in long-context settings. The
right part of Figure 1 demonstrates the estimated single-token inference FLOPs and accumulated
KV cache size of DeepSeek-V3.2 and DeepSeek-V4 series. In the scenario of 1M-token context,
even DeepSeek-V4-Pro, which has a larger number of activated parameters, attains only 27%
of the single-token FLOPs (measured in equivalent FP8 FLOPs) and 10% of the KV cache
size relative to DeepSeek-V3.2. Furthermore, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, with its smaller number of
activated parameters, pushes efficiency even further: in the 1M-token context setting, it achieves
only 10% of the single-token FLOPs and 7% of the KV cache size compared with DeepSeek-V3.2.
Additionally, for DeepSeek-V4 series, the routed expert parameters utilize FP4 precision. While
the peak FLOPs for FP4 × FP8 operations are currently the same as FP8 × FP8 on existing
hardware, they can theoretically be implemented to be 1/3 more efficient on future hardware,
which will further enhance the efficiency of DeepSeek-V4 series.
During pre-training, we train DeepSeek-V4-Flash on 32T tokens and DeepSeek-V4-Pro on 33T
tokens, respectively. After pre-training, these two models can natively and efficiently support
1M-length contexts. In our internal evaluations, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base already surpasses
DeepSeek-V3.2-Base across a majority of benchmarks with its more parameter-efficient design.
DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base further extends this advantage to set a new performance standard among
DeepSeek foundation models, achieving comprehensive superiority across reasoning, coding,
long-context, and world knowledge tasks.
The post-training pipeline of DeepSeek-V4 series features a two-stage paradigm: the inde-
pendent cultivation of domain-specific experts, followed by unified model consolidation via
on-policy distillation (Lu and Lab, 2025). Initially, for each target domain — such as mathematics,
coding, agent, and instruction following — a separate expert model is trained independently.
The base model first undergoes Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on high-quality, domain-specific
data to establish foundational capabilities. Subsequently, Reinforcement Learning (RL) is ap-
plied using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) (DeepSeek-AI, 2025), which further
optimizes the model for domain-aligned behaviors guided by reward models tailored to specific
success criteria. This phase yields a diverse set of specialized experts, each excelling in its
respective field. Finally, to integrate these distinct proficiencies, a single unified model is trained
through on-policy distillation, wherein the unified model acts as the student learning to optimize
the reverse KL loss with teacher models.

Overall, DeepSeek-V4 series retain the Transformer (Vaswani et al., 2017) architecture and Multi-

objectives. Given that the MTP strategy has been validated in DeepSeek-V3, we adopt the same
