1. Introduction
The emergence of reasoning models (DeepSeek-AI, 2025; OpenAI, 2024c) has established a
new paradigm of test-time scaling, driving substantial performance gains for Large Language
Models (LLMs). However, this scaling paradigm is fundamentally constrained by the quadratic
computational complexity of the vanilla attention mechanism (Vaswani et al., 2017), which
creates a prohibitive bottleneck for ultra-long contexts and reasoning processes. Concurrently,
the emergence of long-horizon scenarios and tasks — from complex agentic workflows to
massive cross-document analysis — has also made efficient support for ultra-long contexts
critical for future progress. While recent open-source efforts (Bai et al., 2025a; DeepSeek-AI,
2024; MiniMax, 2025; Qwen, 2025) have advanced general capabilities, this core architectural
inefficiency in handling ultra-long sequences remains a key impediment, limiting further gains
from test-time scaling and hindering further exploration into long-horizon scenarios and tasks.
In order to break the efficiency barrier in ultra-long contexts, we develop the DeepSeek-V4
series, including the preview versions of DeepSeek-V4-Pro with 1.6T parameters (49B activated)
and DeepSeek-V4-Flash with 284B parameters (13B activated). Through architectural innova-
tions, DeepSeek-V4 series achieve a dramatic leap in computational efficiency for processing
ultra-long sequences. This breakthrough enables efficient support for a context length of one
million tokens, ushering in a new era of million-length contexts for next-generation LLMs. We
believe our capability to efficiently handle ultra-long sequences unlocks the next frontier of
test-time scaling, paves the way for deeper research into long-horizon tasks, and establishes a
necessary foundation for exploring future paradigms like online learning.
Compared with the DeepSeek-V3 architecture (DeepSeek-AI, 2024), DeepSeek-V4 series
retain the DeepSeekMoE framework (Dai et al., 2024) and Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) strategy,
while introducing several key innovations in architecture and optimization. To enhance long-
context efficiency, we design a hybrid attention mechanism combining Compressed Sparse
Attention (CSA) and Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA). CSA compresses the KV caches
along the sequence dimension and then performs DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) (DeepSeek-
AI, 2025), whereas HCA applies more aggressive compression to the KV caches but keeps
dense attention. To strengthen modeling capability, we incorporate Manifold-Constrained
Hyper-Connections (mHC) (Xie et al., 2026) that upgrade conventional residual connections.
Additionally, we introduce the Muon (Jordan et al., 2024; Liu et al., 2025) optimizer to the
training of DeepSeek-V4 series, leading to faster convergence and improved training stability.
To enable efficient training and inference for DeepSeek-V4 series as well as productive de-
velopment, we introduce several infrastructure optimizations. First, we design and implement
a single fused kernel for MoE modules that fully overlaps computation, communication, and
memory access. Second, we employ TileLang (Wang et al., 2026), a Domain-Specific Language
(DSL) to balance development productivity and runtime efficiency. Third, we provide efficient
batch-invariant and deterministic kernel libraries to ensure bitwise reproducibility across train-
ing and inference. Fourth, we incorporate FP4 quantization-aware training for MoE expert
weights and the indexer QK path to reduce memory and computation. Fifth, for the training
framework, we extend the autograd framework with tensor-level checkpointing for fine-grained
recomputation control; and we enhance training efficiency with a hybrid ZeRO strategy for the
Muon optimizer, cost-effective mHC implementations via recomputation and fused kernels, and
two-stage contextual parallelism to manage compressed attention. Finally, for the inference
framework, we design a heterogeneous KV cache structure with on-disk storage strategies to
enable efficient shared-prefix reuse.

plied using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) (DeepSeek-AI, 2025), which further
optimizes the model for domain-aligned behaviors guided by reward models tailored to specific
success criteria. This phase yields a diverse set of specialized experts, each excelling in its
respective field. Finally, to integrate these distinct proficiencies, a single unified model is trained
through on-policy distillation, wherein the unified model acts as the student learning to optimize
the reverse KL loss with teacher models.
Summary of Core Evaluation Results
• Knowledge: In assessments of broad world knowledge, DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Max, the maxi-
mum reasoning effort mode of DeepSeek-V4-Pro, significantly outperforms leading open-
source models on the SimpleQA (OpenAI, 2024d) and Chinese-SimpleQA (He et al., 2024)
benchmarks. Regarding educational knowledge — evaluated via MMLU-Pro (Wang et al.,
2024b), HLE (Phan et al., 2025), and GPQA (Rein et al., 2023) — DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Max
shows a marginal lead over its open-source counterparts. DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Max has
significantly closed the gap with the leading proprietary model, Gemini-3.1-Pro, despite
still trailing it in these knowledge-based evaluations.
• Reasoning: Through the expansion of reasoning tokens, DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Max demon-
strates superior performance relative to GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3.0-Pro on standard reasoning
benchmarks. Nevertheless, its performance falls marginally short of GPT-5.4 and Gemini-
3.1-Pro, suggesting a developmental trajectory that trails state-of-the-art frontier models by
approximately 3 to 6 months. Furthermore, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Max achieves comparable

2. Architecture
Overall, DeepSeek-V4 series retain the Transformer (Vaswani et al., 2017) architecture and Multi-
Token Prediction (MTP) modules (DeepSeek-AI, 2024; Gloeckle et al., 2024), while introducing
several key upgrades over DeepSeek-V3: (1) firstly, we introduce the Manifold-Constrained
Hyper-Connections (mHC) (Xie et al., 2026) to strengthen conventional residual connections;
6

(2) secondly, we design a hybrid attention architecture, which greatly improves long-context
efficiency through Compressed Sparse Attention and Heavily Compressed Attention. (3) thirdly,
we employ Muon (Jordan et al., 2024; Liu et al., 2025) as the optimizer. For the Mixture-of-
Experts (MoE) components, we still adopt the DeepSeekMoE (Dai et al., 2024) architecture, with
only minor adjustments from DeepSeek-V3. The Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) (DeepSeek-AI,
2024; Gloeckle et al., 2024; Li et al., 2024; Qi et al., 2020) configuration remains identical to
that of DeepSeek-V3. All other unspecified details follow the settings established in DeepSeek-
V3 (DeepSeek-AI, 2024). Figure 2 illustrates the overall architecture of DeepSeek-V4, and the
details are described below.
2.1. Designs Inherited from DeepSeek-V3
Mixture-of-Experts.
As previous DeepSeek-series models (DeepSeek-AI, 2024; DeepSeek-AI,
2024), DeepSeek-V4 series also adopt the DeepSeekMoE paradigm (Dai et al., 2024) for Feed-
Forward Networks (FFNs), which sets fine-grained routed experts and shared experts. Different
from DeepSeek-V3, we change the activation function that computes the affinity scores from
Sigmoid(·) into Sqrt(Softplus(·)). For load balancing, we also employ the auxiliary-loss-free
strategy (DeepSeek-AI, 2024; Wang et al., 2024a), augmented by a slight sequence-wise balance
loss that prevents extreme imbalance within individual sequences. For DeepSeek-V4, we remove
the constraint on the number of routing target nodes, and carefully redesign the parallelism
strategy to maintain training efficiency. Furthermore, compared with DeepSeek-V3, we replace
the dense FFN layers in the initial several Transformer blocks with MoE layers that employ
Hash routing (Roller et al., 2021). The Hash routing strategy determines the target experts of
each token according to a predefined hash function with regard to the input token ID.
Multi-Token Prediction.
As DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-V4 series also set MTP modules and
objectives. Given that the MTP strategy has been validated in DeepSeek-V3, we adopt the same
strategy for DeepSeek-V4 series without modification.
2.2. Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections
As shown in Figure 2, DeepSeek-V4 series incorporate Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections
(mHC) (Xie et al., 2026) to strengthen the conventional residual connections between adjacent
Transformer blocks. Compared with naive Hyper-Connections (HC) (Zhu et al., 2025), the core
idea of mHC is to constrain the residual mapping onto a specific manifold, and thus enhance the
stability of signal propagation across layers while preserving model expressivity. This subsection
briefly introduces the standard HC and describes how we design mHC for stable training.
Standard Hyper-Connections.
The standard HC expands the width of the residual stream
by a factor of 𝑛hc. Specifically, the shape of the residual stream is expanded from R𝑑to R𝑛hc×𝑑,
where 𝑑is the hidden size of the actual layer input. Let 𝑋𝑙= [x𝑙,1; . . . ; x𝑙,𝑛hc]𝑇∈R𝑛hc×𝑑be the

𝐴𝑙∈R1×𝑛hc, a residual transformation 𝐵𝑙∈R𝑛hc×𝑛hc, and an output mapping 𝐶𝑙∈R𝑛hc×1. The
update of the residual state is then formulated as:
𝑋𝑙+1 = 𝐵𝑙𝑋𝑙+ 𝐶𝑙F𝑙(𝐴𝑙𝑋𝑙),
(1)

R𝑑. Note that the actual layer input 𝐴𝑙𝑋𝑙∈R𝑑is also 𝑑-dimensional, so the expanded residual

2.3. Hybrid Attention with CSA and HCA
As the context length reaches extreme scales, the attention mechanism emerges as the dominant
computational bottleneck in a model. For DeepSeek-V4, we design two efficient attention
architectures — Compressed Sparse Attention (CSA) and Heavily Compressed Attention (HCA)
— and employ their interleaved hybrid configuration, which substantially reduces the compu-
tational cost of attention in long-text scenarios. CSA integrates both compression and sparse
attention strategies: it first compresses the Key-Value (KV) cache of every 𝑚tokens into one
entry, and then applies DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) (DeepSeek-AI, 2025) where each query
token attends to only 𝑘compressed KV entries. HCA aims for extreme compression by consol-
idating the KV cache of every 𝑚′ (≫𝑚) tokens into a single entry. The hybrid architecture of
CSA and HCA remarkably improves the long-context efficiency of DeepSeek-V4 series, making
one-million-token context feasible in practice. This subsection describes the core techniques
of our hybrid attention architecture, and we also provide an open-source implementation1 to
specify more details unambiguously.

summary.core_problem: 这篇技术报告讨论的是：在超长上下文已经从展示能力走向日常可用之后，如何把百万 token 上下文做成一个训练、推理、成本三者都能成立的基座模型方案。核心关注点不是单点长上下文技巧，而是 MoE 架构、注意力压缩、残差连接改造、优化器与后训练如何一起支撑 1M context。
summary.key_insights: 最值得记住的是三件事。第一，DeepSeek 把长上下文问题明确当成系统级预训练问题来做，而不是只靠 RoPE 外推或推理时工程补丁；CSA+HCA 的混合注意力直接瞄准单 token FLOPs 和 KV cache 两个主要瓶颈，报告里给出在 1M context 下相对 V3.2 约 27% FLOPs、10% KV cache 的量级。第二，mHC 和 Muon 被放在与注意力同等重要的位置，说明他们判断百万上下文的可用性不只是 inference efficiency，还取决于深层网络训练稳定性和收敛速度。第三，32T token 预训练加完整 post-training pipeline，配合 reasoning mode，表明长上下文能力已经被当成通用能力底座，而不是单独拉一条长文本 benchmark 曲线。
summary.limits: 当前信息主要来自预览版技术报告，很多关键细节还不够展开，例如 CSA/HCA 的精确机制、不同长度区间的质量-成本折中、mHC 相对标准残差的独立增益、Muon 在这一规模下的稳定性边界，以及 1M context 是否真正转化为稳定的长程任务收益。基准图里也混合了预训练、后训练和推理 effort 的共同效果，暂时不容易拆出各模块的因果贡献。

summary_en.core_problem: This report asks a practical pretraining question: how do you make million-token context a routine capability rather than a demo feature? The focus is not just context extension, but a full-stack recipe spanning MoE design, compressed attention, residual-path changes, optimizer choice, and post-training.
summary_en.key_insights: Three points matter. First, DeepSeek treats long context as a model-design problem, not merely a positional extrapolation trick. The CSA+HCA hybrid attention is aimed directly at the two real inference bottlenecks at 1M length: per-token FLOPs and KV cache, with reported reductions to roughly 27% FLOPs and 10% KV cache versus V3.2. Second, mHC and Muon are presented as core ingredients, which suggests the team sees long-context viability as tightly coupled to optimization stability and deep-network training dynamics, not just serving efficiency. Third, the combination of 32T-token pretraining and a substantial post-training stack indicates that long-context competence is being folded into the general-purpose model backbone rather than treated as a narrow benchmark specialization.
summary_en.limits: It is still a preview report, so several important pieces remain underspecified: the exact CSA/HCA mechanics, quality-cost tradeoffs across different context ranges, the standalone contribution of mHC over standard residual designs, and the stability envelope of Muon at this scale. The headline benchmark gains also mix pretraining, post-training, and reasoning-effort effects, so the causal contribution of each component is not yet cleanly isolated.

recommendation.zh: DeepSeek 把百万上下文当作系统级预训练问题来答，而不是推理期 hack：CSA+HCA 混合注意力直接压 FLOPs 和 KV cache，配合 mHC、Muon 与 32T token 预训练，是目前开源侧看长上下文基座最完整的一份作业，值得精读对照 V3.2 看每一项的增量。
recommendation.en: DeepSeek frames the million-token context as a pretraining-systems problem rather than an inference-time hack. The CSA+HCA hybrid attention attacks FLOPs and KV-cache directly, paired with mHC, Muon, and 32T-token pretraining — the most complete open-side blueprint for a long-context base model today, worth reading closely against V3.2 to isolate per-component gains.

paper.title: LLaDA2.0-Uni: Unifying Multimodal Understanding and Generation with Diffusion Large Language Model
paper.abstract: We present LLaDA2.0-Uni, a unified discrete diffusion large language model (dLLM) that supports multimodal understanding and generation within a natively integrated framework. Its architecture combines a fully semantic discrete tokenizer, a MoE-based dLLM backbone, and a diffusion decoder. By discretizing continuous visual inputs via SigLIP-VQ, the model enables block-level masked diffusion for both text and vision inputs within the backbone, while the decoder reconstructs visual tokens into hig

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是统一多模态理解与生成时，离散 diffusion 路线为什么一直不如 AR 或 AR+diffusion 混合路线。作者给出的诊断很具体：现有统一 masked diffusion 模型通常依赖重建型 VQ tokenizer，token 语义性弱，导致理解任务吃亏；同时 VQ 压缩过强又损伤生成质量；再加上完全双向的文本建模在开放式文本生成上不够可靠，很多方法还默认固定输出长度，难以处理真实的问答和推理场景。LLaDA2.0-Uni 的核心问题就是：能不能在一个原生统一的离散 diffusion 框架里，同时把视觉理解、图像生成、图文交错推理都做起来，而且不靠 AR 主干兜底。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义很直接。第一，它是在认真推进“非 AR 统一基座”这条路线，而不是把 diffusion 只当图像解码器。这里的 backbone 本身就是 dLLM，用统一的 block-wise masked diffusion 目标同时建模文本和视觉 token。第二，它把 tokenizer 问题放回了统一建模的中心位置。作者的判断是，过去 unified diffusion 模型表现不佳，不只是 backbone 不够强，更多是离散视觉 token 不够语义化，导致理解和生成两头都受限。第三，它展示了一种更完整的架构分工：语义离散 token 负责统一建模，扩散 decoder 负责高保真重建。这种“语义建模与像素细节解码解耦”的设计，对未来多模态 pretrain 很有参考价值。第四，它还触及一个关键问题：文本是否必须 AR。LLaDA2.0-Uni 的答案不是简单否定 AR，而是通过 prefix-aware 优化和长度处理机制，尽量缓解 masked diffusion 在文本开放生成上的弱点。这对 next-token 范式之外的语言建模研究是实质性推进。
summary.technical_approach:
整套方案由三部分组成：SigLIP-VQ tokenizer、16B MoE dLLM backbone、Diffusion Decoder。

先看 tokenizer。作者没有沿用传统重建导向的 VQ，而是提出 SigLIP-VQ，把连续视觉输入离散成“fully semantic discrete tokens”。这里的关键不是单纯做更好的压缩，而是让 token 更接近语义单元，能被语言式 backbone 直接消费。传统 VQ token 往往偏局部纹理和重建细节，适合生成但不利于理解；如果压缩率再高一些，生成也会受损。SigLIP-VQ 试图在语义保真和离散统一格式之间找到平衡，使视觉 token 既能支持问答推理，又能作为后续图像生成的中间表示。

再看 backbone。LLaDA2.0-Uni 以 LLaDA2.0 的 16B MoE dLLM 为核心，不走 next-token AR，而是对文本和图像 token 统一采用 block-level masked diffusion。这里的 block-wise mask prediction 很重要。它不是逐 token 自回归，也不是完全无结构地全局去噪，而是在块级别进行掩码和恢复，兼顾并行解码效率与上下文建模能力。作者强调 modality-agnostic MoE，说明专家路由不是按模态硬切，而是让文本和视觉 token 在共享 backbone 中竞争专家容量，这对统一表示学习是更激进的设计。

第三部分是 diffusion decoder。由于 backbone 输出的是语义离散视觉 token，而不是可直接还原高保真图像的重建 token，因此需要一个专门 decoder 把这些 token 转成图像。这个 decoder 经过蒸馏后只需 8 步推理，目的是把统一建模和高质量生成拆成两个相对独立的问题：前者由 dLLM 解决，后者由 decoder 解决。相比把所有视觉细节都塞进统一 backbone，这样更符合容量分工，也更容易扩展到高分辨率生成。

训练上，论文提到 carefully curated large-scale data 和 tailored multi-stage pipeline。虽然你给出的正文片段没有完整展开各阶段细节，但从架构逻辑推断，至少包含：语义视觉 tokenizer 训练、统一多模态 dLLM 训练、decoder 蒸馏与对齐，以及理解/生成混合数据的阶段化配比。这里真正值得注意的是目标函数统一：文本和视觉都在 backbone 中用共享的 masked diffusion objective，而不是像很多混合系统那样文本用 AR、图像用 diffusion，再靠 loss balancing 勉强拼接。作者明确把“单一目标”视为训练稳定性和统一性的来源。

推理优化方面，作者做了两件事。其一是 backbone 的 prefix-aware decoding 优化，用来减少 masked diffusion 文本生成时对已知前缀的重复计算和不必要更新。其二是 decoder 的 few-step distillation，把图像重建压到 8 步。这说明他们知道 unified diffusion 的主要质疑之一就是推理成本，因此在系统层面做了补偿，而不是只强调并行解码的理论优势。
summary.experiments:
实验结论分三块：理解、生成、统一能力。理解侧，LLaDA2.0-Uni 在 VQA、文档理解等 benchmark 上达到与专用 VLM 接近的水平，作者点名对比 Qwen2.5-VL 一类强基线，说明它不是只能做生成的“偏科统一模型”。生成侧，模型能做文本到图像生成和图像编辑，并且支持较灵活的 instruction-based editing。论文示例里包括改图中文字、按文本生成高分辨率图像等，说明离散语义 token 加 decoder 的方案没有把生成能力做残。统一能力侧，最有代表性的是 interleaved generation and reasoning：模型可以在同一框架里交替处理文本、图像 token，边理解边生成，这正是统一架构相对双塔或拼接式系统的优势所在。

从摘要和正文片段可确认的硬信息包括：backbone 是 16B MoE dLLM，decoder 蒸馏后 8 步推理，图像生成示例分辨率至少覆盖 768×1024。作者还强调 inference efficiency 超过单纯并行解码，说明 prefix-aware 优化在实际 wall-clock 上有贡献。全文里大概率还包含 tokenizer 对比、decoder 步数蒸馏、固定长度与开放长度生成、以及与 MMaDA、Lumina-DiMOO、Janus、OmniGen2 等统一模型的横向比较。精读时应重点核对几类数字：1）SigLIP-VQ 的码本规模、压缩率、token 数；2）统一训练数据规模与理解/生成数据配比；3）理解 benchmark 上相对专用 VLM 和其他 unified model 的差距；4）生成 benchmark 上 FID/GenEval/编辑指标或人评结果；5）prefix-aware 优化和 8-step decoder 带来的实际延迟收益。

如果这些结果成立，这篇工作的价值不在于某一项任务绝对领先，而在于它证明了离散 diffusion backbone 可以在统一多模态场景里接近甚至部分追平 AR 系路线，而且不是靠牺牲开放式理解能力换来的。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先抓作者的失败诊断，再看他们怎么逐项修补。Introduction 前半段已经把问题讲得很清楚：旧 unified diffusion 模型差，不只是因为 diffusion 不如 AR，而是 tokenizer、压缩率、文本建模方式、输出长度假设都出了问题。带着这四个问题去读方法，会更容易判断每个模块是不是对症。

阅读顺序上，先看整体架构图，确认三段式分工：SigLIP-VQ 负责把视觉变成语义离散 token，dLLM backbone 负责统一建模，diffusion decoder 负责高保真图像恢复。然后重点读 tokenizer 设计和 backbone 的 block-wise masked diffusion。这里最值得深挖的是：为什么“fully semantic” token 能同时服务理解和生成；block-level masking 相比 token-level masking 或完全双向建模，具体解决了什么；MoE 路由是否真的跨模态共享，而不是名义统一。

实验部分优先看三类表：一是 tokenizer/architecture ablation，二是理解与生成主结果，三是推理效率分析。真正有研究价值的问题包括：统一训练是否出现理解和生成互相拉扯；decoder 是否成为新的瓶颈；文本开放生成质量与 AR 基线相比差距还剩多少；interleaved generation 是自然涌现还是靠专门数据模板学出来的。预计精读时间 2 到 3 小时，因为这篇同时涉及 tokenizer、dLLM、MoE、diffusion decoder 和训练 pipeline；如果只想判断路线是否成立，先读架构图、主结果表、tokenizer 消融和效率章节，1 小时左右足够。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a concrete gap in unified multimodal modeling: discrete diffusion systems have so far trailed autoregressive or AR+diffusion hybrids in both coverage and quality. The authors argue that the failure is not due to diffusion alone. Existing unified masked diffusion models usually rely on reconstruction-oriented VQ tokenizers with weak semantics, which hurts understanding; aggressive compression also damages generation quality; fully bidirectional text modeling is unreliable for open-ended language generation; and many systems assume fixed output lengths, which limits real multimodal QA and reasoning. LLaDA2.0-Uni asks whether a natively unified discrete diffusion model can handle multimodal understanding, image generation, and interleaved reasoning without falling back to an AR backbone.
summary_en.importance: This is important for pretraining research for several reasons. First, it pushes the non-AR foundation-model direction seriously, with diffusion used in the backbone itself rather than only as an image decoder. Text and vision are both modeled under a shared block-wise masked diffusion objective. Second, it puts the tokenizer back at the center of unified modeling. The paper’s diagnosis is that earlier unified diffusion models underperformed largely because their discrete visual tokens were not semantic enough, so both understanding and generation suffered. Third, it proposes a clean division of labor: semantic discrete tokens for unified reasoning, and a separate diffusion decoder for high-fidelity image synthesis. That separation between semantic modeling and pixel-level reconstruction is a useful design pattern for future multimodal pretraining. Finally, it directly engages with a key question beyond next-token prediction: whether text must be modeled autoregressively. The answer here is not a naive rejection of AR, but an attempt to make masked diffusion viable for open-ended text through architectural and inference-side fixes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The system has three main components: a SigLIP-VQ tokenizer, a 16B MoE diffusion LLM backbone, and a diffusion decoder.

The tokenizer is central. Instead of a standard reconstruction-driven VQ tokenizer, the paper introduces SigLIP-VQ to convert continuous visual inputs into fully semantic discrete tokens. The goal is not just compression, but semantic usability. Traditional VQ tokens often preserve local texture and reconstruction detail, which can help generation but are weak for understanding; stronger compression then hurts generation as well. SigLIP-VQ is designed to produce discrete visual units that are useful for reasoning while still serving as an intermediate representation for image synthesis.

The backbone is built on LLaDA2.0, a 16B MoE discrete diffusion language model. Rather than next-token prediction, it uses a shared block-level masked diffusion objective over both text and image tokens. The block-wise design matters. It is not token-by-token autoregression, but it is also not an unstructured fully bidirectional denoising process. It aims to balance parallel decoding efficiency with stronger contextual modeling. The paper also emphasizes modality-agnostic MoE routing, suggesting that experts are shared across text and vision instead of being hard-partitioned by modality. That is a stronger form of unification than simply concatenating modalities into one sequence.

The third component is a diffusion decoder. Because the backbone predicts semantic discrete visual tokens rather than reconstruction-ready image codes, a dedicated decoder is needed to turn those tokens into high-fidelity images. This decoder is distilled to run in only 8 inference steps. Architecturally, this is a clean decomposition: the dLLM handles unified semantic modeling, while the decoder handles visual detail synthesis. Compared with forcing the backbone to carry all low-level image detail, this is a more scalable allocation of capacity.

Training is described as a curated large-scale, multi-stage pipeline. The excerpt here does not include all stage details, but the likely structure includes tokenizer training, unified multimodal dLLM training, decoder distillation, and staged mixing of understanding and generation data. The key point is objective unification: both text and vision are optimized in the backbone with the same masked diffusion objective, instead of using AR for text and diffusion for images and then balancing heterogeneous losses.

On inference, the paper adds two practical optimizations. First, prefix-aware decoding reduces redundant updates and recomputation for conditioned generation in the backbone. Second, few-step distillation compresses the decoder to 8 steps. This matters because inference cost is one of the main objections to unified diffusion systems.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical story has three parts: understanding, generation, and unified capability. On understanding benchmarks, LLaDA2.0-Uni is reported to be competitive with specialized VLMs, including strong baselines such as Qwen2.5-VL, which is important because many unified models become generation-heavy and underperform on open-ended visual reasoning. On the generation side, the model supports text-to-image synthesis and instruction-based image editing, with examples such as editing text on a blackboard and generating high-resolution images. This suggests that the semantic-token-plus-decoder design does not collapse generation quality. The most distinctive capability is interleaved generation and reasoning: the model can process and produce text and image tokens within one native framework, which is exactly the kind of behavior unified architectures are supposed to enable.

The hard facts visible from the provided content are that the backbone is a 16B MoE dLLM, the decoder is distilled to 8 steps, and image generation examples include at least 768×1024 resolution. The paper also claims inference gains beyond naive parallel decoding, implying that prefix-aware optimization improves actual wall-clock behavior. The full paper likely contains comparisons against MMaDA, Lumina-DiMOO, Janus, OmniGen2, and other unified systems, along with ablations on tokenizer design, decoder distillation, fixed-length versus open-length generation, and efficiency. The numbers worth checking carefully are: tokenizer codebook size and compression ratio, total multimodal training scale and the understanding/generation data mix, the gap to specialized VLMs on understanding benchmarks, generation metrics or human evaluations, and the latency reduction from prefix-aware decoding plus the 8-step decoder.

If these results hold, the main contribution is not a single best score, but evidence that a discrete diffusion backbone can be a serious unified multimodal foundation-model route rather than a niche alternative to AR.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start from the authors’ failure analysis, then see how each module addresses one failure mode. The introduction already lays out four issues in prior unified diffusion systems: weakly semantic visual tokens, over-compression, unreliable fully bidirectional text modeling, and fixed-length assumptions. Keeping those four points in mind makes the method section much easier to evaluate.

Read the architecture overview first and identify the three-way split: SigLIP-VQ turns images into semantic discrete tokens, the dLLM backbone performs unified modeling, and the diffusion decoder reconstructs high-fidelity images. Then focus on the tokenizer section and the block-wise masked diffusion backbone. The most important technical questions are: why semantic tokens can support both understanding and generation, what block-level masking fixes relative to token-level masking or fully bidirectional denoising, and whether the MoE routing is genuinely shared across modalities rather than only nominally unified.

In the experiments, prioritize three groups of results: tokenizer and architecture ablations, the main understanding/generation benchmark tables, and the inference-efficiency analysis. The most research-relevant questions are whether understanding and generation interfere with each other during joint training, whether the decoder becomes the new bottleneck, how much open-ended text quality still lags AR baselines, and whether interleaved generation is an emergent consequence of the unified objective or mainly learned from templated data. A full careful read will likely take 2–3 hours because the paper spans tokenizer design, MoE dLLM modeling, diffusion decoding, and training pipeline choices. If you only want to judge whether the route is technically credible, the architecture figure, main results, tokenizer ablations, and efficiency section are enough for a solid first pass in about an hour.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接改变你对“统一多模态必须靠AR”的先验；先看 tokenizer 设计、masking 方案和训练分阶段配方，值得尽快做内部复现。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior that native multimodal unification must be AR-based; start with the tokenizer, masking scheme, and staged training recipe, then consider an internal reproduction.

paper.title: Expert Upcycling: Shifting the Compute-Efficient Frontier of Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become the dominant architecture for scaling large language models: frontier models routinely decouple total parameters from per-token computation through sparse expert routing. Scaling laws show that under fixed active computation, model quality scales predictably with total parameters, and MoEs realize this by increasing expert count. However, training large MoEs is expensive, as memory requirements and inter-device communication both scale with total parameter cou

summary.core_problem: 现有MoE大模型训练需要从初始化阶段固定总专家数，低激活比的大参数量MoE训练成本极高：显存需求随总参数线性增长，多机全对全通信占训练时间的45%-50%，且高显存、高通信开销贯穿训练全程，无法在固定推理成本的前提下降低训练成本。
summary.importance: 刷新了MoE预训练的计算效率边界，为大参数量MoE的训练提供新范式，无需从零开始训练大专家数模型即可获得同等质量，可直接应用于工业界千亿/万亿参数MoE的训练流程，同时为MoE持续预训练、模型迭代提供可复用的技术路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出专家升环方法，训练分为两阶段：第一阶段先训练小专家数的MoE模型，到指定迭代步后，通过专家复制和路由层扩展，将模型扩容为m倍专家数的大MoE，保持每Token激活的专家数K固定，因此推理成本不变；新增基于效用的专家选择策略，通过梯度重要性得分指导非均匀复制专家，相比均匀复制进一步提升训练效率；后续持续预训练打破复制专家的对称性，驱动专家分化。与现有方法的区别：不同于稠密模型渐进式训练、MoE宽度扩展方法会增加激活参数抬高推理成本，也不同于稀疏升环将稠密模型转为MoE，本方法在稀疏MoE架构内部扩容，全程保持推理成本不变。
summary.experiments: 7B总参数→13B总参数的实验中，同等质量下节省约32%的GPU训练时长；在所有激活比区间，本方法（MoE→MoE）性能均优于稀疏升环（稠密→MoE），且激活比越低优势越明显；基于效用的非均匀复制相比均匀复制，在持续预训练预算有限的情况下，性能差距闭合速度提升3倍以上；在154M到7B总参数、3%到50%激活比的不同配置下，方法均稳定有效。
summary.reading_guide: 精读第3章专家升环算子设计、第4章基于效用的专家选择策略，重点关注图2的计算效率对比、表1的下游任务性能对比、第5章的消融实验结论。值得深挖的点包括专家复制的最优时机、非均匀复制的效用得分计算逻辑、专家分化的训练动态过程。

summary_en.core_problem: Current MoE LLM training requires fixing the total number of experts from initialization. Training large MoE models with low activation ratios incurs extremely high cost: memory requirement scales linearly with total parameters, all-to-all cross-device communication takes up 45-50% of total training time, and the high memory and communication overhead persists throughout the entire training process, with no way to reduce training cost while keeping inference cost fixed.
summary_en.importance: This work shifts the compute-efficient frontier of MoE pre-training, and provides a new paradigm for training large-parameter MoE models. It achieves comparable model quality without training a large expert-count model from scratch, which can be directly applied to industrial training pipelines for 100B/1T parameter MoEs, and also provides a reusable technical path for MoE continued pre-training and model iteration.
summary_en.technical_approach: Expert upcycling splits MoE training into two phases. The first phase trains a small MoE model with E experts. At a predefined transition step, the model is expanded to m*E experts via expert duplication and router extension, with per-token activated expert count K fixed, so inference cost remains unchanged. A utility-based expert selection strategy is proposed to guide non-uniform expert duplication using gradient-based importance scores, which further improves training efficiency compared to uniform duplication. Subsequent continued pre-training breaks the symmetry of duplicated experts and drives specialization. Different from dense progressive training and MoE width expansion methods that increase activated parameters and raise inference cost, and different from sparse upcycling that converts dense models to MoE, this method expands capacity within sparse MoE architectures while keeping inference cost constant throughout the process.
summary_en.experiments: In 7B total parameter → 13B total parameter experiments, expert upcycling saves ~32% GPU hours while matching the quality of fixed-size from-scratch baseline. Across all activation ratios, expert upcycling (MoE→MoE) consistently outperforms sparse upcycling (dense→MoE), with larger advantage at lower activation ratios. Utility-based non-uniform duplication more than triples the gap closure speed compared to uniform duplication when continued pre-training budget is limited. The method is consistently effective across configurations from 154M to 7B total parameters, and 3% to 50% activation ratios.
summary_en.reading_guide: Close read Section 3 (expert upcycling operator design) and Section 4 (utility-based expert selection strategy). Focus on Figure 2 (compute efficiency comparison), Table 1 (downstream task performance comparison) and ablation results in Section 5. Worth further exploration points include optimal transition timing for expert duplication, utility score calculation logic for non-uniform duplication, and training dynamics of expert specialization after duplication.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你对 MoE 扩容路径的 prior：别只盯着从头训大模型，先看 upcycling 后专家是否真分化；建议优先复现扩容后 loss 曲线和 load balance。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on MoE growth: don’t assume bigger sparse models must be trained from scratch; first check whether duplicated experts truly specialize by inspecting post-expansion loss and load-balance dynamics.

paper.title: Temporally Extended Mixture-of-Experts Models
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts models, now popular for scaling capacity at fixed inference speed, switch experts at nearly every token. Once a model outgrows available GPU memory, this churn can render optimizations like offloading and pre-fetching ineffective. We make the case that the options framework in reinforcement learning is a perfect match to tackle this problem, and argue for temporally extended mixture-of-experts layers. Building on the option-critic framework with deliberation costs, we add a co

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个常被 MoE 论文默认忽略、但在大规模部署里会迅速变成主瓶颈的问题：专家切换过于频繁。标准 token-level routing 几乎每个 token 都可能换一组专家；当专家总量超过 GPU 显存、需要从主存或磁盘按需加载时，这种高频 churn 会让 offloading、prefetch 和 cache 命中率都变差。论文要解决的不是“如何让 MoE 更准”，而是“如何把专家选择从逐 token 的短视决策，改成带时间延续性的资源调度决策”，在尽量保留模型能力的前提下显著降低切换率。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它把 MoE routing 从静态稀疏激活问题，改写成带切换代价的序列决策问题，这个视角是有启发性的，尤其适合未来超大 expert pool、分层存储和 continual expansion 的 MoE。第二，它说明“更多专家”不只受训练算力约束，也受服务时内存带宽和加载延迟约束；如果不把切换成本写进目标函数，MoE 的可扩展性会被系统层面卡住。第三，这篇工作虽然是后训练改造，不是从头预训练，但它给 pretrain 侧提出了一个明确问题：路由器是否应该在训练时就学习 temporal locality，而不是把这个问题留给 serving heuristics。贡献量级偏中等，更像一个新建模接口和系统-算法结合点，而不是已经成熟的通用方案。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把“当前加载的一组专家”视为 option，把“是否继续沿用当前专家集或切换到新专家集”视为 option-critic 框架里的高层决策。论文将动态专家加载形式化为 semi-Markov Decision Process：状态包含当前上下文和已激活专家相关信息；动作不是单个 token 的 expert routing，而是选择一个可持续若干步的 expert mask；option 的终止函数决定何时切换；切换时显式支付 deliberation cost，对应现实中的加载/替换代价。

实现上，作者在每层加入一个轻量 controller。controller 学两件事：一是 termination policy，决定当前 expert set 是否继续；二是 policy over options，决定若切换则换到哪组专家。这样做与标准 MoE 的区别不在于专家本身，而在于把逐 token 独立路由改成“分段常值”的路由过程。为了避免大规模重训，他们在 gpt-oss-20b 上只训练少量 LoRA/adapter 参数和 controller，而主体权重基本保持不动。训练信号采用 option-critic 风格目标，并加入 deliberation penalty；同时用 self-distillation reward 约束输出质量，等于让改造后的模型尽量模仿原模型行为，再在此基础上压低切换频率。

这套设计和已有 serving-side heuristic 的差别很明确。缓存/预取方法是在既定路由分布上做被动优化；专家剪枝是永久减少容量；这篇工作则直接改变路由策略本身，让模型学会在质量收益不足以覆盖切换代价时保持当前专家集。和传统 RL options 的对应也比较自然：option 持续时间越长，temporal coherence 越强，系统越容易做内存管理；但持续过长会损失 token 级适应性，因此 deliberation cost 成了控制精度-切换率折中的主旋钮。
summary.experiments:
实验主体基于 gpt-oss-20b，并通过少量适配参数做后训练。论文先测了几个开源前沿 MoE 的原始切换行为，结论是平均 switch rate 很高，活跃专家集几乎每个 token 都在变；在 gpt-oss-20b 上基线切换率超过 50%，也就是平均每两个 token 左右就切一次。

引入 temporally extended controller 后，切换率可以降到 5% 以下，进一步调大切换惩罚时可接近 1%。性能方面，摘要里给出的主结论是：在 MATH、MMLU 等任务上仍能保留最高约 90% 的 base-model accuracy。这里要注意，作者强调的是可配置 trade-off，而不是“几乎无损”；也就是说，切换率压得越低，能力损失越明显。论文的价值在于证明这个 trade-off 是可学习、可控的，而不是只能靠手工 heuristic。

从消融逻辑看，关键变量应包括 deliberation cost 大小、controller 结构、是否使用 self-distillation、以及不同层是否共享或独立控制。最值得关注的实验洞察不是单点分数，而是曲线形态：随着切换成本上升，switch rate 会快速下降，而任务性能下降相对平缓，说明原始 MoE 路由里存在大量对最终质量贡献有限的高频切换。这一点如果在更大模型、更长上下文和真实 offloading 环境下仍成立，就会很有意义。

不过也要看到边界：实验主要是 post-hoc adaptation，不是从头训练的 temporally aware MoE；评测也更偏任务精度和切换率，没有完整给出端到端 serving latency、host-device traffic、prefetch hit rate 等系统指标。如果目标是判断真实部署收益，这部分证据还不够完整。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和作者对问题的 framing。重点不是 RL 术语，而是为什么 token-level expert churn 会破坏内存优化。接着看把 expert loading 写成 s-MDP 的那一节，理解 option、termination、deliberation cost 分别对应 MoE 里的什么对象。这里是全文最有信息量的部分。

然后直接看实验里关于 switch rate 与 accuracy trade-off 的主图和表。要确认三件事：基线切换率到底多高；惩罚项如何改变切换分布；性能损失是否集中在某些任务。若时间有限，优先看 gpt-oss-20b 主实验和相关消融，预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主要内容。

值得深挖的点有三个。第一，controller 的状态设计是否足够表达跨 token 的语义阶段变化。第二，self-distillation reward 会不会把模型锁死在原路由习惯附近，限制更优的长期策略。第三，如果从预训练阶段就加入切换代价，路由器是否会学出不同的专家分工，而不是仅仅把已有路由平滑化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical weakness of modern MoE LLMs: expert routing changes too often. Standard token-level routing may switch expert sets almost every token. Once the full expert pool no longer fits in GPU memory and experts must be fetched from host memory or disk, this churn destroys the effectiveness of caching, prefetching, and offloading. The goal is not to improve MoE accuracy in the abstract, but to turn expert selection from a myopic per-token decision into a temporally extended resource-allocation policy that preserves most model quality while sharply reducing switching.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mostly conceptual but meaningful. First, it reframes MoE routing as sequential decision-making with an explicit switching cost, rather than sparse activation alone. That is a useful lens for future MoEs with very large expert pools, hierarchical memory, or continual expert growth. Second, it makes clear that scaling expert count is constrained not only by training compute, but also by inference-time memory bandwidth and load latency. If switching cost is absent from the objective, MoE scalability can be bottlenecked by systems effects. Third, although this is a post-training adaptation rather than a full pretraining recipe, it raises a concrete pretraining question: should routers learn temporal locality during training instead of leaving the problem to serving heuristics. The contribution is moderate in scale: more a new algorithm-system interface than a finished general solution.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The key idea is to treat the currently loaded expert set as an option, and to model the decision to keep or replace that set using the option-critic framework. The paper formulates dynamic expert loading as a semi-Markov decision process. The state includes context and routing-related information; the action is not a single-token expert choice but a temporally persistent expert mask; an option termination function decides when to switch; and each switch incurs a deliberation cost that stands in for real loading latency or memory movement.

Implementation-wise, each layer gets a lightweight controller. The controller learns two things: a termination policy that decides whether to continue with the current expert set, and a policy over options that selects a new set when switching happens. This differs from standard MoE routing in that routing becomes piecewise constant over spans of tokens rather than independently recomputed at every step. To avoid full retraining, the authors adapt gpt-oss-20b with only small LoRA/adapter updates plus the controller, while keeping the base model largely fixed. Training uses an option-critic style objective with a deliberation penalty, and a self-distillation reward that encourages the modified model to stay close to the original model’s behavior while learning to switch less often.

This is distinct from prior serving-side heuristics. Caching and prefetching optimize around a fixed routing distribution; expert pruning permanently reduces capacity. Here the routing policy itself is changed so the model learns to keep the current expert set whenever the expected quality gain from switching does not justify the cost. The RL analogy is clean: longer option duration yields stronger temporal coherence and easier memory management, but too much persistence reduces token-level adaptability. The deliberation cost becomes the main knob controlling that trade-off.
summary_en.experiments:
The main experiments are built on gpt-oss-20b with a small amount of adaptation parameters. The paper first measures switching behavior in several frontier open-source MoEs and finds that active expert sets change extremely often, close to every token. On gpt-oss-20b, the baseline switch rate is above 50%, meaning the model changes expert sets roughly every other token.

With the temporally extended controller, the switch rate drops below 5%, and with stronger switching penalties it can approach 1%. On downstream evaluations such as MATH and MMLU, the adapted model retains up to about 90% of the base-model accuracy. That wording matters: the claim is not near-lossless compression of routing dynamics, but a controllable trade-off. The lower the switch rate, the more quality is sacrificed. The main empirical result is that this trade-off is learnable and tunable, rather than something that must be handled by hand-crafted heuristics.

The most important experimental pattern is likely the curve, not any single score: as deliberation cost increases, switching falls rapidly while task performance degrades more gradually. That suggests a substantial fraction of token-level routing changes in standard MoEs contribute little to final quality. If that pattern holds in larger models, longer contexts, and real offloading settings, it would matter a lot.

There are also clear limitations. The work is a post-hoc adaptation, not temporally aware MoE pretraining from scratch. And the evaluation is centered on task accuracy and switch rate, without a full end-to-end serving analysis of latency, host-device traffic, or prefetch hit rate. So the systems payoff is plausible, but not yet fully demonstrated.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the problem framing. The important part is not the RL terminology, but why token-level expert churn breaks memory optimizations once experts spill beyond GPU memory. Then read the section that maps expert loading to an s-MDP. Focus on what counts as an option, what termination means in MoE terms, and how deliberation cost is injected. That is the conceptual center of the paper.

After that, go straight to the main figures and tables showing the switch-rate versus accuracy trade-off. Check three things: how high the baseline churn really is, how the penalty changes routing persistence, and whether quality loss is concentrated on specific tasks. If time is limited, the gpt-oss-20b main experiment plus the core ablations should be enough; around 25–35 minutes should capture the main ideas.

Three points are worth deeper inspection. First, whether the controller state is expressive enough to capture semantic phase changes across tokens. Second, whether self-distillation keeps the model too close to the original routing behavior and limits better long-horizon policies. Third, whether adding switching cost during pretraining would lead to different expert specialization, rather than merely smoothing an already learned router.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会动到一个默认 prior：MoE 不一定要逐 token 抖动路由；先看切换率-精度 tradeoff，如果曲线干净，值得在内部做长序列/offload ablation。
recommendation.en: This challenges a default prior: MoE routing may not need token-level churn; inspect the switch-rate/accuracy tradeoff first, and if the curve is clean, reproduce it under long-context and offloading setups.

summary.core_problem: 这篇试图把前两篇的经验观察收束成一个更清楚的机制命题：为什么 RYS 只在中层有效，以及这种“可重复的中层”是否对应一个语言无关、甚至跨代码与 LaTeX 的共享语义空间。它关心的不是单次 hack，而是 Transformer 内部表示与可编辑性的关系。
summary.key_insights: 最值得记住的是作者把两件事绑在了一起：共享语义空间出现在哪里，层复制就在哪里最可能有效。文章在五个前沿模型上复查三段式结构，并把比较从自然语言扩展到代码和 LaTeX，论点是中层更按语义/主题组织，而不是按表面语言组织；因此复制这些层，相当于增加抽象计算步数，而不是破坏输入解析或输出成形。对基座研究的意义在于，这给“深度的功能分区”“跨模态/跨语言统一表示”“无训练架构手术的边界”提供了一个可操作的观察框架，也和已有 multilingual interpretability 文献形成了较好的对接。
summary.limits: 文章比前两篇成熟，但仍然停留在博客层面的证据整合。它更像对已有 interpretability 结果的工程化利用与再组织，而不是严格的新理论。‘语言无关中层’并不等于真正独立于训练语料和 tokenizer；扩展到代码、LaTeX 的结论也还需要更系统的任务验证，尤其是对生成质量、校准和长程推理稳定性的影响。

summary_en.core_problem: Part III tries to turn the earlier observations into a sharper mechanistic claim: RYS works specifically in the middle because that is where a language-agnostic semantic space lives, and that space may extend beyond natural language into code and LaTeX-like symbolic forms.
summary_en.key_insights: The strongest idea here is the alignment between representation geometry and model surgery: the layers that can be duplicated profitably are the same layers where surface-form differences collapse and semantic structure dominates. The author revisits the three-phase anatomy across five frontier models, including MoEs, and argues that middle layers are organized more by meaning than by language. For pretraining work, this is useful because it links multilingual representation sharing, functional depth specialization, and zero-training architectural edits under one concrete hypothesis.
summary_en.limits: Even in this more careful version, the evidence remains blog-grade rather than publication-grade. Much of the conceptual framing is an engineering synthesis of prior multilingual interpretability results plus new probing. The broader claims still need stronger controls, wider replication, and clearer evidence that the effect survives beyond the chosen models and probes.

paper.title: StoSignSGD: Unbiased Structural Stochasticity Fixes SignSGD for Training Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Sign-based optimization algorithms, such as SignSGD, have garnered significant attention for their remarkable performance in distributed learning and training large foundation models. Despite their empirical superiority, SignSGD is known to diverge on non-smooth objectives, which are ubiquitous in modern machine learning due to ReLUs, max-pools, and mixture-of-experts. To overcome this fundamental limitation, we propose \textbf{StoSignSGD}, an algorithm that injects structural stochasticity into

summary.core_problem: SignSGD 在非光滑目标（现代网络里很常见，如 ReLU、max、MoE gating）上可能发散，根因是 sign 压缩带来的系统性偏置；论文要解决的是：在保留“只传 1-bit 符号、数值更稳”的前提下，构造一个在理论上可收敛、在 LLM 低精度训练中也能稳定工作的 sign 类优化器。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接意义在于“训练稳定性 + 通信/数值约束下的可用优化器”。它把 sign-based 方法从经验可用推进到：在凸/非凸（含非光滑）下给出更强的收敛保证，并且在 FP8 等容易让 AdamW 早期崩溃的设置里给出可复现的 token 级效率收益。对大规模预训练而言，这类方法的价值不在于替代 AdamW 的默认地位，而在于：当训练被通信带宽、optimizer state 内存、低精度数值范围卡住时，提供一个更“工程可落地”的备选路径。
summary.technical_approach:
核心做法是把确定性的 sign(gt) 换成“带结构化随机性”的随机 sign 算子，使更新在期望意义下无偏（unbiased）。论文的描述是：随机性会随优化轨迹自适应，依赖对“历史最大梯度”的跟踪，从而让 StoSignSGD 在期望上更像一个带预条件的 SGD，而单步通信仍然是每维 1 bit。

从机制上看，它试图同时满足三件事：
1) 仍然输出 ±1 的符号更新（保留通信压缩与低精度鲁棒性）；
2) 通过随机化让 E[update | gt] 对齐某个“合理的梯度步”（消掉 SignSGD 的偏置来源）；
3) 随着训练进展，随机化的尺度/分布能适配不同坐标的梯度尺度（用历史最大值做归一/界定），避免把随机性做成固定噪声导致收敛变慢。

理论部分分两块：
- 在线/凸优化：证明修复了 SignSGD 在非光滑凸目标上的不收敛，并给出达到下界的 sharp rate。
- 非凸：用更“几何友好”的 stationary measure（允许任意范数）来刻画收敛复杂度，并声称复杂度不显式依赖维度 d，相比既有结果提升一个 d√d 的量级。

此外给了一个“unbiased sign conversion framework”，把标准优化器映射到其无偏 sign 版本，用来统一解释 StoSignSGD 的必要组件，并支撑后面的消融。
summary.experiments:
实验重点放在两类场景：
1) FP8 低精度预训练：AdamW 在早期训练容易数值不稳定甚至直接 divergence；sign-based 方法更稳。StoSignSGD 在此基础上进一步提高 token 效率：达到同等 validation loss 所需 token 数减少 30%–53%，对应 1.44×–2.14× 的“训练进度加速”（以 token 计）。
2) 7B 级别 LLM 数学推理微调：相对基线 sign/优化器方案，准确率提升 3%–5%（论文表述为 consistent non-trivial improvement）。

论文还做了围绕“结构化随机性是否必要”的消融：用 sign conversion 框架拆解组件，验证仅做朴素随机化或仅做 sign 压缩不足以同时拿到稳定性与效率（具体对照与数值需要结合正文表格/附录逐项核对）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议按“先机制、再证据”走：
- 先看方法定义：随机 sign 算子如何构造、历史最大梯度如何进入分布参数、为何能保证无偏（通常是全文最关键的 1–2 个公式与推导）。
- 再看理论主结论：凸非光滑下的收敛定理与下界匹配点；非凸部分的 stationary measure 定义（为什么要换度量/范数）以及“去维度依赖”的关键不等式在哪里。
- 最后看 LLM 实验：重点核对 FP8 预训练的设置（模型规模、batch/seq、loss 曲线、失败模式定义）、token 节省的统计口径；以及 7B 微调的任务与评测细节。

预计阅读时间：30–45 分钟可抓住方法与主要结论；若要复现或迁移到自家训练栈，需要额外精读算法伪代码、实现细节与消融表格。

summary_en.core_problem: SignSGD can diverge on non-smooth objectives (common in modern nets via ReLU, max ops, MoE gating) because the deterministic sign operator introduces bias. The paper targets a sign-based optimizer that keeps 1-bit communication and low-precision robustness while restoring convergence guarantees and practical stability for LLM training under FP8-like constraints.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining, the contribution is mainly about stability and efficiency when the training stack is constrained by bandwidth, optimizer-state memory, or low-precision numerics where AdamW may fail early. The work narrows the gap between empirical “sign methods sometimes work” and a more principled, theoretically supported alternative, and it reports token-level efficiency gains in FP8 pretraining plus consistent improvements in 7B-scale finetuning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
StoSignSGD replaces the deterministic sign(g) with a stochastic, structurally designed sign operator whose update is unbiased in expectation. The randomness is not i.i.d. noise; it is adapted along the trajectory using a tracked maximum of historical gradients, so that in expectation the method behaves like a preconditioned SGD step while still emitting ±1 per coordinate (preserving 1-bit communication and numerical robustness).

The theory is presented in two regimes:
- Online/convex optimization: the stochastic sign construction fixes the known non-convergence of SignSGD on non-smooth convex problems and achieves a sharp rate matching the lower bound.
- Non-convex optimization: the paper introduces refined stationarity measures that work under arbitrary norms (to better match problem geometry) and derives a sharp complexity bound claimed to avoid explicit dependence on dimension d, improving prior results by a factor on the order of d√d.

A complementary “unbiased sign conversion” framework is proposed to transform a standard optimizer into an unbiased sign-based counterpart, used to interpret StoSignSGD and to structure ablations around which ingredients are essential.
summary_en.experiments:
Two main empirical settings are emphasized:
- FP8 low-precision pretraining where AdamW can catastrophically diverge early. StoSignSGD reaches the same validation loss with 30%–53% fewer tokens than competitive baselines, reported as a 1.44×–2.14× token-efficiency speedup.
- 7B-scale LLM finetuning for mathematical reasoning, showing a consistent 3%–5% accuracy gain over baselines.

The paper also includes ablations motivated by the sign-conversion view to isolate the role of the proposed structural stochasticity versus simpler sign/randomization variants (exact table-by-table numbers require checking the main text/appendix).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim path:
1) Method section: the exact stochastic sign definition, how the historical max-gradient tracker parameterizes the randomness, and the short argument for unbiasedness.
2) Main theorems: the convex non-smooth convergence result (and where it matches the lower bound), then the non-convex stationarity notion under arbitrary norms and the step that removes explicit d dependence.
3) LLM evidence: FP8 setup details (model/config, what “AdamW fails” means operationally, token-efficiency measurement) and the 7B math finetuning protocol.

Time budget: ~30–45 minutes for the core idea + headline results; longer if you need implementation-level confidence.

recommendation.zh: 这篇别当成“LLM optimizer 已定型”的信号，更像是在修 SignSGD 的理论硬伤；先看定理设定和非光滑 stationary measure，若你在做低比特优化或 MoE 训练，这个 prior 值得更新。
recommendation.en: Do not read this as a ready-made LLM optimizer win; it is mainly a repair of SignSGD’s theoretical failure mode. Check the theorem setup and the non-smooth stationarity notion—worth updating your prior if you care about low-bit optimization or MoE training.

paper.title: Breaking the Training Barrier of Billion-Parameter Universal Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
paper.abstract: Universal Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials (uMLIPs), pre-trained on massively diverse datasets encompassing inorganic materials and organic molecules across the entire periodic table, serve as foundational models for quantum-accurate physical simulations. However, uMLIP training requires second-order derivatives, which lack corresponding parallel training frameworks; moreover, scaling to the billion-parameter regime causes explosive growth in computation and communication overhead, making

summary.core_problem: 解决十亿参数级通用机器学习原子势（uMLIP）训练中二阶导数、通信开销和并行效率导致的训练瓶颈。
summary.importance: 这不是 LLM 论文，但它碰到的是真正的大规模训练系统问题：二阶导训练、MoE 扩展、跨超算并行和硬件感知优化。对做基座训练系统的人有旁路参考价值，贡献类型偏工程系统突破。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 MatRIS-MoE，一个建立在不变性架构上的十亿参数 MoE 原子势模型；同时提出 Janus 分布式训练框架，针对高维二阶导训练做并行化和硬件感知优化，目标是把原本难以扩展的 uMLIP 训练搬到 exascale 超算上稳定运行。
summary.experiments: 论文在两台 Exascale 超算上部署，报告单精度峰值 1.2/1.0 EFLOPS，达到理论峰值的 24%/35.5%，并保持 90% 以上并行效率，显著压缩十亿参数 uMLIP 的训练时间。摘要未给出与其他分布式框架的细粒度 ablation，也没有直接可迁移到 LLM 的 loss/throughput trade-off 分析。
summary.authors_note: 从摘要可确认这是面向材料/分子模拟基础模型训练的系统与模型联合工作，但无法仅凭给定信息可靠确认作者机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the training bottleneck of billion-parameter universal machine-learning interatomic potentials, where second-order derivatives, communication overhead, and poor parallel scaling make training extremely difficult.
summary_en.importance: This is not an LLM paper, but it tackles real large-scale training-system issues: second-order training, MoE scaling, cross-supercomputer parallelism, and hardware-aware optimization. It has side-channel value for researchers building foundation-model training systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce MatRIS-MoE, a billion-parameter MoE interatomic-potential model built on an invariant architecture, together with Janus, a distributed training framework optimized for high-dimensional second-order-derivative workloads. The core idea is to make a previously hard-to-scale training regime practical on exascale systems.
summary_en.experiments: The system is deployed on two exascale supercomputers, reaching 1.2/1.0 EFLOPS peak FP32 performance, 24%/35.5% of theoretical peak, and over 90% parallel efficiency, substantially shortening training time for billion-parameter uMLIPs. The abstract does not provide the kind of clean ablations or loss/throughput trade-off analysis that would directly transfer to LLM training.
summary_en.authors_note: The abstract clearly positions this as a joint model-and-system effort for materials/molecular foundation models, but the author affiliations cannot be reliably confirmed from the provided information alone.

recommendation.zh: 不是 LLM，但二阶导训练和超算并行这套系统账很少有人认真算；若你在做大规模训练栈，只看 Janus 的并行设计和效率数字即可。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but few works seriously quantify second-order training at exascale; if you build large-scale training stacks, read only the Janus system design and efficiency numbers.

paper.title: Qwen3.5-Omni Technical Report
paper.abstract: In this work, we present Qwen3.5-Omni, the latest advancement in the Qwen-Omni model family. Representing a significant evolution over its predecessor, Qwen3.5-Omni scales to hundreds of billions of parameters and supports a 256k context length. By leveraging a massive dataset comprising heterogeneous text-vision pairs and over 100 million hours of audio-visual content, the model demonstrates robust omni-modality capabilities. Qwen3.5-Omni-plus achieves SOTA results across 215 audio and audio-vi

summary.core_problem: 如何把“全模态理解 + 全模态生成 + 实时交互 + 工具调用”的能力做成一个可扩展、可部署的统一基座：既要在超长上下文（256k）下稳定处理长音频/长视频，又要在语音流式生成中做到低延迟、可控、不断句崩坏，同时还要尽量不牺牲同规模纯文本/视觉模型的通用能力。
summary.importance:
这篇报告的价值不在单点指标，而在把 omni 模态系统工程里最难的几件事打通并给出可复用的设计范式：
1) 训练与架构层面：把 Thinker–Talker 拆分继续推进，并把 MoE 引入到理解与生成两侧，给“多模态 + 语音生成”提供了更清晰的容量/成本分配方式。
2) 长上下文层面：明确把长音频、低帧率长视频映射到 256k token 统一上下文，并用时间戳显式建模时序，属于可迁移的长序列多模态建模套路。
3) 实时语音交互层面：围绕 codec 表示、单帧合成、流式对齐（ARIA）做了系统化改造，目标是把语音从“离线 TTS”推到“端到端对话式流式生成”。
对做预训练/持续学习的人来说，关键启发是：多模态基座的瓶颈越来越像“训练分配与表示选择”问题（token 化、时序对齐、MoE 路由与负载、长上下文稳定性），而不是单纯堆数据或堆模块。
summary.technical_approach:
整体是延续 Qwen2.5-Omni 的 Thinker–Talker 两阶段：Thinker 负责跨模态理解与推理并产出文本/中间语义；Talker 负责条件语音生成与流式交互。

1) Hybrid-Attention MoE（Thinker 与 Talker 双侧）：报告强调两侧都采用混合注意力的 MoE 设计，用来在“多模态理解/推理”和“语音生成”之间做容量拆分，同时把推理成本压到可部署。这里的关键不是 MoE 本身，而是把 MoE 放到 Talker（生成侧）并与流式解码耦合，属于更偏系统的取舍：用专家容量换取语音自然度/鲁棒性，同时保持延迟可控。

2) 256k 长上下文的统一序列化：视觉与音频分别经 Vision Encoder 与 AuT（音频侧编码器）进入 Thinker；音频与视频 token 交错（interleave）进入同一上下文，并插入显式时间戳 token 来增强长时序感知。取舍点在于：不走“分塔后期融合”的路线，而是尽量早地把多模态变成同一序列问题，便于复用长上下文训练与注意力机制。

3) 面向实时语音的表示与解码：语音侧采用 RVQ（残差向量量化）codec 表示，并进一步引入 multi-codebook，使得 Talker 可以做到单帧、即时合成（降低首包延迟）。这类设计的核心是把语音生成从“高维连续回归”改成“离散 token 预测”，从而更像语言建模，可与 LLM 解码框架统一。

4) ARIA：流式解码时动态对齐文本单元与语音单元。报告给出的动机很明确：流式场景下文本与语音的节奏不一致会导致断句、重复、吞字或情绪/语速控制失效。ARIA 通过在解码过程中做动态对齐，提升自然度与鲁棒性。这里的关键取舍是：不依赖外部强制对齐器或复杂后处理，而是在生成过程中把对齐作为模型内机制处理。

5) 流式输入 + 流式输出的端到端：Thinker 采用 chunk-wise 流式处理输入；Talker 采用 streaming 设计输出语音，并支持 turn-taking（语义打断/轮次意图识别）、音量/语速/情绪控制、以及基于样本的 voice cloning。报告还强调“native omni agent”：能自主 WebSearch、FunctionCall，并出现 Audio-Visual Vibe Coding（从音视频指令直接生成可执行代码）。从预训练角度看，这意味着其数据与后训练里显式包含了工具调用轨迹与交互式监督，而不是把 agent 作为外部编排层。
summary.experiments:
报告给出的关键信息点主要是规模与覆盖面，而非逐项可复现细节：
- 规模：模型扩展到“数千亿参数级”；上下文长度 256k。
- 数据：异构 text-vision 对 + 超过 1 亿小时音视频内容；语音识别覆盖 113 种语言/方言，语音合成覆盖 36 种语言。
- 长输入能力：支持超过 10 小时音频，或 1 FPS 下超过 400 秒的 720P 音视频内容进入上下文。
- 评测：覆盖 215 个音频与音视频理解/推理/交互子任务与基准；Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus 在多项音频任务上超过 Gemini-3.1 Pro，综合音视频理解达到同一水平。

从“全文深读”角度，建议重点关注其对流式交互与长上下文的定性/定量对比（例如是否给出延迟、首包时间、流式稳定性、以及 ARIA 的消融）。当前提供的正文片段里，具体数字（如各 benchmark 的分数、MoE 激活参数、吞吐/延迟）尚未展开，完整报告里这些表格与消融会决定其工程可迁移性。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议按三条线走：
1) 架构线：先看 Figure 2（Thinker–Talker + Hybrid-Attention MoE）以及与 Qwen3-Omni 的差异描述，搞清楚 MoE 放在两侧分别解决什么瓶颈（容量、延迟、稳定性）。
2) 长上下文线：重点看“音频/视频交错 + 时间戳 token + 256k 训练策略”的章节与相关消融（是否比较了无时间戳、不同帧率/分块策略、不同上下文长度的退化曲线）。
3) 实时语音线：把 RVQ multi-codebook 与 ARIA 放在一起读，关注两点：首包延迟如何被单帧合成改善；流式对齐如何减少重复/吞字/断句，以及在打断、语速/情绪控制下是否稳定。
如果时间有限：先读架构与语音流式两章，再回头看数据配比与多语种覆盖的训练细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to build a scalable, deployable omni-modal foundation model that unifies (1) multi-modal understanding and reasoning, (2) speech generation, (3) real-time streaming interaction, and (4) native tool use—while remaining stable under 256k long context for hours-long audio/video inputs and avoiding regression on text/vision capabilities compared to same-scale unimodal counterparts.
summary_en.importance:
The report is most useful as an engineering blueprint for omni-modal pretraining rather than a single benchmark story. Key takeaways for foundation-model researchers:
- Capacity/cost allocation: extending Thinker–Talker and putting MoE on both the understanding side and the speech-generation side is a concrete pattern for separating “reasoning capacity” from “low-latency generation capacity”.
- Long-context multimodalization: interleaving audio/video tokens into one sequence with explicit timestamp tokens is a pragmatic way to turn long-horizon multimodal perception into a standard long-context modeling problem.
- Streaming speech as token modeling: codec-based discrete speech units + streaming alignment (ARIA) pushes speech generation closer to LLM-style decoding, which matters for unified training and serving.
Overall, the work shifts the bottleneck from “add another modality encoder” to “representation + alignment + routing + long-context stability”, which is where many omni-modal systems fail in practice.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Qwen3.5-Omni continues the Thinker–Talker split: Thinker performs multimodal perception/reasoning and produces textual/semantic outputs; Talker generates speech conditioned on multimodal context and Thinker outputs, optimized for streaming.

1) Hybrid-Attention MoE on both Thinker and Talker: the central design choice is not MoE per se, but using MoE to scale capacity while keeping inference efficient, and explicitly applying it to the speech-generation stack (Talker), where latency and robustness constraints are tighter.

2) Unified 256k long-context modeling: visual inputs go through a vision encoder; audio goes through AuT. Audio and video tokens are interleaved into a single context, with explicit timestamp tokens to improve temporal grounding—especially important for long audio/video. This favors early unification over late fusion, enabling reuse of long-context training recipes.

3) Speech representation for low latency: RVQ codec tokens with a multi-codebook design enable single-frame, immediate synthesis, reducing time-to-first-audio and making speech generation a discrete-token prediction problem compatible with LLM decoding.

4) ARIA for streaming alignment: a decoding-time mechanism that dynamically aligns text units and speech units during streaming generation, targeting common streaming failures (repetitions, dropped content, awkward segmentation) without relying on heavy external alignment/post-processing.

5) End-to-end streaming I/O and agentic behaviors: chunk-wise streaming ingestion in Thinker plus streaming Talker output; built-in turn-taking/semantic interruption, controllable prosody (volume/speed/emotion), and voice cloning. The report also frames the model as a “native omni agent” with WebSearch and FunctionCall, implying training/finetuning includes tool-use trajectories rather than external orchestration only.
summary_en.experiments:
What the report emphasizes (from the provided full-content excerpt) is scale and coverage:
- Scale: “hundreds of billions” parameters; 256k context.
- Data: heterogeneous text–vision pairs plus 100M+ hours of audio-visual content; ASR for 113 languages/dialects; TTS for 36 languages.
- Long-input support: 10+ hours of audio, or 400+ seconds of 720p audio-video at 1 FPS within context.
- Evaluation: 215 audio and audio-visual subtasks/benchmarks; Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus reported to outperform Gemini-3.1 Pro on key audio tasks and match it on overall audio-visual understanding.

For a research-grade read, the decisive parts are the detailed tables and ablations (MoE routing/active params, latency/throughput, ARIA ablation, long-context degradation curves). Those specifics are not present in the excerpt, so they should be verified in the full PDF sections on evaluation and ablations.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Deep-read in three passes:
1) Architecture: start with the main architecture figure (Thinker–Talker + Hybrid-Attention MoE) and the delta vs prior Qwen-Omni versions; identify what is moved to MoE and why.
2) Long-context multimodalization: focus on token interleaving + timestamp tokens + any training/ablation on context length, chunking, and frame rate.
3) Streaming speech: read RVQ multi-codebook and ARIA together; look for concrete latency metrics (time-to-first-audio), streaming stability evaluations, and interruption/prosody-control robustness.
If time-boxed: prioritize the streaming speech chapter and the ablation tables; they contain the most transferable implementation details.

recommendation.zh: 这是该读的技术报告：先盯数据配比、Hybrid Attention 和 Thinker/Talker 分工，榜单可略过；若细节给得足，应立刻对照内部多模态 recipe 做差分复盘。
recommendation.en: This is the kind of technical report worth reading: focus on data mixture, Hybrid Attention, and the Thinker/Talker split, not the leaderboard; if the details are exposed, compare it directly against your internal multimodal recipe.

paper.title: Nemotron 3 Super: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning

summary.core_problem: 在“在线低延迟部署约束”下，把MoE的accuracy-per-FLOP优势真正转化为accuracy-per-parameter/带宽/通信友好的实际效率，并同时兼顾长上下文与agentic推理：提出并验证一种硬件-软件协同的稀疏MoE（LatentMoE）+ Mamba/Attention混合骨干 + MTP原生推测解码的端到端预训练与后训练配方，且在极低精度NVFP4下稳定完成25T token预训练。
summary.importance:
对基座预训练研究的价值是“系统级可复现配方+架构取舍原则”的量级贡献：
- MoE设计从只看FLOPs转向同时优化参数/带宽/路由通信（accuracy per parameter & per FLOP），给出了面向serving的MoE结构原则；
- 证明NVFP4可稳定大规模预训练（25T tokens）并产出强base模型，为低精度预训练的可行边界提供了强证据；
- 把MTP（多token预测）作为预训练结构组件，与推测解码原生耦合，属于“训练-推理协同”的重要方向；
- 作为公开模型/数据/GenRM/RL环境的技术报告，对后续研究者做scaling、数据配比、低精度训练、MoE系统优化都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 总体架构：120.6B总参、每token激活12.7B（不含embedding为12.1B）的MoE；骨干为周期性交织的Hybrid Mamba-Attention（继承Nemotron-3 Nano思路），在吞吐上利用Mamba类线性时间模块，在关键层保留Attention以维持建模能力。

2) LatentMoE（核心创新之一）：从硬件-软件共设计出发重新审视MoE。
- 论文明确区分两种瓶颈：
  a) 低延迟在线推理：主要受“读取专家权重”的内存带宽限制（专家矩阵大小 d×m）；
  b) 吞吐导向分布式推理：主要受all-to-all路由通信限制（路由体积 d×K）。
- 关键设计原则：在不牺牲质量的前提下，保持有效非线性预算 K·m 不变，同时尽量降低d（hidden dim）以缓解带宽与通信；但d不能无限降，受任务有效特征秩 r_eff 下界约束。
- LatentMoE据此在结构上做了不同于“传统FFN专家堆叠”的改造（报告中称其同时提升accuracy/parameter与accuracy/FLOP），目标是把“稀疏带来的理论省算”落到“实际省带宽、省通信、省显存”的可部署效率上。

3) MTP（Multi-Token Prediction）：在预训练中加入多token预测层，使模型天然支持speculative decoding（原生推测解码）以加速生成；同时作者声称MTP还能提升整体模型质量（通常来自更强的训练信号/更好的表示学习）。

4) 低精度预训练：首次在Nemotron 3家族中使用NVFP4完成预训练，强调稳定性与精度保持；并提供NVFP4/FP8/BF16等形态的开源权重。

5) 数据与训练阶段：25T tokens两阶段配比：
- Phase 1：20T（80%）强调多样性与覆盖；
- Phase 2：5T（20%）强调高质量与benchmark对齐。
这是一种典型的“先广覆盖后高质量收敛”的数据scaling策略。

6) 长上下文：最终模型支持最高1M context（报告称final model supports up to 1M context length），属于长上下文扩展的工程化落地。

7) 后训练：SFT + RL，且显著扩大agentic RL环境与数据，采用大规模异步RL基础设施提升鲁棒性；并开源GenRM（Qwen3-Nemotron-235B-A22B-GenRM-2603）与面向代码/逻辑/经济学/选择题等的合成数据集。
summary.experiments:
从你提供的全文内容中可抽取的关键量化信息：
- 模型规模：120.6B total / 12.7B active（12.1B excl. embeddings）。
- 预训练token：25T（20T+5T两阶段）。
- 上下文：最高支持1M。
- 吞吐对比（8k输入/64k输出设定）：相对GPT-OSS-120B最高2.2×吞吐；相对Qwen3.5-122B最高7.5×吞吐。
- Base模型对比：报告宣称base显著优于同量级公开base（GLM-4.5-Air-Base、Ling-flash-Base-2.0）在“综合benchmark套件”上，但你给的片段未包含具体benchmark表格与分数。

缺失但应在全文后续章节出现、且对预训练研究最关键的实验信息包括：LatentMoE相对标准MoE的等FLOP/等参数对比、MTP对质量与推测解码速度的消融、NVFP4 vs FP8/BF16的收敛曲线与最终精度差、长上下文扩展方法与困惑度/长文任务指标。若你补充§2/§3/§4的实验表格页，我可以把这些数字逐项抽取并给出更细的训练动态解读。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议（建议按“预训练研究价值密度”排序）：
1) §2.1.1 LatentMoE：这是全文最值得深挖的部分。重点看作者如何从带宽/通信建模推导出“保持K·m、降低d”的原则，以及LatentMoE具体结构如何实现更高accuracy/parameter与accuracy/FLOP；同时关注其与常见MoE（Switch/GShard/DeepSeekMoE等）在路由、专家形状、激活K、分片策略上的差异。
2) §2.1.2 MTP：关注训练时如何做多token预测（head设计、loss权重、预测步数）、对困惑度/下游的增益，以及与推测解码的耦合方式（为什么称native speculative decoding）。
3) §2 数据与两阶段配比：看数据组成、质量过滤、第二阶段“对齐benchmark”的具体策略（是否包含合成/代码比例提升/去重强度变化），这对数据scaling很有参考。
4) NVFP4训练稳定性：看loss曲线、溢出处理、量化策略、optimizer与缩放因子细节；这是低精度预训练可复现的关键。
5) 长上下文到1M：看位置编码/注意力改造/训练课程（curriculum）与评测。
6) §3 RL基础设施与环境扩展：如果你关心RL pretrain/持续学习，重点看异步RL如何做稳定性（off-policy程度、reward model/GenRM、采样与更新比）。

核心创新集中在：LatentMoE的serving约束驱动结构设计 + MTP训练-推理协同 + NVFP4大规模稳定预训练。
summary.authors_note: NVIDIA（Nemotron / NeMo团队）。作者名单在你提供的片段中未出现，无法基于当前内容逐一确认。

summary_en.core_problem: Turning MoE’s theoretical compute efficiency into practical serving efficiency under real latency/bandwidth/communication constraints, while also supporting long-context and agentic reasoning. The paper proposes and validates an end-to-end recipe—LatentMoE (hardware–software co-designed sparse MoE) + hybrid Mamba/Attention backbone + MTP for native speculative decoding—trained stably in NVFP4 over 25T tokens.
summary_en.importance:
High impact as a systems-and-pretraining technical report rather than a single isolated trick:
- Reframes MoE efficiency from accuracy-per-FLOP to also optimizing accuracy-per-parameter (proxying memory footprint, bandwidth, routing/sharding overhead), which is crucial for deployable foundation models.
- Demonstrates large-scale NVFP4 pretraining stability at 25T tokens, strengthening the evidence that ultra-low-precision pretraining can produce competitive base models.
- Treats MTP as a pretraining-time architectural component tightly coupled with inference-time speculative decoding (training–inference co-design).
- Releases models, recipes, RL environments, and a GenRM, making it a strong reference point for scaling, data staging, low-precision training, and MoE deployment-aware design.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Architecture and training stack:
1) Model: 120.6B total parameters with 12.7B active per token (12.1B excluding embeddings). Backbone is a periodic interleaving of Mamba-style sequence modules and attention layers, aiming to improve throughput while preserving modeling capacity.
2) LatentMoE: derived from a hardware–software co-design analysis.
- For low-latency serving, MoE is often memory-bandwidth bound by reading expert weights (expert matrix size d×m).
- For throughput-oriented distributed serving, MoE is often communication bound by all-to-all routing (routing volume d×K).
- To preserve quality, keep the effective nonlinearity budget K·m; reduce d where possible, but d is lower-bounded by an effective feature rank r_eff.
LatentMoE implements a structural variant of MoE intended to improve both accuracy/FLOP and accuracy/parameter in practice (not just on paper).
3) MTP (Multi-Token Prediction): adds multi-token prediction layers during pretraining to enable “native” speculative decoding and reportedly improve model quality.
4) Pretraining precision: NVFP4 end-to-end pretraining (first in Nemotron 3 family), with released checkpoints in NVFP4/FP8/BF16.
5) Data scaling: 25T tokens in two phases—20T (diversity/coverage) then 5T (higher-quality, benchmark-focused).
6) Long context: final model supports up to 1M context.
7) Post-training: SFT + RL with expanded agentic environments and large-scale asynchronous RL infrastructure; releases a GenRM and multiple synthetic datasets targeting code/algorithms/logic/econ/MCQ.
summary_en.experiments:
Quantitative details available from the provided full text:
- Size: 120.6B total / 12.7B active (12.1B excl. embeddings).
- Pretraining: 25T tokens (20T + 5T staged).
- Context: up to 1M.
- Throughput (8k input / 64k output): up to 2.2× vs GPT-OSS-120B and up to 7.5× vs Qwen3.5-122B.
- Base model quality: claimed to outperform comparable public base models (GLM-4.5-Air-Base, Ling-flash-Base-2.0) on a broad benchmark suite, but the excerpt does not include the actual tables/scores.

Key missing (likely in later sections) but essential for deep pretraining analysis: controlled LatentMoE vs standard MoE comparisons (iso-FLOP/iso-param), MTP ablations (quality vs speed), NVFP4 vs FP8/BF16 convergence/accuracy deltas, and the exact long-context extension method and metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Deep-read priorities:
1) LatentMoE section (§2.1.1): focus on the bandwidth/communication cost model, the derived design rules (keep K·m, reduce d subject to r_eff), and the concrete architectural differences vs common MoEs (routing, expert shapes, sharding implications).
2) MTP section (§2.1.2): how multi-token prediction is implemented (loss, heads, horizon), how it improves quality, and how it enables native speculative decoding.
3) Data staging (20T+5T): composition, filtering, and what “benchmark-focused” means in practice—high value for data scaling decisions.
4) NVFP4 training details: stability mechanisms, optimizer/scaling, and any reported accuracy gaps.
5) Long-context to 1M: positional/attention changes and training curriculum.
6) RL infrastructure: if you care about RL-pretrain/agentic scaling, examine the asynchronous RL design and environment breadth.

Core novelty is concentrated in: deployability-driven MoE design (LatentMoE) + training–inference co-design via MTP + large-scale NVFP4 pretraining.
summary_en.authors_note: NVIDIA (Nemotron / NeMo team). Individual author names are not present in the provided excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 把“MoE算力省”落到带宽/路由通信/低精度可训的端到端配方，直接改我对serving导向MoE取舍的prior；建议立刻按其NVFP4+LatentMoE+MTP做内部复现实验。
recommendation.en: This is one of the rare MoE reports that actually optimizes for bandwidth/routing comms and low-precision trainability, not just FLOPs—strong enough to change my serving-first MoE priors; I’d immediately replicate their NVFP4 + LatentMoE + MTP recipe internally.

paper.title: SpecMoE: A Fast and Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Inference via Self-Assisted Speculative Decoding

summary.core_problem: 解决MoE推理部署中的高显存/带宽开销与吞吐受限问题，尤其在内存受限与CPU-offload场景下实现更高效的MoE推理。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为推理系统创新：将speculative decoding引入MoE推理且无需额外训练/微调，面向部署痛点（显存、内存/互连带宽）给出可落地加速方案；对MoE大模型工程与高效推理有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SpecMoE：基于“self-assisted speculative decoding”的MoE推理框架，在不训练额外draft模型/不微调的前提下进行推测解码以减少昂贵MoE计算与数据搬运；系统层面优化内存与互连带宽占用，适配内存受限平台与较大batch推理。
summary.experiments: 报告吞吐最高提升约4.30×，并显著降低内存与互连带宽需求；摘要未给出具体MoE模型规模、硬件配置、对比系统（如CPU-offloaded MoE基线）与不同batch/序列长度下的细分结果（需看正文）。

summary_en.core_problem: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference is often bottlenecked by high memory/bandwidth costs and limited throughput, particularly under memory-constrained deployment and CPU-offload settings.
summary_en.importance: The paper introduces a practical inference-system technique that brings speculative decoding to MoE without extra training, targeting real deployment pain points (GPU memory, host-device/interconnect bandwidth) to accelerate MoE serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpecMoE uses self-assisted speculative decoding to reduce expensive MoE computation and data movement without training a separate draft model or fine-tuning; it additionally incorporates system optimizations to lower memory and interconnect bandwidth usage and to support larger-batch inference on constrained platforms.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports up to about 4.30× throughput improvement and substantial reductions in memory and interconnect bandwidth demand, but omits detailed model sizes, hardware configurations, baselines, and breakdowns across batch/sequence regimes.

recommendation.zh: 把 speculative decoding 套到 MoE 推理且不改训练，适合当部署技巧备查；重点看在 CPU-offload/带宽受限下是否真能稳住收益。
recommendation.en: A practical deployment trick: speculative decoding for MoE without retraining; keep it as a reference and focus on whether gains persist under CPU-offload / bandwidth-bound settings.
